152831.name: Adventure Time
152831.overview: Young Finn and his shape-shifting dog buddy, Jake, go on a series of surreal adventures as they journey through the postapocalyptic Land of Ooo.

similar.name: My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic

0-1.title: Adventure Time (Pilot)
0-1.overview: Princess Bubblegum is imprisoned by the Ice King. Jake and Finn battle their way past the Iceclops, Snow Golem, and other monsters that inhabit the Ice Kingdom to rescue her.

0-2.title: The Wand
0-2.overview: Finn and Jake come across a magic wand, but when the wand becomes uncontrollable, they must team up with the Ice King to stop it.

0-3.title: How an Idea Becomes Adventure Time
0-3.overview: Pen Ward, Adam Muto and Kent Osborne discuss their experiences working on Adventure Time.

0-4.title: All's Well That Rats Swell
0-4.overview: BMO discovers a rogue rat in the tree house's flour and attempts to drive off the creature.

0-5.title: Have You Seen the Muffin Mess
0-5.overview: Jake and Finn assist Princess Bubblegum in attempting to stop a muffin-based plague.

0-6.title: Sow, Do You Like Them Apples
0-6.overview: Ice King and Marceline are hungry for a snack.

0-7.title: The Gift That Reaps Giving
0-7.overview: Death tries to make a mixtape for his girlfriend, Life.

0-8.title: Good Jubies: The Making of Bad Jubies
0-8.overview: A behind-the-scenes look at the making of Season 7, Episode 20 "Bad Jubies".

0-9.title: Frog Seasons: Spring
0-9.overview: Finn and Jake are compelled to follow a frog carrying a crown.

0-10.title: Frog Seasons: Summer
0-10.overview: Finn and Jake are in for a surprise when they force the hand of fate.

0-11.title: Frog Seasons: Autumn
0-11.overview: Finn and Jake discover the power held by the crown.

0-12.title: Frog Seasons: Winter
0-12.overview: Finn and Jake follow the frog into the Ice Kingdom. Will they finally bear witness to the purpose of the crown?

0-13.title: Frog Seasons: Spring (Again)
0-13.overview: Finn and Jake come full circle in their pursuit of frog royalty.

0-14.title: Diamonds and Lemons
0-14.overview: Finn and his friends experience setbacks and creative triumphs in a fantastic new vision of Ooo.

0-15.title: Final Voice Session
0-15.overview: This episode features scenes from the Adventure Time series finale! Come along with us for Willow Smith's rendition of the finale theme, plus an exclusive look at the final voice session for Adventure Time. Highlights include John DiMaggio (Jake the Dog), Jeremy Shada (Finn the Human) and Olivia Olson (Marceline the Vampire Queen) reflecting on their experiences with the show, plus the voice session itself featuring the legendary Tom Kenny (Ice King).

0-16.title: Adventure Time Forever
0-16.overview: This a fun behind-the-scenes featurette that looks back on the creation and continuing popularity of the show. Several members of the crew discuss the production's early difficulties, finding the series' tone, the growing fandom, and the show's unique appeal to all ages.

0-17.title: Distant Bands: The Music of Adventure Time
0-17.overview: Pendleton Ward, Jesse Moynihan, Rebecca Sugar, and Patrick McHale talk about the role of music and creating songs for the animated series "Adventure Time".

1-1.title: Slumber Party Panic
1-1.overview: Finn and Princess Bubblegum must protect the Candy Kingdom from a horde of candy zombies they accidentally created.

1-2.title: Trouble in Lumpy Space
1-2.overview: Finn must travel to Lumpy Space to find a cure that will save Jake, who was accidentally bitten by Lumpy Space Princess at a tea party.

1-3.title: Prisoners of Love
1-3.overview: When the Ice King kidnaps a number of princesses he sees as potential brides, Finn and Jake team with the prisoners to set everybody free.

1-4.title: Tree Trunks
1-4.overview: Finn and Jake join Tree Trunks in search for the rare Crystal Gem Apple, but question whether Tree Trunks has what it takes to adventure.

1-5.title: The Enchiridion!
1-5.overview: Finn and Jake go on a quest for a magical book that would prove them worthy of being righteous heroes.

1-6.title: The Jiggler
1-6.overview: A jiggly creature attracted by Finn's auto-tuned singing follows Finn and Jake home but soon feels ill effects of separation from its family.

1-7.title: Ricardio the Heart Guy
1-7.overview: When a Heart Guy named Ricardio comes to Candy Kingdom, Finn gets really jealous and finds a way to get him out of the Land of Ooo.

1-8.title: Business Time
1-8.overview: When Finn and Jake discover a group of businessmen frozen in an iceberg, the duo thaws them and hires them to help with their adventures.

1-9.title: My Two Favorite People
1-9.overview: Jake's plan to spend time with both Lady Rainicorn and Finn backfires.

1-10.title: Memories of Boom Boom Mountain
1-10.overview: Finn reflects on an upsetting experience in his past and pledges to help everyone in town, but this proves more difficult than imagined.

1-11.title: Wizard
1-11.overview: Finn and Jake temporarily get magic powers from an evil wizard, but are tricked into helping stop a comet.

1-12.title: Evicted!
1-12.overview: Finn and Jake search the land of Ooo for a new home after Marceline claims the duo's treehouse as her own.

1-13.title: City of Thieves
1-13.overview: Finn and Jake go off to face a thief king who has been stealing from little girls.

1-14.title: The Witch's Garden
1-14.overview: Finn and Jake consider breaking up after a witch strips Jake of his powers.

1-15.title: What Is Life?
1-15.overview: Finn brings a pie-throwing robot to life, but the machine begins to long for a more fulfilling existence.

1-16.title: Ocean of Fear
1-16.overview: Finn struggles to overcome his fear of the ocean.

1-17.title: When Wedding Bells Thaw
1-17.overview: The Ice King gets married but not before he convinces Finn and Jake to throw him a manlorette party.

1-18.title: Dungeon
1-18.overview: Finn's headstrong decision to explore a dungeon in defiance of Jake's warnings leads to a dangerous escapade.

1-19.title: The Duke
1-19.overview: Finn must tell the truth when he accidentally turns Princess Bubblegum bald and green and blames the Duke of Nuts.

1-20.title: Freak City
1-20.overview: After being transformed into a foot, Finn joins forces with a band of misfits to make things right.

1-21.title: Donny
1-21.overview: Finn and Jake try to help an obnoxious grass ogre named Donny develop better social skills, only to find out Donny's jerky behavior protects the house people from the why-wolves, which eat the house people.

1-22.title: Henchman
1-22.overview: After seeing Marceline the vampire queen torment an elderly henchman, Finn steps in to be her new henchman, doing whatever he is told to do.

1-23.title: Rainy Day Daydream
1-23.overview: Stuck inside the treehouse due to a knife storm, Finn and Jake use their imagination to pass the time.

1-24.title: What Have You Done?
1-24.overview: Finn and Jake capture the Ice King as their prisoner, but feel guilty when unable to explain the wrongs he committed.

1-25.title: His Hero
1-25.overview: The great warrior Billy inspires Finn and Jake to practice nonviolence, but the duo finds it difficult to resist old ways.

1-26.title: Gut Grinder
1-26.overview: When the Fluffy People's gold has been devoured by a culprit only known as "The Gut Grinder", Finn and Jake team up to find him with his tracks.

2-1.title: It Came from the Nightosphere
2-1.overview: Marceline's evil father goes on a soul-sucking rampage after Finn and Marceline accidentally release him from the Nightosphere.

2-2.title: The Eyes
2-2.overview: Finn and Jake try to rid themselves of a weird horse that creeps them out.

2-3.title: Loyalty to the King
2-3.overview: Finn and Jake are excited to meet the Nice King who has come to Ooo. They soon realize that he looks suspiciously like someone else they know; the Ice King.

2-4.title: Blood Under the Skin
2-4.overview: When Finn gets a splinter on his finger, he wants to get the best armor. In order to receive it, he must go on a quest to get the Magical Armor of Zelderon and survive one embarrassing situation after another.

2-5.title: Storytelling
2-5.overview: Jake is sick and demands to hear a good story full of romance, fighting and suspense.

2-6.title: Slow Love
2-6.overview: Finn and Jake agree to help a snail named Snorlock find a girlfriend.

2-7.title: Power Animal
2-7.overview: Finn is captured by gnomes who want to use his energy to power their infernal machines, and it's up to Jake to stay focused and rescue him.

2-8.title: Crystals Have Power
2-8.overview: Jake takes a pledge of nonviolence just before Finn is kidnapped by outlaws from the crystalline dimension.

2-9.title: The Other Tarts
2-9.overview: Finn choses to cross the Desert of Doom to deliver the royal tarts to the annual back rubbing ceremony.

2-10.title: To Cut a Woman's Hair
2-10.overview: A tree witch demands a lock of princess hair or else Jake will be sucked into her bottomless bottom.

2-11.title: The Chamber of Frozen Blades
2-11.overview: Whilst the Ice King goes out to take Gunther to the hospital, Finn and Jake decide to sneak inside his lair and flex their ninja skills.

2-12.title: Her Parents
2-12.overview: Jake's relationship with Lady Rainicorn is in danger when he promises to meet with her parents, as both species had a long history of war with each other. However, thanks to Jake's shape-shifting powers, they mistake the dog as one of their own, but for how long?

2-13.title: The Pods
2-13.overview: Finn and Jake discover a box containing three beans. Planting them causes three pods to grow. Two of them are good and one is evil, but which is which?

2-14.title: The Silent King
2-14.overview: After defeating a evil king of goblins, Finn finds himself crowned as their new king. Unfortunately, he's unable to do anything for them due to the rules of the previous king including defending the goblins from the previous king.

2-15.title: The Real You
2-15.overview: Finn has to give a speech at Princess Bubblegum's science barbecue and seeks a quick fix to make himself smarter.

2-16.title: Guardians of Sunshine
2-16.overview: Finn and Jake get sucked into one of BMO's games and they have to defeat all three of his bosses.

2-17.title: Death in Bloom
2-17.overview: After killing Princess Bubblegum's plant when left to take care of it, Finn and Jake make a trip to the Land of the Dead in order to get it's soul back.

2-18.title: Susan Strong
2-18.overview: Finn is excited to discover what appears to be a tribe of humans living underground near the Candy Kingdom, but gets more than he expected when he tries to teach one of them about the surface world.

2-19.title: Mystery Train
2-19.overview: Wanting to surprise Finn on his birthday, Jake takes Finn on a train, where they get wrapped up in a murder mystery.

2-20.title: Go with Me
2-20.overview: Marceline and Jake give Finn advice so he can ask Princess Bubblegum to see a movie with him.

2-21.title: Belly of the Beast
2-21.overview: In order to cure the stomach ache of a giant, Finn and Jake must break up a party happening in his belly.

2-22.title: The Limit
2-22.overview: On a mission to save soldiers of the Hot Dog Princess, Finn and Jake go inside a massive maze where wishes can be granted and where Jake's stretching powers are pushed to their limits.

2-23.title: Video Makers
2-23.overview: After discovering government warnings prior to movies for their film club, Finn and Jake decide to make their own, but get into a fight over the direction of their film.

2-24.title: Mortal Folly
2-24.overview: When the Lich is accidentally freed from its amber prison in Princess Bubblegum's Castle, Finn and Jake must head forth to stop it from regaining its full power, all while being pestered by the Ice King to give him their blessing to marry Princess Bubblegum.

2-25.title: Mortal Recoil
2-25.overview: Princess Bubblegum recovers from being dropped in the Well of Power by the Ice King; however, she is altered and her condition leads to an unlikely final showdown with one of the greatest evils in order to save all life in Ooo.

2-26.title: Heat Signature
2-26.overview: Marceline plays a prank on Finn and Jake by making them believe they're vampires, but it goes too far and escalates when they're manipulated by her ghost friends.

3-1.title: Conquest of Cuteness
3-1.overview: Finn and Jake must defend their home from the Cuties, a tiny race who believe themselves to be evil, destructive invaders.

3-2.title: Morituri te Salutamus
3-2.overview: The duo choose to partake in gladiatorial combat against the Fight King's ghost warriors, but Finn succumbs to bloodlust while Jake becomes obsessed in keeping a cool morale.

3-3.title: Memory of a Memory
3-3.overview: Finn and Jake enter Marceline's mind to awaken her from a sleep spell she had cast on herself, without knowing that they are being tricked by a person from her past.

3-4.title: Hitman
3-4.overview: The grounded Ice King hires a fire-manipulating hitman to attack Finn and Jake, without realizing the potentially deadly consequences.

3-5.title: Too Young
3-5.overview: The Earl of Lemongrab takes over the Candy Kingdom due to Princess Bubblegum's age regression, forcing her and Finn to try and get rid of him even if it means a life-altering decision.

3-6.title: The Monster
3-6.overview: The king and queen of Lumpy Space ask Finn and Jake to bring their daughter back home. At the same time, they attempt to stop a "monster" from destroying a village.

3-7.title: Still
3-7.overview: Finn and Jake are literally unable to move and are at the mercy of the Ice King.

3-8.title: Wizard Battle
3-8.overview: Finn and Jake enter a competition for wizards in disguise so they can prevent Ice King from winning the grand prize: a kiss from Princess Bubblegum.

3-9.title: Fionna and Cake
3-9.overview: In this gender-swapped episode, Fionna and Cake must battle the evil Ice Queen.

3-10.title: What Was Missing
3-10.overview: Finn and his friends must come together as a genuine band in order to open the gate of the Door Lord and get back their taken items.

3-11.title: Apple Thief
3-11.overview: When Tree Trunks's apples go missing, she, Finn and Jake descend into the dark side of the Candy Kingdom in order to find the thief.

3-12.title: The Creeps
3-12.overview: Finn and Jake receive an invitation to a masquerade dinner. It turns into a whodunit as guests start to meet their demise.

3-13.title: From Bad to Worse
3-13.overview: When another plague of Candy Zombies arises and Princess Bubblegum is among the undead, Finn and his friends are in a race against time to figure out how to stop it...without making things even worse!

3-14.title: Beautopia
3-14.overview: Susan Strong asks Finn and Jake to help fight off the Glub Glubs in the sewers below to regain her people's home in Beautopia.

3-15.title: No One Can Hear You
3-15.overview: Finn awakens after an accident to find the Candy Kingdom citizens mysteriously gone and Jake acting crazier than usual.

3-16.title: Jake vs. Me-Mow
3-16.overview: Finn and Jake take on a request to protect Wildberry Princess from an unknown assassin. The assassin turns out to be a tiny cat assassin called Me-Mow, who ends up bribing Jake by poisoning him.

3-17.title: Thank You
3-17.overview: The Snow Golem visits the Fire Kingdom and finds an unlikely follower.

3-18.title: The New Frontier
3-18.overview: Jake dreams about his death, and Finn takes action when events from the dream start to come true.

3-19.title: Holly Jolly Secrets (1)
3-19.overview: Finn and Jake find the Ice King's video diary and have a chance to unearth his secrets.

3-20.title: Holly Jolly Secrets (2)
3-20.overview: The Ice King summons an army of snowmen to recover the secret tapes Finn and Jake are watching. They must work against the clock to find out the secrets enclosed within.

3-21.title: Marceline's Closet
3-21.overview: Finn and Jake play Cloud Hunt in Marceline's house, but they get trapped in her closet after she comes home.

3-22.title: Paper Pete
3-22.overview: Library books seek help from Finn and Jake to save them from the evil Moldari.

3-23.title: Another Way
3-23.overview: Cyclops tears may heal Finn and Jake's broken toes.

3-24.title: Ghost Princess
3-24.overview: Finn and Jake play detective and try to solve Ghost Princess' murder.

3-25.title: Dad's Dungeon
3-25.overview: Jake's dad presents a strange challenge to the guys when he appears to them in a holographic message, telling them about a dungeon he made for them.

3-26.title: Incendium
3-26.overview: Jake embarks on a solo mission to help a broken-hearted Finn.

4-1.title: Hot to the Touch
4-1.overview: Finn develops a crush on Flame Princess and tries to get to know her, which proves difficult due to her destructive power.

4-2.title: Five Short Graybles
4-2.overview: Follow as 5 stories intertwine together, can you find the connection?

4-3.title: Web Weirdos
4-3.overview: When Finn gets trapped in a giant spider web, he ends up playing marriage counselor to a couple of grumpy arachnids.

4-4.title: Dream of Love
4-4.overview: Tree Trunks is courted by an oinking suitor, but much to Jake’s dismay, this interferes with her baking habits.

4-5.title: Return to the Nightosphere
4-5.overview: Marceline’s dad banishes Finn and Jake to the Nightosphere, and it stinks. Literally.

4-6.title: Daddy's Little Monster
4-6.overview: Finn and Jake attempt to rescue Marceline and find out what's making her behave so strangely.

4-7.title: In Your Footsteps
4-7.overview: A bear cozies up to the guys, but his true intentions may be hidden.

4-8.title: Hug Wolf
4-8.overview: Finn goes through a transformation after a run-in with a hug wolf.

4-9.title: Princess Monster Wife
4-9.overview: Princesses lose body parts under mysterious circumstances.

4-10.title: Goliad
4-10.overview: Battling with her new realization of her own mortality, in a sleep deprived state Princess bubblegum creates her own heir to the throne. After meeting the heir, Finn and Jake decide to teach her the ways of the world.

4-11.title: Beyond This Earthly Realm
4-11.overview: When Finn finds a porcelain lamb, it transports him into the spirit world and only the Ice King can help get him out.

4-12.title: Gotcha!
4-12.overview: In order to do research for her tell-all memoir about men, Lumpy Space Princess goes undercover working for Finn and Jake.

4-13.title: Princess Cookie
4-13.overview: Finn and Jake are called to solve a Candy Kingdom hostage crisis when a rogue cookie takes over.

4-14.title: Card Wars
4-14.overview: Finn and Jake play Card Quest, an epic game.

4-15.title: Sons of Mars
4-15.overview:
Magic man has most of his power taken from him by his brother, in a fit of desperation, he swaps the way Jake and Himself look.

Magic Mans brother takes Jake to Mars for punishment,

4-16.title: Burning Low
4-16.overview: Princess Bubblegum may be jealous when Finn start hanging out with Flame Princess.

4-17.title: BMO Noire
4-17.overview: BMO tries to find Finn's sock.

4-18.title: King Worm
4-18.overview: Finn has a vivid dream that may be more than it seems.

4-19.title: Lady & Peebles
4-19.overview: Princess Bubblegum and Lady Rainicorn look for Finn and Jake, who are missing after a run-in with the Ice King.

4-20.title: You Made Me!
4-20.overview: When a creepy sleep-peeping Lemongrab upsets Princess Bubblegum with his creepy ways, Finn and Jake need to tend to some issues in the Outer Realm.

4-21.title: Who Would Win?
4-21.overview: The guys challenge a monster to a fight but end up battling each other.

4-22.title: Ignition Point
4-22.overview: Finn and Jake sneak into the Fire Kingdom to retrieve Fire Princess' scented candles and overhear a plot to assassinate the king.

4-23.title: The Hard Easy
4-23.overview: Frog People seek protection from an evil lizard who's attacking their swamp.

4-24.title: Reign of Gunters
4-24.overview: The Gunters cause chaos in Ooo.

4-25.title: I Remember You
4-25.overview: The Ice King and Marceline bond over song and memories.

4-26.title: The Lich
4-26.overview: A visit from the Lich King sheds light on Ooo's secrets.

5-1.title: Finn the Human
5-1.overview: Part 2 of a three-part episode. Finn and Jake chase the Lich through a dimensional portal and meet a wishmaster. After the Lich wishes that humanity never existed, Finn wishes that the Lich never existed.

5-2.title: Jake the Dog
5-2.overview: Part 3 of a three-part episode. Finn and Jake chase the Lich through a dimensional portal and meet a wishmaster. After the Lich wishes that humanity never existed, Finn wishes that the Lich never existed.

5-3.title: Five More Short Graybles
5-3.overview: A series of short stories all centered around a common theme, hosted by a mysterious man named Cuber from the future.

5-4.title: Up a Tree
5-4.overview: The guys' game of catch goes awry when their throwing disc is lodged in a large tree.

5-5.title: All the Little People
5-5.overview: Finn receives a bag full of miniature versions of his friends.

5-6.title: Jake the Dad
5-6.overview: Jake's a daddy, but being a father and keeping his rainicorn pups from killing themselves or each other is a lot harder than he imagined.

5-7.title: Davey
5-7.overview: Finn creates an alter ego, Davey. Davey soon begins to take over, and Jake is forced into action to get his old friend back.

5-8.title: Mystery Dungeon
5-8.overview: Ice King, NEPTR, Tree Trunks, Shelby, and Lemongrab are trapped inside a mysterious dungeon and must work together to free themselves.

5-9.title: All Your Fault
5-9.overview: Princess Bubblegum sends Finn and Jake to investigate a message of distress from the Earls of Lemongrab.

5-10.title: Little Dude
5-10.overview: Finn's hat comes to life and becomes evil after it is touched by a wizard. Finn, Jake, and the wizard track the hat down, and manage to turn the hat good.

5-11.title: Bad Little Boy
5-11.overview: The princesses tire of Ice King’s crazy Fionna-and-Cake fan-fiction stories, so Marceline stops by the Ice Kingdom to show him how to properly write a story.

5-12.title: Vault of Bones
5-12.overview: When Flame Princess begins to doubt her evilness, Finn insists she is not evil and takes her on a journey into a dungeon to help her sort out her thoughts.

5-13.title: The Great Bird Man
5-13.overview: Xergiok, the former Goblin king who was deposed by Finn and Jake claims to have turned over a new leaf.

5-14.title: Simon & Marcy
5-14.overview: A look at what Ice King and Marceline were like 996 years ago.

5-15.title: A Glitch Is a Glitch
5-15.overview: The Ice King creates a computer virus that will delete everyone in Ooo except for him and Princess Bubblegum. Finn and Jake hack into the universal source code to destroy the virus.

5-16.title: Puhoy
5-16.overview: While dwelling on a joke he told to Flame Princess, Finn finds himself trapped in a strange pillow world.

5-17.title: BMO Lost
5-17.overview: BMO makes his way home after being snatched by an eagle. On its way, BMO meets Bubble and a baby, and the three decide to journey home together.

5-18.title: Princess Potluck
5-18.overview: Ice King gets super jealous when he finds out that he wasn't invited to the Princess Potluck.

5-19.title: James Baxter the Horse
5-19.overview: Finn and Jake stumble across a horse named James Baxter who has the ability to make sad people feel better.

5-20.title: Shh!
5-20.overview: Finn and Jake make a bet to see who can not talk the longest, and the two use signs to communicate.

5-21.title: The Suitor
5-21.overview: Peppermint Butler thinks that Bubblegum is working too hard in her lab, so he tries to get her a suitor.

5-22.title: The Party's Over, Isla de Señorita
5-22.overview: After another one of his schemes fails, the Ice King decides to give up.

5-23.title: One Last Job
5-23.overview: Jake Jr. gets involved with a group of troublemakers, and Jake is forced to reunite his old gang—which includes Tiffany who first appeared in the first season episode "My Two Favorite People"—to rescue his daughter.

5-24.title: Another Five More Short Graybles
5-24.overview: A series of short stories with a common theme, hosted by a mysterious man named Cuber from the future. In this entry, Finn and Jake build a time machine. Meanwhile, Princess Bubblegum helps Cinnamon Bun overcome his fear of the dark.

5-25.title: Candy Streets
5-25.overview: Lumpy Space Princess is robbed, but before she is able to explain the details to Finn and Jake, she faints.

5-26.title: Wizards Only, Fools
5-26.overview: After Starchy comes down with a cold and needs a magic cure, Finn, Jake, and Princess Bubblegum disguise themselves as wizards and sneak into Wizard City.

5-27.title: Jake Suit
5-27.overview: Jake gets upset with the amount of times that Finn uses his body as a suit of armor, so he convinces Finn to trade places with him.

5-28.title: Be More
5-28.overview: BMO accidentally deletes his core system files. Finn and Jake disguise themselves as MOs to infiltrate the MO factory and save BMO from a memory wipe.

5-29.title: Sky Witch
5-29.overview: Marceline tracks the Sky Witch, but finds out that she may need Princess Bubblegum's help.

5-30.title: Frost & Fire
5-30.overview: Flame Princess and the Ice King fight each other, prompting Finn to have an interesting dream.

5-31.title: Too Old
5-31.overview: Finn, Jake and Princess Bubblegum discover a talented mutant named Lemonhope at The Pageant of Mutants. Now they must find a way to free him from the lemongrabs.

5-32.title: Earth & Water
5-32.overview: Princess Bubblegum subjects Flame Princess to a series of tests to gauge Flame Princess' fiery tendencies. But when there's an emergency at the treehouse, and Princess Bubblegum leaves Cinnamon Bun to watch Flame Princess, her experiment might literally backfire in her face.

5-33.title: Time Sandwich
5-33.overview: Jake crafts the most delicious sandwich ever, but when Magic Man steals it, Finn must defy the laws of space and time to win back Jake's creation.

5-34.title: The Vault
5-34.overview: When Finn starts sleepwalking and dreaming about the Green Lady he filed away in his memory vault, Jake and BMO help him tap into his repressed memories to uncover a secret past. Who is the Green Lady? And how is she connected to Finn?

5-35.title: Love Games
5-35.overview: Slime Princess needs a husband or else she'll lose the Slime Kingdom to her obnoxious sis. Finn steps in to save the day, but first they will need to win a series of Love Games to prove to Slime Princess's dad that they are really in love. This is definitely not what Finn signed up for!

5-36.title: Dungeon Train
5-36.overview: All aboard! Finn and Jake discover a train where every car is a dungeon filled with a new foe for Finn to fight. Jake quickly gets bored and wants to leave, but Finn is having the best time and doesn't want to leave... ever!

5-37.title: Box Prince
5-37.overview: Finn meets the Box Prince—a cat with a box on its back—and learns that the Box Kingdom has been taken over by an imposter. Finn must therefore help the real Box Prince reclaim the throne.

5-38.title: Red Starved
5-38.overview: Finn, Jake and Marceline are trapped in an underground cavern with no red in sight. If Marceline doesn't feed, like ASAP, she will turn into a vampiric beast and suck out all of Jake's blood! So, Finn heads off to explore the cave and find something red to satiate her until they can be rescued. But time is running out!

5-39.title: We Fixed a Truck
5-39.overview: Finn finds an old truck, and Jake calls Banana Man to help with the repairs. But when BMO stays up all night working on the truck, he hears on a spooky radio talk show that Princess Bubblegum is a reptilian replicant. Is it just another one of Starchy's crazy conspiracy theories, or a fact?

5-40.title: Play Date
5-40.overview: Sick and tired of babysitting Ice King while the Ice Kingdom is being rebuilt, Finn and Jake call up an old friend to hang out with their annoying houseguest: Abracadaniel.

5-41.title: The Pit
5-41.overview: Finn needs Lady Rainicorn's help to rescue Jake when he is kidnapped by Kee-Oth the Blood Demon.

5-42.title: James
5-42.overview: Finn, Jake, and Princess Bubblegum are attacked by nasty goo monsters in the Desert of Wonders.

5-43.title: Root Beer Guy
5-43.overview: Root Beer Guy works a boring job during the day and tries to write mystery stories at night. But his life is about to change when he witnesses Finn and Jake kidnapping Princess Bubblegum! There's only one problem: no one believes Root Beer Guy...

5-44.title: Apple Wedding
5-44.overview: Tree Trunks and Mr. Pig are celebrating the wedding of the year.

5-45.title: Blade of Grass

267440.name: Attack on Titan
267440.overview: 100 years ago, the last remnants of humanity were forced to retreat behind the towering walls of a fortified city to escape the massive, man-eating Titans that roamed the land outside their fortress. Only the members of the Scouting Legion dared to stray beyond the safety of the walls – but even those brave warriors seldom returned alive. Those within the city clung to the illusion of a peaceful existence until the day that dream was shattered, and their slim chance at survival was reduced to one horrifying choice: kill – or be devoured!

1-4.overview: Two years pass and the time for the recruits' graduation approaches. Annie proves her skill in a sparring session, Jean dreams of serving alongside the King, and graduation day brings shocking revelations — along with the sudden appearance of an old foe.

1-5.title: First Battle: The Struggle for Trost (1)
1-5.overview: Five years have passed since the fall of Wall Maria and Eren faces off against the Colossal Titan after it appears out of nowhere once again, and knocks a strategic hole in the gate of Wall Rose. As Titans swarm the city, the newly graduated Cadets are called in to fight a brutal battle that won't be without casualties.

1-6.title: The World the Girl Saw: The Struggle for Trost (2)
1-6.overview: Armin tries to cope with the loss of his friends and allies after Titans massacre his squad. Elsewhere in the city, Mikasa manages to take out several of the monsters, which brings back tragic memories of her past and the first time she met Eren.

1-7.title: Small Blade: The Struggle for Trost (3)
1-7.overview: After the retreat bell sounds, many cadets find themselves without enough fuel to scale the wall back to safety. Mikasa begins to lose hope once she hears of the deaths in Armin's squad, but the appearance of a new type of Titan stokes her will to fight.

1-8.title: I Can Hear His Heartbeat: The Struggle for Trost (4)
1-8.overview: Armin comes up with a risky plan that pits Titan against Titan as the abandoned cadets attempt to take back their headquarters. Getting into the building might be possible, but getting out alive and refueled will mean facing more of the giants.

1-9.title: Whereabouts of His Left Arm: The Struggle for Trost (5)
1-9.overview: A miraculous return is met with anger and fear. Cannons are fixed on Eren as he struggles to remember what happened to him inside the belly of a Titan and how he ended up as humankind's enemy. One question is all that matters: is Eren human or Titan?

1-10.title: Response: The Struggle for Trost (6)
1-10.overview: Cadets respond to Eren's terrifying transformation with doubt and fear as he struggles to understand it himself. If Armin can’t talk the commander into using Eren’s newfound powers for the good of humankind, all hope of stopping the Titans might be lost.

1-11.title: Idol: The Struggle for Trost (7)
1-11.overview: Plans are made to use Eren's Titan powers to seal the hole in the wall in an attempt reclaim Trost. But with the government's bloodstained history and vocal dissenters in the military ranks, the biggest threat to humankind may not be the Titans.

1-12.title: Wound: The Struggle for Trost (8)
1-12.overview: The plan to reclaim Trost falls apart when Eren's newfound powers turn him into a mindless giant. As Titans continue to swarm the city, it's up to Armin and Mikasa to make sure the cadets massacred during the mission haven't died in vain.

1-13.title: Primal Desire: The Struggle for Trost (9)
1-13.overview: Jean takes desperate measures to replace his broken Maneuver Gear. Meanwhile, Eren is able to seal the hole in the wall thanks to the help of his fellow cadets, but the cost of humanity's first victory against the Titans will be enormous.

1-14.title: Can't Look into His Eyes Yet: Eve of the Counterattack (1)
1-14.overview: A special military tribunal will decide Eren's fate. The Military Police calls for his execution while the Recon Corps argues that he is a powerful resource for humankind, and Mikasa is put on the spot when asked about the events of the Trost mission.

1-15.title: Special Operations Squad: Eve of the Counterattack (2)
1-15.overview: The Recon Corps moves Eren to an old abandoned castle where he will continue his training. Hange visits and reveals that she's been putting two captured Titans through a series of tests and trials — experiments that she wants Eren's help with.

1-16.title: What Needs to Be Done Now: Eve of the Counterattack (3)
1-16.overview: Everyone is a suspect in the investigation to find out who killed the two test-subject Titans. Meanwhile, the cadets pick which military branch they'll be joining, but after the harrowing events in the Trost attack, many are uncertain which branch to choose.

1-17.title: Female Titan: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (1)
1-17.overview: As the Recon Corps begins its push toward Shiganshina, they encounter an intelligent Female Titan unlike any they've seen before. When Armin hypothesizes that it's really a human that's been turned into a Titan, he, Jean, and Reiner attempt to stop it.

1-18.title: Forest of Giant Trees: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (2)
1-18.overview: As the Female Titan continues to tear its way through the Recon Corps, Levi makes a bold decision to split the ranks and send Eren and the supply wagons through a huge forest. Is his strategy genius, or does it spell certain death for the scouts?

1-19.title: Bite: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (3)
1-19.overview: With the Female Titan still chasing after Levi's squad, Eren considers turning himself into his Titan form, but Levi tells him to choose to be either a monster or a member of the Recon Corps. As Eren remembers what he has learned from the squad, he realizes that the danger and sacrifice they all share is not what binds them — it is trust. Now it is up to Eren to make the decision of who he will trust.

1-20.title: Erwin Smith: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (4)
1-20.overview: With the help of Levi's squad, the Recon Corps has successfully captured the Female Titan. As Commander Erwin and Captain Levi begin preparations to extract whoever is inside the Titan, will the Recon Corps discover its true identity, or does the Female Titan have one last trick up its sleeve?

1-21.title: Crushing Blow: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (5)
1-21.overview: After a last act of desperation, the person inside the Female Titan has escaped from the Recon Corps and reverted to their human form. Now, disguised as a member of the Recon Corps and equipped with Maneuver Gear, they finally catch up to their prey — Levi's squad.

1-22.title: The Defeated: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (6)
1-22.overview: The Female Titan has captured Eren after ripping him out of his Titan body, but Mikasa and Captain Levi give chase. Elsewhere, the Recon Corps begins preparations for the journey back home to the Wall with their numerous dead in tow.

1-23.title: Smile: Assault on Stohess (1)
1-23.overview: Following the disastrous results of the 57th Expedition, Eren is to be brought to the King’s palace for a court martial. Armin, desperate to save Eren from certain execution, enlists the help of an old friend to assist with an escape plan.

1-24.title: Mercy: Assault on Stohess (2)
1-24.overview: With the identity of the Female Titan now revealed, Eren has reservations about fighting her. Mikasa, Armin, and the rest of the Recon Corps try to fight the Female Titan, hoping to distract her long enough to buy Eren time to come to terms with his feelings.

1-25.title: Wall: Assault on Stohess (3)
1-25.overview: Eren, spurred on by his promise to kill every single Titan, unleashes the full power of his Titan form in the fight with the Female Titan. As their bloody battle draws to a close, it seems humanity may finally have a chance at survival. However, with many mysteries still left unsolved, what will await Eren, Mikasa, and Armin?

2-1.title: Beast Titan
2-1.overview: Coupled with the military's cover-up of a previous incident, the shocking discovery inside the Walls causes a stir. Elsewhere, while the new Scout recruits are held for observation, a surprising threat appears.

2-2.title: I'm Home
2-2.overview: With the appearance of Titans within Wall Rose, Sasha and Connie ride as messengers to warn their villages of the impending threat.

2-3.title: Southwestward
2-3.overview: The Scouts search for a hole in the wall while Eren and the others learn that someone close may be hiding all the answers.

2-4.title: Soldier
2-4.overview: Unarmed and overwhelmed by the Titan assault on the castle, the only hope for the Scouts may lie in a promise and a secret.

2-5.title: Historia
2-5.overview: Utgard Castle comes crumbling down as Ymir desperately battles the Titans. Now, Christa must fulfill the promise they made long ago during winter training.

2-6.title: Warrior
2-6.overview: Following the battle, the Scouts regroup atop the wall only to find more questions than answers.

2-7.title: Close Combat
2-7.overview: With a new enemy revealed, Eren and the Scouts fight back using all the techniques at their disposal.

2-8.title: The Hunters
2-8.overview: Without a way to pursue the Titans, the Scouts have no choice but to recuperate as they wait for reinforcements. But do they still have faith in Eren?

2-9.title: Opening
2-9.overview: The Scouts rally and charge in pursuit, but Reiner is not quite himself while the group is trapped in the giant forest until nightfall.

2-10.title: Children
2-10.overview: When their group finally flees, Ymir wonders whether she should lie or stay true to herself, even if it means ruining the lives and future of those she cares about.

2-11.title: Charge
2-11.overview: The pursuit begins as the Recon Corps battles their way to Eren. But as the Scouts start to take numerous casualties, Erwin executes a risky strategy.

2-12.title: Scream
2-12.overview: The battle continues as Eren and the Scouts face many hard decisions. Who is the real enemy? What is the war really about? And what will the future hold for mankind?

3-1.title: Smoke Signal
3-1.overview: After barely surviving Eren's recovery, a rising threat from the shadows puts everyone's lives in danger again.

3-2.title: Pain
3-2.overview: The Scouts take a stand against a new enemy, but it's not just Titans they'll be fighting anymore.

3-3.title: Old Story
3-3.overview: Historia and Erwin look back on their past, revealing a shady government with a hidden agenda and inspiration for an uprising.

3-4.title: Trust
3-4.overview: On the run and running out of time, the Scouts must entrust their lives to others if they plan on surviving.

3-5.title: Reply
3-5.overview: Erwin pleads his case for the Scouts to be spared, but an unforeseen announcement puts the fate of humanity at risk.

3-6.title: Sin
3-6.overview: While sins of the past reveal new truths, both sides prepare for the upcoming showdown before they run out of time.

3-7.title: Wish
3-7.overview: As battle breaks out to prevent the ritual, Historia makes a shocking decision which leads to catastrophe.

3-8.title: Outside the Walls of Orvud District
3-8.overview: When everything falls apart, Eren must believe in himself to save his friends. But Eren alone may not be enough to stop the impending doom.

3-9.title: Ruler of the Walls
3-9.overview: The survey corps and the wall garrison must protect the Orvud District from the impending attack of Rod Reiss' titan.

3-10.title: Friends
3-10.overview: Kenny recalls the life which has brought him to death's door, but he gets to decide whether to live on or not.

3-11.title: Bystander
3-11.overview: Having seen a glimpse of his father's memories, Eren attempts to track down a man hoping they might shed some light on his father's secrets.

3-12.title: Night of the Battle to Retake the Wall
3-12.overview: The Scouts gather for a feisty feast before leaving to retake Wall Maria to uncover what's hidden in the basement once and for all.

3-13.title: The Town Where Everything Began
3-13.overview: The operation to retake Wall Maria commences in Shiganshina, the town where everything began. But when the Scouts arrive, something seems very wrong.

3-14.title: Thunder Spears
3-14.overview: Against a rush of enemies, the Scouts scramble to defend their horses. But despite falling into a trap, they have their own surprise for the Armored Titan.

3-15.title: Descent
3-15.overview: Though their Thunder Spears prove effective, the Scouts' celebration is short-lived as disaster descends upon Shiganshina.

3-16.title: Perfect Game
3-16.overview: While one front in the battle is rained on by flames, the other is battered by boulders. With no way out, the Scouts are forced to fight or die trying.

3-17.title: Hero
3-17.overview: As Erwin’s heroic charge buys Levi time to confront the Beast Titan, Armin comes up with a plan of his own that lays it all on the line.

3-18.title: Midnight Sun
3-18.overview: While picking up the pieces from the costly battle, tensions rise when deciding which of the wounded Scouts to use the single syringe on.

3-19.title: The Basement
3-19.overview: The Scouts reflect on all they have gained and lost in their mission. With their enemies gone, Eren and the Scouts finally enter the basement to uncover the truth that will change everything.

3-20.title: That Day
3-20.overview: A look into Grisha's memories shows Eren the many secrets his father was hiding, including one which led to his mother's demise.

3-21.title: The Attack Titan
3-21.overview: Eren learns the truth about his Titan powers, his Father and himself. The Survey Corps have a meeting that discusses the future of Eldia with all their new information.

3-22.title: The Other Side of the Wall

4-1.title: The Other Side of the Sea
4-1.overview: As Marley battles the Mid-East Alliance to end a four-year war, a group of Warrior candidates on the front lines compete to be the successor of the Armored Titan.

4-2.title: Midnight Train
4-2.overview: Though glad the war is over, both the Eldian Warriors and Marley brass realize that neither have a future unless they finish the job of retaking the Founding Titan.

4-3.title: The Door of Hope
4-3.overview: Reiner reflects on his past, remembering what pushed him to become a Warrior and keep moving forward when all hope was lost.

4-4.title: From One Hand to Another
4-4.overview: A sudden visit from the Tybur family shakes up the Marleyan military. Meanwhile, Falco smuggles letters for a friend and helps two old comrades reunite.

4-5.title: Declaration of War
4-5.overview: While Willy Tybur reveals the truth in a shocking speech to the world, tensions rise behind the stage as Eren and Reiner meet face to face.

4-6.title: The War Hammer Titan
4-6.overview: Eren's rampage is thwarted by the War Hammer Titan whose tenacity leaves him stumped. With Marley's military joining the fight, he'll be hard-pressed to survive on his own.

4-7.title: Assault
4-7.overview: The forces of Paradis begin their assault, but the Warriors stand their ground. As Marley troops close in around them, Eren struggles to break the War Hammer's defenses.

4-8.title: Assassin's Bullet
4-8.overview: With no Titans left to threaten their escape, the Scouts retreat on the airship. Determined to make them pay for trampling on her home, Gabi chases after with gun in hand.

4-9.title: Brave Volunteers
4-9.overview: As Paradis deals with the aftermath of the raid on Liberio, Armin looks back in the past to meeting the volunteer soldiers who reshaped their world.

4-10.title: A Sound Argument
4-10.overview: Two years ago, Paradis welcomed their first visitor who was surprised to see one of their own. Obtaining their help will be critical in a three-part plan to protect Paradis.

4-11.title: Deceiver
4-11.overview: Trapped on the world's most dangerous island, Falco and Gabi will do anything to survive. Elsewhere, the public demands answers when they learn the savior of Paradis has been detained.

4-12.title: Guides
4-12.overview: While Hange and Pixis piece together Zeke's true intentions, tension builds outside HQ where Armin and Mikasa plead for permission to speak with Eren.

4-13.title: Children of the Forest
4-13.overview: Gabi and Falco seek out a fellow Marleyan who's surprised to see Warrior candidates. The truth of what happened at Ragako may shed some light on Zeke's secret plans.

4-14.title: Savagery
4-14.overview: Armin and Mikasa speak with Eren, but are astounded by what he says. In the forest, Levi considers feeding the Beast Titan to someone new, but Zeke has other plans in mind.

4-15.title: Sole Salvation
4-15.overview: A look into Zeke's past shows his struggle to become a Warrior. His plans to end the suffering of all Eldians stems from a chance friendship made in his youth.

4-16.title: Above and Below
4-16.overview: With the Yeagerists now in charge, Zeke's master plan is revealed. But before it is put in motion, Eren recruits help to flush out any invaders in their midst.

4-17.title: Judgment
4-17.overview: Caught off guard by Marley's surprise attack, Eren fends off their Titans alone. As the battle rages on above, the Scouts consider Eren's motives from the underground dungeons.

4-18.title: Sneak Attack
4-18.overview: The Beast Titan joins the fray, but General Magath is determined to take him down. Meanwhile, with the city in flames, Colt and Gabi rush to rescue Falco who's held captive by the Yeagerists.

4-19.title: Two Brothers
4-19.overview: Colt pleads with Zeke to not use his scream and turn Falco into a Titan. All the while, soldiers and Titans clash in battle as Eren struggles to make contact with his brother.

4-20.title: Memories of the Future
4-20.overview: Zeke takes Eren through Grisha's memories to show him how he's been brainwashed. But in doing so, Zeke discovers something about Eren that he never knew.

4-21.title: From You, 2,000 Years Ago
4-21.overview: For 2,000 years, the Founder Ymir has been waiting--a slave to those with royal blood. However, Eren's yearning for freedom gives her a choice that could shake things up.

4-22.title: Thaw
4-22.overview: With no walls left on the island and Shiganshina full of Titans, the Scouts must battle their former comrades. In the midst of it all, Gabi is determined to find and rescue Falco at whatever cost.

4-23.title: Sunset
4-23.overview: The rumbling is set in motion once all hardening is undone, but this also sets Annie free. As the Jaegerists take control of the island, Conny races towards Ragako to feed Falco to his Titan mother.

4-24.title: Pride
4-24.overview: Upon reaching Ragako, Conny hatches a plan to trick Falco into being eaten by his mother. Elsewhere, hero of the Eldian Empire, Jean, is to execute Yelena and Onyankopon for their crimes against humanity.

4-25.title: Night of the End
4-25.overview: Deep in the forest, an unlikely rabble of Marley stragglers and island fugitives attempt to set their hatred aside and talk around a campfire without killing each other.

4-26.title: Traitor
4-26.overview: The Azumabito's flying boat is guarded by a port full of Jaegerists, but the Scouts are reluctant to kill their former friends. If they wish to avoid bloodshed, they can't afford their plan to go wrong.

4-27.title: Retrospective
4-27.overview: For the flying boat to take off, the mechanics need half a day to service it. Knowing they'll never last that long with Jaegerist reinforcements on the way, the crew is forced to change their plans.

4-28.title: The Dawn of Humanity
4-28.overview: Regardless of where it all began, Eren commits to his path of destruction during the Scouts' first visit to the Marleyan mainland, leaving Mikasa to wonder if things could've been different.

121361.name: Game of Thrones
121361.overview: Seven noble families fight for control of the mythical land of Westeros. Friction between the houses leads to full-scale war. All while a very ancient evil awakens in the farthest north. Amidst the war, a neglected military order of misfits, the Night's Watch, is all that stands between the realms of men and icy horrors beyond.

0-14.overview: “George R.R. Martin meets Chris Martin – what could go wrong?” That’s Emilia Clarke in the epic, 12-minute video for Coldplay’s totally fake Game of Thrones musical, right before she rips into a song called “Rastafarian Targaryen.” Here’s a sample lyric: “Call me Daenerys Targaryen when you want to reach me, and if you feel the love then you can call me Khalessi.” The sketch, part of Red Nose Day, includes cast members Kit Harington, Peter Dinklage, John Bradley, Rose Leslie, Charlotte Pope, Thomas Brodie-Sangster, Alfie Allen and Nikolaj Coster-Waldau, who performs a piano ballad called “Closer to Home” to a photo of Lena Headey as Cersei. (“Are you thinking about Joffrey? Such a spirited lad. I was his uncle, I was also his dad.”)

0-57.overview: Bran Stark recounts the stories of legendary figures of several of the seven independent kingdoms that existed prior to the War of Conquest.

0-58.title: Histories & Lore: The Old Gods and the New
0-58.overview: Catelyn and Bran Stark discuss the worship of the Old Gods of the Forest and the Seven in Westeros.

0-59.title: Histories & Lore: The History of the Night's Watch (Jeor Mormont)
0-59.overview: Jeor Mormont discusses the earliest days, structure and duty of the Night's Watch.

0-60.title: Histories & Lore: The History of the Night's Watch (Maester Luwin)
0-60.overview: Maester Luwin details the steady decline that the Night's Watch has suffered with the passage of time.

0-61.title: Histories & Lore: The History of the Night's Watch (Tywin Lannister)
0-61.overview: Tywin Lannister mocks the faded glory of the Night's Watch and questions the need for the order.

0-62.title: Histories & Lore: The Order of the Maesters
0-62.overview: Maester Luwin explains the role and function of the Order of Maesters in the Seven Kingdoms as well as studies aspiring Maesters undergo.

0-63.title: Histories & Lore: Valyria and the Dragons
0-63.overview: Viserys Targaryen recounts the history of Valyria from its rise to becoming the greatest civilization the world has ever seen to its destruction in the Doom.

0-64.title: Histories & Lore: The Field of Fire (Viserys Targaryen)
0-64.overview: Viserys Targaryen reflects on the victory which secured Aegon I Targaryen's domination of the Seven Kingdoms.

0-65.title: Histories & Lore: The Field of Fire (Robb Stark)
0-65.overview: Robb Stark recalls how Aegon the Conqueror forced the lords of Westeros into submission with his brutal victory on the Field of Fire.

0-66.title: Histories & Lore: Mad King Aerys (Robert Baratheon)
0-66.overview: Robert Baratheon reflects on the actions of King Aerys II Targaryen and his son Rhaegar leading to his rebellion.

0-67.title: Histories & Lore: Mad King Aerys (Maester Luwin)
0-67.overview: Maester Luwin looks back on Prince Rhaegar's capture of Lyanna Stark and the horrific injustice inflicted on House Stark by the Mad King Aerys.

0-68.title: Histories & Lore: Mad King Aerys (Tywin Lannister)
0-68.overview: Tywin Lannister reminisces on the collapse of his alliance with Aerys as the latter descended further and further into madness.

0-69.title: Histories & Lore: Robert's Rebellion (Robert Baratheon)
0-69.overview: Robert Baratheon reminisces on his glorious victories against the supporters of the Mad King Aerys II Targaryen.

0-70.title: Histories & Lore: Robert's Rebellion (Viserys Targaryen)
0-70.overview: Viserys Targaryen bitterly recalls the treachery of the Usurper Robert Baratheon putting an end to the Targaryen dynasty.

0-71.title: Histories & Lore: The Sack of King's Landing (Viserys Targaryen)
0-71.overview: Viserys Targaryen bitterly recounts Tywin Lannister's treachery bringing down the Targaryen dynasty.

0-72.title: Histories & Lore: The Sack of King's Landing (Robert Baratheon)
0-72.overview: Robert Baratheon reflects on his victory over the Targaryen dynasty and the necessity for the death of Rhaegar Targaryen's children.

0-73.title: Histories & Lore: The Sack of King's Landing (Maester Luwin)
0-73.overview: Maester Luwin details the downfall of the Mad King and the death of the royal family, as well as how it impacted those who won the war.

0-74.title: Histories & Lore: The Sack of King's Landing (Tywin Lannister)
0-74.overview: Tywin Lannister reminisces on the part he played in defeating the Targaryens and the rewards his family reaped for it.

0-75.title: Histories & Lore: House Stark
0-75.overview: Bran and Robb Stark discuss House Stark's reign as the Kings of Winter before kneeling to Aegon the Conqueror.

0-76.title: Histories & Lore: House Lannister
0-76.overview: Tywin Lannister recalls how House Lannister survived and rose to prominence through cunning.

0-77.title: Histories & Lore: House Targaryen
0-77.overview: Viserys Targaryen recounts the conquest of House Targaryen and its ruling of the Seven Kingdoms before being brought down by the treacherous Usurper Robert Baratheon.

0-78.title: Histories & Lore: House Baratheon
0-78.overview: Robert Baratheon recalls the victories that led to House Baratheon cementing themselves as one of the greatest houses in Westeros.

0-79.title: Histories & Lore: House Arryn

0-94.overview: Jorah Mormont explains the rise of the “Free Cities” of Essos in the wake of Valyria’s Doom, detailing how the cities differ and what one can expect to find in each one.

0-95.overview: Xaro Xhoan Daxos explains Qarth’s role in Essos’ commerce, and how the merchant council known as the Thirteen rules the city to ensure it remains the greatest city that was or ever will be.

0-96.overview: Yara Greyjoy explains the worship of the Drowned God, His importance in the Iron Islands, and the legends of His halls beneath the waves.

0-97.overview: Wisdom Hallyne provides an account of the Alchemist Guild (or Pyromancers), detailing their knowledge of wildfire and how their once great influence in Westeros has faded over the years.

0-98.title: Histories & Lore: The Warlocks
0-98.overview: Xaro Xhoan Daxos explains the mysterious order of the warlocks and their relationship with the House of the Undying, their center of power.

0-99.title: Histories & Lore: Old Ghis & Slaver's Bay
0-99.overview: Jorah Mormont charts the rise and fall of the Ghiscari Empire, including its battles with the Valyrian Freehold and the slaver cities that carry on in the wake of its destruction.

0-100.title: Histories & Lore: The Unsullied

0-101.title: Histories & Lore: House Reed
0-101.overview: Meera Reed discusses the history and modern perceptions of House Reed, leaders of the crannogmen, the mysterious swamp-dwelling gatekeepers of the North.

0-102.title: Histories & Lore: House Bolton

0-103.title: Histories & Lore: House Frey
0-103.overview: Catelyn Stark tracks the House Frey’s quick rise to wealth and power through control of the Crossing, as well as their current reputation under the prickly and resentful Lord Walder Frey.

0-104.title: Histories & Lore: House Tully

0-105.title: Histories & Lore: The Lord of Light

0-106.title: Histories & Lore: Wargs and the Sight

0-107.title: Histories & Lore: Robert's Rebellion (Petyr Baelish and Varys)

0-108.title: Histories & Lore: The Red Keep

0-109.title: Histories & Lore: The North

0-110.title: Histories & Lore: The Reach

0-111.title: Histories & Lore: The Riverlands

0-112.title: Histories & Lore: The Stormlands
0-112.overview: Brienne of Tarth recounts the tumultuous history of the Stormlands, from the constant battles waged by the Storm Kings, to the relative peace under Targaryen rule, to Robert’s Rebellion.

0-113.title: Histories & Lore: The Westerlands
0-113.overview: Tywin Lannister reveals the history of the Westerlands, and the true strength behind the richest region of the Seven Kingdoms; House Lannister.

0-114.title: Histories & Lore: The Vale
0-114.overview: Petyr Baelish delves into the history of the Vale, from its mythical beginnings to the impregnable Eyrie, the noble House Arryn, and the unpredictable Hill Tribes.

0-115.title: Histories & Lore: House Martell
0-115.overview: Oberyn Martell discusses the history and reputation of House Martell, the strong-willed ruling family of Dorne that refused to join the Seven Kingdoms for centuries.

0-116.title: Histories & Lore: House Baelish
0-116.overview: Petyr Baelish explains how, despite humble beginnings, House Baelish has rapidly risen to power, thanks mostly to his own wit and ambition.

0-117.title: Histories & Lore: Dragons
0-117.overview: Grand Maester Pycelle recounts the mysterious origins, magical powers, and inexplicable downfall of history's last generation of dragons.

0-118.title: Histories & Lore: Poisons
0-118.overview: Oberyn Martell explains the sources, surreptitious uses, and lethal effects of the many poisons circulating throughout Westeros and Essos.

0-119.title: Histories & Lore: The Bastards of Westeros
0-119.overview: Ellaria Sand explains the shame cast upon bastards throughout much of Westeros, and how these unwanted children can tear families and kingdoms apart.

0-120.title: Histories & Lore: The Iron Bank of Braavos
0-120.overview: Tycho Nestoris reveals the history behind the legendary Iron Bank of Braavos, an institution renowned for its economic power and formidable reputation.

0-121.title: Histories & Lore: Sellswords & Hedge Knights
0-121.overview: Bronn describes the unique profession and skill of the sellsword, as well as the debatable merits of the hedge knight.

0-122.title: Histories & Lore: Robert's Rebellion (Oberyn Martell)
0-122.overview: Oberyn Martell reveals the Dornish perspective of Robert's Rebellion - or the War of the Usurper as they call it - including the murder of his sister, Elia Martell, during the sack of King's Landing.

0-123.title: Histories & Lore: The Wall
0-123.overview: Samwell Tarly explains the impressive construction and function of the Wall, including its natural defenses against wildling attempts to scale, breach, and circumnavigate it.

0-124.title: Histories & Lore: The Nations of the North
0-124.overview: Tormund Giantsbane describes the varied clans of Free Folk living beyond the Wall, from Thenns to the Hornfoots to the Giants, all of whom Mance Rayder has rallied to his cause.

0-125.title: Histories & Lore: The Kingsguard (Jaime Lannister)

0-126.title: Histories & Lore: The Kingsguard (Bronn)

0-127.title: Histories & Lore: The Maester's Chain
0-127.overview: Qyburn explains the significance of the Maester's Chain, a symbolic ornament earned by students of The Citadel, with each link representing the mastery of a different subject.

0-128.title: Histories & Lore: The Death of Kings
0-128.overview: Varys tracks the lives and all too common deaths of the Kings of Westeros over the years, proving that the Iron Throne is truly an uncomfortable seat to hold.

0-129.title: Histories & Lore: Valyrian Steel
0-129.overview: Jorah Mormont details the mysterious properties of Valyrian Steel, a metal considered magical that was used to forge the blades of the great Houses of Westeros.

0-130.title: Histories & Lore: Justice of the Seven Kingdoms
0-130.overview: Bronn offers his view on the Seven Kingdoms' questionable methods of justice, including the dramatic trial by combat and the rarely invoked trial by Seven.

0-131.title: Histories & Lore: The Seven-Pointed Star

0-133.title: Histories & Lore: Volantis

0-134.title: Histories & Lore: Braavos

0-135.title: Histories & Lore: The Faceless Men

0-136.title: Histories & Lore: Winterfell

0-138.title: Histories & Lore: Robert's Rebellion (Barristan Selmy)

Barristan describes the fateful Tourney at Harrenhal, the ensuing War of the Five Kings, and how he fought beside Rhaegar at the Battle of the Trident where he was killed.

0-139.title: Histories & Lore: Dorne

1-1.title: Winter Is Coming
1-1.overview: Jon Arryn, the Hand of the King, is dead. King Robert Baratheon plans to ask his oldest friend, Eddard Stark, to take Jon's place. Across the sea, Viserys Targaryen plans to wed his sister to a nomadic warlord in exchange for an army.

1-2.title: The Kingsroad
1-2.overview: While Bran recovers from his fall, Ned takes only his daughters to Kings Landing. Jon Snow goes with his uncle Benjen to The Wall. Tyrion joins them.

1-3.title: Lord Snow
1-3.overview: Lord Stark and his daughters arrive at King's Landing to discover the intrigues of the king's realm.

1-4.title: Cripples, Bastards, and Broken Things
1-4.overview: Eddard investigates Jon Arryn's murder. Jon befriends Samwell Tarly, a coward who has come to join the Night's Watch.

1-5.title: The Wolf and the Lion
1-5.overview: Catelyn has captured Tyrion and plans to bring him to her sister, Lysa Arryn, at The Vale, to be tried for his, supposed, crimes against Bran. Robert plans to have Daenerys killed, but Eddard refuses to be a part of it and quits.

1-6.title: A Golden Crown
1-6.overview: While recovering from his battle with Jamie, Eddard is forced to run the kingdom while Robert goes hunting. Tyrion demands a trial by combat for his freedom. Viserys is losing his patience with Drogo.

1-7.title: You Win or You Die
1-7.overview: Robert has been injured while hunting and is dying. Jon and the others finally take their vows to the Night's Watch. A man, sent by Robert, is captured for trying to poison Daenerys. Furious, Drogo vows to attack the Seven Kingdoms.

1-8.title: The Pointy End
1-8.overview: Eddard and his men are betrayed and captured by the Lannisters. When word reaches Robb, he plans to go to war to rescue them. The White Walkers attack The Wall. Tyrion returns to his father with some new friends.

1-9.title: Baelor
1-9.overview: Robb goes to war against the Lannisters. Jon finds himself struggling on deciding if his place is with Robb or the Night's Watch. Drogo has fallen ill from a fresh battle wound. Daenerys is desperate to save him.

1-10.title: Fire and Blood
1-10.overview: With Ned dead, Robb vows to get revenge on the Lannisters. Jon must officially decide if his place is with Robb or the Night's Watch. Daenerys says her final goodbye to Drogo.

2-1.title: The North Remembers
2-1.overview: Tyrion arrives to save Joffrey's crown from threats old and new; Daenerys searches for allies and water in the Red Waste.

2-2.title: The Night Lands
2-2.overview: Arya shares a secret with a familiar recruit; a scout returns to Dany with disturbing news; Theon comes home to the Iron Islands.

2-3.title: What Is Dead May Never Die
2-3.overview: Tyrion roots out a spy; Catelyn meets a new king and queen; Bran dreams; Theon drowns.

2-4.title: Garden of Bones
2-4.overview: Catelyn tries to save two kings from themselves; Tyrion practices coercion; Robb meets a foreigner; Dany finds her ally.

2-5.title: The Ghost of Harrenhal
2-5.overview: The Baratheon rivalry ends; Tyrion learns of Cersei's secret weapon; Dany suffers a loss; Arya collects a debt she didn't know was owed.

2-6.title: The Old Gods and the New
2-6.overview: Arya has a surprise visitor; Dany vows to take what is hers; Joffrey meets his subjects; Qhorin gives Jon a chance to prove himself.

2-7.title: A Man Without Honor
2-7.overview: Jaime meets a distant relative; Dany receives an invitation; Theon leads a search party; Jon loses his way in the wilderness.

2-8.title: The Prince of Winterfell
2-8.overview: Theon holds down the fort; Arya calls in her debt with Jaqen; Robb is betrayed; Stannis and Davos approach their destination.

2-9.title: Blackwater
2-9.overview: Tyrion and the Lannisters fight for their lives as Stannis' fleet assaults King's Landing.

2-10.title: Valar Morghulis
2-10.overview: Tyrion wakes up in a new world; Dany goes to a strange place; Jon proves himself.

3-1.title: Valar Dohaeris
3-1.overview: Jon is tested by the wildling king; Tyrion asks for his reward; Dany sails to Slaver's Bay.

3-2.title: Dark Wings, Dark Words
3-2.overview: Sansa says too much. Shae asks Tyrion for a favor. Jaime finds a way to pass the time, while Arya encounters the Brotherhood Without Banners.

3-3.title: Walk of Punishment
3-3.overview: Tyrion shoulders new responsibilities. Jon is taken to the Fist of the First Men. Daenerys meets with the slavers. Jaime strikes a deal with his captors.

3-4.title: And Now His Watch Is Ended
3-4.overview: The Night's Watch takes stock. Varys meets his better. Arya is taken to the commander of the Brotherhood. Dany exchanges a chain for a whip.

3-5.title: Kissed by Fire
3-5.overview: The Hound is judged by the gods. Jaime is judged by men. Jon proves himself. Robb is betrayed. Tyrion learns the cost of weddings.

3-6.title: The Climb
3-6.overview: Four Houses consider make-or-break alliances. Jon and the Wildlings face a daunting climb.

3-7.title: The Bear and the Maiden Fair
3-7.overview: Dany exchanges gifts in Yunkai; Brienne faces a formidable foe in Harrenhal.

3-8.title: Second Sons
3-8.overview: Dany meets the Titan's Bastard; King's Landing hosts a royal wedding.

3-9.title: The Rains of Castamere
3-9.overview: House Frey joins forces with House Tully. Jon faces his most difficult test yet.

3-10.title: Mhysa
3-10.overview: Joffrey challenges Tywin. Dany waits to see if she is a conqueror or a liberator.

4-1.title: Two Swords
4-1.overview: King's Landing prepares for a royal wedding; Dany finds the way to Meereen; the Night's Watch braces for a new threat.

4-2.title: The Lion and the Rose
4-2.overview: The Lannisters and their guests gather in King's Landing; Stannis loses patience with Davos; Ramsay finds a purpose for his pet.

4-3.title: Breaker of Chains
4-3.overview: Tyrion ponders his options; Tywin extends an olive branch; Jon proposes a bold plan; The Hound teaches Arya the way thing are.

4-4.title: Oathkeeper
4-4.overview: Dany balances justice and mercy; Jaime tasks Brienne with his honor; Jon readies his men.

4-5.title: First of His Name
4-5.overview: Cersei and Tywin plot the Crown's next move. Dany discusses future plans. Jon Snow embarks on a new mission.

4-6.title: The Laws of Gods and Men
4-6.overview: Stannis and Davos set sail with a new strategy. Dany meets with supplicants. Tyrion faces down his father in the Throne Room.

4-7.title: Mockingbird
4-7.overview: Tyrion enlists an unlikely ally. Daario entreats Dany to allow him to do what he does best. Jon's warnings fall on deaf ears.

4-8.title: The Mountain and the Viper
4-8.overview: Mole's Town receives some unexpected visitors. Littlefinger's motives are questioned. Tyrion's fate is decided.

4-9.title: The Watchers on the Wall
4-9.overview: Jon Snow and the rest of the Night's Watch face the biggest challenge to the Wall yet.

4-10.title: The Children
4-10.overview: Circumstances change after an unexpected arrival from north of the Wall. Dany must face harsh realities. Bran learns more about his destiny. Tyrion sees the truth about his situation.

5-1.title: The Wars to Come
5-1.overview: Cersei and Jaime adjust to a world without Tywin. Varys reveals a conspiracy to Tyrion. Dany faces a new threat to her rule. Jon is caught between two kings.

5-2.title: The House of Black and White
5-2.overview: Arya arrives in Braavos. Podrick and Brienne run into trouble on the road. Cersei fears for her daughter's safety in Dorne as Ellaria Sand seeks revenge for Oberyn's death. Stannis tempts Jon. An adviser tempts Daenerys.

5-3.title: High Sparrow
5-3.overview: In Braavos, Arya sees the Many-Faced God. In King's Landing, Queen Margaery enjoys her new husband. Tyrion and Varys walk the Long Bridge of Volantis.

5-4.title: Sons of the Harpy
5-4.overview: The Faith Militant grow increasingly aggressive. Jaime and Bronn head south. Ellaria and the Sand Snakes vow vengeance.

5-5.title: Kill the Boy
5-5.overview: Dany makes a difficult decision in Meereen. Jon recruits the help of an unexpected ally. Brienne searches for Sansa. Theon remains under Ramsay's control.

5-6.title: Unbowed, Unbent, Unbroken
5-6.overview: Arya trains. Jorah and Tyrion run into slavers. Trystane and Myrcella make plans. Jaime and Bronn reach their destination. The Sand Snakes attack.

5-7.title: The Gift
5-7.overview: Jon prepares for conflict. Sansa tries to talk to Theon. Brienne waits for a sign. Stannis remains stubborn. Jaime attempts to reconnect with family.

5-8.title: Hardhome
5-8.overview: Arya makes progress in her training. Sansa confronts an old friend. Cersei struggles. Jon travels.

5-9.title: The Dance of Dragons
5-9.overview: Stannis confronts a troubling decision. Jon returns to The Wall. Mace visits the Iron Bank. Arya encounters someone from her past. Dany reluctantly oversees a traditional celebration of athleticism.

5-10.title: Mother's Mercy
5-10.overview: Stannis marches. Dany is surrounded by strangers. Cersei seeks forgiveness. Jon is challenged.

6-1.title: The Red Woman
6-1.overview: The fate of Jon Snow is revealed. Daenerys meets a strong man. Cersei sees her daughter once again.

6-2.title: Home
6-2.overview: Bran trains with the Three-Eyed Raven. In King’s Landing, Jaime advises Tommen. Tyrion demands good news, but has to make his own. At Castle Black, the Night’s Watch stands behind Thorne. Ramsay Bolton proposes a plan, and Balon Greyjoy entertains other proposals.

6-3.title: Oathbreaker
6-3.overview: Daenerys meets her future. Arya trains to be No One.

6-4.title: Book of the Stranger
6-4.overview: Tyrion strikes a deal. Jorah and Daario undertake a difficult task. Jaime and Cersei try to improve their situation.

6-5.title: The Door
6-5.overview: Tyrion seeks a strange ally. Bran learns a great deal. Brienne goes on a mission. Arya is given a chance to prove herself.

6-6.title: Blood of My Blood
6-6.overview: An old foe comes back into the picture. Gilly meets Sam's family. Arya faces a difficult choice. Jaime faces off against the High Sparrow.

6-7.title: The Broken Man
6-7.overview: The High Sparrow eyes another target. Jaime confronts a hero. Arya makes a plan. The North is reminded.

6-8.title: No One
6-8.overview: While Jaime weighs his options, Cersei answers a request. Tyrion's plans bear fruit. Arya faces a new test.

6-9.title: Battle of the Bastards
6-9.overview: Slaver envoys demand terms of surrender in Meereen. Ramsay plays the odds in defense of Winterfell.

6-10.title: The Winds of Winter
6-10.overview: Cersei faces a day of reckoning. Daenerys antes up for the 'Great Game.'

7-1.title: Dragonstone
7-1.overview: Jon Snow organizes the defense of the North. Cersei tries to even the odds. Daenerys comes home.

7-2.title: Stormborn
7-2.overview: Daenerys receives an unexpected visitor. Jon faces a revolt. Sam risks his career and life. Tyrion plans the conquest of Westeros.

7-3.title: The Queen's Justice
7-3.overview: Daenerys holds court. Tyrion backchannels. Cersei returns a gift. Jaime learns from his mistakes.

7-4.title: The Spoils of War
7-4.overview: The Lannisters pay their debts. Daenerys weighs her options. Arya comes home.

7-5.title: Eastwatch
7-5.overview: Daenerys offers a choice. Arya grows suspicious. Tyrion answers a good question.

7-6.title: Beyond the Wall
7-6.overview: Jon and the Brotherhood hunt the dead. Arya confronts Sansa. Tyrion thinks about the future.

7-7.title: The Dragon and the Wolf
7-7.overview: Tyrion tries to save Westeros from itself. Sansa questions loyalties.

8-1.title: Winterfell
8-1.overview: Arriving at Winterfell, Jon and Daenerys struggle to unite a divided North. Jon Snow gets some big news.

8-2.title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
8-2.overview: The battle at Winterfell is approaching. Jaime is confronted with the consequences of the past. A tense interaction between Sansa and Daenerys follows.

8-3.title: The Long Night
8-3.overview: The Night King and his army have arrived at Winterfell and the great battle begins. Arya looks to prove her worth as a fighter.

8-4.title: The Last of the Starks
8-4.overview: In the wake of a costly victory, Jon and Daenerys look to the south as Tyrion eyes a compromise that could save countless lives.

8-5.title: The Bells
8-5.overview: Daenerys brings her forces to King's Landing.

8-6.title: The Iron Throne
8-6.overview: In the aftermath of the devastating attack on King's Landing, Daenerys must face the survivors.

278157.overview: Inspired by a small-statured pro volleyball player, Hinata creates a volleyball team in his last year of middle school. Unfortunately the team is matched up against the "King of the Court" Tobio Kageyama’s team in their first tournament and inevitably lose. After the crushing defeat, Hinata vows to surpass Kageyama After entering high school, Hinata joins the volleyball team only to find that Tobio has also joined.
