2-3.overview: Despite the shocking news the gang have just discovered, Aang insists on trying to find Bumi within Omashu's borders, even with the dangers that will await him and his friends if his real identity is discovered.  Meanwhile Azula goes in search of old friends to help her with her mission.

2-4.title: The Swamp
2-4.overview: A mysterious tornado pulls the kids into a supernatural swamp where Katara, Sokka and Aang have mysterious visions. Meanwhile, Momo and Appa are chased by rogue swamp dwellers and only Aang and the gang can save them.

2-5.title: Avatar Day
2-5.overview: Aang and the gang discover an Earth town that celebrates something called "Avatar Day." But when they get there and learn the festival is of "anti-Avatar" sentiment and Aang is put on trial for a crime a past incarnation allegedly committed. Looking to clear the Avatar's good name, Katara and Sokka venture back to a familiar  place to gather evidence and discover the truth.

2-6.title: The Blind Bandit
2-6.overview: In search for an earthbending teacher for Aang, the kids go to an underground earthbending tournament called Earth Rumble 6, where they encounter Toph, a blind but powerful earthbending girl. After seeing her unique style of earthbending, Aang wants Toph to become his teacher, but there are complications with Toph's family.

2-7.title: Zuko Alone
2-7.overview: Zuko travels by himself to an Earth Kingdom town where he meets a local boy. The two almost become friends, while Zuko suffers from flashbacks of his past.

2-8.title: The Chase
2-8.overview: Tired from trying to escape a machine that shows up every time they try to sleep, Aang and the gang have to escape Azula and her team, but their exhaustion leads to a tight situation. Meanwhile, Zuko must deal with something personal, and Iroh bonds with an unlikely individual.

2-9.title: Bitter Work
2-9.overview: Toph's instructing abilities come into question when Aang cannot seem to overcome a block that keeps him from earthbending. Sokka gets himself in a jam, while befriending what was, moments before, his next meal, and Iroh and Zuko begin training utilizing new philosophies and methods that originate from the other elements.

2-10.title: The Library
2-10.overview: When Aang and his friends find a professor who knows of a library that contains information about the world, Sokka decides to go there to hopefully find some information to use against the Fire Nation. The library is guarded by the knowledge spirit, Wan Shi Tong, who unfortunately doesn't welcome humans into his library, because he believes they only seek information for evil purposes.

2-11.title: The Desert
2-11.overview: Aang searches for Appa while Katara struggles to keep everyone together to survive in the vast desert. Meanwhile, Iroh and Zuko seek help from an ancient secret society.

2-12.title: The Serpent's Pass
2-12.overview: When Aang and the gang meet up with a group of refugees, they tell the gang where they can get on a ferry to Ba Sing Se. But after a series of events they have to take a deadly route called the serpent's pass with the help of an old friend, Suki. Meanwhile, Zuko and Iroh meet up with a boy named Jet and his freedom fighters.

2-13.title: The Drill
2-13.overview: Having made it to the outer wall of Ba Sing Se, the kids confront a Fire Nation army that is driving a massive Fire Nation drill, which poses an imminent threat to the last Earth Kingdom stronghold. Meanwhile, Zuko and Iroh make crucial mistakes which begin to attract Jet's suspicions.

2-14.title: City of Walls and Secrets
2-14.overview: Having finally made it into Ba Sing Se, the kids are given a house in the upper ring. The kids are anxious to tell the Earth King their plan but there are complications. Meanwhile, still convinced that Iroh and Zuko may be Fire Nation, Jet decides to take matters into his own hands and do whatever it takes to get the refugees to reveal their true nature.

2-15.title: The Tales of Ba Sing Se
2-15.overview: A series of short stories, highlighting different characters and their individual adventures in the city. Tales of Katara and Toph, Iroh, Sokka, Aang, Zuko, and Momo.

2-16.title: Appa's Lost Days
2-16.overview: Appa's journey from being abducted in the desert to the present is explored.

2-17.title: Lake Laogai
2-17.overview: Aang and his friends continue to search for Appa and, unbeknownst to them, they aren't the only ones looking for him. During their search, the kids meet up with Jet, whom they are understandably reluctant to trust. The kids soon realize that the Dai Li are doing their best to thwart the kids' efforts to find Appa. Meanwhile, Iroh is offered his own tea shop in the upper ring, and Zuko discovers the avatar is in the city.

2-18.title: The Earth King
2-18.overview: The kids battle Long Feng and the Dai Li when they attempt to show the Earth King the vast conspiracy taking place in his city. Zuko becomes seriously ill and has feverish dreams as he faces a spiritual crisis.

2-19.title: The Guru
2-19.overview: Aang travels to the Eastern Air temple to receive guidance from Guru Pathik while Sokka is reunited with his long-lost father. Meanwhile, Azula has something diabolical in store for her enemies in the Earth Kingdom, including Zuko and Iroh.

2-20.title: The Crossroads of Destiny
2-20.overview: Everyone races against time to stop Azula's sinister plan. Zuko finds companionship in an unlikely source. Aang's destiny hangs in the balance—and so does Zuko's, as Iroh tells him it's time to make a choice.

3-1.title: The Awakening
3-1.overview: Aang awakens to find himself aboard a captured Fire Nation ship with a full head of hair and sustaining serious injuries from the previous battle for Ba Sing Se. At his side are Katara, Sokka, and their father Hakoda who recount the events that led the four to the ship and contemplate their next move. Aang struggles to fight his own desire to face the Fire Lord before he is ready. Meanwhile, Zuko deals with his own issues as he makes his long-awaited journey home, with the fear of his father's rejection hanging over his head.

3-2.title: The Headband
3-2.overview: To better blend in as Fire Nation citizens, Aang enrolls in a Fire Nation school, giving himself an opportunity to learn more about the Nation and to enjoy life as a normal kid for the first time since he discovered he was the Avatar. Meanwhile Zuko, growing more and more paranoid about the Avatar's false demise, brings himself to confront the imprisoned Iroh.

3-3.title: The Painted Lady
3-3.overview: When the gang arrives at a suffering fishing village, a mysterious spirit appears to help the villagers.

3-4.title: Sokka's Master
3-4.overview: Feeling as though he isn't contributing enough to the group, Sokka seeks out an elusive swordsmaster from whom he can learn the ways of the blade.

3-5.title: The Beach
3-5.overview: Zuko, Azula, Mai and Ty Lee take a vacation to Ember Island. In the process, they come to learn more about themselves and each other as well as their desires for the future. Elsewhere, Aang and the others face off against a new adversary.

3-6.title: The Avatar and the Firelord
3-6.overview: The tale of Avatar Roku and Fire Lord Sozin is revealed to Aang and Zuko by different sources.  Both learn about themselves and are shown the origins of the war.

3-7.title: The Runaway
3-7.overview: When Katara expresses her disapproval of Toph's new way to make quick cash, the group finds her too motherly and tension grows between Katara and Toph. When Katara finally decides to participate in this scam to disprove Toph's accusations, they are left vulnerable and are forced to face the dire consequences.

3-8.title: The Puppetmaster
3-8.overview: The gang investigates the bizarre disappearances taking place within an eerie town.

3-9.title: Nightmares and Daydreams
3-9.overview: Four days prior the invasion, Aang becomes nervous over his soon-to-come confrontation with the Fire Lord. His anxiety gets the better of him as he begins to suffer from outrageous nightmares and hallucinations. Meanwhile, Zuko becomes upset to learn that he was not informed about a war meeting.

3-10.title: The Day of Black Sun: The Invasion (1)
3-10.overview: The day of the eclipse has arrived, and the invasion force gathers together to make last preparations. They infiltrate the island and the battle begins. Meanwhile, Aang searches for the Fire Lord.

3-11.title: The Day of Black Sun: The Eclipse (2)
3-11.overview: As the invasion force fights their way to the Fire Nation capital, the kids help Aang find the Fire Lord in time for the eclipse. Zuko confronts his father with shocking news.

3-12.title: The Western Air Temple
3-12.overview: Aang and the group arrive at the Western Air Temple, with Zuko in pursuit. Zuko wishes to help the Avatar end the war by teaching him firebending.

3-13.title: The Firebending Masters
3-13.overview: While teaching Aang firebending, Zuko realizes that he has lost all his firebending skills. To regain his powers, Zuko and Aang must seek the original source of firebending within the ruins of a lost civilization.

3-14.title: The Boiling Rock (1)
3-14.overview: Sokka wants to break his father out of jail and asks Zuko for information on Fire Nation prisons. Sokka and Zuko head for the Boiling Rock, a prison located in the middle of a volcano, to rescue Sokka's father.

3-15.title: The Boiling Rock (2)
3-15.overview: Zuko and Sokka make new plans to break out of the prison with Suki, Sokka's father and some others while a shocking twist leaves Azula none too happy with her two closest friends.

3-16.title: The Southern Raiders
3-16.overview: Katara decides to confront the Fire Nation soldier responsible for her mother's death. Aang tries to talk her out of it, but she doesn't listen.

3-17.title: The Ember Island Players
3-17.overview: A play recounting the gang's adventures does not sit well with Aang and his friends, except for Toph who enjoys it very much. Meanwhile, Aang confesses his love to Katara, but the response is ambiguous.

3-18.title: Sozin's Comet: The Phoenix King (1)
3-18.overview: Aang struggles to decide whether or not he has to kill the Fire Lord and, during the night, is drawn toward an island which disappears before morning. Zuko leads the rest of the group to the Earth Kingdom to meet a tracker whom they hope can find Aang. The Fire Lord crowns himself Phoenix King and Aang awakens on the island not knowing where he is.

3-19.title: Sozin's Comet: The Old Masters (2)
3-19.overview: While on the island, Aang seeks guidance from his past lives, but is not pleased with what he is told. The island, in fact, turns out to be a lion turtle from which Aang is given the guidance he had been seeking. Meanwhile, after the tracker is unable to track Aang, the rest of the group decide they must find Iroh. While tracking him down, the group meets up with The Order of the White Lotus, a group that transcends the division of the four nations.

3-20.title: Sozin's Comet: Into the Inferno (3)
3-20.overview: Sokka, Suki, and Toph try to stop the Fire Nation's air fleet. Meanwhile, Zuko and Azula duel in an Agni Kai and Aang confronts the Fire Lord.

3-21.title: Sozin's Comet: Avatar Aang (4)
3-21.overview: Aang is on the offensive after getting hit in the back of his scar and triggering the Avatar State. Meanwhile, after Zuko seems to have the upper hand against Azula, Katara is forced to join the fight when Azula resorts to desperate measures.

72454.name: Detective Conan
72454.overview: The son of a world famous mystery writer, Jimmy Kudo, has achieved his own notoriety by assisting the local police as a student detective. He has always been able to solve the most difficult of criminal cases using his wits and power of reason.

0-1.title: Conan vs. Kid vs. Yaiba - The Grand Battle for the Treasure Sword!!
0-1.overview: Conan borrows a large amount of manga from Mitsuhiko and crazy things begin to happen around Beika City. Things aren't always the way they appear to be. A family asks Kogoro to help them protect a special sword in their dojo since Kaitou KID has sent word he's going to steal it. However Kaitou KID will have to steal the sword while Conan and Yaiba are after him.

0-2.title: 16 Suspects!?
0-2.overview: The whole gang gets invited to Inspecter Shiratori's villa, where he keeps his wine collection, to celebrate the completion of it.

0-3.title: Conan, Heiji, and the Vanished Boy
0-3.overview: Conan and Ran are visiting Heiji and Kazuha in Osaka but while they are touring around they come across a group of three kids that look like Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, and Genta. The group are looking for their missing friend and Conan agrees to help.

0-4.title: Conan, Kid, and the Crystal Mother
0-4.overview: Kaitou Kid targets the Crystal Mother, a jewel worn by Queen Selizabeth of the Principality of Ingram, who is currently touring Japan on the Royal Express railway.

0-5.title: Time Travel of the Silver Sky

0-6.title: The Target Is Kogoro!! The Detective Boys' Secret Report

0-7.title: Follow the Vanished Diamond! Conan and Heiji vs Kid!

0-9.title: A Challenge from Agasa! Agasa vs. Conan and the Detective Boys

0-10.title: Magic File
0-10.overview: A 7-Eleven exclusive compilation DVD of episodes 132, 133, 134, 196, 266, 267, 268, 291, 292, and 293.

0-11.title: Shinichi Kudo Returns! Showdown with the Black Organization

0-14.title: The Casebook of Female High-School Detective Sonoko Suzuki

0-15.title: Shinichi Kudo, The Case of the Mysterious Wall and the Black Lab

0-16.title: Shinichi and Ran, Memories of Mahjong Tiles and Tanabata

0-17.title: The Stranger from Ten Years Later

0-18.title: Kid in Trap Island
0-18.overview: In this entirely new story produced specifically for the DVD, Conan leads a group of young detectives against the phantom thief Kaitou Kid, who has his eyes set on a jewel at a hotel on an isolated island.

0-20.title: Shinichi Kudo's Written Challenge! The Mystery of the Legendary Strange Bird

0-25.title: Shinichi Kudo and the Kyoto Shinsengumi Murder Case
0-25.overview: The high school detectives of the East and West meet as Shinichi and Heiji compete to solve a murder at a Kyoto film studio.

0-26.title: Flower of Fantasista
0-26.overview: "Fantasista Flower" is a side-story OVA related to The Eleventh Striker.

0-32.title: Police Academy Arc Wild Police Story CASE. Furuya Rei

0-33.title: Kid vs. Komei: The Targeted Lips
0-33.overview: Kaito Kid targets a museum's Fairy Lip pearl, with detectives in a thrilling game of wits.

0-34.title: The Gold-Star Answer
0-34.overview: When Ayumi hears jewelry stores are being robbed, she believes she might get to meet Precure.

1-1.title: The Big Shrink
1-1.overview: While on a date with Rachel, Kudo is attacked by two shady thugs who slip him an experimental drug. The effects of the poison will turn Jimmy’s life upside down!

1-2.title: The Kidnapped Debutante
1-2.overview: Conan sets out to discover the fate of a wealthy businessman’s kidnapped daughter. His new identity is a secret to everyone but his eccentric inventor friend, Dr. Agasa.

1-3.title: Beware of Idols
1-3.overview: Pop diva Yoko Okino is being stalked and she's come to star-struck Richard Moore's doorstep for help! Luckily for all involved, Conan is on the job, too.

1-4.title: Fish Marks the Spot
1-4.overview: Treasure hunt! When a mysterious coded map ends up in the hands of Conan and his new friends from school, the Junior Detective League is born!

1-5.title: The Time Bomb Express
1-5.overview: On a cross country train, Conan comes across two sketchy men that might be connected to the night of his big shrink! To make matters worse, the hoods are packing a bomb!

1-6.title: Tragic Valentine
1-6.overview: When Rachel and Serena attend a Valentine’s Day dinner party with some boys, Conan decides to tag along. It’s a good thing, too, because murder is on the menu!

1-7.title: The Case of Mysterious Gifts
1-7.overview: Dr. Woodman has been receiving children’s toys - and cash - once a month for the last two years, and he has no idea why. Conan and Richard take the case and find some interesting twists along the way.

1-8.title: The Art Museum Murder Case
1-8.overview: The owner of an art museum is killed by what appears to be someone wearing medieval body armor from the 15th century. Can Conan bring the killer to justice?

1-9.title: Festival Fiasco
1-9.overview: An author scripts the perfect murder of his ex-partner, complete with an airtight alibi. Can Conan see through the holes in his plot, or has this writer penned himself a perfect happy ending?

1-10.title: Deadly Game
1-10.overview: A star soccer player's been thrown off his game. A girl claiming to be Jimmy's girlfriend has surfaced, asking for help in finding a kidnapped boy. Are the events connected?

1-11.title: The Moonlight Sonata Murder Case (1/2)
1-11.overview: There is murder abound on Moonlight Island, and with every victim that is found, the haunting sounds of a classical composition are heard. Conan must solve the crime before all the suspects disappear!

1-12.title: Kidnapped: Ayumi
1-12.overview: An innocent game of hide-and-seek becomes a race through the city when two thugs kidnap Amy. With the clock running against them, can the Junior Detective League rescue her before it's too late?

1-13.title: Mystery Mastermind
1-13.overview: Richard finds the missing father of a girl named Michelle. Unfortunately, the next day, the father is found murdered and Michelle has vanished. It’s up to Conan to find the girl before it’s too late!

1-14.title: The Shooter
1-14.overview: As Conan’s gang fishes on the riverbank, they witness a most unusual sight. Can they convince Inspector Meguire and Richard of its importance before it’s too late?

1-15.title: The Two Faced Brother
1-15.overview: When Conan has to deal with a disappearing body, an oddly similar pair of brothers, and a jaded law enforcement system, everything is helter-skelter!

1-16.title: A Loan Repaid
1-16.overview: What starts out as a lazy day soon takes an exciting turn when an antique collector meets his end by the edge of an ancient sword. Can Conan cut through all the confusion?

1-17.title: The Case of the Hi-Jacked Department Store
1-17.overview: When Conan and his pals find themselves locked in a department store, they stumble right into the hands of a vicious ring of burglars. Will anyone come to their rescue?

1-18.title: Wedding Day Blues
1-18.overview: While Conan suffers through the wedding of a former teacher, someone is plotting to poison the bride’s favorite drink! What diabolical mind is behind this act of evil?

1-19.title: Fashion Sense
1-19.overview: What began as an enjoyable day for Conan, Richard, and Rachel, who is being interviewed for a potential job as a fashion model, soon turns toxic. A beautiful young lady has been found dead!

1-20.title: The Disappearing Act
1-20.overview: Conan, George, Mitch, and Amy explore a haunted house. With strange noises and mysterious screams around every corner, what they find is more bizarre than any ghost ever imagined.

1-21.title: Lights, Camera... Murder
1-21.overview: When a crewmember is killed, a movie set becomes a crime scene! Everyone involved in the movie is labeled a suspect, but who could be capable of such a horrendous deed?

1-22.title: Smooth Sailing (1)
1-22.overview: Conan, Richard, and Rachel attempt to relax aboard a cruise ship, but the gang soon ends up being cast into the middle of a dangerous family drama. Can Conan find the killer before he takes out the entire family?

1-23.title: Smooth Sailing (2)
1-23.overview: Lucas becomes the next victim on the voyage, and it’s revealed that Theodore’s escape from his makeshift cell was only possible with an accomplice. Amid two-timing and back-stabbing, Conan’s on the case.

1-24.title: Better Off Forgotten
1-24.overview: During Richard’s day at the track, he must dodge a revenge-driven ex-con and help a beautiful woman recover her memories.

1-25.title: The Counterfeit Ransom Kidnapping
1-25.overview: A dramatic car chase leaves two people dead - or does it? What does a diving watch, a sun tan, and five million dollars add up to? Just another puzzling case for Conan.

1-26.title: Jack Attacks!
1-26.overview: A dog named Jack kills a college student, shocking the dog’s owner and Conan as well! Conan’s known the pooch forever, and if he doesn’t get to the bottom of the attack, Jack will be put to sleep!

1-27.title: Richard's Class Reunion (1)
1-27.overview: Conan and Rachel join Richard for the 15-year reunion of Moore’s state-winning Judo team. But when the knock-out Jamie Hummelford turns up dead in her room, reminiscing will have to wait.

1-28.title: Richard's Class Reunion (2)
1-28.overview: Richard’s class reunion continues, and the killer is still among them. Can Conan apprehend him in time? Everyone’s a suspect in this exciting episode of Case Closed!

1-29.title: The Computer Murder
1-29.overview: A chance meeting with a corporate executive lands Conan in the middle of a murder investigation. A curious cat, a suspicious limo driver, and pile of melted chocolates have Conan wondering who the killer is.

1-30.title: The Missing Melody
1-30.overview: When an attorney’s wife is murdered under strange circumstances, Conan steps in to make sense of it all. A music box, a telephone call, and a staple all point to a killer no one would expect.

1-31.title: Murder at the Television Studio
1-31.overview: Richard Moore stars on the popular television show Prime Time Mystery Hour, and while Conan and Rachel enjoy the broadcast from the audience, a vicious murder takes place at the studio.

1-32.title: Murder at the Local Diner
1-32.overview: Rachel has a date and Conan is determined to find out who this guy is. But when a brutal murder takes place at the diner he’s in, Conan steps into his detective shoes to solve the case.

1-33.title: A Hunting We Will Go
1-33.overview: A treasure hunt turns scary for the Junior Detective League. They’re lost in the wild, miles from civilization, and two suspicious-looking men are sneaking around!

1-34.title: Mountain Villa Murder (1)
1-34.overview: When Rachel is invited to a friend’s villa, it seems like an ideal get-away from the city. But when one of the guests is murdered, the holiday turns into a nightmare - and Rachel’s the killer’s next target!

1-35.title: Mountain Villa Murder (2)
1-35.overview: A group of Rachel’s old friends seek to defend themselves against a deadly axe-murderer. But is the assailant really stalking them from outside of the villa - or is he lurking within?

1-36.title: Wrong Place at the Wrong Time
1-36.overview: When a real estate agent is murdered in his condo, the police suspect a well-known dentist in town. Will Conan’s investigation vindicate the beautiful dentist or debunk her perfect alibi?

1-37.title: Prickly Past
1-37.overview: When a pretty girl hires Detective Moore to help her find an old flame, Conan finds out that the man she is looking for was responsible for the death of her fiancé!

1-38.title: Flames of Confusion
1-38.overview: When a body is discovered in a bonfire, Moore finds out that the victim is the same man he’s been tailing for the past three days! Can Conan crack the case before the prime suspect leaves the country?

1-39.title: Billionaire Birthday Blues (1)
1-39.overview: A billionaire hosts a birthday gala for his daughter Reika and Detective Moore is the celebrity guest of honor. But when one of Reika’s suitors turns up dead, the remaining guests are suspects for murder.

1-40.title: Billionaire Birthday Blues (2)
1-40.overview: When a beautiful heiress is murdered on her birthday, Conan springs into action to solve the baffling crime. The stakes are soon raised, as Rachel becomes a target for the assassin’s sinister game.

1-41.title: Left in Tatters
1-41.overview: A baseball game is interrupted when the School Chairman reveals that someone has slashed the cherished Championship Flag! Scandal rocks Shore View High as Conan investigates.

1-42.title: Karaoke Killing
1-42.overview: Rachel and Serena find themselves in a Karaoke Bar with the hottest band in the land! It seems like a dream come true until the brash lead singer - Justin Moon - is poisoned right in front of their eyes.

1-43.title: Conan Is Kidnapped
1-43.overview: A lady who claims to be Conan’s mother might really be a spy working for the organization that poisoned him! Can Conan escape from her murderous intentions and find an antidote for the poison?

1-44.title: Unhappy Birthday
1-44.overview: A lazy drive through Chiyoda mountain, Tokyo, lands Kogoro, Ran, and Conan in the middle of a murder mystery surrounding the death of billionaire industrialist, Kosaku Hotta. As Conan tries to unravel the clues before the killer can strike again, he faces one disturbing reality. The prime suspects are the victim's children. It's an explosive whodunit you won't want to miss.

1-45.title: Unexpected Visitors
1-45.overview: Another day, another case as Kogoro stumbles upon the death of the President of a popular apparel company. Just why would the President be wearing an unflattering facial mask if she had been expecting company? It's just one of the many perplexing elements of a most unusual case.

1-46.title: A Game of Murder
1-46.overview: Conan and the gang's ski-trip turns deadly when a medical professor is murdered right under their noses. A secret message left by the victim points to one of his students as being the killer. However, unraveling the secret proves one of the greatest challenges the pint-sized sleuth has ever faced.

1-47.title: The Last Dive
1-47.overview: The bitter rivalry between two world-class high divers boils over as the reigning champion is found dead. Due to the nature of the injuries and eye witness testimony, it seems as if this death was nothing more than a tragic accident. But nothing is ever as it seems as the brilliant mind of Conan soon reveals.

1-48.title: No Immunity for the Diplomat (1)
1-48.overview: Conan, Richard and Rachel are joined by Harley Hartwell, a teen detective from the west coast, in solving the sealed room murder of a diplomat.

1-49.title: No Immunity for the Diplomat (2)
1-49.overview: Jimmy Kudo returns to the surprise of everyone, especially himself! As Jimmy tries to expose the real secret behind the perfectly sealed room, the rivalry between he and Harley Hartwell heats up!

1-50.title: The Book Without Pages
1-50.overview: A routine afternoon at the library turns into the hunt for a corpse after an attendant turns up missing. When Conan and the Detective Boys try to solve the mystery by staying after-hours, they find themselves trapped, in the dark, and not alone. Will they catch the killer before he catches them?

1-51.title: Driving a Bomb
1-51.overview: A relaxing day at the driving range leads Kogoro, Ran, and Conan to their next explosive case, as the president of a leading electronics manufacturer meets an untimely end. With many suspects and few clues, will Conan unravel the mystery in time to catch a killer?

1-52.title: The Mist Goblin Murder (1/2)
1-52.overview: A baffling and seemingly impossible murder is committed at a secluded Mount Takao temple. Luckily Conan and Kogoro are on the scene. It is believed that the terrible Mist Goblin (Kiritengu), a creature with super strength, haunts the temple. Conan doesn't believe in goblins, but he may have to change his tune as the evidence suggests that the Mist Goblin may be more than just a legend.

1-53.title: Weapon of Choice
1-53.overview: After finding a wounded bird on the ground Conan, Kogoro, and Ran hear a loud scream coming from the building next to them. Once upon entering the building they find a terrified woman in the hall, screaming about how she has just found her husband dead. The murder victim on the balcony, believed to have been killed by a plant pot.

1-54.title: Game Gone Bad
1-54.overview: Kogoro is invited to a party for the release of a game which stars himself. While there, Conan runs into a man who uses the alias Tequila and learns that he plans to meet with Gin and Vodka. Conan follows Tequila to the bathroom where an explosion occurs and kills the man. Conan investigates the explosion and realizes that it was a murder attempt but the wrong person was killed.

1-55.title: The Train Trick Murder Case
1-55.overview: As Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are on their way home from a hot spring in Komono, Mie Prefecture, they boarded a train together with a pair of doctors. They arrived at a station where one may change trains to another line, but no one could possibly change trains since the two lines are scheduled differently by a mere five-minute difference. At the station where the trio are to change trains to one going to Tokyo, a murder is discovered. The only suspect rides in the train with Conan's group while the victim rides on a train from a different line.

1-56.title: The Sunfish Murder
1-56.overview: Conan's on the case when the manager of a cleaning company is crushed by a piece of steel, but he encounters only dead ends in the alleyway where the murder was committed.

1-57.title: Footsteps of the Hero (1)
1-57.overview: Conan enters a Sherlock Holmes contest to win a rare first-edition book and persuades Ran Mouri and Kogoro to attend.

1-58.title: Footsteps of the Hero (2)
1-58.overview: Conan enters a Sherlock Holmes contest to win a rare first-edition book and persuades Ran Mouri and Kogoro to attend.

1-59.title: Shopping Can Be Murder
1-59.overview: The Detective Boys are back on the case when a young boy finds himself the unknowing target of a killer. Conan and his friends must use all their deductive powers to protect the tiny tot and bring a murderer to justice before he strikes again.

1-60.title: Illustrated Murder
1-60.overview: Kenjin Hanaoka is a popular painter who seems to have everything that a man could want: his own design firm, best selling books, and untold wealth. But when he decides to eat the forbidden fruit and have an affair with one of his pretty, young illustrators his life starts to come apart at the seams.

1-61.title: Ghost Ship Murder (1)
1-61.overview: Ran and Conan accompany Kogoro to Shiki Island, a very superstitious island, where many of the residents believe in local legends.

1-62.title: Ghost Ship Murder (2)
1-62.overview: Ran and Conan accompany Kogoro to Shiki Island, a very superstitious island, where many of the residents believe in local legends.

1-63.title: Gomera!
1-63.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys visit the film set of their favorite monster, Gomera, and stumble onto a real-life murder. The most puzzling aspect of the case is the prime suspect: Gomera. The kids must uncover the truth behind the grizzly killing before the death toll rises higher.

1-64.title: The Three Fingerprints
1-64.overview: Kogoro must choose between friendship and the law when an old friend is suspected of murder. It is up to Conan to find the clues and piece together the truth that will either condemn Kogoro's mentor, or set him free.

1-65.title: The Crab and Whale
1-65.overview: A relaxing night out turns into the search for a kidnapped little boy, as Kogoro Ran, and Conan come to the aide of a desperate father in his hour of need. As they search to find the truth, nothing is certain, except the kidnapper's deadly ultimatum: No police, no mercy, no time.

1-66.title: Moonless Murder
1-66.overview: How can blood from one victim, murdered on the street, wind up on the wall of an abandoned building, the railing of a rooftop, and broken glass of an upper apartment window? This is the question Conan must answer if he is to catch a crafty killer entrenched in a seemingly innocent mountain-climbing fraternity, which hides a deadly secret.

1-67.title: The Case of the Murdered Actress
1-67.overview: Kogoro is given a case to solve the sender of a threat note. His teacher Heihachiro Shiota appears at his house and decides to go to the theater, too. Conan and Ran tag along. Kogoro's case turns into a murder, but he soon breaks his backbone before Conan can solve it.

1-68.title: Knight Baron Mystery (1)
1-68.overview: Conan and the Mouris attend a mystery tour involving the Night Baron, a character from the books written by Shinichi's father, at a beach hotel.

1-69.title: Knight Baron Mystery (2)
1-69.overview: The tour takes a deadly turn when one of the guests falls from a room and is impaled on a statue.

1-70.title: Knight Baron Mystery (3)
1-70.overview: Conan closes in on the killer's identity when he realizes something he missed earlier. Meanwhile, Rachel suspects that an idol of her's, a karate champion staying at the hotel, is involved.

1-71.title: The Stalker
1-71.overview: Richard, Conan, and Rachel discover a corpse in the street. While the police believe the incident to be a random murder, the victim's past leads Conan to pin the blame on the most unassuming suspect of all!

1-72.title: Triple Terror
1-72.overview: Conan and Rachel find themselves embroiled in a murder at a private beach. However, even more disturbing than the brutal death is the list of prime suspects: the victim's triplet sons!

1-73.title: The Ship Wreck Murder
1-73.overview: An S.O.S. message in a bottle disrupts Conan's beachside vacation. Can he and his Junior Detective League friends find the young woman they believe to be the note's author?

1-74.title: Jinnai, King of Death
1-74.overview: When a killer claiming to be the King of Death sends a threat to movie star, Conan, Richard, and Rachel must stop the culprit from making good on his warning: At the stroke of Midnight, you will die!

1-75.title: Murder and Mahjong
1-75.overview: Mahjong: a game of strategy, skill, and luck - three things that a sinister murderer hopes he has on his side! Conan must stack the clues and place details in order if he is to win this terrifying game!

1-76.title: Phantom Thief 1412 (1/2)
1-76.overview: Conan enters a battle of wits with an elusive master thief known as Kaito Kid and has to stop him from stealing a precious pearl from Sonoko's family aboard a cruise ship.

1-77.title: Mysterious Masked Murder (1)
1-77.overview: When Richard is hired to find wealthy Gerard Dufour's childhood sweetheart, a murder takes place right under his nose - and the prime suspect turns up dead.

1-78.title: Mysterious Masked Murder (2)
1-78.overview: Conan and Harley Hartwell's covert investigation continues. But with precious few suspects, one big question haunts the brilliant duo: If Roland Dufour didn't commit the murder, then who did?

1-79.title: The Revengeful Robber
1-79.overview: Conan and Rachel become embroiled in a bank robbery that ends in murder. Just when Inspector Meguire thinks he's solved the crime, Conan discovers a hidden agenda that busts the case wide-open!

1-80.title: Dead Hobo
1-80.overview: When the Junior Detective League sets out to help an ailing homeless man, they end up involved in a new murder mystery. They know who did it - but can they get anyone to listen to them?

1-81.title: Two Times Trouble (1)
1-81.overview: Ran and Sonoko are getting ready to attend a huge concert by the very popular J-Pop band Two-Mix. Some hours before that, Conan and the Detective Boys go to a coffee parlor and meet a lady with sunglasses and a cap... who turns out to be the singer of the group, a woman named Minami Takayama whose voice is rather similar to Conan's.

1-82.title: Two Times Trouble (2)
1-82.overview: Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, and Genta tells Inspector Megure everything except how to find Conan. They decide to follow him and they learned who the kidnapper is and why the crime was committed.

1-83.title: The Set Up
1-83.overview: Richard witnesses a murder in the hospital, but his eyes may be playing tricks on him: he sees the same scene four nights in a row. Things get even stranger when he emerges as the prime suspect.

1-84.title: Massacre Night (1)
1-84.overview: Conan, Rachel and Serena get stranded at a ski lodge with an old teacher while someone is hiding in the dark and strangling the residents in the night

1-85.title: Massacre Night (2)
1-85.overview: After Serena was attacked, the words MASSACRE NIGHT were found written on her hand. Conan leaps into action to uncover the truth, but sometimes the truth is too much to handle.

1-86.title: Find the Kidnap Site
1-86.overview: The Junior Detective League is after a kidnapper who has dubious intentions. There's more than one life at stake if Conan can't figure out where the captive child is hidden.

1-87.title: For the Birds
1-87.overview: Conan and Rachel take Richard on a crane-watching trip, but the man responsible for the birds' well being is found murdered. The victim's son turns himself in, but Conan suspects the guy is innocent.

1-88.title: Vampire Villa (1)
1-88.overview: Richard is hired by a horror novelist to find out with whom his wife is having an affair. Later the same evening, the man is killed in a ritualistic manner and all of the house guests turn out to have motives.

1-89.title: Vampire Villa (2)
1-89.overview: Horror novelist Stefan Van Croven has been pierced through the chest with a wooden stake. Richard is convinced that the answer is right under his nose, but he doesn't know that Conan's figured out the trick.

1-90.title: Deadly Art
1-90.overview: Richard is asked to investigate a murder threat against Rika Okano, a respected artist who is up for an award. The threat is simple: If Rika receives the award, she will be murdered.

1-91.title: Hospital Homicide
1-91.overview: After Richard breaks his leg, Conan's stops by to visit and senses all is not right with Moore's hospital roommates. His suspicions are justified when a high stakes game of kidnapping and murder begins.

1-92.title: Mountain Fox (1)
1-92.overview: Richard, Rachel and Conan join a client who has hired an assassin known as "the Fox" to kill him to a hike in the mountain to stop the assassin, who turns out to be a member of the party when a guide is killed

1-93.title: Mountain Fox (2)
1-93.overview: Conan is faced with the task of tracking the Fox, the world's most notorious assassin, after the mysterious death of two campers. Can Conan stop him from killing again?

1-94.title: The Other Girl
1-94.overview: A wonderland of wintertime fun becomes a stage for tragedy following the death of an actress at the peak of her career. But a suicide note and a history of poor health don't always add up to the obvious.

1-95.title: Richard's Deadly Date
1-95.overview: Richard's set to reunite with a childhood friend, but what happens is more than Richard ever could have imagined. What do an old ink pen, a security camera, and three children add up to? Murder.

1-96.title: Jimmy Kudo Revealed (1-4)
1-96.overview: Rachel becomes suspicious of Conan when she notices that he looks a lot like Jimmy when he was his age. Meanwhile, Conan becomes involved in the investigations of the murders of a magician and a friend of his mother's.

1-97.title: The Farewell Wine Murder Case
1-97.overview: Richard is hired by a retiring billionaire to stop his daughters from killing him for the inheritance. When he is poisoned, Conan realizes that there is more to his death than meets the eye.

1-98.title: Potter's Gambit (1)
1-98.overview: While visiting a famous potter, Conan, Richard, and Rachel stumble upon what they believe to be a suicide - but was it? As the detectives soon learn, looks can often times be deceiving.

1-99.title: Potter's Gambit (2)
1-99.overview: Conan tries to unravel the mystery of Margery Taylor's apparent suicide, but how can he prove a murder took place when all of the suspects - including Richard, Rachel, and himself - share the same alibi?

1-100.title: The Memories of First Love (1)
1-100.overview: Rachel and Conan join Annette, one of Jimmy's old flames, on a weekend getaway. When the villa catches fire, Rachel risks her life to save her competition. Was the fire an accident? Or is something sinister afoot?

1-101.title: The Memories of First Love (2)
1-101.overview: Conan quickly figures out the complicated method the arsonist used to torch the house, as well as the motive behind it. But after the case is solved, Jimmy is in for an embarrassing surprise of his own.

1-102.title: Fame and Misfortune (1)
1-102.overview: A movie star hires Richard to advise him for a role as a detective. But the line between fact and fiction blurs when Richard, Rachel, and Conan discover they have front row seats to an act of murder.

1-103.title: Fame and Misfortune (2)
1-103.overview: As the media flocks to the high-profile murder case, the police prepare to charge a movie star with murder. Can Conan prove he knows who actually committed the crime?

1-104.title: The Mystery of Bludcraven Manor (1)
1-104.overview: When Conan and Rachel join Richard for a trip to Bludcraven Manor, they learn of a troubling secret that may link Morfius Bludcraven, the original lord of the estate, to a band of thieves known as The Goblins.

1-105.title: The Mystery of Bludcraven Manor (2)
1-105.overview: Conan, Richard, and Rachel attempt to decipher a secret code that promises to solve the strange mysteries of Bludcraven Manor. The unsuspecting sleuths have no clue that the goblins they hunt are very real.

1-106.title: Snapshots of Death
1-106.overview: When a photographer wins an award for capturing a fire on film, it seems like his career has been made - but when Richard accuses him of being a murderer on TV, one of their careers is about to go up in smoke.

1-107.title: The Mystery Moletian Case (1)
1-107.overview: A distraught man visits Richard about his murdered sister, but things just don't add up. A jewelry store heist and a car chase lead Conan back to the scene of the crime as another case unfolds.

1-108.title: The Mystery Moletian Case (2)
1-108.overview: A suspected murder, a jewel heist, and a missing body have Conan and the Junior Detective League working every angle to crack the case. Will Conan be able to put the clues together in time?

1-109.title: Hit and Run
1-109.overview: When a killer spies the Junior Detective League on TV, he decides to use them for his own evil purposes. Can Conan and his pals see through his plan or will they unwittingly help him get away with murder?

1-110.title: Recipe for Murder (1)
1-110.overview: When Rachel and Serena attend a cooking class and the teacher is stabbed in the back with a very thin weapon during a blackout, Conan realizes that the killer is one of her students and the weapon is hidden somewhere in the classroom.

1-111.title: Recipe for Murder (2)
1-111.overview: All four suspects had a reason to stab their cooking instructor in the back. But what was the murder weapon, where is it hidden, and how was the killer able to strike in a pitch-black kitchen?

1-112.title: School of Ghouls
1-112.overview: Intruders and disappearances lead to rumors that Teitan Elementary School is haunted. The Junior Detective League springs into action, and Conan senses that a few teachers are covering something up.

1-113.title: Prescription for Murder
1-113.overview: Rachel and Conan discover a woman's body, and the victim's best friend accuses the Medical Examiner of murder. The Doctor is definitely a heel, but is he really guilty of murder?

1-114.title: Scuba Dying (1)
1-114.overview: Conan and the gang befriend a group of university students at an ocean resort. When a banded sea snake attacks, a life hangs in the balance! Can Conan uncover the truth behind an attempted murder?

1-115.title: Scuba Dying (2)
1-115.overview: A young woman is barely clinging to life and every individual in the group of college students is a suspect. Can Conan make sense of it in time? Or will a murderer escape without a trace?

1-116.title: The Mystery Writer Disappearance (1)
1-116.overview: When a vanished mystery writer begins a new story series, his daughter seeks help from Kogoro to track him down. Conan realizes that time is running out when he finds hidden messages in his new texts.

1-117.title: The Mystery Writer Disappearance (2)
1-117.overview: The codes hidden within the novel are more complex than Conan originally thought. But how can he lead the investigators toward answers without his voice-emulating tie?

1-118.title: License to Die (1/2)
1-118.overview: While visiting Harley's hometown on the west coast, Conan joins him in investigating a mysterious serial killer case.

1-119.title: The Masked Yaiba Murder Mystery
1-119.overview: Reality and fantasy collide! After the Junior Detective League meets a member of the Laser Police - and Masked Yaiba - a murder takes place right before their eyes!

1-120.title: The Big Sting
1-120.overview: Richard is invited to a mountain retreat by a former client, but his hopes of romance end when she jumps off of a balcony to her death. Did she commit suicide or was it murder?

1-121.title: The Forgotten Bond (1)
1-121.overview: Richard loses his Yoko concert ticket and finds Maya instead. The detective discovers the two share some common interests: music, Yoko Okino, and murder!

1-122.title: The Forgotten Bond (2)
1-122.overview: A blood stain leads Conan to revisit one of the most disturbing murder mysteries of his career. Unless he can get through to Meguire, a killer could walk free!

1-123.title: The Disappearing Weather Girl
1-123.overview: A popular anchorwoman disappears and the Junior Detective League is called into action! Coded messages, symbols, and wild weather send the gang on a frenzied game of cat and mouse!

1-124.title: A Mysterious Sniper Murder Case (1)
1-124.overview: Kogoro is hired by a company president to act as his bodyguard because of threats he's gotten. At a banquet, a politician is shot and killed by a sniper while Kogoro's client is grazed by the bullet.

1-125.title: A Mysterious Sniper Murder Case (2)
1-125.overview: Seiji Ishimoto tells the police about the threat letters after he's approached by the minister's secretary, Tsuneaki Niikura. When everyone leaves the hotel room, Conan searches for clues.

1-126.title: The Traveling Drama Troupe Murder Case (1)
1-126.overview: Rachel, Serena, and the Junior Detective League are given backstage access by Tamanosuke Ito to his drama/acrobatics show that specializes in plays depicting “Edo Boy”, a feudal-themed thief responsible for crimes across Japan who has evaded arrest to the present day.

1-127.title: The Traveling Drama Troupe Murder Case (2)
1-127.overview: Tamanosuke is seen wandering around Tetsuo’s murder scene and is found attacked by Conan and Megumi.

1-128.title: The Black Organization: One Billion Yen Robbery Case
1-128.overview: A group ambushes a bank money transport vehicle and flees. Then two of the suspects are found dead.

1-129.title: The Girl from the Black Organization and the University Professor Murder Case
1-129.overview: A girl named Ai Haibara transfers into Conan's class. Ayumi invites her to solve a case with them.

1-130.title: The Indiscriminate Threatening Stadium Case (1)
1-130.overview: The Junior Detective League are at attending a soccer stadium match when Conan notices someone shot a ball with a handgun. The police arrive and Conan learns that a culprit called the TV director demanding a ransom or else he will begin shooting at people from inside the crowd.

1-131.title: The Indiscriminate Threatening Stadium Case (2)
1-131.overview: The caller demands 1¥ billion in exchange for calling the police. Conan, knowing that it is impossible to gather that amount of money in a short time, concludes the caller plans to murder someone regardless of the money.

1-132.title: Magic Lover's Murder Case (The Murder)
1-132.overview: Serena invites Rachel, to attend a meeting full of avid magic fans she met online.

1-133.title: Magic Lover's Murder Case (The Suspicion)
1-133.overview: The members of the lounge decide to leave the Hamano's body untouched to preserve the crime scene and retreat back into the lounge.

1-134.title: Magic Lover's Murder Case (The Resolution)
1-134.overview: Conan recreates the crossbow attack on the top floor and lures everyone outside. Using a tranquilizer, Conan knocks Serena out and reveals the culprit.

1-135.title: The Disappearing Weapon Case
1-135.overview: The Detective Boys accompany Ayumi Yoshida to Mitsue Mika, her barber, for a haircut. They discover that Mika died after being strangled by an unknown culprit.

1-136.title: The Old Blue Castle Investigation Case (1)
1-136.overview: The Detective Boys are on a camping trip but Dr. Agasa forgot the tent. They wander to a castle owned by Masuyo Mamiya, meet Katsuo Tabata, Mitsuru Mamiya, Takahito Mamiya, and learn that there's a secret treasure somewhere inside.

1-137.title: The Old Blue Castle Investigation Case (2)
1-137.overview: Haibara leads the investigation and is accompanied by the Detective Boys.

1-138.title: The Final Screening Murder Case (1)
1-138.overview: The Detective Boys, accompanied with Dr. Agasa, attend the final opening day of a theater as it is about to be demolished. They meet the theater owner, Akio Muramatsu, and his employees Minoru Furuhashi and Yuriko Tomosato. Seiji Haruta, a sadistic real estate agent, arrives and announces his plan to tear the theater down to make way for new business.

1-139.title: The Final Screening Murder Case (2)
1-139.overview: After gaining sufficient evidence and reviewing Toshiyuki's video, Conan uses Dr. Agasa's voice to shed light on the matter at hand and reveals the killer.

1-140.title: SOS! Message from Amy!
1-140.overview: There is a burglar on the loose! But Ayumi is sick so she stays home. When a burglar invades her house, she tries using the detective badge to call for help.

1-141.title: The Night Before the Wedding Locked Room Case (1)
1-141.overview: Heiji and Kazuha visit Tokyo accompanied by Kogoro, Ran, and Conan. They run into Heiji's father's friend and are invited to their mansion. There a murder occurs and his father's friend is found dead in a locked room.

1-142.title: The Night Before the Wedding Locked Room Case (2)
1-142.overview: Continuing the investigation, Heiji proclaims the butler was the murderer and he is taken away, screaming his innocence.

1-143.title: The Suspicious Astronomical Observation
1-143.overview: Ran, Serena, and Conan go to watch the stars. Serena is especially hoping that she will see a shooting star. Ran has a friend at the observatory that helps her use a telescope; he introduces his senpais that work at the observatory. One of them just won an award known as the "Star Pioneer". However, that same night, that same person falls from the higher level of the observatory. Conan knows that this isn't an accident - but how can he prove it?

1-144.title: The North Star No. 3 Express Leaving Ueno (1)
1-144.overview: Conan, Kogoro, and Ran take the overnight North Star Express to Hokkaido to meet a former client. Conan notices that the events is eerily similar to the plot of an unpublished novel written by his father, Yusaku, that had been stolen ten years prior.

1-145.title: The North Star No. 3 Express Leaving Ueno (2)
1-145.overview: Conan reveals the suspicious woman to be his mother, Yukiko Kudo. When Kogoro calls all the passengers to witness his inaccurate deduction, Conan figures out the trick.

1-146.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story (1)
1-146.overview: The Detective Boys go to the police station trying to figure out who robbed a nearby bank.

1-147.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story (2)
1-147.overview: Conan continues his investigation, closing in on Keizo, his prime suspect in the stabbing death of his wife, Kayo. With all pieces of the crime in place, Conan understands the hidden truth and drops hints for the officers.

1-148.title: The Sudden Street Car Stopping Case
1-148.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys wake up at 5:30 in the morning to go get in line for a roller coaster ride. There are only three other people on the train, all of them are trainspotters. One of the photographers waits outside so he can take pictures of the train coming towards him; suddenly, the ladder underneath him tips over and he falls onto the track. The train conductor quickly applies the emergency brakes, and everybody rushes out of the train to find him unhurt. However, when Conan comes back into the train to continue their journey, they find one of the other photographers dead. How can Conan make the officer in charge of the case see sense that this was a murder, not an accident?

1-149.title: The Amusement Park Bungee Jumping Case
1-149.overview: At an amusement park, an accident occurs during a Kamen Yaiba playing. As Yaiba jumped from a bungee cord, the cord burns and he falls into the water. 20 minutes later, he is found dead.

1-150.title: The Truth of the Exploding Car Case (1)
1-150.overview: Kogoro reveals that he tutored in his youth, and resolves to meet up with one of his students. However, when they go see her, her car suddenly explodes as her sister drives it out of the driveway. Kogoro is determined to solve the case and find the murderer as soon as possible.

1-151.title: The Truth of the Exploding Car Case (2)
1-151.overview: With some prodding by Conan, Kogoro surprisingly finds the truth of the case himself. He confronts the criminal, and with some help from Conan, he overcomes his ideals and gets to the heart of the matter.

1-152.title: The Mysterious Old Man Disappearance Case
1-152.overview: While on the bus home, Ran meets an old man who later disappears.

1-153.title: Sonoko's Dangerous Summer Story (1)
1-153.overview: In an attempt to find a man and fix her love life, Sonoko goes to the beach with Ran and Conan

1-154.title: Sonoko's Dangerous Summer Story (2)
1-154.overview: After talking with Tadahiko, Sonoko falls asleep in the car, and someone puts it in drive.

1-155.title: The Key in the Water Locked Room Case
1-155.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan pay a visit to an old woman. She decides to take them to her grandson, but he's found dead when they get into the house. The bathroom door is locked however. How could this have happened?

1-156.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 2 (1)
1-156.overview: Detective Sato is chasing a murderer through the school building where Conan, Haibara, Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, and Genta happen to be in.

1-157.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 2 (2)
1-157.overview: With the help of Conan, Haibara, Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, and Genta, the case is solved.

1-158.title: The Silent Ring Line
1-158.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are waiting for the train when they notice a group of people leaving work on a Sunday. Once they boarded the train the group finds their co-worker dead in an empty train car.

1-159.title: The Bizarre Legend of the Five Storied Pagoda (1)
1-159.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are visitors at the 5 story pagoda. After running into the manager, they are invited out to dinner as guest of the temple on him, thanks to the Great Kogoro. The morning after hearing the legend of 5 story pagoda, the manager (who was planning on turning it into a tourist attraction) turns up dead, hanging from the top floor, in a fashion mimicking the legend.

1-160.title: The Bizarre Legend of the Five Storied Pagoda (2)
1-160.overview: More evidence presents itself as Conan notices there are burn marks on the rope used to hang him, and also a slip knot tied. In addition, there was not enough length in the rope meaning, he would have needed to jump into the noose to commit suicide. Right before the police detective was going to call it a suicide case, Conan stuns Kogoro and reveals the method in which the murder was committed, followed by the key piece of evidence to prove who the murderer was.

1-161.title: The Murder Floating in Ryusuitei
1-161.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are at a fancy traditional Japanese restaurant where food is delivered on a small computer controlled boat that navigates over a running stream around the restaurant. Later, a murder occurs and Conan realizes the only way it could have been possible was for a person to be alone, and to use the stream to access the room.

1-162.title: Locked Room in the Sky: Shinichi Kudo's First Case
1-162.overview: Kogoro, Ran and the Detective Boys board a plane to Okinawa. Ran dreams about Shinichi's first case, which took place on a flight one year earlier.

1-163.title: The Secret of the Moon, the Star, and the Sun (1)
1-163.overview: Agasa takes the Detective Boys to his uncles house which has been abandoned fifty years ago for a treasure hunt he had set up.

1-164.title: The Secret of the Moon, the Star, and the Sun (2)
1-164.overview: Conan matches the symbols to the Hiragana table and reveals that the symbols in the objects direct to other objects in the room.

1-165.title: The Disappearing Junior Detective League Case
1-165.overview: The Detective Boys are in a puppeteer camping trip, where they are practicing for a school puppet play. At the same time, a serial killer has been spotted near the areas of the camp. While at the camp, the students disappear with their puppets, leaving the Detective Boys alone.

1-166.title: Tottori Spider Mansion Demon (The Murder)
1-166.overview: Hattori Heiji, bringing along Kazuha, is hired by the rich Takeda family to investigate a series of suspicious suicides that has plagued their mansion in Tottori Prefecture.

1-167.title: Tottori Spider Mansion Demon (The Suspicion)
1-167.overview: Conan and Heiji investigate further into the ghastly death of Nobukazu as well as the suicides of Misa, Kinuyo, and Negishi.

1-168.title: Tottori Spider Mansion Demon (The Resolution)
1-168.overview: Conan tranquilizes Kogoro and cooperates with Heiji to shed light on the case.

1-169.title: Venus' Kiss
1-169.overview: Kogoro is invited to an aquarium where an underwater play is to take place, A woman's dead body rises from the water when it's her cue to come out of a clam's shell in the play.

1-170.title: Blind Spot in the Darkness (1)
1-170.overview: Kogoro's doctor invites him, Ran and Conan over for dinner, but the evening takes a shocking turn when their host dies during a power outage.

1-171.title: Blind Spot in the Darkness (2)
1-171.overview: Conan investigates a clinic director's electrocution and uncovers clues during a blackout reenactment that reveal the truth behind the accident.

1-172.title: The Revival of the Dying Message (1)
1-172.overview: Ran, Sonoko, and Conan are at the Tropical Land ice rink where they meet a group of people: Yasuharu Misawa, Izumi Sano, Yoriko Komatsu, Chihiro Itami, and Kunitomo Oda. Chihiro goes to the women's bathroom where she is being followed by a cloaked figure.

1-173.title: The Revival of the Dying Message (2)
1-173.overview: Bloody marks are discovered at and near the crime scene. Conan puts Kogoro to sleep to reveal that the culprit.

1-174.title: The 20 Year Old Murder Case: The Symphony Serial Murders
1-174.overview: Saizo Kano, known as the Organizer of Shadows, is shot to death by his subordinates, Sadao Kujirai, Korehisa Kanie, and Teruyoshi Kameda. In the present day, while celebrating their last heist on a luxury cruise ship, Kano’s crew is picked off one by one by a mysterious killer. The stakes are raised when Heiji is thrown into the Pacific Ocean while investigating and a bomb is discovered to be hidden on the ship. Is there something more sinister afloat, or has Kano returned from the dead to enact his vengeance 20 years later?

1-175.title: The Man Who Was Killed Four Times
1-175.overview: Richard is called to investigate a suspicious murder where three people admit to killing a man for hitting him on the head.

1-176.title: Re-encounter with the Black Organization (Haibara's Part)
1-176.overview: Conan overhears the Black Organization's plans to assassinate a man. Can he stop their murder?

1-177.title: Re-encounter with the Black Organization (Conan's Part)
1-177.overview: The Black Organization kills a politician, and the assassin locks Ai in the hotel's wine cellar.

1-178.title: Re-encounter with the Black Organization (The Resolution)
1-178.overview: While hiding inside a fireplace, Ai tries to find a way to escape.

1-179.title: The Coffee Shop Truck's Wild Entrance Case
1-179.overview: Conan and the group go to a coffee shop. Nearby, two men are having a meeting. One of them gets up to go to the bathroom, and while he's gone, a truck slams into the coffee shop and smashes the other man who was still seated. Conan realizes it was a planned murder and finds evidence through the truck.

1-180.title: The Nocturne of Red Murderous Intent (1)
1-180.overview: Kogoro is invited by Yoshinori Kana to his home to investigate an unknown stalker harassing his wife, Misaki, who leaves mysterious gifts and letters.

1-181.title: The Nocturne of Red Murderous Intent (2)
1-181.overview: The case is solved, the mysterious man was figured out to be a statue hanged by a fishing rod.

1-182.title: The Big Investigation of the Nine Doors
1-182.overview: The Detective Boys are walking home one day when they discover two s shaped hooks and a ring with the initials M to A, a wedding ring. They decide to investigate seeing it as an S.O.S.

1-183.title: A Dangerous Recipe
1-183.overview: One day, The Detective Boys were bored so they picked up receipts in a convenience store to guess what the people are buying for dinner. George picks up a weird receipt with food items, a dust bin, a container, a handler light, rechargeable batteries, thin lytax gloves, and chlorine.

1-184.title: A Cursed Mask Coldly Laughs
1-184.overview: Kogorou, Ran, and Conan are invited by the hostess of a car accident charity named Shou Beniko. While driving, they find a message from the Phantom of the Cursed Masks who tells them they should not go.

1-185.title: The Murdered Famous Detective (1)
1-185.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are driving by when an arrow almost hits Kogoro. Afterwards, they stay at a hotel when an actor is found dead with a bullet in his head and all the evidence suggests it is the work of an outsider.

1-186.title: The Murdered Famous Detective (2)
1-186.overview: Conan later solves the case by showing how the culprit tried to place false evidence to lure the police to think it was an outsider.

1-187.title: The Mysterious Gun Rings in the Dark
1-187.overview: Kogoro is invited to a house as to impress the client's mother who is a finance trader, simply a loaner. Later, loaner is murdered and with the clues, the suspects are her son, daughter, or maid.

1-188.title: Risking Life for Revival: The Detective Boys in a Cave
1-188.overview: During a camping trip with Professor Agasa, the Detective Boys discover three men hiding a dead body in a cave. Conan is shot and seriously injured.

1-189.title: Risking Life for Revival: The Wounded Great Detective
1-189.overview: The Detective Boys solve the riddle of the cave's exit, but the robbers spot them. Just when all hope seems lost, Inspector Megure appears.

1-190.title: Risking Life for Revival: The Third Choice
1-190.overview: Ai points a gun at Conan and offers him three choices. Later, at the school festival, a doctor in the audience dies during Ran's performance.

1-191.title: Risking Life for Revival: The Knight in Black
1-191.overview: Inspector Megure rules the doctor's death as a suicide, but the black knight insists it's a murder before removing his mask to reveal a familiar face.

1-192.title: Risking Life for Revival: Shinichi Returns...
1-192.overview: Shinichi invites Ran to a fancy dinner, but as he struggles to find the right words, a piercing scream rings out through the restaurant.

1-193.title: Risking Life for Revival: The Promised Place
1-193.overview: With a suspect firmly in mind, Shinichi rushes to solve the murder case and tell Ran something important before Ai's antidote wears off.

1-194.title: The Significant Music Box (1)
1-194.overview: A girl named Yuuki Haruna asks Kogoro Mouri to search for a man named Shuugo whom she texts with on her pager.

1-195.title: The Significant Music Box (2)
1-195.overview: Conan investigates and realizes how the pranks were done and who is attempting to scare Haruna away.

1-196.title: The Invisible Weapon, Rachel's First Investigation
1-196.overview: Ran and Sonoko are on their way to a restaurant when Chie Yoshino allegedly falls asleep in her car but nearly misses them at the last moment. They soon meet Akio, Chie’s husband, but Ran finds his actions suspicious.

1-197.title: The Super Car's Trap (1)
1-197.overview: Kogoro wins the city lottery for first place and the reward was an all-expense paid vacation in a hotel and Conan and Ran tag along. In the hotel, a car exhibition is about to do its grand opening.

1-198.title: The Super Car's Trap (2)
1-198.overview: After investigating, Conan reveals that a cover was used to direct the fume into the car. He reveals who the culprit is.

1-199.title: Kogoro Mouri, Suspect (1)
1-199.overview: Kogoro is relaxing at a luxury hotel. After dinner, a drunken Kogoro goes missing, prompting the others to search for him. Eri calls his phone, hears it ringing from the inside of Ritsuko’s room, open the door with the chain lock in place, and find Ritsuko strangled to death. Worst of all, Kogoro emerges from the bed, much to everyone’s shock.

1-200.title: Kogoro Mouri, Suspect (2)
1-200.overview: Eri continues to pretend Kogoro is the killer but only to fool real guilty party.

1-201.title: The Tenth Passenger (1)
1-201.overview: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are riding a bonnet bus, driven by bus operator Mamoru Kajita and guided by Touko Natsume, through the mountains. On the bus already is the president of the Kagekura youth club, Takurou Yabe. The bus stops to pick up other travelers including Souchiki Okumura, who forces Kogoro out of his seat. He argues with Yabe then drinks from his water bottle and collapses dead from poison.

1-202.title: The Tenth Passenger (2)
1-202.overview: Ran reveals that the person who ran past her after Funaki was killed was Yabe. Kogoro catches him but Yabe maintains his innocence.

1-203.title: The Black Wing of Icarus (1)
1-203.overview: Mouri, Ran, and Conan are staying at a hotel where they meet the twins from the case of the cursed mask. Later, an actress comes and causes trouble. The next day, she is found hanged in her room.

1-204.title: The Black Wing of Icarus (2)
1-204.overview: Conan notices that this is not a suicide but a murder. He later proves that the culprit hang-glided to the hotel and went back by stowing in the trunk of a car.

1-205.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 3 (1)
1-205.overview: A serial arsonist sets huge fires across the city and Takagi and Miwako with the Detective Boys are out to solve it.

1-206.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 3 (2)
1-206.overview: After Ai reveals the pattern of the arsonist attack, Ayumi, Genta, and Mitsuhiko run into the arsonist who attempts to kill them.

1-207.title: The Deduction That Was Too Good
1-207.overview: Kogoro is carried by Ran and accompanied by Conan one night picking him up from a bar. While walking they witness a fight in an apartment. The next day a murder occurs. One of the man who's heard arguing comes to Moore for help to prove his innocence. The man has made good suggestions on where to find evidence which are in fact too good.

1-208.title: The Entrance to the Maze: The Anger of Colossus
1-208.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are invited for a ceremony for a ropeway which is built through a giant Goddess Statue on the mountains by Doumouto Guze. They learn that there is a rumour about a curse by the goddess' anger and Kogoro was invited to disprove it. After riding through the ropeway on the opening day, Doumouto, who has disappeared from the ropeway cart, is later found dead on the goddess' hand.

1-209.title: The Falling from Mt. Ryushin Case
1-209.overview: The Detective Boys excluding Ai, are traveling through a winding path on Mt Ryushin. There they witness a derailed car fall off the mountain. The man has died and through the evidence, Conan concludes another car rammed into that car.

1-210.title: The Water Palace of 5 Colors (1)
1-210.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan came as the substitutes for Serena and her father, the Suzuki president, and decided to attend a tea meeting at the Aonogi house. At the backyard of the mansion, there was a pond that shined in five colors. And there was a bridge which led to the tea room. While they were enjoying the pond’s colors something unusual happened… The headmaster died in the tea room, the same way as the legend.

1-211.title: The Water Palace of 5 Colors (2)
1-211.overview: Conan searches for clues to who murdered the Headmaster busily and finally figures out the trick that was used.

1-212.title: Mushrooms, Bears, and the Detective Boys (1)
1-212.overview: The Detective Boys decided to go mushroom picking in the mountains. And during it, Genta got lost in the hunting area.

1-213.title: Mushrooms, Bears, and the Detective Boys (2)
1-213.overview: Ai deduces that if they reveal themselves, the hunter trying to get rid of them will shoot them and say that he thought they were bears. So Ai and Mitsuhiko leave a clue for Conan in the form of different types of mushrooms that tells him who the killer is.

1-214.title: The Mysterious Retro Room Case
1-214.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are attending a dolphin show when a murder occurs in the hotel.

1-215.title: The Bay of Revenge (1)
1-215.overview: While Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are driving near the ocean, their car breaks down, prompting them to ask for help at a house which belongs to famous lawyer Kensuke Tachibana. There, they meet secretary Yuuichi Sakuraba, his caretaker Yaeko Kamei, his wife Yuki Tachibana, his office's accountant Noriko Sugimura, and lawyer Fumio Fujisawa. As the day progresses, Kensuke explains to Kogoro that he’s been receiving threatening letters from someone with the initials “T.K.”

1-216.title: The Bay of Revenge (2)
1-216.overview: Conan believes that Kumada was met with foul play. Conan puts Kogoro to sleep, deducing that the killer drugged Kensuke while he was out with Kumada.

1-217.title: Megure's Locked Away Secret (1)
1-217.overview: The police inform Kogoro about a serial offender attacking women wearing ganguro makeup. According to the victims’ testimony, their attacker stood at 150 centimeters tall. Kogoro mentions a similar case 20 years ago where female high school students were run over, shocking Megure.

1-218.title: Megure's Locked Away Secret (2)
1-218.overview: Megure reveals a case in the past which is why he was so anxious.

1-219.title: The Detectives Gathered Together! Shinichi Kudo vs. Kid the Phantom Thief
1-219.overview: Kogoro receives a strange invitation to join a gathering at a countryside manor. Five other detectives are also in attendance — until one is murdered.

1-220.title: The Client Full of Lies (1)
1-220.overview: Conan becomes suspicious of Kogoro's latest client, a woman looking for an old lover, even more so when a murdered man is found clutching a photo of her.

1-221.title: The Client Full of Lies (2)
1-221.overview: After a thorough investigation, Conan tranquilizes Kogoro and reveals the culprit.

1-222.title: And There Were No Mermaids (The Murder)
1-222.overview: Conan, along with Heiji, Ran, and Kazuha travel the Isle of Mermaids looking for Saori Kadowaki, who had sent a letter to Heiji asking him to save her from being killed by a mermaid.

1-223.title: And There Were No Mermaids (The Deduction)
1-223.overview: Conan and Heiji investigate Naoko's brutal murder and discover a trail of fish scales that suggest Naoko's killer came from the sea.

1-224.title: And There Were No Mermaids (The Resolution)
1-224.overview: With Kogoro stunned, Conan clears the suspects who were accused of murder, then explains that each victim was called out by the person they trusted and was lured with the promise of a personal gain before being murdered, and reveals the killer.

1-225.title: The Secret of the High Sales
1-225.overview: A boy named Rintaro asks the Detective Boys to investigate on a strange man named Yuuji Kamekura. Rintaro explains that Yuuji appeared one day at his family restaurant claiming he owes Rintaro's grandfather a favor and would like to work at the restaurant. Yuuji soon after begins living with the family and helps them improve the restaurant to the point the family are constantly busy with the customers.

1-226.title: Battle Game Trap (1)
1-226.overview: While at an arcade, Ran, Sonoko and Conan run into their English teacher, who recommends a virtual fighting game. But one player’s fun ends in death.

1-227.title: Battle Game Trap (2)
1-227.overview: Forensics show that Bito was injected with poison, but the murder weapon is still missing. Conan identifies an odd sound crucial to solving the case.

1-228.title: The Murderous Pottery Class (1)
1-228.overview: Ran, Sonoko, and Conan attend Muneyuki Mino's pottery class to make pretty mugs. Muneyuki is pleased to see Ran as her father Kogoro solved a murder case at The Forgemaster's estate. Later on, Muneyuki displays a dark personality.

1-229.title: The Murderous Pottery Class (2)
1-229.overview: Conan finds something suspicious about the pendant on the necktie and figures out Muneyuki and his methods.

1-230.title: Mysterious Passenger (1)
1-230.overview: On the way on to a ski trip, Ai is terrified when she senses the Black Organization's presence.

1-231.title: Mysterious Passenger (2)
1-231.overview: Conan and his friends are on a hijacked bus. Conan suspects an accomplice among the passengers.

1-232.title: The Apartment Degradation Case
1-232.overview: Mouri Kogoro accepts a case to help to find out who has been sending threatening phone calls and letters to a man named Mitsuo Yoshimura. On the way to Yoshimura's apartment with his friend Joji Ueda, Kogoro and Conan witness Yoshimura fall to his death.

1-233.title: The Evidence That Didn't Disappear (1)
1-233.overview: Agasa takes the Detective Boys to a neighbor named Teruya Kanou who is giving away his belongings before moving to England. While there Kanou's Papillon goes missing when the longcase clock strikes twelve and chimes twelve times.

1-234.title: The Evidence That Didn't Disappear (2)
1-234.overview: Conan notices that there is glass wool, which muffles sound, in the incinerator and realizes who the culprit is.

1-235.title: The Locked Wine Cellar
1-235.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are invited to a private party by a President of a financial business, who is known for his expensive collection and various tastes in wine.

1-236.title: The Nanki Beach Mystery Tour (1)
1-236.overview: Ran, Kogoro, and Conan go to Shirahama on a vacation they won from a shopping district lottery, and there meet a group of college students named Maki Shinjou, Tatsuhiko Yura, Madoka Mitsui, Kanako Miyahara, and Kouta Fuji. They are all in the same art club, but don't seem to get along well.

1-237.title: The Nanki Beach Mystery Tour (2)
1-237.overview: Conan investigates and finds out that Madoka was cheating on her boyfriend with another student, Fuji, but that none of them committed the murder.

1-238.title: The 3 "K"s of Osaka Case (1)
1-238.overview: Heiji invites Kogoro, Ran, and Conan to a celebration of the opening of the 3K restaurant by three American celebrities, a heavyweight boxing champion named Ricardo Barreira, a Major League Baseball player named Mike Norwood, and the pro soccer player known named Ray Curtis who Conan admires.

1-239.title: The 3 "K"s of Osaka Case (2)
1-239.overview: As Heiji is investigating the rooms, Conan suddenly appears and talks to him about that all three sport celebrities are all innocent.

1-240.title: The Bullet Train Transport Case (1)
1-240.overview: While traveling home on the Shinkansen from Osaka, Conan, Ran and Kogoro ran into Officer Satou and Takagi, who were transporting a criminal. Later, a bomb was found on the train that Officer Satou went to investigate.

1-241.title: The Bullet Train Transport Case (2)
1-241.overview: From the crime scene, Conan found a suspicious thing that makes the scene as the place of homicide. During the investigation, Conan observes three suspects. Conan points out the suspects of who the murderer is. After investigating and finding clues, Conan reveals the culprit.

1-242.title: Boy George's Misfortune
1-242.overview: Genta has been acting weird at school lately. The Detective Boys learns that he is being targeted by a killer. Genta tries to remember where he sees the killer.

1-243.title: Richard Moore's Imposter (1)
1-243.overview: Tatsuo Mori, a Mori Kogoro impersonator, arrives at the Aoiya Hotel near a creepy forest where he is invited to investigate a case where a long-haired man is said to have committed suicide 4-5 years ago.

1-244.title: Richard Moore's Imposter (2)
1-244.overview: After analyzing the clues and facts, Conan is convinced that the long-haired man and Tatsuo were murdered.

1-245.title: The Gun Shot in the Sunflower Building
1-245.overview: Conan, Kogoro and Ran all go to an isolated mansion called the Sunflower building because every 12 hours it rotates. They are having a BBQ outside while the owner is inside when they hear a shot fired. They rush inside to find the owner shot through the forehead.

1-246.title: The Mystery in the Net (1)
1-246.overview: Professor Agasa takes the Detective Boys and Conan at the beach during school break while Ran and Sonoko also happen to be on the exact beach. At night, all of them ate dinner in a hotel together with the lifeguards they met that morning. The man the lifeguards were supposed to meet didn't show up so they tried calling him but the only sound that could be heard was the sound of the waves.

1-247.title: The Mystery in the Net (2)
1-247.overview: Conan figures out the culprit and decides to use Professor Agasa's voice to reveal the trick but remembers he forgot his voice changing bow tie at the hotel.

1-248.title: The Alibi of the Soothing Forest
1-248.overview: While Conan, Ran and Kogoro are going sightseeing, the village head is killed by the somebody who visited the village head before post office lady.

1-249.title: The Idol Stars' Secret (1)
1-249.overview: Ran and Kogoro get an invitation for an engagement party from his favorite idol Youko-chan. Kaoru the one who is getting engaged is another star and a former member of a group they all used to be in. She is a fan of Kogoro and wanted him to find out who was stalking her.

1-250.title: The Idol Stars' Secret (2)
1-250.overview: Megure searches everyone for the murder weapon but it isn't found. Though they discover a listening device and find drawers tampered with.

1-251.title: The Tragedy at the OK Corral
1-251.overview: Because of Kogoro's love of horses he takes Conan and Ran to an OK corral ranch. One of their prize winning horses gets spooked and they all go running after her. They reach the horse and Conan finds blood on her horseshoe. They then find the farrier; one who shoes the horses, murdered.

1-252.title: The Kidnapper in the Picture
1-252.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys find out about a kidnapping case and decide to investigate.

1-253.title: Metropolitan Police Detective Love Story 4 (1)
1-253.overview: Satou is having an arranged marriage meeting with a man due to her mother's persistence. She arrives to find out it's Ninzaburo Shiratori. She proposes that if Takagi does not arrive to her before sunset, she will marry him whether she wants to or not. He accepts, but Takagi is busy with a store robbery.
