1-1107.overview: Conan and Kogoro visit the home of real estate company manager Sanada on a job. However, Sanada says he no longer needs his help and offers him a cancellation fee. Sanada's eagerness for them to leave leads Kogoro to question him, and Sanada begins explaining that he never intended to kill anyone. Three days earlier, Sanada's real estate office was visited by a man named Inumaru. Blackmailed over wrongdoings he never committed, Sanada asked his friend Kawakatsu for advice, but then something happened.

1-1108.title: The Secret Hidden by the Cards
1-1108.overview: Mitsuhiko and Genta enjoy playing a trading card game against each other at a table set up in a used bookstore. Conan, Ayumi, Haibara, and Professor Agasa are with them. TCG tournament regulars Nitta, Masaki, Zaizen, and Kuno show up. As usual, Zaizen heads to the bathroom before the game. He instructs Kuno to watch his valuable rare cards, so Nitta, as well as Conan and his friends, move away from the table. Suddenly, the store enters a state of chaos...

1-1109.title: Takagi and Date and the Notebook Promise (1)
1-1109.overview: Conan, Ayumi, Genta, Mitsuhiko, and Haibara visit Professor Agasa while he's sick in the hospital. On their way home, they happen upon Detective Takagi chasing down a robber. Detective Sato arrives from another direction to execute a pincer move on the robber, who is successfully apprehended. When Detective Takagi opens his police notebook to note the time of arrest, he notices the code written there by Detective Date, who passed away in a traffic accident one year ago. Thinking he may be able to decipher it, Conan reviews the code, which leads them to...

1-1110.title: Takagi and Date and the Notebook Promise (2)
1-1110.overview: Conan, Ayumi, Genta, Mitsuhiko, Haibara, and Detectives Takagi and Sato decipher the code Detective Date left in his notebook and arrive at café Poirot. They deduce the ransom handoff method described by the kidnapper based on information left at Poirot and successfully rescue Alan, the son of the vice president of a French car maker. The case seems resolved until they learn Alan was being held captive along with his friend Inukai Yuji. They must deduce the location where he is being held based on Alan's time in the car.

1-1111.title: Rube Goldberg Machine (1)
1-1111.overview: A job brings Conan, Ran, and Kogoro to a resort area in Gunma Prefecture, where they run into Inspector Yamamura investigating a case. Inoue Kohei was murdered by Rube Goldberg Machine, a device made up of a chain reaction of many simple gimmicks.

1-1112.title: Rube Goldberg Machine (2)
1-1112.overview: When the contraption that was used to kill the victim is found, the falling chimney incident at the resort area Conan, Ran, and Kogoro were visiting is investigated as a homicide. Several of the victim's acquaintances are staying nearby, so they go to question them. The victim's wife, the company's president and CEO, an old friend and shareholder, an investor with whom the victim had a rocky relationship, and the victim's mistress are all suspects. They discover one of the suspects is rather knowledgeable about the type of device found at the villa and becomes the prime suspect, but...

1-1113.title: Last Dinner for You
1-1113.overview: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro come across an Italian restaurant on fire. A nearby man rushes inside the building. In an attempt to stop him, Kogoro follows him inside, where he discovers a body. The police investigation identifies the victim as Head Chef Marcello. The man who rushed into the building was Akiyama the waiter. Later, the owner Kurasaka, his daughter Mariko, and the victim's wife Arisa arrive. The police believe a burglar broke into the closed restaurant and ran into the victim while he was cooking, but...

1-1114.title: The Holed-Up Sensation
1-1114.overview: A man armed with a gun shows up in a residential neighborhood. He takes a woman hostage and holes up inside a nearby home. Conan and Kogoro rush to the scene after seeing the situation on TV. The police are confused by the culprit's nonsensical demands. The homeowner arrives and tells the police not to worry about breaking down doors or walls since the home is vacant and will be demolished the next day. While they're talking outside, two gunshots are heard from inside the house...

1-1115.title: Chihaya and Jugo's Matchmaking Party (1)
1-1115.overview: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are refused entry to a restaurant, privatized that day to host a masked party for singles. Participating in this event, Inspector Yokomizo meets Chihaya, and both will be confronted with a murder...

1-1116.title: Chihaya and Jugo's Matchmaking Party (2)
1-1116.overview: Faced with a murder committed during a singles' masked party, the police try to find the culprit among three suspects. Nothing conclusive emerges from their interrogation, but Conan notices an important detail...

1-1117.title: Karate Teacher Mori Ran
1-1117.overview: Ran steps in as a temporary karate instructor when the dojo's regular instructor is injured. Just as the class is ending, a scream is heard from the second floor.

1-1118.title: Girls Day Mystery 2
1-1118.overview: While the boys relax at a hot spring, the girls happen to meet up at a snowy mountain resort. They are enjoying their day together when they discover that strange pranks have been happening at the resort.

1-1119.title: The Four-Person Class Reunion
1-1119.overview: Detective Kogoro is asked to be the bodyguard of the owner of a high-end host club. On the first day of his duties, he finds the owner dead in his own pool. It looks like one of the members of his annual four-person class reunion may be responsible.

1-1120.title: Mystery of the Lost Treasure
1-1120.overview: Conan accompanies Sonoko to the studio of a famous potter. While there, Conan discovers that one of his pottery pieces has been broken, and worse, that the piece was already sold! It will take Conan's skills in deductive reasoning to figure out the culprit.

1-1121.title: The Dangerous Melon Field
1-1121.overview: Detective Kogoro is asked to investigate the damages and theft of a melon farmer's crops. While at the farm, there are several mysteries they will have to solve...

1-1122.title: Stakeout 3
1-1122.overview: The kids assist Detective Takagi in trying to catch a murderer. They have to stakeout a bakery to try to find the culprit. Can they focus on solving the crime instead of focusing on pastries and sweets from the bakery?

1-1123.title: The Body on the Gunma-Nagano Border (1)
1-1123.overview: Detective Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are in Gunma after solving a missing persons case when Detective Mori calls Detective Yamamura. Detective Yamamura asks Detective Mori for help with a murder that took place directly on the border between Gunma and Nagano.

1-1124.title: The Body on the Gunma-Nagano Border (2)
1-1124.overview: Detective Yamamura's past holds a key to solving the mystery of the murder on the border between Gunma and Nagano. With the best detectives on the scene, can they solve this murder mystery? Did the victim leave any clues behind?

1-1125.title: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary 4
1-1125.overview: Ayumi is tired of so many peaceful days in a row and enlists the help of the Detective Boys to hunt for a case. Unfortunately, when one goes looking for trouble, that is exactly what they usually find.

1-1126.title: The Detective Who Lost His Mind
1-1126.overview: Detective Kogoro is called upon by a beautiful client. Fortunately, Ran sends Conan with her father, since she knows he has a penchant for being blinded by pretty women.

1-1127.title: Interrogation Room 2
1-1127.overview: A former grade school teacher confesses to committing a murder, but the more the police question him, the more questionable his testimony sounds.

1-1128.title: Conan and Megure's Two Hostages (1)
1-1128.overview: While at a bookstore, Conan stumbles upon a note from a child named Kazuo who's been kidnapped. Conan is able to switch places with Kazuo, but will he be able to outwit the kidnappers and escape himself?

1-1129.title: Conan and Megure's Two Hostages (2)
1-1129.overview: Conan helps the married couple that kidnapped Kazuo, doing his best to make sure that their child, Tetsuya, is safely reunited with them. But what fate lays in wait for Kazuo?

1-1130.title: The Suspected Infidelity of the Triple Collab (1)
1-1130.overview: The Detective Boys are having lunch and talking about their favorite band, when they spot Kobayashi-sensei, Det. Chiba and Shukichi Haneda. Ayumi assumes they are on a triple date, but...

1-1131.title: The Suspected Infidelity of the Triple Collab (2)
1-1131.overview: A poisoning occurs at the restaurant where Conan and the Detective Boys are dining, but without knowing how to plant the poison, the investigation grinds to a halt. Detective Kobayashi looks to Conan for advice.

1-1132.title: Tsuburaya Mitsuhiko's Detective Notes 3
1-1132.overview: At the venue for the "North American Flower Festival: Audition for the Role of the Lord," Mitsuhiko, Ayumi, and Genta encounter Makio Yuita and Kōzō Yuita, who are arguing. After Makio leaves, the remaining Kōzō explains that the two of them are brothers who happened to meet at the audition venue.

1-1133.title: Best Husband
1-1133.overview: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro visit the home of politician Reiko Mutsu. They are guided by her secretary, Shinji Inui, and wait inside the mansion, but Reiko doesn't appear for some time. Suddenly, Reiko's scream echoes through the mansion.

1-1134.title: Misfortune of the Positive Man
1-1134.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys become acquainted with a kind man named Shojichi Aida. While heading to Aida's apartment, they encounter a quarrel between his neighbor, Nenji Kotakara, and the landlord, Teruyo Imaizumi.

1-1135.title: Ooka Momiji's Sweet Trap (1)
1-1135.overview: A stage play modeled after Kogoro and Heiji is being planned, and Conan and the others have come to Kyoto for a meeting. When they visit the director's home, they find the producer, stage manager, and scriptwriter there.

1-1136.title: Ooka Momiji's Sweet Trap (2)
1-1136.overview: Conan, Kogoro, and Heiji are at the home of the director, Kabumoto, for a meeting about a stage play. Present are also Momiji Ooka, who claims to be Heiji's fiancée, and Hyoe Kuroda, an officer from the Metropolitan Police Department.

1-1137.title: The Secret of the Popular Restaurant's Changing Flavor
1-1137.overview: The Detective Boys are distressed to discover the flavor of popular ramen shop Ogataken's flavor has changed, so they head to the restaurant to investigate.

1-1138.title: The Moving Police Box
1-1138.overview: The Detective Boys help with the unveiling of a mobile police box car. While the vehicle is touring around, it is hijacked by some robbers, and everyone onboard is taken hostage.

1-1139.title: The Sister Troubled by Her Naughty Brother
1-1139.overview: Shigatsu Makabe comes to the Mouri Detective Agency with a request after malicious flyers were posted on his apartment condominium. Kogoro, who was conducting surveillance at the condominium, apprehends a suspicious young man, but... a few days later, a body is found in a unit of a luxury condominium.

1-1140.title: Girls Day Mystery 3
1-1140.overview: The "Five Female Detectives" aka Ran, Sonoko, Haibara, Ayumi and Detective Sato sense a suspicious high-paying part-time job advertisement that involves "dressing as ninjas and going to designated locations" to hint at a crime, and decide to go undercover to investigate.

1-1141.title: The Mori Family House Sits
1-1141.overview: Kogoro receives a request from literary critic Takahiko Kamiyu: "I am planning to go to the countryside, so I would like you to stay home and watch over my house for three days."

1-1142.title: The Ranpo Mansion Murder Case (1)
1-1142.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys visit the Edogawa Rampo Residence under the guidance of Ms. Kobayashi. Professor Goto, who manages the residence, learns about the Detective Boys and offers to guide them through the storehouse, which is not usually open to the public.

1-1143.title: The Ranpo Mansion Murder Case (2)
1-1143.overview: While Conan and the Detective Boys are visiting the Edogawa Ranpo Residence with Kobayashi-sensei, a series of murders occur. Conan realizes the case isn't over yet and rushes to solve the crime before another victim can be killed, but the culprit is already closing in on their next target.

1-1144.title: The Hotel Serial Bombing Case (1)
1-1144.overview: Conan visits Sera's hotel room at the Haido Hotel, lured in by the code used in the hotel serial bombing case. However, they realize the hotel they're at is the bomber's next target when they happen to be present when the next bomb threat is discovered.

1-1145.title: The Hotel Serial Bombing Case (2)
1-1145.overview: With help from Haido Hotel's lawyer Kisaki Eri, Conan and Sera get their hands on the previous hotel bomber codes and narrow down the room with the bomb to six rooms. With the time limit approaching, will Conan and Sera be able to identify the culprit?

1-1146.title: The Whistling Bookstore 4
1-1146.overview: While reading at Tamaki Book Cafe, the Detective Boys meet Komachi Ami, who accidentally sold a precious book that was a keepsake from her father.

1-1147.title: Stakeout 4
1-1147.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys come to an amusement park that is closing today. There, they find Detectives Takagi and Chiba disguised as security guards and holding out a stakeout.

1-1148.title: The Detective Boys and the Two Leaders (1)
1-1148.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys, accompanied by Professor Wakasa and Subaru Okiya, go to a beach in Shizuoka that is collaborating with Kamen Yaiba. Wakasa and Okiya meet and negotiate! Furthermore, an incident occurs at the beach house.

1-1149.title: The Detective Boys and the Two Leaders (2)
1-1149.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys, who are accompanied by Professor Wakasa and Subaru Okiya to the beach, encounter a case. The victim is the manager of a beach house, and the suspects are the staff. Who is the culprit? And what is the relationship between Wakasa and Okiya?

1-1150.title: Kaito Kid and the Crown Trick (1)
1-1150.overview: Kaito Kid declares his intent to steal the Siren Splash, a crown embedded with one of the world's largest tourmalines. However, Suzuki Jirokichi is confident in his newest anti-Kid device, the Fujin Road. As the clock counts down to Kid's arrival, will Conan the Kid Killer once against be able to stop the Reiwa Wizard?

1-1151.title: Kaito Kid and the Crown Trick (2)
1-1151.overview: Kid makes the Siren Splash crown vanish from its display case at the Suzuki building, but the alarm was never triggered. Just how did he do it?

1-1152.title: Last Dance
1-1152.overview: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko are invited to a dance party. While changing into their dance shoes, a scream is heard.

1-1153.title: The Yamahime of Yakushima (1)
1-1153.overview: Kogoro, Conan, and Ran visit Yakushima in Kagoshima Prefecture to investigate the case of a body being abandoned on Jomon cedar.

1-1154.title: The Yamahime of Yakushima (2)
1-1154.overview: Kogoro is certain the culprit is Tsukada, but Conan and Ran aren't so sure.

1-1155.title: Follow Them! Detective Taxi 2
1-1155.overview: A woman is robbed at a shrine's jewel-washing festival.

1-1156.title: The Ishikawa Yorumasshi Mystery (1)
1-1156.overview: Kogoro is hired to investigate a theft at a charity concert that took place three years ago.

1-1157.title: The Ishikawa Yorumasshi Mystery (2)
1-1157.overview: The video evidence suggests that the band's guitarist stole the donations from the charity concert, but Conan suspects another member.

1-1158.title: The Detective Boys and the Traditional Dream House
1-1158.overview: A couple discovers a body inside the walls of their new home.

1-1159.title: The Whereabouts of the Goodbye
1-1159.overview: Kogoro's client is found dead in her apartment. The police suspect suicide, but Conan isn't so sure.

1-1160.title: When the Shishiodoshi Sounds
1-1160.overview: Conan investigates Komada murder; a photo captures the killer’s strike but hides his face. Who is the culprit?

1-1161.title: The Secret's Afterimage
1-1161.overview: Megure suspects his subordinate of having an affair.

1-1162.title: Ayumi's Illustrated Diary 5
1-1162.overview: The Detective Boys film a documentary about Kogoro and the serial vandalism case he solved.

1-1163.title: The Counting Song Heard in the Dark
1-1163.overview: When a valuable old coin is found at an inn, a man is murdered and the coin goes missing.

1-1164.title: The 17-Year-Old Truth: The Bloodstained Knight
1-1164.overview: Conan and his friends attend a chess tournament to show support for Inspector Shiratori.

1-1165.title: The 17-Year-Old Truth: The Perceptive Devil
1-1165.overview: While watching Conan solve the murder, Kuroda recalls an unsolved case from 17 years ago.

1-1166.title: The 17-Year-Old Truth: The Far-Sighted Bishop
1-1166.overview: At a chess event, a case echoes a 17-year-old murder. Conan is asked to uncover the shadow behind it.

1-1167.title: The 17-Year-Old Truth: The Queen's Gambit
1-1167.overview: 17 years ago, Kuroda helped Asaka escape. Now, Rum sets his sights on a new target tied to the past.

1-1168.title: Genta's Casebook of the Eel
1-1168.overview: While Genta delivers food for an eel restaurant, the chef is stabbed in the chest.

1-1169.title: The Mystery of the Man-Eating Classroom (1)
1-1169.overview: A rumor begins spreading at Teitan Elementary School about a man-eating classroom.

1-1170.title: The Mystery of the Man-Eating Classroom (2)
1-1170.overview: Conan identifies the culprit who started the fire that could cancel the class visit.

1-1171.title: The Reason He Became a Butler (1)
1-1171.overview: Heiji and Kazuha happen to find themselves on the same bullet train bound for Tokyo as Momiji and Iori.

1-1172.title: The Reason He Became a Butler (2)
1-1172.overview: Momiji's butler Iori becomes involved in a murder on a train, and Momiji is taken hostage.

1-1173.title: It's a Ghost!
1-1173.overview: The Detective Boys investigate a ghost that appears on the roof of a building every Thursday night.

1-1174.title: The Glassy Water's Surface (1)
1-1174.overview: Kogoro is hired to investigate the mysterious death of a fisherman in a small town famous for its boathouses.

1-1175.title: The Glassy Water's Surface (2)
1-1175.overview: One mysterious murder turns into two in a remote port town in Kyoto prefecture.

1-1176.title: The Hero of Ishinomaki
1-1176.overview: The Detective Boys go to Miyagi Prefecture to film an episode of Kamen Yaiba.

1-1177.title: Find the Phantom Giant
1-1177.overview: The Detective Boys encounter Takagi and Chiba, who are looking for a tall man to verify a suspect's alibi.

1-1178.title: The Crimson Skeleton of Mt. Washio (1)
1-1178.overview: A sudden downpour forces Conan and his friends to seek shelter at a temple.

1-1179.title: The Crimson Skeleton of Mt. Washio (2)
1-1179.overview: The missing monk turns up dead, but Kogoro is still missing. Could it be the curse of the Crimson Skeleton?

1-1180.title: The Lucky Cat Saw Everything
1-1180.overview: While birdwatching, Conan, Ran, and Kogoro spot a suspicious man driving away from house with a body inside.

393810.name: Record of Ragnarok
393810.overview: Before eradicating humankind from the world, the gods give them one last chance to prove themselves worthy of survival. Let the Ragnarok battles begin.

similar.name: Fate/Grand Order Absolute Demonic Front: Babylonia
The Idaten Deities Know Only Peace

1-1.title: Ragnarok
1-1.overview: At the Council of Valhalla, the gods vote unanimously for humankind's extinction. But Brunhilde, eldest of the Valkyrie sisters, raises her objection.

1-2.title: Worthy Opponent
1-2.overview: In the first round of the Ragnarok battle, Han dynasty warlord Lü Bu puts up a good fight against Norse god Thor, surprising the gods in attendance.

1-3.title: Killer Move
1-3.overview: To give Lü Bu the upper hand against Thor, Brünnhilde summons her sister Randgriz and asks her to transform into a sacred weapon — the Shield Breaker.

1-4.title: Joy
1-4.overview: Lü Bu's legs are crushed by the mighty Geirröd Thor's Hammer attack, but just when all hope seems lost, the warlord's trusty horse Red Hare rides in.

1-5.title: FILE No.00000000001
1-5.overview: Chosen for the next round is the father of humankind and the man bearing more hatred towards the gods than anyone else: Adam himself.

1-6.title: Great Emulation
1-6.overview: Zeus insists on going up against Adam, who joins forces with Valkyrie Reginleif to obtain a most peculiar weapon: a knuckleduster.

1-7.title: Expelled from Paradise
1-7.overview: Just when it looks like Adam will earn humankind the victory they long for, Zeus gathers his strength to ask Adam why he's really fighting.

1-8.title: Grace Abounding
1-8.overview: Zeus has transformed into his final most powerful form, but after the beating he's suffered, he may not last much longer in the fight.

1-9.title: Tyrant of the Ocean
1-9.overview: Humankind is desperate to win the next bout, but the god they're going up against is one of the mightiest of them all: Poseidon.

1-10.title: Greatest Loser
1-10.overview: Kojiro Sasaki uses his mighty Tsubame Gaeshi move to finish off Poseidon, but the god of the sea won't be sunk so easily.

1-11.title: The Swallow Gazes into the Abyss
1-11.overview: Through the power of Valkyrie Hrist, Kojiro's broken blade is transformed into dual swords, allowing him to tap into the depths of his inner strength.

1-12.title: And Ragnarok Goes On
1-12.overview: Despite Kojiro's Niten Ganryu duel blade method, Poseidon's powerful attacks continue to wear him down. But the battle isn't over yet.

2-1.title: Good vs. Evil
2-1.overview: The gods have no intention of letting the humans win the next round; for their next fighter, they present none other than the great hero, Hercules.

2-2.title: The Indomitable War God
2-2.overview: The spectators notice that the tattoos on Hercules have grown significantly — and if they continue to grow, the hero will suffer a painful death.

2-3.title: Birth of a Monster
2-3.overview: In late 19th century London, the young son of a prostitute has a special ability that helps him survive the poverty he was born into.

2-4.title: The Final Labor
2-4.overview: Although he’s lost his left arm, Hercules remains steadfast, easily summoning the strength to unleash his ultimate move: the Twelfth Labor.

2-5.title: Requiem
2-5.overview: The brutal fourth round has pushed both fighters beyond their breaking point; when the winner is finally announced, there is no joy or celebration.

2-6.title: Conflicting Motives
2-6.overview: To capitalize on humanity's momentum, Brünnhilde pays a visit to the colossal Tameemon Raiden, the most powerful sumo wrestler in history.

2-7.title: Hundred Seals
2-7.overview: Stepping into the sumo ring to take on Tameemon Raiden is the God of Destruction, the Destroyer himself: Supreme Lord Shiva.

2-8.title: The Pinnacle of 1116
2-8.overview: Years ago, Shiva spent many happy days with his best friend Rudra. Then one day, Rudra asks Shiva to join him on a journey to the top.

2-9.title: Resonance
2-9.overview: As a child, Raiden had to suppress his full strength so he wouldn’t hurt other people. But now, to win this battle, he’s not holding anything back.

2-10.title: The Brink
2-10.overview: The match comes to a moving end. Even Zeus is impressed by humanity's powerful spirit; but he's going to make sure the gods get the ultimate victory.

2-11.title: Round Six
2-11.overview: With the scoreboard almost neck-and-neck, Buddha declares that he'll fight in the next round — but whose side will he be fighting on?

2-12.title: Zero
2-12.overview: Struck by the amount of suffering humans must endure, Zerofuku decides to absorb all of their unhappiness, but it still isn't enough to end their pain.

2-13.title: The strongest puberty in history
2-13.overview: There was once a prince who was born into great wealth and given the very best of everything. But one day, he decides to leave it all behind.

2-14.title: Legend of the Underworld
2-14.overview: Nobody knows who the strange new creature is, but he's clearly very strong. And most worryingly, Buddha can't foresee his new opponent's next moves.

2-15.title: The Way of Light
2-15.overview: It looks like the match is over. But then Buddha gets up, looking stronger than ever. Will he be able to gain another crucial point for the humans?

3-1.title: Prologue: Recollections
3-1.overview: While humanity celebrates, the sixth round's result rattles the gods. Brunhilde and Hermes reflect on the previous battles and humanity's resilience.

3-2.title: King vs. King
3-2.overview: With the gods desperate for a win, Hades steps up to avenge his brother. Humanity sends Qin Shi Huang, setting the stage for a monumental clash of kings.

3-3.title: Chi You
3-3.overview: After uniting China, Qin Shi Huang ascends Mount Tai alone to prove himself before the demon god Chi You. There, he masters the ultimate martial art.

3-4.title: A Promise and an Oath
3-4.overview: As a child, Qin Shi Huang's daily life is filled with hostility. Yet over time, he finds happiness in the close bond he forms with his strict caretaker.

3-5.title: Pride of the King of Helheim
3-5.overview: As the seventh round heats up, Hades gouges his own chest, humming as blood pours out and empowers his divine weapon with new strength.

3-6.title: Return of the King
3-6.overview: On the brink of death, Qin Shi Huang draws strength from Alvitr, unleashing the Force of the Phoenix again. Hades readies his spear for the final blow.

3-7.title: Satan
3-7.overview: For the eighth round, the gods choose Beelzebub, the god cursed by Satan. Though shunned by all, he once had three close friends who shaped his destiny.

3-8.title: Light vs. Shadow
3-8.overview: While struggling with Beelzebub's vibration-based powers, Tesla recognizes them as a form of science and counters with the full force of human ingenuity.

3-9.title: A Curse and a Prayer
3-9.overview: Tesla traps Beelzebub in the Gematria Zone and unleashes the Tesla Step, but Beelzebub learns to nullify the onslaught. The gods expect victory, but...

3-10.title: The Torch Passed On
3-10.overview: Even after Beelzebub unleashes Helheim's forbidden technique, Tesla stands firm. As the battle peaks, he recalls childhood memories of his brother.

3-11.title: Progress
3-11.overview: Though battered, Tesla is relentless, pushing Beelzebub on the defensive and to his limits. The showdown between science versus myth reaches its climax.

3-12.title: The Sun God and the Rebellious Hero
3-12.overview: The gods' next fighter is Apollo, the radiant sun god. Representing humanity is King Leonidas of Sparta. As round nine begins, neither will back down.

3-13.title: Pride vs. Pride
3-13.overview: In the past, King Leonidas of Sparta defies Apollo's prophecies and goes to war. Now, with his pride on the line, he delivers a decisive strike at Apollo.

3-14.title: Know Thyself
3-14.overview: Fueled by unyielding resolve, Leonidas slams Apollo down. As the bloodied god rises, most gods scorn his pride, but Zeus and Ares see the truth.

3-15.title: A Clash of Souls
3-15.overview: Both fighters near death but stand tall, honoring each other's valor. Leonidas transforms his shield and advances as Apollo draws his mythical bow.

247982.name: Madan Senki Ryukendo
247982.overview: Akebono City is a peaceful community overflowing with humanity. Since there was a Power Spot that released the magical power in the community, the people were distressed by the threat of the demon army Jamanga who are gathering Minus Energy from the frightened masses for a sinister purpose. The secret organization S.H.O.T. was formed to protect the people of the community from the Jamanga, concealing their existence as ordinary members of the Akebono Police Station, which considers demons beyond their jurisdiction. Kenji Narukami, a student of the Narukami Dragon God Style for fighting demons, arrives at Akebono to fight the demons, eventually getting his wish when he is transformed to RyuKenDo and faces off against Jamanga's forces together with his friends to restore peace in the community.

0-1.title: Twin Edge God GekiRyuKen Version
0-1.overview: A special episode where Kenji Narukami competes with Juushirou Fudou to see if RyuKenDo or RyuGunOu is the better Madan Warriors. This episode also introduces the various characters from the series, along with several of the weapons that the Madan Warriors use.

0-2.title: Ryujinou Gunman (Magna) Ryuguno
0-2.overview: A special episode showing how Juushirou Fudou comes to meet his partner, GouRyuGun.

1-1.title: This is the Hero!
1-1.overview: A young man sets foot in Akebono City, a town likely to be anywhere in Japan. A newly appointed police detective, Kenji Narukami. The town is under martial law. A horde of demons was pouring in and causing big panic in the city. Kenji, who stands alone, witness policemen running away at first sight of demons, also sees S.H.O.T.'s warrior, RyuGunOu, wiping out the demons thus regaining peace to Akebono City. However, a further threat to the town appears, the attack by Demon Beast Reptolilix! Kenji bravely challenged the battle...

1-2.title: Burn! Become a Flame!
1-2.overview: The people of Akebono City are suffering from the evil organization known as Jamanga. They are collecting the negative energy generated when people feel fear and anxiety for the resurrection of the Great Demon King. On the other hand, Kenji is taken to the secret base of S.H.O.T., an organization that fights against Jamanga. Therefore, he vows to fight as S.H.O.T.'s warrior, RyuKenDo, together with the sword, GekiRyuKen, who has the will and can speak languages. At that time, the Plant Demon Beast Giga Flower attacks the town. It's time to use the new key, Fire Key for RyuKenDo!!

1-3.title: Dash! King of Beasts
1-3.overview: Jamanga General, Doctor Worm, arrives with a huge armoured black tank to attack Akebono City! The demons are catching the residents one after another. Kenji comes across a female police officer who shoots and fights with a handgun. It is Ichiko and Ritsuko of the Akebono Police Department, Traffic Division. Kenji is impressed by their determination to protect their city by themselves and transform into RyuKenDo and summon the beast king, Brave Leon. Brave Leon is transformed into Leon Trike. To defeat the armoured black tank, RyuKenDo began to track them using Leon Trike!

1-4.title: Freezing Armament! Aqua Ryukendo
1-4.overview: Fire RyuKenDo defeated the advanced demon, Tsukaima using his finishing move, Blazing Slash. At S.H.O.T.'s Base, the Madan key obtained from defeating Jamanga's armoured black tank was found to be Aqua Key by The Book of Canon of Light and began to adjust. But they don't know how to use it. On the other hand, Rin pointed out from the people in the city that the stronger RyuKenDo is, the more powerful the enemy will be. Then, the Tsukaima who should have been defeated appeared again. The enemy has challenged the battle with its new flame slashing power!

1-5.title: That Guy's the Rival
1-5.overview: Kenji, who gained Fire Mode, Aqua Mode, and even the Beast King, is completely ecstatic. Around that time, another General of Jamanga, Jack Moon, appeared in Akebono City, and after searching for S.H.O.T.'s information, people were trapped in a crystal ball! Komachi, a ghost that appears in Akebono City stopped Kenji from facing the fight alone. However, he struggles with the powerful attacks from the proud swordsmen, Jack Moon. An unexpected reinforcement appeared there ...

1-6.title: Single Blow Certain Victory! Dragon Cannon!
1-6.overview: As a result of analyzing the acquired Madan Key at S.H.O.T., it became clear that it was a key to activate RyuGunOu's new powerful technique, the Dragon Cannon. So in order to acquire the powerful technique, Fudou repeatedly undergoes severe training. In the sky of the city, Jamanga's demon beast, Balloon Gunner, appeared. People who took a beam from Balloon Gunner, made them swells like a balloon and floated in the sky. Fudou, who completed the technique with amazing speed, decided to work with Kenji to defeat the enemy and save people...

1-7.title: I Summon You! Gorilla JuuOh!
1-7.overview: Giant iron weights crush buildings and cars. Akebono Police Station is in a state of trouble with the work of Jamanga. RyuKenDo struggles with the attack of the demon beast, Meganōma which can make iron weights fall from the sky. Not even a Blazing Slash can defeat it. So RyuKenDo summons a new beast king! The name is Gorilla Beast King, Fire Kong. However, Fire Kong, who has a lot of pride on the other hand, was hurt by RyuKenDo's words and ran away without listening to orders!!

1-8.title: The Demon Hidden in the Water
1-8.overview: The river flowing through the town suddenly gets dirty, and the demon beast, Edenoid appears from the water! Pollution spreads in a moment. RyuKenDo and RyuGunOu are fighting the demon, but it escapes too quickly and lost track. S.H.O.T's member, Rin Sakyo, burns hostility at the demon who soils clean water as an act that cannot be forgiven. Rin had memories of her late brother. With her brother trying to protect the river where fireflies can live, Rin headed towards the forest alone for the search where Edenoid is likely to be lurking.

1-9.title: Ring On, Bell of Friendship
1-9.overview: A mysterious giant statue suddenly appeared on the outskirts of Akebono City. S.H.O.T. strengthens vigilance against the disturbing scheme of Jamanga. Meanwhile, Kenji ends up fighting with his partner, GekiRyuKen. Then, a mysterious sound wave was emitted in Akebono City, making people wanted to cover their ear. People begin to suffer. At the same time, GekiRyuKen breaks. To stop the mysterious sound waves, Kenji, who can not transform, endured pain and jumped out to the town!!

1-10.title: The Monster from the West
1-10.overview: An incident occurred in Akebono City where various things were gnawed. People begin to fear at the sight of ancient demon creatures flying in the sky. But, Kenji had a more frightening cause of worry. It is said that his older sister who is scarier than the demon coming for a visit. If he doesn't show his older sister how well he is doing in town, he'll be taken back to the countryside. Kenji, who doesn't reveal that he is RyuKenDo, falls into a pinch. With flying demons appearing here and there, his older sister finally came to town!

1-11.title: The Thunder Key's Power
1-11.overview: In Jamanga's Base, Thunder Key with the strongest magic was fused with a part of the body from Jack Moon, and the clone, Elemoon was born. Elemoon is on the mission of defeating RyuKenDo and is rampaging by shooting lightning everywhere. Kenji and Fudou are powerless against the power of thunder. Devices in S.H.O.T.'s base are also short-circuited due to the influence of overcurrent, and Commander Amachi will carry out unprecedented ground operations. It was a strategy to hunt down Elemoon and capture it in an armoured tank!

1-12.title: Forbidden Activation! Thunder Ryukendo!
1-12.overview: The use of unadjusted Thunder Key caused GekiRyuKen to be in a state of shock, and Kenji fell into an inability to transform. In such a case, a tremendous magic wave runs in the town of Akebono City. Suddenly, a huge Jack Moon's Castle that appeared in the sky started the attack. The explosion occurred in various places by the ray which was shot indiscriminately! Hiding in shelters, among the feared people, the old town chairman called for a decision. The people of the town who stood up got on the fighter jet and headed for Jack Moon's Castle.

1-13.title: A Time-Surpassing Meeting
1-13.overview: Kenji and Fudou are staked out in abandoned factories on criminal missions. He finds and tracks the thief, but Kenji falls off the roof. After regaining consciousness, Kenji calls out to RyuGunOu, who is fighting the Tsukaima on the spot. However, he declared that he does not know about Kenji like memory loss. To tell the truth, Kenji went back in time and returned six months ago. It was a time when Fudou was fighting alone. Kenji began to talk about the upcoming fierce match against Jamanga.

1-14.title: The New Enemy
1-14.overview: A new General of Jamanga, Lady Gold, has boarded the town of Akebono City. Mysterious magic was cast on the Florist, Kaori in her flower shop, and showed an illusion of RyuKenDo slashing Ichiko and Ritsuko. Kaori's sightings spread quickly and the townspeople begin to lose trust in RyuKenDo. Also, Giant RyuKenDo began to destroy the town!! A mysterious black warrior has appeared in front of RyuKenDo who challenge Lady Gold who set the trap.
