When she is promised with the prosperity of working in the big city, Cosette is separated from her mother in the hopes a caretaker will watch over her while her mother earns some money.

similar.name: Disney's Adventures of the Gummi Bears

1-1.title: Fantine and Cosette
1-1.overview: Fantine unsuccessfully searches for a job in Montfermeil alongside her three-year-old daughter, Cosette, and eventually drops Cosette off under the care of the Thénardier family, while she travels to the economically-thriving town of Montreuil-sur-Mer. Little does Fantine know, the Thénardiers are a wicked and abusive family, who force Cosette into hard labor, while Cosette waits for the return of her mother.

1-1.overview: April 26, 1986, Ukrainian SSR. Plant workers and firefighters put their lives on the line to control a catastrophic 1986 explosion at a Soviet nuclear power plant.

1-2.title: Please Remain Calm
1-2.overview: With untold millions at risk after the Chernobyl explosion, nuclear physicist Ulana Khomyuk makes a desperate attempt to reach Valery Legasov, a leading Soviet nuclear physicist, and warn him about the threat of second explosion that could devastate the continent.

1-3.title: Open Wide, O Earth
1-3.overview: Lyudmilla Ignatenko, a Pripyat resident, ignores warning about her firefighter husband's contamination. Valery Legasov lays out a decontamination plan, complete with human risks.

1-4.title: The Happiness of All Mankind
1-4.overview: Valery Legasov and Soviet Deputy Prime Minister Boris Shcherbina consider using lunar rovers to remove radioactive debris, while Ulana Khomyuk faces government hurdles in determining the truth about the cause of the explosion.

1-5.title: Vichnaya Pamyat
1-5.overview: Valery Legasov, Boris Shcherbina and Ulana Khomyuk risk their lives and reputations to expose the truth about Chernobyl.

360388.name: When They See Us

Monsters: The Lyle and Erik Menendez Story

1-1.title: Part One
1-1.overview: In the spring of 1989, five boys of color are arrested, interrogated and coerced into confessing to the vicious attack of a woman in Central Park.

1-2.title: Part Two
1-2.overview: As the jogger case stirs tensions nationwide, the families of the boys and their lawyers prepare for a bitter legal fight against the city of New York.

1-3.title: Part Three
1-3.overview: The boys struggle with the difficult reality of life behind bars. Years later, Raymond, Antron, Yusef and Kevin return home as men to a changed world.

1-4.title: Part Four
1-4.overview: At age 16, Korey begins a brutal journey through the adult prison system. A shocking turn of events reveals the truth of the crime, long ignored.

410047.name: The Billion Dollar Code
410047.overview: In 1990s Berlin, an artist and a hacker invented a new way to see the world. Years later, they reunite to sue Google for patent infringement on it.

1-1.title: Episode 1
1-1.overview: Juri and Carsten recount meeting in Berlin and securing Deutsche Telekom's investment in their completely unproven idea – with a hard one-year deadline.

1-2.title: Episode 2
1-2.overview: After their success at the Kyoto conference and a trip to Silicon Valley, Carsten and Juri return to Berlin and start seeking investors for the company.

1-3.title: Episode 3
1-3.overview: When Juri storms out of the deposition, Carsten flies to Budapest to convince him to rejoin the case while the lawyers debate pulling the plug.

1-4.title: Episode 4
1-4.overview: The trial begins in Delaware, with an array of expert witnesses and consultants summoned to assist. On the last day, both Juri and Brian take the stand.

1-1.overview: Rick searches for his family after emerging from a coma into a world terrorized by the walking dead. Morgan and Duane, whom he meets along the way, help teach Rick the new rules for survival.

1-2.title: Guts
1-2.overview: Rick unknowingly causes a group of survivors to be trapped by walkers. The group dynamic devolves from accusations to violence, as Rick must confront an enemy far more dangerous than the undead.

1-3.title: Tell It to the Frogs
1-3.overview: Rick makes a decision to go back to Atlanta to retrieve the bag of guns and save a man's life. Lori and Shane must deal with the surprising return of someone they thought was dead.

1-4.title: Vatos
1-4.overview: Rick's mission to Atlanta is jeopardized when things go awry. Jim becomes unhinged in camp.

1-5.title: Wildfire
1-5.overview: Rick leads the group to the CDC after the attack. Jim must make a terrible life and death decision.

1-6.title: TS-19
1-6.overview: Rick and the group are allowed into the CDC by a strange doctor, but all is not what it seems in their newfound haven.

2-1.title: What Lies Ahead
2-1.overview: Rick leads the group out of Atlanta. On the highway, they are stopped by a threat unlike anything they have seen before. The group searches for someone who has gone missing.

2-2.title: Bloodletting
2-2.overview: Coming to the aid of another, Rick discovers a possible safe haven. Shane must go on a dangerous mission to get badly-needed medical supplies.

2-3.title: Save the Last One
2-3.overview: The group desperately awaits Shane's return. Shane finds himself trapped in a school, surrounded by the undead. Daryl and Andrea search for someone in the woods.

2-4.title: Cherokee Rose
2-4.overview: Shane makes a deadly sacrifice which leads to unusual behavior and self-distancing. The rest of the group tries to hang on somewhere between living to die and dying to live.

2-5.title: Chupacabra
2-5.overview: Glenn, the only one breaking barriers between both groups, knows far too much for his comfort level. Daryl finds a sign of life and, in his delirium, tries to make it back to the farm alive.

2-6.title: Secrets
2-6.overview: Secrets are told and secrets are revealed. Hershel refuses to acknowledge the world’s new reality. Andrea comes out of her shell. Everyone is becoming more and more aware that “everything is food for something.”

2-7.title: Pretty Much Dead Already
2-7.overview: Hershel sets a deadline. All secrets are out in the open. Glenn stands up for himself and Shane takes charge.

2-8.title: Nebraska
2-8.overview: Rick and the others try to restore order in the aftermath of a terrible discovery. Hershel takes up an old habit and disappears, Rick and Glenn must follow him into town.

2-9.title: Triggerfinger
2-9.overview: Trapped, Rick, Hershel and Glenn fight to survive against new foes, both dead and alive. Shane finds Lori in danger on the road and makes it his mission to bring her back to the farm.

2-10.title: 18 Miles Out
2-10.overview: Rick and Shane are in conflict over the fate of an outsider; Andrea helps Hershel's daughter face a crucial decision.

2-11.title: Judge, Jury, Executioner
2-11.overview: Rick sides with Shane on an important decision, causing Dale to worry that the group is losing its humanity. Carl's actions have unintended consequences on the group.

2-12.title: Better Angels
2-12.overview: The group learns that someone dangerous may be on the loose near the farm. As night falls, Rick, Shane, Daryl, and Glenn comb the woods to handle the situation and keep the group safe.

2-13.title: Beside the Dying Fire
2-13.overview: Rick and Carl return from the woods to find the farm in jeopardy. The group is split up in the ensuing chaos. With things looking grim, Rick's leadership is questioned.

3-1.title: Seed
3-1.overview: With the world growing increasingly more dangerous and Lori’s pregnancy advancing, Rick discovers a potentially safe haven. But first he must secure the premises, pushing his group to its limit.

3-2.title: Sick
3-2.overview: After a traumatic event, a life hangs in the balance. Complicating matters, the group must also deal with a potential threat to their new surroundings.

3-3.title: Walk with Me
3-3.overview: After witnessing an accident, Andrea and Michonne are introduced to a new community of survivors. As conflicts arise with their new acquaintances, a decision must be made.

3-4.title: Killer Within
3-4.overview: The group is severed and lives are put in jeopardy. In Woodbury, Merle has a request for the Governor.

3-5.title: Say the Word
3-5.overview: After another loss, Rick struggles. Michonne remains suspicious of the Governor as he throws a party with a unique twist for the people of Woodbury.

3-6.title: Hounded
3-6.overview: As Andrea grows closer to the Governor, Michonne makes a decision about Woodbury. Glenn and Maggie go on a run. Rick struggles.

3-7.title: When the Dead Come Knocking
3-7.overview: The Governor presses for information. A new guest arrives at the prison, forcing Rick's hand.

3-8.title: Made to Suffer
3-8.overview: Andrea steps up as the people of Woodbury are thrown into uncharted territory. At the prison, a new threat arises.

3-9.title: The Suicide King
3-9.overview: Rick tries to rescue a member of his group. Woodbury is in disarray after a recent attack. New guests raise concerns at the prison.

3-10.title: Home
3-10.overview: As the group debates their next course of action, Rick wanders after a lost friend. Daryl and Merle question their choices. The Governor restores order in Woodbury and makes plans to punish those responsible.

3-11.title: I Ain't a Judas
3-11.overview: Rick and the group must make a choice when security is threatened. With Woodbury in a police state, Andrea grows uneasy.

3-12.title: Clear
3-12.overview: Realizing they are heavily outgunned against the Governor's forces, Rick leads an expedition to get more weapons.

3-13.title: Arrow on the Doorpost
3-13.overview: In an effort to prevent any more deaths, Rick and the Governor meet to come up with a peace treaty.

3-14.title: Prey
3-14.overview: The Governor chases a dissenter who fled Woodbury. While the Governor is gone, a traitor tries to sabotage his upcoming plans.

3-15.title: This Sorrowful Life
3-15.overview: Rick and the group are faced with a serious problem. If they want a truce with the Governor, they will have to make a huge sacrifice.

3-16.title: Welcome to the Tombs
3-16.overview: Rick and the group have to seriously consider if the prison is worth defending as the Governor's impending attack looms over their heads.

4-1.title: 30 Days Without an Accident
4-1.overview: Rick and the group are as close to an ideal life as possible at the prison. Will they be able to hold on to humanity in the face of a new evil?

4-2.title: Infected
4-2.overview: As the group faces a brand new enemy, Rick and the others must fight to protect the livelihood they worked so hard to create at the prison.

4-3.title: Isolation
4-3.overview: As one group leaves the prison in search for supplies at a local college, those who stay must deal with recent losses while preserving what remains.

4-4.title: Indifference
4-4.overview: While on a supplies mission to a local college, members of the group run into multiple hurdles. Things at the prison are getting worse.

4-5.title: Internment
4-5.overview: Multiple enemies put pressure on Rick and the group. Could this finally be the breaking point for the survivors and the prison?

4-6.title: Live Bait
4-6.overview: A familiar face returns as each member of the group struggles to find his or her humanity in a world of constant threats.

4-7.title: Dead Weight
4-7.overview: A new and scary chapter is unfolding at a camp outside the prison. Will peace be attainable with the addition of new members?

4-8.title: Too Far Gone
4-8.overview: Just when everything started to calm down at the prison, Rick and his group now face imminent danger and destruction. This time, they might not win.

4-9.title: After
4-9.overview: As Rick deals with old wounds, members of the prison have to come to terms with their new environment and ask themselves if survival alone is enough.

4-10.title: Inmates
4-10.overview: The group encounters many obstacles in their quest to find stability and safety, but sometimes all they have to guide them is hope.

4-11.title: Claimed
4-11.overview: Just when Rick thinks he's going to be able to relax, he's faced with multiple immediate threats. Other members of the group deal with their past.

4-12.title: Still
4-12.overview: Faced with the day-to-day survival of life outside shelter, a simple request by someone in the group leads to a bizarre but enlightening mission.

4-13.title: Alone
4-13.overview: As one group finds what may be an ideal shelter, another group comes to realize that the best protection comes from those around them.

4-14.title: The Grove
4-14.overview: After finding an idyllic place to establish a new shelter, the group starts to question whether it is possible to go back to the way things were.

4-15.title: Us
4-15.overview: However brutal some survivors believe they must be to stay alive, we get to see that faith can sometimes be the strongest survival tool.

4-16.title: A
4-16.overview: Many paths collide. Rick faces sheer brutality. The group struggles to survive.

5-1.title: No Sanctuary
5-1.overview: We learn the true motives of the Terminans as Rick and the group find themselves in a vulnerable situation. Will they be able to work together?

5-2.title: Strangers
5-2.overview: With supplies running low and not knowing whether to trust the people around them, Rick leads a mission where the risk might not be worth the reward.

5-3.title: Four Walls and a Roof
5-3.overview: Rick and the group find themselves pitted against some very nasty people, but our group might just have a plan to gain the upper hand.

5-4.title: Slabtown
5-4.overview: Beth gets to meet a whole group of other survivors, but what looks safe and nice on the outside has a bit of a dark side.

5-5.title: Self Help
5-5.overview: A new set of issues confront our group while on a mission. Will they be able to push through and survive these challenges? Or better yet, each other?

5-6.title: Consumed
5-6.overview: Cautiously, members of our group must venture into a familiar location on a heroic rescue mission. It's a huge stage, but so are the stakes.

5-7.title: Crossed
5-7.overview: Between holding down the church and going on a rescue mission, our group is spread pretty thin. Is this going to be the breaking point?

5-8.title: Coda
5-8.overview: Rules and morals have been tossed aside by new enemies. Rick will try to find a peaceful agreement, but they might prefer violence.

5-9.title: What Happened and What's Going On
5-9.overview: After all the recent trials the group has faced, a slight detour might prove to be the solution they've been looking for.

5-10.title: Them
5-10.overview: Life on the road has left the group beaten and beleaguered. Will they be able to trudge along? Are they even the same people they once were?

5-11.title: The Distance
5-11.overview: Lasting through a spectacular storm, Rick and the group meet a seemingly friendly person. Can they be trusted or are they just manipulating Rick?

5-12.title: Remember
5-12.overview: Adjusting into a new lifestyle is proving difficult for the group. Has life on the road proven too treacherous to go back to who they once were?

5-13.title: Forget
5-13.overview: Rick and the group continue to acclimate to their new surroundings. Will they be able to go back to normalcy? Then again, what is normal now?

5-14.title: Spend
5-14.overview: While trying to secure their new home, Rick and his group face many challenges, some life threatening. Is this really the utopia it seems to be?

5-15.title: Try
5-15.overview: The group realizes that sheltered life might not be possible as life within the walls starts to mimic life outside. Will these setbacks break Rick?

5-16.title: Conquer
5-16.overview: Daryl experiences trouble on a run, while Rick and his group continue to feel like outsiders in Alexandria, where trouble is creeping into the gates.

6-1.title: First Time Again
6-1.overview: Rick and the group are still having trouble assimilating into Alexandria. Will a new threat bring them closer together or drive them further apart?

6-2.title: JSS
6-2.overview: Just when it looks like things can return to normal, or as normal as things can be in the apocalypse, a new problem arises for the Alexandrians.

6-3.title: Thank You
6-3.overview: A return home doesn't go as expected.

6-4.title: Here's Not Here
6-4.overview: A new face and setting are introduced. With all that's gone on in the apocalypse, can people be trusted?

6-5.title: Now
6-5.overview: Trouble is inside and outside the gate.

6-6.title: Always Accountable
6-6.overview: Daryl, Abraham and Sasha encounter many obstacles and a new threat while trying to return to Alexandria.

6-7.title: Heads Up
6-7.overview: Things in Alexandria are quiet, briefly.

6-9.title: No Way Out
6-9.overview: While trying to escape Alexandria, Rick and his group meet trouble when sudden noise draws walkers towards them with what could be fatal consequences.

6-10.title: The Next World
6-10.overview: A simple scavenging run proves to be more tricky, when the survivors are not the only ones after a goldmine of supplies.

6-11.title: Knots Untie
6-11.overview: After Rick comes to the realization that Alexandria might not be as safe as he thought, decisions must be made about where to go from here.

6-12.title: Not Tomorrow Yet
6-12.overview: Rick and the group realize the only way to maintain the peace of Alexandria is to fight a new enemy. This time, though, our group might be outmatched.

6-13.title: The Same Boat
6-13.overview: With no hope of safety in Alexandria, Rick and his band of survivors soon discover a larger world with new dangers and new opportunities.

6-14.title: Twice as Far
6-14.overview: Two separate groups leave Alexandria for supplies, and while both worry over the future of the community, they will face immediate danger.

6-15.title: East
6-15.overview: When someone goes missing in Alexandria, the community goes on alert, and search parties venture out.

6-16.title: Last Day on Earth
6-16.overview: To save one of their own, Rick's group must venture outside the walls; their experience changes their lives forever.

7-1.title: The Day Will Come When You Won't Be
7-1.overview: Rick and his group kneel helplessly before Negan and the Saviors. What Negan does will haunt those who survive forever.

7-2.title: The Well
7-2.overview: For a number of familiar faces, a new, well-established community seems too good to be true.

7-3.title: The Cell
7-3.overview: A new group of survivors seem to have it all in their impressive community, however, there is a price.

7-5.title: Go Getters
7-5.overview: Saddled with grief and surrounded by enemies, members of the group try to find safety at the Hilltop before it's too late.

7-6.title: Swear
7-6.overview: Someone stumbles upon a brand new society unlike anything seen before.

7-7.title: Sing Me a Song
7-7.overview: A deeper look at the Sanctuary and the world of the Saviors. Members of Alexandria look for supplies.

7-8.title: Hearts Still Beating
7-8.overview: Negan's unwelcome visit to Alexandria continues as other members scavenge for supplies and things quickly spin out of control.

7-9.title: Rock in the Road
7-9.overview: Rick and the group are led to a new community where they are introduced to its inhabitants and ruler. A familiar face resurfaces.

7-10.title: New Best Friends
7-10.overview: While searching for a missing Alexandrian, Rick and his group encounter a mysterious collective, its inhabitants unlike any they have come across.

7-11.title: Hostiles and Calamities
7-11.overview: An Alexandrian discovers that he must navigate the mysterious, confusing and horrifying world within the Saviors' Sanctuary.

7-12.title: Say Yes
7-12.overview: The group scavenges for supplies; back in Alexandria, someone must make a morally challenging decision.

7-13.title: Bury Me Here
7-13.overview: Things do not go as planned when a group of Kingdommers deliver goods to the Saviors during a routine supply drop-off.

7-14.title: The Other Side
7-14.overview: The Saviors visit the Hilltop unexpectedly, surprising everyone, with plans of taking more than supplies.

7-15.title: Something They Need
7-15.overview: A group of Alexandrians embarks on a journey to the distant community; one member of the group must make a heartbreaking decision.

7-16.title: The First Day of the Rest of Your Life
7-16.overview: The stakes continue to grow higher as paths cross; the group enacts an intricate plan.

8-1.title: Mercy
8-1.overview: Rick and his group, along with the Kingdom and Hilltop, have banded together to bring the fight to Negan and the Saviors.

8-2.title: The Damned
8-2.overview: The plan involving Alexandrians, Kingdommers and Hilltoppers unfolds. As Rick continues to fight, he encounters a familiar face.

8-3.title: Monsters
8-3.overview: Conflict with the Saviors leads to unintended consequences for the Hilltop, the Kingdom, and Alexandria; morality proves tricky in wartime.

8-4.title: Some Guy
8-4.overview: A new weapon in the Savior arsenal proves to be a giant hurdle as fighting continues between Rick's forces and those of the Saviors.

8-5.title: The Big Scary U
8-5.overview: With war raging all around him, we get a close look at Negan and the lives of the Saviors during the conflict through a familiar set of eyes.

8-6.title: The King, the Widow, and Rick
8-6.overview: With things looking up for Rick and the group, an argument breaks out at the Hilltop; the consequences of the decision are life versus death.

8-7.title: Time for After
8-7.overview: Negan has to enlist the help of his lieutenants in solving a huge issue facing the Sanctuary; Rick and the group continue to enact the plan.

8-8.title: How It's Gotta Be
8-8.overview: Every story and battle comes crashing together.

8-9.title: Honor
8-9.overview: Rick faces new difficulties after a battle. Meanwhile, the fight continues in other communities as core members face hard decisions.

8-10.title: The Lost and the Plunderers
8-10.overview: Groups unite their forces and converge on the Hilltop. Meanwhile, Aaron and Enid search for allies. Simon takes matters into his own hands.

8-11.title: Dead or Alive Or
8-11.overview: Daryl finds himself in bad company as his group heads to the Hilltop; Maggie makes difficult decisions at the Hilltop; Gabriel's faith becomes tested.

8-12.title: The Key
8-12.overview: Hilltop's leadership faces a difficult dilemma after the arrival of unexpected visitors. Rick comes face to face with an adversary.

8-13.title: Do Not Send Us Astray
8-13.overview: Trouble arises when unexpected visitors arrive at the Hilltop and the community is thrust into action; heartbreaking discoveries are made.

8-14.title: Still Gotta Mean Something
8-14.overview: A Heaps prisoner makes a discovery; Carol searches for someone in the nearby forest; Rick and Morgan find themselves in the company of strangers.

8-15.title: Worth
8-15.overview: With the threat of the Saviors still looming, Aaron continues searching for allies. Daryl and Rosita take action and confront an old friend.

8-16.title: Wrath
8-16.overview: The communities join forces in the last stand against the Saviors as all-out war unfolds.

9-1.title: A New Beginning
9-1.overview: Rick and his group make a risky run into Washington, D.C. to search for artifacts they will need to build the civilization he and Carl envisioned.

9-2.title: The Bridge
9-2.overview: The communities join forces to restore a bridge that will facilitate communication and trade. Someone is gravely injured at the construction site.

9-3.title: Warning Signs
9-3.overview: Rick's vision for the future is threatened by a mysterious disappearance that divides the work camp where the communities are building a bridge.

9-4.title: The Obliged
9-4.overview: Rick's vision of a civilized future is threatened by a sudden reckoning with past sins that remain unavenged and unforgiven.

9-5.title: What Comes After
9-5.overview: Rick is forced to face the past as he struggles to maintain the safety of the communities and protect the future he and Carl envisioned.

9-6.title: Who Are You Now?
9-6.overview: The Survivors encounter unfamiliar faces outside the safety of their community's walls and must decide whether or not this new group can be trusted.

9-7.title: Stradivarius
9-7.overview: Carol seeks out an old friend living alone in a wilderness teeming with walkers; survivors make the perilous trek to a new home.

9-8.title: Evolution
9-8.overview: A small rescue mission braves a dangerous herd in their hunt for a missing comrade, only to discover a surprising threat that could doom them all.

9-9.title: Adaptation
9-9.overview: The group unmasks a disturbing and dangerous new threat. An escaped captive revisits his past.

9-10.title: Omega
9-10.overview: A captive or a refugee? A new arrival at the Hilltop opens up about the leader of a group of mask-wearing savages. A search party sets out on a daring mission to find two missing friends.

9-11.title: Bounty
9-11.overview: The savage group led by Alpha confronts the Hilltop in a harrowing attempt to retrieve her daughter; a supply run for the Kingdom turns into a dangerous quest.

9-12.title: Guardians
9-12.overview: While one community struggles to ease tensions that threaten to divide from within, the true nature of another group comes into focus; a mission to rescue a friend has deadly consequences.

9-13.title: Chokepoint
9-13.overview: Daryl's daring rescue mission forces Alpha to unleash a group of her own to retrieve what belongs to her, even if the price is paid in blood; the Kingdom's plans to reunite the communities are put in jeopardy.

9-14.title: Scars
9-14.overview: An outsider's arrival forces Alexandria to rehash devastating old wounds; eye-opening secrets from the past are revealed.

9-15.title: The Calm Before
9-15.overview: The fair at the Kingdom is underway, with all four communities coming together in celebration for the first time in years, while some pacts are renewed, other deals will come at a much steeper price.

9-16.title: The Storm
9-16.overview: In the aftermath of an overwhelming loss, the communities must brave a ferocious blizzard; as one group deals with an enemy from within, another is forced to make a life or death decision.

10-1.title: Lines We Cross
10-1.overview: The group continue to train in Oceanside in case the Whisperers return. Tensions are high as our heroes struggle to hold onto their concept of civilization.

10-2.title: We Are the End of the World
10-2.overview: The origins of Alpha and Beta are revealed. Alpha attempts to toughen up Lydia as they prepare to walk with the dead. Meanwhile, the Whisperers create their herds.

10-3.title: Ghosts
10-3.overview: The threat of the Whisperers return leads to paranoia sweeping over Alexandria; in the meantime, Carol battles with the need for revenge.

10-4.title: Silence the Whisperers
10-4.overview: Still paranoid Alexandrians get riled up over the Whisperers and take their fear out on Negan; back at Hilltop, the group deals with an unexpected safety issue.

10-5.title: What It Always Is
10-5.overview: Supplies go missing from Hilltop, Negan is idolized by an Alexandrian, and Ezekiel holds a secret.

10-6.title: Bonds
10-6.overview: Carol and Daryl go on a mission together while Siddiq struggles to solve a mystery.

10-7.title: Open Your Eyes
10-7.overview: Carol pushes boundaries that make Daryl uncomfortable. Alpha and Beta have reservations about someone.

10-8.title: The World Before
10-8.overview: A fight causes tensions in Oceanside while the Alexandrians set out on a high-stakes mission.

10-9.title: Squeeze
10-9.overview: Our group must figure out how to get out of a precarious situation.

10-10.title: Stalker
10-10.overview: Our group must defend Alexandria from a threatening outside force.

10-11.title: Morning Star
10-11.overview: The Whisperers are coming for Hilltop. After Daryl and Lydia's encounter with Alpha, the communities must decide whether to run or fight. Meanwhile, Eugene's communication with Stephanie gets complicated.

10-12.title: Walk with Us
10-12.overview: Alpha and the Whisperers attack Hilltop, with Negan's help.

10-13.title: What We Become
10-13.overview: Michonne takes Virgil back to his mysterious island to reunite with his family; in exchange, Virgil promises weapons that could change the tide of the Whisperer War.

10-14.title: Look at the Flowers
10-14.overview: Heroes and villains reckon with the aftermath of the Hilltop fire; Eugene takes a group on a journey to meet Stephanie, with the hopes of befriending another civilisation.

10-15.title: The Tower
10-15.overview: The communities prepare for the final battle of the Whisperers' War. Meanwhile, Eugene's group encounters Princess.

10-16.title: A Certain Doom
10-16.overview: The final battle against Beta and his allies is at its peak. Aaron and Alden find themselves in a predicament.

10-17.title: Home Sweet Home
10-17.overview: Maggie has returned with a story she is not ready to share, even when her past catches up to her. Negan’s safety is at stake again. Daryl and Maggie fight an unseen and unknown threat.

10-18.title: Find Me
10-18.overview: An adventure for Daryl and Carol turns sideways when they come across an old cabin. It takes Daryl back to the years when he left the group after Rick disappeared as he relives a time that only the apocalypse could manifest.

10-19.title: One More
10-19.overview: Gabriel and Aaron search for food and supplies to bring back to Alexandria. Small tragedies lead to bigger tragedies as faith is broken and optimism is fragmented when they are put to the ultimate test.

10-20.title: Splinter
10-20.overview: Eugene, Ezekiel, Yumiko and Princess are captured and separated. Princess struggles with memories of her traumatic past and tries to escape one way or another with the help of Ezekiel.

10-21.title: Diverged
10-21.overview: Daryl and Carol come to a fork in the road and head their separate ways. Each going into their own type of survival mode, the easiest of challenges become much harder. Will their individual journeys be the tipping point needed to mend their friendship, or is the distance between them permanent?

10-22.title: Here's Negan
10-22.overview: Carol takes Negan on a journey, hoping to minimize the increasing tension. Negan reflects on the events that led him to this point and comes to a conclusion about his future.

11-1.title: Acheron (1)
11-1.overview: Daryl leads a mission team to scavenge the military base he discovered. Maggie tells her story, prompting a new mission for survival that only Negan can lead. Eugene and his group go through assessment by the Commonwealth's paramilitary police.

11-2.title: Acheron (2)
11-2.overview: Maggie's mission takes the team through a subway tunnel, challenged by lurking walkers and a recalcitrant Negan. With Eugene's group, Yumiko seeks answers about her brother and demands expedited processing into the Commonwealth.

11-3.title: Hunted
11-3.overview: Maggie's mission team gets separated and hunted by the Reapers. Carol, Rosita, Magna, and Kelly attempt to catch horses for Alexandria. Judith, R.J., Hershel, and Gracie cope with their parents going away.

11-4.title: Rendition
11-4.overview: Daryl and Dog get captured by the Reapers. Taken to the Meridian, they reconnect with a familiar figure from their past.

11-5.title: Out of the Ashes
11-5.overview: Aaron, Carol, Lydia, and Jerry go to the Hilltop ruins for blacksmith tools and nearby game; Eugene's group goes through orientation at the Commonwealth; Maggie and Negan trudge through the woods; Judith and the kids clash with teenagers.

11-6.title: On the Inside
11-6.overview: Escaping from walkers, Connie and Virgil hide in a house occupied by mysterious creatures. Pope tests Daryl's loyalty to the Reapers with a conflicting mission. Kelly leaves Alexandria in search of Connie.

11-7.title: Promises Broken
11-7.overview: Maggie and Elijah learn a new survival tactic from Negan. Eugene's group clears walkers to pay their fines. Yumiko interviews for an upper-class job. Daryl learns more about Leah and the Reapers. Gabriel encounters a man of God.

11-8.title: For Blood
11-8.overview: The Reapers defend Meridian from an incoming herd. Pope suspects Maggie is behind the attack, while Daryl treads carefully. Alexandrians scramble to protect themselves when a violent storm leaves them vulnerable to walkers.

11-9.title: No Other Way
11-9.overview: Daryl, Maggie, Gabriel, Negan, and Elijah battle the Reapers for food. Aaron and the Alexandrians must survive a storm.

11-10.title: New Haunts
11-10.overview: The heroes experience Halloween in the Commonwealth; Daryl and Rosita undergo military training led by Mercer; Carol investigates Ezekiel's medical condition.

11-11.title: Rogue Element
11-11.overview: Eugene looks for Stephanie after she mysteriously goes missing. Connie investigates a story on Trooper Davis. Carol helps Hornsby with a labor dispute at a drug farm.

11-12.title: The Lucky Ones
11-12.overview: Aaron and Maggie meet Governor Pamela Milton as she tours Alexandria, Oceanside and Hilltop. Ezekiel finds himself lucky during a routine checkup. Eugene processes Max's story.

11-13.title: Warlords
11-13.overview: Maggie, Lydia, and Elijah help a stranger from another community called Riverbend. They run into Aaron, who tells them about a mission he embarked on with Gabriel as emissaries for the Commonwealth.

11-14.title: The Rotten Core
11-14.overview: Maggie, Lydia, and Elijah help Aaron and Gabriel on a rescue mission. In the chaos, Negan finds himself watching over Hershel. Sebastian coerces Daryl and Rosita into pulling a heist.

11-15.title: Trust
11-15.overview: Hornsby marches Daryl and troops to confront Maggie at Hilltop. After a harrowing heist, Rosita gets Connie, Kelly, Eugene, and Max to investigate the Miltons. Ezekiel helps hospital patients in need.

11-16.title: Acts of God
11-16.overview: Maggie prepares to defend Hilltop and the people of Riverbend against Hornsby. Meanwhile, Hornsby hires Leah to kill her.

11-17.title: Lockdown
11-17.overview: Daryl and Negan rush to the Commonwealth to stop Hornsby from going after their families. Pamela deals with protestors demanding justice for Sebastian's crimes. Mercer needs Rosita's help to fight a swarm.

11-18.title: A New Deal
11-18.overview: Carol makes a deal with Pamela to wipe the slate clean on behalf of her friends. Aaron, Jerry, Lydia, and Elijah get on the road to Oceanside to fill them in on a plan. The Commonwealth celebrates Founders Day.

11-19.title: Variant
11-19.overview: Eugene goes on the run after the Founders Day incident. Pamela tasks Mercer to investigate his whereabouts, to Max and Princess' dismay. Meanwhile, Aaron, Jerry, Lydia, and Elijah encounter an unusual complication at an abandoned Renaissance Faire.

11-20.title: What's Been Lost
11-20.overview: Daryl and Carol investigate the whereabouts of their friends after Pamela disappeared them from the Commonwealth. Unfortunately, their only lead is Hornsby. Meanwhile, Pamela asks Yumiko to prosecute Eugene on behalf of the Commonwealth.

11-21.title: Outpost 22
11-21.overview: Separated from their children, Maggie, Gabriel, and Rosita track a military convoy to a mysterious destination. Ezekiel, Kelly, Negan, and Annie find themselves at a work site. Daryl and Carol follow a train that has taken Connie aboard.

11-22.title: Faith
11-22.overview: Ezekiel and Negan team up to lead a clandestine labor revolt against the Warden. Aaron, Jerry, Lydia, and Elijah catch up with Luke and Jules fleeing Oceanside. Eugene stands trial with Yumiko as his defense attorney.

11-23.title: Family
11-23.overview: The Alexandrians and the prisoners head back to the Commonwealth to confront Pamela Milton. A swarm approaches the city.

11-24.title: Rest in Peace
11-24.overview: Daryl and Carol rush Judith to the hospital. Rosita, Eugene, and Gabriel search for Coco. Maggie and Negan take arms against Pamela. As the citizens of the Commonwealth deal with the herd, our heroes assemble for one last stand to save their future.

277466.name: Noddy's Toyland Adventures
277466.overview:
Noddy's Toyland Adventures was a children's television programme that was broadcast from September 1992 until December 1994 and again from 1999 to 2001 on the BBC. It was produced by Cosgrove Hall Films and was produced and shown in stop-motion animation.

It follows the adventures of Noddy a little wooden doll who lives in Toyland with his red and yellow taxi often trying to make sixpence or getting himself in trouble. His best friends Big Ears, Mr Plod and Tessie Bear are always ready to lend a hand, especially when he gets tricked by Gobbo and Sly the wicked Goblins. Whatever the situation the episode mostly ends with Noddy laughing and nodding his head which makes the bell on his hat ring.

cast.name: Benedict Campbell
cast.character: BIg Ears / Mr. Plod / Clockwork Clown (voice)

cast.name: Michael Stark
cast.character: Mr. Wobblyman / Clockwork Mouse / Mr. Sparks / Mr. Jumbo (voice)

1-1.title: Noddy Loses Sixpence
1-1.overview: Noddy begins to look for the milkman's watch for sixpence in return but ends up losing sixpence from his customers until Big Ears helps him.

1-2.title: Noddy and the Goblins
1-2.overview: The Goblins steal Noddy's car and hat, and Big Ears and Mr. Plod help Noddy catch the goblins.

1-3.title: Noddy and the Naughty Tail
1-3.overview: Noddy sets out with Martha Monkey to find her magic rubber but Martha Monkey's tail is being naughty.

1-4.title: Noddy and the Pouring Rain
1-4.overview: Noddy is sad because the heavy rainfall and Big Ears' umbrella. Instead, the Train Man makes him a porter for a day.

1-5.title: Noddy and Martha Monkey
1-5.overview: Noddy lets Master Tubby wash his car, who ends up putting gingerbeer in the car instead of petrol. Since Noddy has to give his car for repair to Mr. Sparks, he runs the errands of the day on Big Ears' bicycle, with the help of Martha Monkey.

1-6.title: Noddy and the Kite
1-6.overview: Noddy and Tessie bear go to have a picnic and fly Noddy's kite on a windy day and instead end up losing eggs and the milk churn the kite was tied to.

1-7.title: Noddy's New Friend
1-7.overview: Noddy makes a new friend, Bunkey, who was thrown out from a circus caravan. But Bunkey ends up stealing things to help Noddy and his friends.

1-8.title: Noddy and His Bell
1-8.overview: There has been a burglary at Mrs. Skitte's larder and Noddy is accused because she had heard some jingling in the night. Now, everyone in Toyland is avoiding Noddy while Big Ears and Tessie Bear helps him solve the mystery.

1-9.title: Noddy and the Milkman
1-9.overview: Noddy looks after Bumpy Dog while Tessie Bear goes to visit her aunt. The milkman has to go out of town and Noddy promises to deliver his milk but Bumpy dog becomes a niusance.

1-10.title: Noddy Gets A New Job
1-10.overview: While Mr. Plod recovers from an accident, Big Ears and Noddy are left in charge of keeping law and order in Toytown.

1-11.title: Noddy and the Broken Bicycle
1-11.overview: Big Ears gets injured in an accident and also gets his bike broken. Noddy runs errands to help him buy a new bike.

1-12.title: Noddy and the Special Key
1-12.overview: As everyone goes to the seaside on a hot day, Noddy and Big Ears have an adventure all because of a magic Goblin's key that clockwork mouse gives them.

1-13.title: Noddy Delivers Some Parcels
1-13.overview: Noddy decides to deliver some parcels to earn some money to buy BIg Ears a present for his birthday.

2-1.title: Noddy and the Missing Hats
2-1.overview: Noddy and Big Ears have their hats switched and Noddy loses Big Ears' hat.

2-2.title: Noddy and the Useful Rope
2-2.overview: Noddy gets a rope from Mr. Tubby and uses it to run various errands in the day for Mr. Jumbo and others.

2-3.title: Noddy Loses his Bell
2-3.overview: Noddy loses his bell due to Martha monkey's tail which Bumpy finds in a puddle and wears it on its collar.

2-4.title: Noddy Cheers up Big Ears
2-4.overview: Big Ears is sad that his tyre burst and Noddy promises him a surprise by 3 o'clock to cheer him up.

2-5.title: Noddy Goes Shopping
2-5.overview: Noddy goes shopping since Big Ears is sick. But he gets confused about the list and runs into some adventures!

2-6.title: Noddy Borrows an Umbrella
2-6.overview: Noddy borrows Big Ears' umbrella to drop Tessie Bear home. He refuses to leave the umbrella out of sight because Big Ears threatens to take his bell away otherwise.

2-7.title: Noddy Meets Some Silly Hens
2-7.overview: Noddy decides to help Mr. & Mrs. Straw by taking their hens to the market. Mr. Sparks gets a fire engine and helps Noddy get his car out of the farm pond and other errands with the hens.

2-8.title: Noddy Lends a Hand
2-8.overview: Noddy leaves his car at the garage and wants to be useful to people. Mrs. Tubby has errands that Noddy runs for her with some adventures.

2-9.title: Noddy Finds a Furry Tail
2-9.overview: Noddy finds a furry tail in his car one morning and tries it on. Everybody finds it amusing as he goes around the town flaunting it and finding the person whose tail it is.

2-10.title: Noddy Sets a Trap
2-10.overview: The toy town folks complain that Noddy and his car played tricks on them during the night because they heard the car go "Harp! Harp!" However, Noddy along with Tessie bear and Big Ears set up a trap to catch the thief.

2-11.title: Noddy and the Magic Night
2-11.overview: Noddy and Tessie Bear are surprised to see the moon in the pond and believe that it is a magical phenomenon of the night. But Big Ears clears this misconception.

2-12.title: Noddy to the Rescue
2-12.overview: Master Tubby runs away from home after being scolded by his parents. Noddy, Big Ears, Mr. Plod and Mr. Sparks form a search party and go to the forest to look for Master Tubby.

2-13.title: Noddy Has a Bad Day
2-13.overview: Noddy has a bunch of errands to run during the day but all of them become problems to solve.

3-1.title: Noddy and the Fishing Rod
3-1.overview: Noddy enters the Toyland fishing contest and catches more than anybody expected.

3-2.title: Noddy and the Warm Scarf
3-2.overview: Noddy delivers long scarves to Noah's Ark but the giraffes refuse to wear them. The next day, there are a series of mischief in Toyland.

3-3.title: Noddy the Champion
3-3.overview: Big Ears coaches Noddy for Sports Day in Toyland.

3-4.title: Noddy and the Golden Tree
3-4.overview: The goblins put Noddy's car under a spell to get Big Ears to tell them the location of the Golden tree.

3-5.title: Noddy and his Unhappy Car
3-5.overview: Noddy is upset with his car as it is malfunctioning and he misses out on multiple fares. As a result, Noddy's car runs away.

3-6.title: Noddy has an Afternoon Off
3-6.overview: Noddy has an afternoon off that he spends doing favours for everyone so he can give Tubby bear a big red juicy apple.

3-7.title: Noddy the Magician
3-7.overview: Noddy buys some magic spells from Sammy the Sailor and accidentally ends up spilling them on the Toyland folks.

3-8.title: Noddy and his Money
3-8.overview: Big Ears and Noddy trick the goblins into admitting that they were stealing the money that Noddy wanted to use to help his friends.

3-9.title: Noddy Borrows Some Trousers
3-9.overview: After Master Tubby's prank, Noddy is left without clean pants and borrows Big Ear's trousers for Mrs. Noah's picnic

3-10.title: Noddy and his Alarm Clock
3-10.overview: Noddy's alarm clock is broken and he needs to help out with Diana doll's charity sale. How will Noddy wake up now?

3-11.title: Noddy Buys a Parasol
3-11.overview: Noddy wants to buy a parasol that he has seen at Dinah Doll's stall. To earn the money, he helps Clockwork Clown and Sammy Sailor and even opens a cleaning stall in the market. Will he earn enough money before the parasol is sold?

3-12.title: Noddy Tastes some Cakes
3-12.overview: Noddy wants to earn two sixpences so he can enter the Toytown Cake Tasting Contest, so he's delighted when Sally Skittle asks him to look after her children. But it's very tiring work, even with the help of Martha Monkey and her dressing up box!

3-13.title: Noddy the Dancer
3-13.overview: It's the evening of the Toytown Dancing Competition, and Tessie Bear has asked Noddy to be her partner. The only trouble is, he doesn't know how to dance - can he learn in time?

3-14.title: Noddy and Father Christmas
3-14.overview: Father Christmas is coming to Toyland, and he's invited all the toys to a special Christmas party in the market square. But the trouble is, Sly and Gobbo the Goblins are threatening to spoil everything.

4-1.title: Noddy and the Magic Watch
4-1.overview: Noddy decides to buy himself a watch at Dinah Doll's stall, but on his way home, he is stopped by the mischievous Martha Monkey, who forces Noddy to drive to Stoney Bridge. Noddy does so and at 12:00, the entire world of Toyland, except for Noddy, is turned into lifeless statues!

4-2.title: Noddy and the Goblins
4-2.overview: Noddy is driving to the train station to collect a precious parcel for Miss Pink Cat, but the Goblins steal it before Noddy arrives. Can Big Ears and Noddy catch the Goblins and return the precious parcel to Miss Pink Cat?

4-3.title: Noddy and the Treasure Map
4-3.overview: Miss Pink Cat is organising a Top Toy Award in Toyland. When Noddy borrows a map from Mr. Tubby Bear and discovers it leads to hidden treasure, he finds himself with a surprise entry.

4-4.title: Noddy and the Singing Bush
4-4.overview: The Goblins want to get their hands on a magic singing bush. They put a spell on Noddy, but everyone comes to help and the Goblins are sent packing.

4-5.title: Noddy Gets Caught in a Storm
4-5.overview: Noddy and Bert Monkey decide to make some money by picking as many blackberries as they can. But as soon as they fill their baskets, the Goblins steal them! What will Noddy do when he finds the Goblins?

4-6.title: Noddy and the Noisy Drum
4-6.overview: Master Tubby Bear is given a new drum on his birthday, but when the Goblins cast a Can't Stop spell on him and he can't stop playing it, the noise starts to drive everyone mad!

4-7.title: Noddy Tidies Toyland
4-7.overview: Miss Pink Cat has offered a reward for rubbish collection, and Noddy is determined to win! However, he also has to collect Mr. Spark's car from the stream. Can he manage to tidy Toyland in time to collect the reward?

4-8.title: Noddy and the Bouncing Ball
4-8.overview: The Goblins are up to mischief again! They secretly swap Bumpy Dog's brand new birthday ball for their magic one, which whizzes around Toyland creating havoc and making noises. However, good old Big Ears soon comes to the rescue...

4-9.title: Noddy is Far Too Busy
4-9.overview: Noddy is very busy – he must earn enough sixpences to buy a beautiful scarf for Tessie Bear, and keep his promise to Mr and Mrs Noah. But will Noddy remember the important job he was supposed to do? And why are there strange, muddy footprints all over Toytown?

4-10.title: Noddy Tells a Story
4-10.overview: Bert Monkey's naughty tail knocks over Mr Tubby Bear's can of paint. Noddy thinks he is helping Bert by pretending that an imp knocked the paint over. But telling stories usually leads to more trouble.

4-11.title: Noddy and the Artists
4-11.overview: Everyone goes painting crazy, except for Dinah Doll. No one wants to buy from her stall anymore, so she decides to leave Toyland - unless Noddy and Big Ears can persuade her to stay.

4-12.title: Noddy the Nurse
4-12.overview: Big Ears and Noddy decide to have a tin-can day to frighten away the Goblins. But the Goblins have got other ideas and nothing goes to plan.

4-13.title: Noddy and the Driving Lesson
4-13.overview: Noddy needs to earn some sixpences quickly. Tessie Bear has a good idea but Noddy isn't too sure. The ‘good idea’ is letting Clockwork Mouse drive Noddy's car!

389597.name: Solo Leveling
389597.overview: They say whatever doesn’t kill you makes you stronger, but that’s not the case for the world’s weakest hunter Sung Jinwoo. After being brutally slaughtered by monsters in a high-ranking dungeon, Jinwoo came back with the System, a program only he could see, that’s leveling him up in every way. Now, he’s inspired to discover the secrets behind his powers and the dungeon that spawned them.

similar.name: I'm Standing on a Million Lives
HELL MODE: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing

0-1.title: How to Get Stronger
0-1.overview: Jinwoo recaps the events of the story so far, from his humble beginnings as the Weakest Hunter of All Mankind to his newfound power and renewed purpose.

1-1.title: I'm Used to It
1-1.overview: Around ten years ago, gates that connected our world to another dimension began to appear, leading to the rise of hunters who would traverse these gates to fight the magic beasts within. Sung Jinwoo, E-Rank hunter, is the weakest of them all.

1-2.title: If I Had One More Chance
1-2.overview: Jinwoo and his party appear to have cleared a low-level dungeon, when a hidden path to an unfamiliar temple is revealed. There they encounter a set of commandments and a group of monsters that cause them absolute despair.

1-3.title: It's Like a Game
1-3.overview: Jinwoo remains behind in the temple dungeon to save his few surviving party members, and with a swing from the god statue's blade, his life comes to an end—or so it seems, before he wakes up in a hospital bed.

1-4.title: I've Gotta Get Stronger
1-4.overview: Having entered the instance dungeon located inside the subway, Jinwoo levels up time and time again by fighting waves of magic beasts. As he gradually makes his way forward, he finds a long stairway leading deeper underground.

1-5.title: A Pretty Good Deal
1-5.overview: Jinwoo joins a party led by Hwang Dongsuk to meet the headcount necessary for a C-Rank dungeon. Joined by another temporary hire, Yoo Jinho, the party defeats beasts without much trouble, but Jinwoo has suspicions about the group's lack of a healer.

1-6.title: The Real Hunt Begins
1-6.overview: While the C-Rank dungeon raid by Jinwoo and the others seems to be progressing well, the moment they step into an area covered in mana stones with a sleeping dungeon boss, things take a wrong turn.

1-7.title: Let's See How Far I Can Go
1-7.overview: As Jinwoo continues his training, he completes a daily quest one day by doing more than the quest requires, and a key that leads to a certain item appears in front of him.

1-8.title: This Is Frustrating
1-8.overview: Jinwoo answers a Hunter's Association request to take part in the raid of a D-Rank dungeon, where he encounters a few familiar faces.

1-9.title: You've Been Hiding Your Skills
1-9.overview: At the D-Rank raid, Jinwoo is reunited with four of the Cartenon Temple survivors. Together, they explore the dungeon with Kang Taeshik and his men. After splitting up, they hear a scream, and then...

1-10.title: What Is This, a Picnic?
1-10.overview: Jinwoo survives tragedy once again, but Woo Jinchul warns him that Hwang Dongsoo, an S-Rank hunter, may be after his life. Determined to grow stronger, Jinwoo teams up with Jinho to raid a succession of C-Rank dungeons, but they attract attention...

1-11.title: A Knight Who Defends an Empty Throne
1-11.overview: Out of the blue, a "job-change quest" pops up in Jinwoo's window. Feeling that it may help him get stronger, he enters the gate. Inside, he fights wave after wave of enemies, culminating in a knight who brings back memories of the Cartenon Temple.

1-12.title: Arise
1-12.overview: Drained from endless battle, Jinwoo sees a phantom of his past self. To overcome his own past as the Weakest Hunter of All Mankind, he struggles to find a way to clear the job-change quest.

1-13.title: You Aren't E-Rank, Are You
1-13.overview: After a scheduled meeting with Jinah's teachers, Jinwoo is asked to talk to one of her classmates, Han Song-yi, who is working as a hunter. In an effort to show her the harsh reality of the job, Jinwoo takes her to a raid designated for new hunters of the White Tiger guild.

1-14.title: I Suppose You Aren't Aware
1-14.overview: After being trapped inside of a red gate, Jinwoo has to contend with a bloodthirsty pack of ice elves who question his humanity.

1-15.title: Still a Long Way to Go
1-15.overview: Having completed his promise to Jinho to clear 19 dungeons, Jinwoo is stronger than he was when he fought the Cerberus. In order to gather the ingredients for the Elixir of Life and save his mother, he once again enters the S-Rank Demon's Castle dungeon.

1-16.title: I Need to Stop Faking
1-16.overview: Jinwoo realizes that he'll need to become even stronger in order to clear the Demon's Castle and decides to have his hunter rank reassessed.

1-17.title: This Is What We're Trained to Do
1-17.overview: Before attempting to finish the Demon's Castle, Jinwoo decides to earn some money to help prepare.

1-18.title: Don't Look Down on My Guys
1-18.overview: The Hunters Guild strike team is confronting the high orc shaman Kargalgan when Jinwoo crashes the fight.

1-19.title: The 10th S-Rank Hunter
1-19.overview: Jinwoo officially becomes an S-Rank hunter, allowing him to finalize his preparations for the Demon's Castle.

1-20.title: Looking Up Was Tiring Me Out
1-20.overview: Seeking the remaining ingredient for the Elixir of Life, Jinwoo continues his conquest of the Demon's Castle.

1-21.title: It Was All Worth It
1-21.overview: Jinwoo tries to cure his mother with the Elixir of Life while preparations for the 4th Jeju Island Raid begin.

1-22.title: We Need a Hero
1-22.overview: Sparks fly as the S-rank hunters spar in preparation for the Jeju Island raid.

1-23.title: It's Going to Get Even More Intense
1-23.overview: As the S-Rank hunters continue fighting, they're confronted by a new magic beast resembling a humanoid ant.

1-24.title: Are You the King of Humans
1-24.overview: Jinwoo arrives at Jeju Island to save the S-Rank hunters, but to do that he'll have to face the Ant King.

1-25.title: On to the Next Target
1-25.overview: After no shortage of hardship, the 4th Jeju Island raid comes to a close. But for Jinwoo, the hunt never ends.

78987.name: Black Cat
78987.overview: The bounty hunter Sven is barely scraping by when he crosses paths with the Black Cat (a.k.a. Train Heartnet) and the young bio-weapon Eve. The three new companions will need more than luck to survive when they find themselves sought by both the Chronos Numbers and a Taoist revolutionary group called the Apostles of the Star.

0-1.title: The Distant Cat
0-1.overview: Creed Diskenth uses the power of the media to reveal Chronos' existence to the world. While the Chrono Numbers become anxious, Sephiria gives temporary power to Belze, and goes with plans to confront Train. Unbeknown to her, Charden is waiting to ambush her.

1-1.title: The Solitary Cat
1-1.overview: Train, better known as Black Cat, completes another mission for Chronos, and is informed of his next mission. Later, Sven is inside a restaurant, planning how to catch his next target. A parade is happening outside, celebrating a new governor coming into office. One of the waitresses informs Sven that the new governor is also a gangster, the same man that Sven is targeting. A party is held that night, and Sven learns he isn't the only one targeting the governor. The infamous Black Cat is as well, though with a very different objective...

1-2.title: The Hesitant Cat
1-2.overview: Sven goes back to his usual sweeper to find some more work. Not long after, a girl runs in with a couple of thugs not far behind. Sven steps in and drives the thugs off. After talking to the girl, he finds out that the thugs have her little sister hostage, and she has the ransom money for her sister's return. She offers Sven the money if he can get her sister back. Will Sven take the job?

1-3.title: The Cat in the Dark
1-3.overview: Sven accepts the task of rescuing Elena's sister, Eve, and makes an attempt to infiltrate the manor, but without success. Afterwards, Sven learns that Eve is not really Elena's sister, nor is Elena who she appears to be. Later, Sven discovers Eve in a park, and decides to talk with her, and he shows Eve there's a entire world outside the manor she's been held in. Unfortunately for Sven, Torneo's men find them, and forcibly take Eve back to the manor. Sven comes to realize that Eve is not merely a bio-weapon, she's a human being with thoughts and feeling of her own, and becomes even more determined to rescue her, no matter what the cost.

1-4.title: The Grinning Cat
1-4.overview: As Sven begins to put his plan into action, to save Eve from Torneo, Black Cat is right behind him. Meanwhile in the Torneo's basement the thief Rinslet discovers a shocking truth about Eve. Back upstairs Sven and Black Cat make their own attempts to get Eve, with their own reasons. Who will get Eve and what is the shocking truth?

1-5.title: The Departing Cat
1-5.overview: As Sven heals at a hideout with Eve and Rinslet, Train's conscience grows. With his decision to leave Chronos, Creed is sent out to pull him back in. When he fails Chronos sends more operatives. Will they pull Train back to Chronos?

1-6.title: The Cat Under Fire
1-6.overview: Coming back from his first failed attempt to bring back Train, Creed returns. With Train fully turning his back on Chronos it is all up to Creed. Since his first attempts failed Creed uses his magic to kidnap Train. When that doesn't work he goes for the thing Train cares about the most... Saya. Can Train stop him?

1-7.title: The Wounded Cat
1-7.overview: Train awakens in Sven and Eve's company. Confused and saddened, he has to decide what course of action to take with his life next. As Sven goes out to get supplies, Eve comes to realize that she has to repent for her sins as well. Meanwhile, someone from Chronos is close by, looking to capture Eve.

1-8.title: The Sweeping Cat
1-8.overview: Rinslet Walker accepts a dangerous new job, seeking help, she looks for Sven to ask for his assistance. Meanwhile, coming to a new town, Sven, Eve and Train look for their next target, a man who works at the town's garden. Unbeknown to them, a group known as the Apostles of the Stars, people bent on the destruction of the world, are also targeting this man, though for a different reason.

1-9.title: The Charming Cat
1-9.overview: A man named Ganza is terrifying the residents of a town, coming out at night and killing people with his bare hands. Two members of the Apostles of the Stars attempt to recruit him to their group, but Ganza refuses, he'd much rather spend his time killing innocent people. Meanwhile, Train and the others learn of Ganza. Train, Sven and Eve come up with a plan to lure out and capture Ganza, but their plan doesn't turn out the way they had hoped.

1-10.title: The Cat Unleashed
1-10.overview: A summit conference between leaders is being held, and the Apostles of the Stars plan to interrupt it in the form of a revolution. Train, learning that Creed is alive, goes to confront him, abandoning his friends in the process. Eve and the others follow to try and stop the Apostles of the Stars from causing chaos. Sven has a terrible vision, and races to find and protect Train from powers beyond his current state.

1-11.title: The False Cat
1-11.overview: A man named Woodney, claiming to be the legendary assassin, Black Cat, meets Eve. Eve helps him out of a potentially dangerous situation. Soon afterwards, a member of the Apostles of the Stars, Durham, appears, eager to kill Black Cat. Train saves Eve and Woodney, and then confronts the gunman. Who is the superior gunman, Train or Durham?

1-12.title: The Fighting Cat
1-12.overview: Train learns where the Apostles of the Stars base is, and leaves the group to go after Creed. Sven and the others quickly follow after Train, desperate to prevent him from doing anything foolish. Meanwhile, three members of Chronos infiltrate Creed's base, determined to finish off the Apostles of the Stars once and for all.

1-13.title: The Love Cat
1-13.overview: Kyoko, a member of the Apostles of the Stars, leaves the group, along with Charden. They are being targeted for their betrayal. Train and Eve go to see if there are any good bounties available to capture, and come across Kyoko. Another member of the Apostles of the Stars, Dr. Kanzaki, has plans to test a new experiment, a bullet that will supposedly turn whatever it hits into a monster. His intention is to use Kyoko as a test subject. Can Train stop him?

1-14.title: The Kitty Cat
1-14.overview: Having been affected by the bullet Dr. Kanzaki made, Train is forced to inhabit a smaller and younger body. Train and Eve come across a group of orphaned kids living in an abandoned part of town. A group of gangsters have plans, they want to tear down the abandoned buildings for new development, and will even go as far as killing all the children in their way. Can Train and Eve stop them?

1-15.title: The Cat and the Lizard
1-15.overview: Sven learns of a group of sweepers that gather and team up to take out the more dangerous targets. After discovering that the group is after Creed Diskenth, Sven tries to prevent Train from learning, worried that this will cause Train to recklessly go after Creed again. To distract him, Sven has Train and Eve help a woman get back her pet lizard, Flora. They soon find out that this isn't the easy task they expected, as Flora isn't an ordinary lizard.

1-16.title: The Napping Cat
1-16.overview: Train travels toward a port where he can get a boat to reach Kraken Island, where the Apostles of the Stars are. He decides to take a faster route, and goes through a dangerous canyon. Train soon collapses, and later awakens in a strange house. He meets a girl who looks remarkably like Saya. He stays there for a while, and learns more about this mysterious girl called Saki, and of the troubles that confront her.

1-17.title: The Cat Deploys
1-17.overview: Chronos and the sweepers make plans to leave and go to the island where the Apostles of the Stars' headquarters is. Dr. Kanzaki, however, doesn't plan on letting the sweepers reach the island alive. He sends monsters to destroy the sweepers, leaving them with no choice but to fight before they can even reach the island.

1-18.title: The Sprinting Cat
1-18.overview: Train and the others arrive on the island, where the Apostles of the Stars are located. Eve fights Leon, while the others attempt to get rid of the soldiers and other members blocking their way to Creed. Can the sweepers and Chronos defeat the Apostles of the Stars?

1-19.title: The Cat's Showdown
1-19.overview: The war against the Apostles of the Stars continues. While Sven fights against Preta Ghoul, Train confronts Creed. Sephiria informs Train that the only way to defeat Creed is with a titanium bullet. Creed, having given up on Train joining him, is determined to kill him. Who will win in this climactic battle?

1-20.title: The Drowning Cat
1-20.overview: Having returned from their mission, Train and the others rejoice. Rinslet discovers something called The Eden Project, meanwhile, members of Chronos betray the organization. Sven decides that Eve should leave, and go on to live her own life with girls her own age. Eve however, doesn't want to leave him, and runs off to think for a while. Unbeknownst to the group, someone is after Eve's power.

1-21.title: The Cat Bares Claws
1-21.overview: Eve has been captured, and placed inside a machine called Eden. Sven and Rinslet talk to Tearju, Eve's creator. She explains about The Eden Project. The goal is to eliminate violence and greed by using nanomachines to control humans. Can Train and the others save Eve from her fate?

1-22.title: The Cat's Paradise
1-22.overview: As Eden rains down nanomachines on a city full of people, everyone else tries to think of a plan to rescue Eve. Chronos and the Apostles of the Stars team up with Train and the others, and come up with a plan to lure Eden to the ground. Will they succeed?

1-23.title: The Carefree Cat
1-23.overview: As Chronos and remaining members of the Apostles of the Stars fight the monsters outside Eden, Train and Sven go inside to rescue Eve, determined to save her even if it would cost them their lives. While Sven tries to get close to Eve, Train has to face off against his own inner demons first.

282254.name: BoJack Horseman
282254.overview: Meet the most beloved sitcom horse of the '90s , 20 years later. He's a curmudgeon with a heart of...not quite gold...but something like gold. Copper?

0-1.title: Sabrina's Christmas Wish
0-1.overview: It's Christmas, and BoJack Horseman wants nothing to do with it, especially when Todd shows up with a giant candy cane and one of BoJack’s "Horsin' Around" Christmas episodes from his TV star days. But BoJack agrees to watch it with Todd, if only for the residual check. One heart-warming orphan story and lots of cans of beer later, BoJack might be willing to re-think his attitude -- unless Todd gets too enthusiastic about the whole holiday thing.

In this exclusive featurette for PlayStation, BoJack auditions for a few of Netflix original series. Want to know how he does, check out the clip.

Show summary:  Meet the most beloved sitcom horse of the '90s ... 20 years later. BoJack Horseman was the star of the hit TV show "Horsin' Around," but today he's washed up, living in a Hollywood bachelor pad, complaining about everything, and sometimes wearing colorful sweaters. Set in an L.A. where humans and anthropomorphic animal-people coexist, "BoJack Horseman" is about one man (well, horse-man) who peaked too early and must figure out what to do next.

BoJack Horseman, A Netflix original series, launches on August 22 in all Netflix territories.

0-5.title: Horsin' Around
0-5.overview: Opening credits for the 90s hit TV show, starring the one and only BoJack Horseman. Three little orphans - one, two, three. Without a home or a family tree. Until this horse said, "Live with me," and now they've got a new family!

0-6.title: BoJack Horseman | Interview Exclusive
0-6.overview: Straight from the horse's mouth. BoJack Horseman talks about his return to television.

1-1.title: BoJack Horseman: The BoJack Horseman Story, Chapter One
1-1.overview: To help with the memoir he hopes will put him back in the spotlight, BoJack hires a ghostwriter.

1-2.title: BoJack Hates the Troops
1-2.overview: BoJack finds himself the subject of national media attention after he calls the troops "jerks."

1-3.title: Prickly-Muffin
1-3.overview: BoJack reconnects with a friend from his past who moves into his house and creates pandemonium.

1-4.title: Zoës and Zeldas
1-4.overview: BoJack decides to mentor Todd; Diane's ex-boyfriend writes an article about Mr. Peanutbutter.

1-5.title: Live Fast, Diane Nguyen
1-5.overview: A business trip for BoJack and Diane takes a detour; Todd runs a scam that gets him in trouble.

1-6.title: Our A-Story Is A 'D' Story
1-6.overview: BoJack is jealous of Diane's relationship with Mr. Peanutbutter; Todd's in a new environment.

1-7.title: Say Anything
1-7.overview: BoJack sabotages himself with an epic bender; Princess Carolyn's agency merges with another.

1-8.title: The Telescope
1-8.overview: When he learns that his old friend from "Horsin' Around" is dying, BoJack tries to mend fences.

1-9.title: Horse Majeure
1-9.overview: A lovestruck BoJack tries to sabotage a wedding; Todd accepts a surprising new professional role.

1-10.title: One Trick Pony
1-10.overview: BoJack shoots a movie at Mr. Peanutbutter’s house; Diane finishes her book.

1-11.title: Downer Ending
1-11.overview: BoJack embarks on a project in his typically gonzo style, leading to a drug-fueled revelation.

1-12.title: Later
1-12.overview: Months after his memoir is released, BoJack's being considered for a role that's a lifelong dream.

2-1.title: Brand New Couch
2-1.overview: BoJack believes an upbeat attitude will change his life, but that attitude doesn't mesh well with his new acting job.

2-2.title: Yesterdayland
2-2.overview: BoJack is drawn to the one female in town who has no idea who he is (because she was in a coma). Todd opens a theme park.

2-3.title: Still Broken
2-3.overview: A funeral turns into a treasure hunt for the "Horsin' Around" cast -- and a potential schmooze-fest for Princess Caroline and Mr. Peanutbutter.

2-4.title: After the Party
2-4.overview: Princess Caroline, BoJack, Diane, and Mr. Peanutbutter learn some important lessons about love in the wake of a surprise birthday party.

2-5.title: Chickens
2-5.overview: BoJack really wants his director, Kelsey, to like him. Todd, Diane and Kelsey's daughter help a chicken who's on the lam from the police.

2-6.title: Higher Love
2-6.overview: Princess Caroline sees an opportunity when Mr. Peanutbutter's agent dies. BoJack flips when he says the "L" word out loud to Wanda.

2-7.title: Hank After Dark
2-7.overview: Diane goes off script during BoJack's book tour, jeopardizing Mr. Peanutbutter's new show. Todd gets involved in international affairs.

2-8.title: Let's Find Out
2-8.overview: BoJack is one of the celebrity guest stars on the first episode of Mr. Peanutbutter's game show, but the game doesn't go as expected.

2-9.title: The Shot
2-9.overview: BoJack cooks up a scheme with Kelsey, Todd, Princess Caroline and Mr. Peanutbutter to steal a crucial shot for the Secretariat film.

2-10.title: Yes And
2-10.overview: Todd gets sucked into the cult of improv comedy. Wanda thinks Diane is a bad influence on BoJack when he has to deal with a career crisis.

2-11.title: Escape from L.A.
2-11.overview: BoJack goes on a road trip to visit an old friend, and gets a taste of existence outside the Holywood bubble.

2-12.title: Out to Sea
2-12.overview: The important things in life becomes clear to BoJack when Todd moves out to join the improv comedy group on their special cruise ship.

3-1.title: Start Spreading the News
3-1.overview: Ana Spanakopita sends BoJack to New York to do interviews, and Todd tags along. Princess Carolyn tells Mr. Peanutbutter to get back to work.

3-2.title: The BoJack Horseman Show
3-2.overview: In 2007, Princess Carolyn finds a new project for BoJack, Diane meets Mr. Peanutbutter at the coffee shop where she works, and Todd kisses a girl.

3-3.title: BoJack Kills
3-3.overview: BoJack is framed for the murder of a Whale World dancer. Mr. Peanutbutter and Todd get into a stinky situation with the skunk next door.

3-4.title: Fish Out of Water
3-4.overview: BoJack takes an underwater trip to the Pacific Ocean Film Festival for the “Secretariat” premiere, where he tries to reach out to Kelsey.

3-5.title: Love And/Or Marriage
3-5.overview: While Todd and BoJack crash a rehearsal dinner, Diane gets high with a client. Princess Carolyn goes on a series of blind dates.

3-6.title: Brrap Brrap Pew Pew
3-6.overview: Diane's tweet lands Sextina Aquafina in hot water. Prankster and A-list actor Jurj Clooners gets under BoJack's skin.

3-7.title: Stop the Presses
3-7.overview: Todd builds a giant papier-mâché Todd head. A customer service rep gives BoJack some sound advice when he tries to cancel his newspaper subscription.

3-8.title: Old Acquaintance
3-8.overview: BoJack is up for a part in David Pincher's latest film. Diane meets Mr. Peanutbutter's brother,  and Todd takes the business in a new direction.

3-9.title: Best Thing That Ever Happened
3-9.overview: BoJack meets Princess Carolyn at Elefante, leading to a night of soul-searching as they help the staff impress a food critic.

3-10.title: It's You
3-10.overview: Mr. Peanutbutter announces the Oscar nominees. BoJack surrounds himself with admirers, but his real friendships are falling apart.

3-11.title: That's Too Much, Man!
3-11.overview: On a drug-fueled bender, BoJack and Sarah Lynn crash an AA meeting, and BoJack decides to make amends to the people he hurt.

3-12.title: That Went Well
3-12.overview: Mr. Peanutbutter saves the day. Todd gets exciting news. BoJack, Diane and Princess Carolyn pursue new opportunities.

4-1.title: See Mr. Peanutbutter Run
4-1.overview: Mr. Peanutbutter's campaign to recall the governor of California culminates in a high-stakes ski race. Meanwhile, BoJack is nowhere to be found.

4-2.title: The Old Sugarman Place
4-2.overview: BoJack goes off the grid and winds up at his grandparents' dilapidated home in Michigan where he reflects on his family legacy and befriends another soul haunted by the past.

4-3.title: Hooray! Todd Episode!
4-3.overview: Helpful to a fault, Todd is spread thin doing favors for Princess Carolyn, Mr. Peanutbutter and a visitor with a potential connection to BoJack.

4-4.title: Commence Fracking
4-4.overview: The campaign takes a toll on Diane's love life. BoJack helps Hollyhock search for her mom. Princess Carolyn tries to get pregnant.

4-5.title: Thoughts and Prayers
4-5.overview: A mass shooting at a mall creates a PR nightmare for Princess Carolyn. BoJack takes Hollyhock to visit his estranged mother.

4-6.title: Stupid Piece of Sh*t
4-6.overview: Surrounded by family, BoJack spirals into self-loathing. Princess Carolyn and Rutabaga Rabitowitz plan Courtney and Todd's sham wedding.

4-7.title: Underground
4-7.overview: Mr. Peanutbutter's posh campaign fundraiser takes a terrifying turn. As chaos swirls around them, BoJack and Diane get drunk.

4-8.title: The Judge
4-8.overview: Hollyhock starts dating an intern on BoJack's new show. Princess Carolyn meets Ralph's parents. Mr. Peanutbutter throws his support behind Woodchuck.

4-9.title: Ruthie
4-9.overview: On one awful day, Princess Carolyn deals with rejection, deception and loss. BoJack and Diane try to track down Hollyhock's birth certificate.

4-10.title: lovin that cali lifestyle!!
4-10.overview: Diane leaks damaging information on Jessica Biel, Todd's clown dentist business hits a snag, and Princess Carolyn finds hope in an unlikely place.

4-11.title: Time's Arrow
4-11.overview: In 1963, young socialite Beatrice Sugarman meets the rebellious Butterscotch Horseman at her debutante party.

4-12.title: What Time Is It Right Now
4-12.overview: Princess Carolyn pitches "Philbert" to company execs. Todd gets a better business idea. BoJack comes to a realization about Hollyhock.

5-1.title: The Light Bulb Scene
5-1.overview: BoJack has misgivings about his new show. Princess Carolyn visits an adoption agency. Todd interviews for a job at WhatTimeIsItRightNow.com.

5-2.title: The Dog Days Are Over
5-2.overview: Diane divorces Mr. Peanutbutter and moves into a shabby studio. Feeling melancholy, she travels to Vietnam to get away from it all.

5-3.title: Planned Obsolescence
5-3.overview: Todd meets Yolanda's parents, who don't know she's asexual. Mr. Peanutbutter romances a young waitress. Gina confesses a childhood dream to BoJack.

5-4.title: BoJack the Feminist
5-4.overview: When Princess Carolyn casts a disgraced celeb in "Philbert," BoJack inadvertently takes a stand. Mr. Peanutbutter tries to toughen up his image.

5-5.title: The Amelia Earhart Story
5-5.overview: Painful memories come rushing back when Princess Carolyn visits her hometown and meets a pregnant teen. A stunt goes awry on the "Philbert" set.

5-6.title: Free Churro
5-6.overview: BoJack delivers a eulogy at a funeral.

5-7.title: INT. SUB
5-7.overview: Diane's therapist encourages her to set boundaries with BoJack. A missing string cheese ignites a dispute between Todd and Princess Carolyn.

5-8.title: Mr. Peanutbutter's Boos
5-8.overview: At BoJack's 25th annual Halloween party, Pickles gets a crash course in Mr. Peanutbutter's romantic history -- and some advice from Diane.

5-9.title: Ancient History
5-9.overview: A visiting Hollyhock dumps BoJack's painkillers, sending him on a desperate search for more. Todd tries to solve Emily's dating dilemma.

5-10.title: Head in the Clouds
5-10.overview: At the "Philbert" premiere party, Princess Carolyn deftly negotiates a deal, Gina steps into the limelight, and Diane confronts BoJack.

5-11.title: The Showstopper
5-11.overview: "Philbert" is a hit, and filming begins on Season 2. But as BoJack spirals deeper into addiction, he loses his grip on reality.

5-12.title: The Stopped Show
5-12.overview: In the midst of the latest PR crisis, Princess Carolyn gets a life-changing opportunity. With Diane's help, BoJack finally faces the music.

6-1.title: A Horse Walks into a Rehab
6-1.overview: BoJack checks into Pastiches, a Malibu rehab facility, where he grapples with memories of Sarah Lynn's death and his own troubled childhood.

6-2.title: The New Client
6-2.overview: When her nanny quits, Princess Carolyn struggles to balance the demands of work and parenting. Mr. Peanutbutter visits BoJack in rehab.

6-3.title: Feel-Good Story
6-3.overview: Girl Croosh sends Diane on the road with rugged cameraman Guy, but she balks when they ask her to produce more feel-good stories.

6-4.title: Surprise!
6-4.overview: Todd organizes a surprise wedding for Pickles and Mr. Peanutbutter, but the party quickly goes off the rails when Mr. Peanutbutter makes a confession.

6-5.title: A Little Uneven, Is All
6-5.overview: Dr. Champ tells BoJack it's time to leave rehab. Mr. Peanutbutter's reputation takes a hit. In Chicago, Diane wrestles with writer's block.

6-6.title: The Kidney Stays in the Picture
6-6.overview: The assistants of Hollywoo go on strike. BoJack tries to help Dr. Champ. When Todd learns that his mother needs a kidney, Diane comes up with a plan.

6-7.title: The Face of Depression
6-7.overview: BoJack travels around the country reconnecting with loved ones, while Mr. Peanutbutter embarks on his own national tour as the face of depression.

6-8.title: A Quick One, While He's Away
6-8.overview: A reporter digs into the circumstances surrounding Sarah Lynn's death. Hollyhock goes to a party in New York City.

6-9.title: Intermediate Scene Study w/ BoJack Horseman
6-9.overview: When BoJack starts teaching an acting class at Wesleyan, Hollyhock sets some boundaries in their relationship

6-10.title: Good Damage
6-10.overview: Diane's depression lifts, but she's still struggling to start writing her memoir. Reporters Paige and Max pay Penny a visit.

6-11.title: Sunk Cost and All That
6-11.overview: While Paige and Max question Mr. Peanutbutter at his restaurant, a panicked BoJack tries to piece together what's happening.

6-12.title: Xerox of a Xerox
6-12.overview: After the Sarah Lynn story breaks, BoJack gives a live interview on TV. Diane meets Guy's teenage son.

6-13.title: The Horny Unicorn
6-13.overview: BoJack gets a new AA sponsor. Todd plans a sophisticated party to impress his parents. Diane gets to know Sonny.

6-14.title: Angela
6-14.overview: Angela Diaz reaches out to BoJack. Princess Carolyn gets an offer from Lenny Turteltaub. Todd cooks up a scheme.

6-15.title: The View from Halfway Down
6-15.overview: BoJack reconnects with faces from his past.

419168.name: Meltdown: Three Mile Island
419168.overview: Insiders recount the events, controversies and lingering effects of the accident at the Three Mile Island nuclear power plant in Pennsylvania.

similar.name: Love Has Won: The Cult of Mother God
Turning Point: The Bomb and the Cold War

1-1.title: The Accident
1-1.overview: In 1979, a plant malfunction causes confusion and a radiation leak. As fear spreads, so does suspicion that the authorities are concealing the truth.

1-2.title: Women and Children First
1-2.overview: Panic strikes the community as a full-blown catastrophe looms. Locals mobilize to confront the authorities and protest the nuclear power industry.

1-3.title: The Whistleblower
