1-3.overview: During cleanup at the plant, insiders claim that cost-cutting measures and intimidation tactics create a danger far worse than the accident itself.

1-4.title: Fallout
1-4.overview: Despite disturbing revelations of wrongdoing at Three Mile Island before and after the accident, the utility fights to bring the plant back online.

75164.name: Samurai Jack
75164.overview: A great warrior is displaced to the distant future by the evil shape-shifting wizard Aku. The world has become a bleak place under the rule of Aku, segregated into fantastic tribes and ruled by Aku's evil robot warlords. Jack travels this foreign landscape in search of a time portal that can return him to his home time so he can "undo the future that is Aku!".

similar.name: G.I. Joe: A Real American Hero

0-1.title: Samurai Jack: Season 5 Behind the Scenes
0-1.overview: Behind the scenes of Samurai Jack season 5 production

0-3.title: Samurai Jack: Season 5 Behind the Music

0-6.title: The Martial Arts of Samurai Jack

0-21.title: XXXVII: The Birth of Evil, Part 1
0-21.overview: This epic story tells how Aku came to exist and how he came to be in conflict with Jack's Father.

0-22.title: XXXVIII: The Birth of Evil, Part 2
0-22.overview: This epic story tells how Aku came to exist and how he came to be in conflict with Jack's father.

1-1.title: I
1-1.overview: When Aku is reborn to set forth his reign of terror, the Emperor's son is sent off to learn the ways of the samurai. That boy becomes a man and attempts to slay Aku with a mighty sword, but Aku banishes him to the future.

1-2.title: II
1-2.overview: The Samurai lands in the future and is named Jack. He is enlisted by a race of dogs to destroy Aku.

1-3.title: III
1-3.overview: Jack gets weapons and beats back Aku's army of beetles saving the canine race.

1-4.title: IV
1-4.overview: Jack helps free the Woolies from the tyrannical Chritchellites.

1-5.title: VII
1-5.overview: Jack must get past three blind archers to reach an all-powerful wishing well.

1-6.title: V
1-6.overview: When Jack mistakenly destroys a group of scientists' chance to escape Aku, he and the scientists join forces to try and fix the problem, hopefully returning Jack home as well.

1-7.title: IX
1-7.overview: Jack has an underwater adventure with a jelly-whale and sea monkeys while hunting foran ancient time portal.

1-8.title: X
1-8.overview: Jack goes through a cave full of challenges only to find an old warrior longing to reach Valhalla.

1-9.title: VIII
1-9.overview: Jack meets up with Mad Jack and must battle his darker self.

1-10.title: XI
1-10.overview: When Jack and a Scotsman meet on a never-ending bridge, they end up shackled together and on the run from bounty hunters.

1-11.title: VI
1-11.overview: Jack and a mysterious woman go on a quest in an attempt to resolve their personal goals.

1-12.title: XII
1-12.overview: Jack hooks up with some Chicago gangsters to try and get close to Aku.

1-13.title: XIII
1-13.overview: Aku tells fairy tales to the children to try and win them over to his side instead of Jack's.

2-1.title: XIV
2-1.overview: Jack comes upon a monkey-man and agrees to train his tribe in the ways of defending themselves if the monkey-man teaches him how to "jump good".

2-2.title: XV
2-2.overview: Three short stories: Jack vs. the Worm: Jack confronts a two-headed riddling serpent who will grant him his wish if he can answer their questions;  The Metal-Eaters: Jack confronts a family that feed on metal and eat Jack's sword; Jack, the Gargoyle and the Fairy: Jack tries to rescue a wish-granting fairy from a gargoyle so that she may grant his wish to return home.

2-3.title: XVI
2-3.overview: Jack is kidnapped and placed in a chain gang of warriors chosen to battle in front of a coliseum audience against the Dome of Doom's Champions.

2-4.title: XVII
2-4.overview: The Scotsman needs Jack's help to save his kidnapped wife. But this woman is hardly the distressed damsel the Scotsman makes her out to be.

2-5.title: XVIII
2-5.overview: Jack goes from destroyed village to another looking for those responsible, only to find the destruction was commissioned by Aku.

2-6.title: XIX
2-6.overview: Jack comes upon ruins of a village and realizes it is his home. He then reflects on the past when he was a young boy.

2-7.title: XX
2-7.overview: Jack travels vertically up a mountain with three monks to witness the magic of the mountain only to have the power of the mountain save his very life.

2-8.title: XXI
2-8.overview: When a flatulent dragon begins stinking out an entire village. Jack slays the beast and ventures inside it to cure to source of its bellyache.

2-9.title: XXII
2-9.overview: Aku hires the best hunters in the galaxy to track down the most elusive of prey - Samurai Jack.

2-10.title: XXIII
2-10.overview: Aku sends out Demongo, the soul collector, to destroy Jack. Now Jack must fight all the mighty warrior souls that Demongo has collected.

2-11.title: XXIV
2-11.overview: When Jack has his sword and clothing stolen, he must give chase to a white rabbit who took them while trying to maintain his modesty.

2-12.title: XXV
2-12.overview: Jack comes upon a battle where a mere 300 men are fighting a vast, unending army of robots and their evil robotic leader.

2-13.title: XXVI
2-13.overview: When a band of bikes mow over Jack's sandals, he goes on a hunt for the perfect footwear.

3-1.title: XXVII
3-1.overview: Jack is turned into a chicken by a cranky wizard. While he tries to fix this, he gets caught by a "handler" and becomes a prize-winning Creature Combat fighter.

3-2.title: XXX
3-2.overview: Aku leads Jack to a graveyard where the dead begin to rise. An evil spirit takes over Jack's sword, leading Jack to defend himself against his own weapon. When Aku gets hold of the sword, Jack fears he's finally met his end.

3-3.title: XXVIII
3-3.overview: When a man's daughter is kidnapped by Aku's Children, Jack must infiltrate a rave to stop the musical brainwashing.

3-4.title: XXIX
3-4.overview: Jack boards a train to his next destination only to be attacked by a couple of arguing bounty hunters.

3-5.title: XXXI
3-5.overview: Jack must read hieroglyphics, solve riddles and assemble a sacred scarab to call upon Ra for help in fighting evil ancient Egyptian shadow warriors.

3-6.title: XXXII
3-6.overview: Jack must travel along a water creature, a mountain creature and a flying creature to get to a portal to return home. But once he reaches the portal, it is guarded by an undefeatable warrior who tells him that this portal is not for him.

3-7.title: XXXIII
3-7.overview: An over-friendly creature begins following Jack, messing up Jack's every move along his quest.

3-8.title: XXXIV
3-8.overview: Jack and a Swamp Wizard travel to the four corners of the earth, collecting pieces that are meant to get Jack home. But when Aku reveals himself to be the Swamp Wizard, Jack must battle these pieces which are now being puppeteered by Aku's evil hands.

3-9.title: XXXV
3-9.overview: When Jack enters a spooky, old mansion and gets locked inside, he catches sight of a figure and sets after it to find out what is going on. As Jack is led further and further in, he discovers that the house and its inhabitants have an evil plan that involves…him.

3-10.title: XXXVI
3-10.overview: Jack falls into a hidden temple sanctuary to find monks trained like him in the style of the Ancient Master. The Ancient Master's Son then tells Jack of a portal to send him home, but in order to use it, his new friends must be sacrificed.

3-11.title: XXXIX
3-11.overview: Jack is directed to a deathtrap-filled labyrinth which holds a diamond that can restore him to his time. Unfortunately a master thief also enters the labyrinth going for the item.

4-1.title: XL
4-1.overview: Aku sends a Ninja to destroy Jack who is busily helping a port town in distress.

4-2.title: XLI - Robo/Mondo - Bot
4-2.overview: Jack enters a village to discover that he is their Chosen One meant to embody the Robo-Samurai and destroy the Mondo-bot that has come to destroy them.

4-3.title: XLII
4-3.overview: Jack is approached by a cool Samurai-punk who wants to battle with Jack in order to prove that he is the best.

4-4.title: Birth of Evil
4-4.overview: When ancient gods try to destroy a powerful evil, they send one piece of the beast hurtling through space. This piece lands on earth, spreading its evil through the land. When it encroaches on an Emperor's empire, he takes it upon himself to destroy the evil, but ends up unleashing the evil that is Aku.

4-5.title: Scotsman Saves Jack
4-5.overview: Jack has lost all memory of who he is and it's up to the Scotsman to put the pieces of the puzzle together to save the samurai.

4-6.title: XLIII
4-6.overview: When Aku catches a cold and sneezes on Jack, Jack becomes infected with Aku’s badness which begins to take over his entire body.

4-7.title: XLIV
4-7.overview: When Aku raises the bounty on Jack, the best bounty hunters in the world gather to capture him.

4-8.title: XLVII
4-8.overview: Jack helps save a Prince and Princess whose ship has been shot down to Earth by Aku.

4-9.title: XLVIII
4-9.overview: Tired of all the bounty hunters and robots failing, Aku fights Jack, mano y mano.

4-10.title: XLIX
4-10.overview: As Jack goes through fall, winter, spring and summer, he must battle the perils that each season brings.

4-11.title: L
4-11.overview: Aku forces an old, ace robot assassin out of retirement to eliminate the ultimate mark - Jack.

4-12.title: LI
4-12.overview: Young Jack is brought to Africa for part of his training, but when his tribe is abducted, he must learn how to use their unique sword-like weapon – and fast!

4-13.title: LII
4-13.overview: Jack finds a baby and the two travel together as Jack tries to return the boy to his mother.

5-1.title: XCII
5-1.overview: It's been 50 years since we last saw Samurai Jack and time has not been kind to him. Aku has destroyed every time portal and Jack has stopped aging, a side effect of time travel. It seems he is cursed to just roam the land for all eternity. His past haunts him as well as a cult of assasins dedicated to killing him for Aku's glory.

5-2.title: XCIII
5-2.overview: Jack's will to survive is pushed to its absolute limits after a deadly, unseen foe launches a relentless surprise attack.

5-3.title: XCIV
5-3.overview: Samurai Jack is gravely injured, but still decides to face one of the deadliest foes he's ever faced, Assassins from the Cult of Aku.

5-4.title: XCV
5-4.overview: Samurai Jack partners with a deadly assassin in order to escape a gargantuan creature that has swallowed them whole.

5-5.title: XCVI
5-5.overview: Samurai Jack fights to save a group of enslaved people from being harvested as the power source for a monstrous Mega-Robot.

5-6.title: XCVII
5-6.overview: Ashi's search for Samurai Jack helps her to see his effect on the world after encountering numerous people and places where he has changed things for the better

5-7.title: XCVIII
5-7.overview: Jack and Ashi overcome a series of dangerous physical and spiritual tests in order to recover Jack's sword.

5-8.title: XCIX
5-8.overview: The burgeoning relationship between Jack and Ashi takes a turn after they are hunted by one of the galaxy's deadliest creatures.

5-9.title: C
5-9.overview: Samurai Jack's worst fear is realized when he faces off against Aku; the demon makes a shocking discovery about Ashi that puts her in grave danger.

5-10.title: CI
5-10.overview: The fate of the entire universe hangs in the balance as Samurai Jack faces Aku.

75579.name: Fullmetal Alchemist
75579.overview: Two young brothers are raised as alchemists, but when they are severely injured trying to perform a forbidden act, they begin searching for the one thing that can save them; the fabled philosopher's stone.

similar.name: The Legend of the Legendary Heroes

0-1.title: Reflections
0-1.overview: A recap of the series, with sections narrated by the Elric brothers, Roy Mustang, Maes Hughes, Greed and Envy.

0-2.title: Interactive Experience - Preshow
0-2.overview: In this interactive short, the viewer is introduced as a new member of the military, welcomed by Fuhrer Bradley who assigns the viewer to Mustang's group.

0-3.title: Interactive Experience - Zone 1-4
0-3.overview: In this interactive short, the viewer is lectured by Jean Havoc about Alchemy, State Alchemists, Automail, Mustang's unit, Homunculi, before introducing the next short.

0-4.title: State Alchemists vs Seven Homunculi
0-4.overview: A 10 minute film featuring: Ed, Al, Mustang and many other members of the State doing battle with the deadly Homonculi in an alternate reality Amestris.

0-5.title: Chibi Party
0-5.overview: Short 6 minute Skit drawn in Super Deformed style where every character in the series (including bad guys) are celebrating an "After Party" of the Conqueror of Shambala movie.

0-6.title: Kids
0-6.overview: Short 3 minute story which features Edward and his grandkids in present day 2005.

0-7.title: Live Action
0-7.overview: Alphonse Elric, in his armor form, embarks on a quest in a real-life Japan to find his brother, Edward. His search eventually takes him to Studio Bones, where the series was produced, but due to his size, he cannot fit through the door.

1-1.title: Those Who Challenge the Sun
1-1.overview: When Edward and Alphonse meet a so-called religious leader who can invoke miracles, they believe he's carrying the philosopher's stone.

1-2.title: Body of the Sanctioned
1-2.overview: Edward and Alphonse struggle over whether they should reveal the truth behind Cornello's miracles -- and possibly ruin the townspeople's lives.

1-3.title: Mother
1-3.overview: A young Ed and Al are determined to bring back their dead mother, who was their pillar of strength during dreary times of war.

1-4.title: A Forger's Love
1-4.overview: While on their way to seek out an important man from their childhood, Ed and Al come across a town haunted by a ghostly woman.

1-5.title: The Man with the Mechanical Arm
1-5.overview: Ed and Al hop aboard a train to Central City and quickly find themselves defending the passengers -- including Gen. Hakuro -- from terrorists.

1-6.title: The Alchemy Exam
1-6.overview: Once in Central City, Ed and Al move into the vast mansion of sewing-life alchemist Shou Tucker and begin to prepare for the Alchemy Exam.

1-7.title: Night of the Chimera's Cry
1-7.overview: Now an official State Alchemist, Ed takes a closer look at Tucker's chimera experiments and begins to realize there's something very wrong going on.

1-8.title: The Philosopher's Stone
1-8.overview: A disenchanted Ed resigns from his position as State Alchemist, and when Winry arrives in town, she may be the serial killer's next victim.

1-9.title: Be Thou for the People
1-9.overview: Ed and Al go on assignment to inspect a small mining colony and discover its inhabitants are being heavily taxed by a tyrant and his Alchemist.

1-10.title: The Phantom Thief
1-10.overview: While trying to avoid their meeting with Mustang, Ed and Al end up in a small town and become embroiled in a manhunt for a female Robin Hood.

1-11.title: The Other Brothers Elric (1)
1-11.overview: Ed and Al head to Xenotime in hopes of finding the Philosopher's Stone, but they find only two boys creating a strange red water.

1-12.title: The Other Brothers Elric (2)
1-12.overview: Ed and Al uncover a conspiracy involving the Tringham Brothers' father, his involvement with the red water and the disease that's stricken Xenotime.

1-13.title: Fullmetal vs. Flame
1-13.overview: Ed reports back to Mustang in East City, where discussion of Doctor Marcoh and the Philosopher's Stone leads to a duel between Ed and the colonel.

1-14.title: Destruction's Right Hand
1-14.overview: While the shape-shifting Envy disguises himself as Cornello, Ed and Al find Marcoh and learn about the Stone's involvement in the Ishbal Rebellion.

1-15.title: The Ishbal Massacre
1-15.overview: As the Strong Arm Alchemist defends them from the surrounding chaos, Marcoh reveals to the Elrics the vast atrocities of the Ishbal Massacre.

1-16.title: That Which Is Lost
1-16.overview: As Marcoh faces a deadly encounter with Lust, Armstrong and the Elrics flee to Resembool. Ed is sent into a rage when they lose Al in the process.

1-17.title: House of the Waiting Family
1-17.overview: While resting and receiving repairs back in Resembool, Ed visits his mother's grave and Al reveals his concerns about his fading memories.

1-18.title: Marcoh's Notes
1-18.overview: Ed and Al are forced to go in search of another source for Marcoh's book after Lust, Gluttony and Scar burn the First Branch Library to the ground.

1-19.title: The Truth Behind Truths
1-19.overview: Ed and Al are horrified when they learn what the key ingredient in making a Philosopher's Stone is, but they forge ahead to explore an abandoned lab.

1-20.title: Soul of the Guardian
1-20.overview: Several malfunctions in their armor impede Ed and Al as they face off against some tortured souls bound to empty suits.

1-21.title: The Red Glow
1-21.overview: Barry sets off a series of explosions that inadvertently free Greed and the other prisoners. Tucker returns from the dead in a surprising new form.

1-22.title: Created Human
1-22.overview: As Envy, in the form of Basque Grand, gathers the human ingredients to form the Stone, Maes Hughes sets out to rescue the Elrics from Laboratory 5.

1-23.title: Heart of Steel
1-23.overview: Edward upsets Winry with his refusal to talk, and Alphonse decides to confront Edward with his questions about artificial souls.

1-24.title: Bonding Memories
1-24.overview: Alphonse runs off and comes face to face with Scar, who's been hiding out among the mercenary-plagued refugees of Ishbal.

1-25.title: Words of Farewell
1-25.overview: When Ed and Al take Winry on a quest to tail Scar and learn more about the Stone, they discover a connection between Lab 5 and the war in Ishbal.

1-26.title: Her Reason
1-26.overview: As Ed, Al and Winry arrive in Rush Valley to retrieve automail, Mustang figures that a high-ranking officer must be responsible for Hughes' death.

1-27.title: Teacher
1-27.overview: Edward and Alphonse fear for their lives when they come face to face with Izumi Curtis, their former teacher, who brings them back to Dublith.

1-28.title: All is One, One is All
1-28.overview: In order to teach them a life lesson and give them time to reflect, Izumi leaves Ed and Al on Yock Island -- the place where she first found them.

1-29.title: The Untainted Child
1-29.overview: Edward and Alphonse discover that the young boy on Yock Island is, all at once, an alchemist, a homunculus and able to transmute his own body.

1-30.title: Assault on South Headquarters
1-30.overview: As the military captures the mysterious Yock Island boy and imprisons him in South Headquarters, Yoki spots Scar among a group of Ishbalans.

1-31.title: Sin
1-31.overview: Envy disguises herself as Bradley and plucks the homunculus child from Izumi. Meanwhile, the boy remembers his past after he eats Stone fragments.

1-32.title: Dante of the Deep Forest
1-32.overview: Izumi drops in on Ed and Al's fight with Wrath, a new homunculus who seeks the rest of Edward's body in order to make himself human.

1-33.title: Al, Captured
1-33.overview: When Martel takes over Al's armor and brings him to Greed's headquarters, it's up to Izumi and Edward to come to the rescue

1-34.title: Theory of Avarice
1-34.overview: With Ed, Izumi and Sig in his custody, Lt. Col. Archer reinstates Shou Tucker as State Alchemist and orders his men to hunt down Greed.

1-35.title: Reunion of the Fallen
1-35.overview: As Edward and Alphonse head out to the Ishbal camp with Winry, Lust is sitting down at a restaurant when a man from her past enters the room.

1-36.title: The Sinner Within
1-36.overview: Ed and Alphonse hope to learn more about the Philosopher's Stone when they lend a hand to a group of Ishbalan refugees being shipped further south.

1-37.title: The Flame Alchemist, The Bachelor Lieutenant & The Mystery of Warehouse 13
1-37.overview: While he investigates Mustang, Lt. Havoc orders his man Falman to find him a girlfriend. Later, Mustang must investigate the haunted Warehouse 13.

1-38.title: With the River's Flow
1-38.overview: After an argument splits up Ed, Al and Winry, Al bumps into a familiar face, and Winry decides to investigate Hughes' murder with Sheska.

1-39.title: Secret of Ishbal
1-39.overview: Kimblee is named State Alchemist and heads out with the troops to Liore, where Scar is gouging out the earth with a large stone.

1-40.title: The Scar
1-40.overview: After Lust and Gluttony drop in on Edward's confrontation with Scar in Liore, the seventh and final homunculus is finally revealed.

1-41.title: Holy Mother
1-41.overview: With the help of Rose, the Holy Mother, Scar instructs the inhabitants of Liore not to provoke violence as they lure the military into town.

1-42.title: His Name Is Unknown
1-42.overview: With Ed busy aiding the people of Liore, Scar is the only one who can help Alphonse when his armor begins transforming into an explosive compound.

1-43.title: The Stray Dog
1-43.overview: While the Elric Brothers flee Liore, Winry meets a complete stranger in Resembool who is later introduced to her as Ed and Al's father.

1-44.title: Hohenheim of Light
1-44.overview: As the Elrics' father, Hohenhelm of Light, sets out to confront the leader of the Homunculi, Lyra and Rose find a secret stairway in an old church.

1-45.title: A Rotted Heart
1-45.overview: A complex and entangled history reveals itself as Van Hohenheim of Light battles Dante, the leader of the Homunculi.

1-46.title: Human Transmutation
1-46.overview: The brothers are in danger when they become separated. Ed returns to Dante's mansion to look for clues. Al meets with the deranged Shou Tucker.

1-47.title: Sealing the Homunculus
1-47.overview: Wrath believes that Sloth is his real mother. Sloth battles Shou Tucker. Ed realizes that Al has been tricked by Tucker.

1-48.title: Goodbye
1-48.overview: Armstrong declares an uprising against the Führer on the northern border while Ed, joined by Izumi, fights the remaining Homunculi in Central.

1-49.title: The Other Side of the Gate
1-49.overview: King Bradley comes home to give his son a birthday gift. Edward meets with Russell in an abandoned church. Maria and Denny arrive to support Izumi.

1-50.title: Death
1-50.overview: Edward Elric arrives in World War I after being pulled through the Gate. Roy Mustang confronts his enemy, Homunculus Pride.

1-51.title: Laws and Promises
1-51.overview: Edward Elric realizes he must make the ultimate sacrifice if he wants to retrieve his brother from the Gate. Hawkeye breaks free from her captors.

76568.name: Gilmore Girls
76568.overview: Set in the charming town of Stars Hollow, Connecticut, the series follows the captivating lives of Lorelai and Rory Gilmore, a mother/daughter pair who have a relationship most people only dream of.

0-1.title: Unaired Pilot
0-1.overview: Unaired Pilot of Gilmore Girls, featuring different actors playing Dean and Sookie, and different sets for exterior Stars Hollow and the inside of Luke's.

0-2.title: A Film by Kirk
0-2.overview: A spoof on student art films.

1-1.title: Pilot
1-1.overview: When Rory is accepted to attend a prestigious prep school, Lorelai must swallow her pride and ask her wealthy parents for help paying the tuition.

1-2.title: The Lorelais' First Day at Chilton
1-2.overview: Rory's first day at Chilton doesn't go smoothly: First, Lorelai's attire offends Emily and the headmaster; then Rory meets some obnoxious classmates.

1-3.title: Kill Me Now
1-3.overview: When Rory and Richard bond during a day of golf at the club, Lorelai feels jealous of Rory's deepening connection with her grandparents.

1-4.title: The Deer Hunters
1-4.overview: After Rory receives a bad grade on her English paper, Lorelai helps her cram for a big Shakespeare exam – but catastrophe strikes on test day.

1-5.title: Cinnamon's Wake
1-5.overview: Lorelai admits she has feelings for someone. Meanwhile, Rory has a budding relationship of her own that is moving forward.

1-6.title: Rory's Birthday Parties
1-6.overview: Rory clashes with Emily when Emily plans a formal birthday party for her. Meanwhile, Lorelai organizes a casual get-together to celebrate.

1-7.title: Kiss and Tell
1-7.overview: Rory shares a romantic moment with Dean, but doesn't tell Lorelai. When Lorelai hears about it from Mrs. Kim, she invites Dean over for movie night.

1-8.title: Love and War and Snow
1-8.overview: Snow strands Rory at her grandparents' home, while Lorelai spends the day with her beau. Meanwhile, Lane misses Rory and comes to visit.

1-9.title: Rory's Dance
1-9.overview: Rory attends her first dance with Dean but they get home late, causing Emily and Lorelai to fight over Lorelai's mothering skills.

1-10.title: Forgiveness and Stuff
1-10.overview: Misfortune strikes at the Gilmores' Christmas party. Dean assures Lorelai that nothing improper happened the night he and Rory fell asleep together.

1-11.title: Paris is Burning
1-11.overview: After Paris causes a scandal by exposing the relationship between a parent and a teacher, she is confronted.

1-12.title: Double Date
1-12.overview: Lorelai goes on a hellish double date with Sookie, Jackson and Jackson's odd cousin. Meanwhile, Rory double dates with Dean, Lane and Dean's friend.

1-13.title: Concert Interruptus
1-13.overview: Trouble ensues when Rory takes her friends to a Bangles concert in New York. Lorelai learns something about Luke's romantic past.

1-14.title: That Damn Donna Reed
1-14.overview: Rory and Dean argue about women's roles after watching "The Donna Reed Show." Emily makes Lorelai face her feelings.

1-15.title: Christopher Returns
1-15.overview: Rory's father returns, causing tension in Emily and Richard's house – and forcing Lorelai to make a big decision about her family's future.

1-16.title: Star-Crossed Lovers and Other Strangers
1-16.overview: Rory and Dean celebrate their three-month anniversary, but things don't go as planned. Luke's ex-girlfriend Rachel arrives in town.

1-17.title: The Breakup, Part 2
1-17.overview: After recent events, Rory keeps busy, refusing to give in to self-pity. Meanwhile, Stars Hollow's residents rally around her, much to her dismay.

1-18.title: The Third Lorelai
1-18.overview: When Lorelai's grandmother offers a trust fund for Rory's education, Emily fears losing contact with a financially independent Lorelai and Rory.

1-19.title: Emily in Wonderland
1-19.overview: Emily is horrified when she sees the place where Lorelai and Rory first lived, so she sets out to create a perfect bedroom for Rory in her house.

1-20.title: P.S. I Lo...
1-20.overview: Still upset over recent events, Rory becomes angry with Lorelai, who didn't tell her that she is dating again.

1-21.title: Love, Daisies and Troubadours
1-21.overview: Rory finally tells Dean the truth about how she feels about him. Sensing something between Lorelai and Luke, Rachel makes a decision.

2-1.title: Sadie, Sadie...
2-1.overview: Lorelai makes a big decision, but when Emily hears about it from someone else, she's hurt and angry that Lorelai didn't bother to tell her.

2-2.title: Hammers and Veils
2-2.overview: Rory's sudden flurry of extracurricular activity strains her relationship with Dean. Emily is cold when Lorelai finally reveals her big news.

2-3.title: Red Light on the Wedding Night
2-3.overview: During a wild party, Lorelai impulsively calls someone, and their conversation gives her second thoughts about her plans.

2-4.title: The Road Trip to Harvard
2-4.overview: With her big plans canceled, Lorelai is eager to escape the reactions of everyone in Stars Hollow, so she and Rory take off on a road trip.

2-5.title: Nick & Nora/Sid & Nancy
2-5.overview: Lorelai tries to dissuade Luke from allowing his relative to live with him. Rory finds herself attracted to another boy.

2-6.title: Presenting Lorelai Gilmore
2-6.overview: Rory surprises everyone by agreeing to make her debut at a ball, and Lorelai finds herself attracted to a changed man.

2-7.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
2-7.overview: Advised to become more social at Chilton, Rory winds up in the most popular school clique, while Lorelai helps with a fundraising fashion show.

2-8.title: The Ins and Outs of Inns
2-8.overview: Lorelai and Sookie have the first fight of their long friendship when Lorelai panics and decides their dream of opening an inn together will fail.

2-9.title: Run Away, Little Boy
2-9.overview: When Rory and her classmate Tristan are cast as Romeo and Juliet in a school play, a jealous Dean insists on attending every rehearsal.

2-10.title: The Bracebridge Dinner
2-10.overview: While Rory struggles to keep the budding rivalry between Dean and Jess under control, Lorelai invites most of Stars Hollow to an elaborate feast.

2-11.title: Secrets and Loans
2-11.overview: Lorelai can't afford to repair her home's extensive termite damage but becomes angry when Rory involves Emily, who again offers Lorelai a loan.

2-12.title: Richard in Stars Hollow
2-12.overview: Newly retired Richard is driving Emily crazy, so Lorelai agrees to take her father for a day in Stars Hollow, where he annoys both Lorelai and Rory.

2-13.title: A-Tisket, A-Tasket
2-13.overview: The annual Stars Hollow Picnic Basket Auction causes romantic complications when Jess outbids Dean to win a picnic lunch date with Rory.

2-14.title: It Should've Been Lorelai
2-14.overview: Christopher brings a visitor to Stars Hollow who wants to get to know Rory. Emily is furious that Lorelai isn't trying to win Christopher back.

2-15.title: Lost & Found
2-15.overview: Rory panics when she realizes she's lost the bracelet Dean made for her. When Lorelai spots someone in Rory's room, she makes accusations of theft.

2-16.title: There's the Rub
2-16.overview: Lorelai and Emily's weekend at a spa doesn't go as planned. Meanwhile, Rory's night alone becomes difficult when Paris, Jess and Dean arrive.

2-17.title: Dead Uncles & Vegetables
2-17.overview: Lorelai and Rory help out at the diner while Luke makes funeral arrangements. Emily goes overboard helping to plan a wedding.

2-18.title: Back in the Saddle Again
2-18.overview: After helping Rory with her project for Chilton's annual business fair, Richard realizes he's tired of retirement and wants to start a second career.

2-19.title: Teach Me Tonight
2-19.overview: As a favor to Luke, Rory tutors Jess, but during their first study session, Jess convinces Rory to go on a quick outing with him.

2-20.title: Help Wanted
2-20.overview: Lorelai helps Richard establish a consulting business. Rory becomes angry that everyone blames Jess for what happened to her.

2-21.title: Lorelai's Graduation Day
2-21.overview: Lorelai is about to graduate from business school, so Rory secretly invites guests to her graduation ceremony. Rory makes a trip to New York.

2-22.title: I Can't Get Started
2-22.overview: On the day before the wedding, Lorelai enjoys a romantic evening. Meanwhile, Rory is thrilled when a familiar face returns to Stars Hollow.

3-1.title: Those Lazy-Hazy-Crazy Days
3-1.overview: Back from a summer internship in Washington, D.C., Rory finds herself torn between Dean and Jess. Meanwhile, Lorelai questions her future.

3-2.title: Haunted Leg
3-2.overview: Emily's attempts to reunite Christopher with Lorelai and Rory result in an ugly confrontation between Rory and Christopher.

3-3.title: Application Anxiety
3-3.overview: After a Harvard application arrives, Rory and Lorelai seek advice. Meanwhile, Lane places an ad and becomes enamored with a respondent.

3-4.title: One's Got Class and the Other One Dyes
3-4.overview: Things get ugly when Lorelai speaks at the high school's career day. To rebel against her conservative mother, Lane does something drastic.

3-5.title: Eight O'Clock at the Oasis
3-5.overview: After a disastrous date with a man she met at an auction organized by Emily, Lorelai tries to cancel the second date, despite her parents' objections.

3-6.title: Take the Deviled Eggs...
3-6.overview: When Lorelai winds up attending a social event with Rory, she learns more about Christopher's life than she wanted to know.

3-7.title: They Shoot Gilmores, Don't They?
3-7.overview: Lorelai forces Rory to be her partner at the Stars Hollow dance marathon, where Rory can't stop arguing with a boy – and another definitely notices.

3-8.title: Let the Games Begin
3-8.overview: Lorelai, Rory, Richard and Emily visit Richard's alma mater, but Richard causes trouble by secretly making some arrangements in advance.

3-9.title: A Deep-Fried Korean Thanksgiving
3-9.overview: Lorelai and Rory have four Thanksgivings when they stop for celebrations with Lane, Sookie and Luke on the way to dinner with Richard and Emily.

3-10.title: That'll Do, Pig
3-10.overview: Lorelai misses the town carnival when a visitor arrives. Rory's beau won't take her to the carnival – until he learns she might go with another boy.

3-11.title: I Solemnly Swear...
3-11.overview: A classmate convinces Paris that Rory has been plotting against her. Meanwhile, Emily is sued by a former maid, and Lorelai meets an interesting man.

3-12.title: Lorelai Out of Water
3-12.overview: Lorelai gets an angling lesson from Luke before her fishing date with her new beau. Meanwhile, the political battle between Rory and Paris escalates.

3-13.title: Dear Emily and Richard
3-13.overview: When Sherry goes into labor and asks Rory to stay with her at the hospital, Lorelai reminisces about the day Rory was born.

3-14.title: Swan Song
3-14.overview: Lorelai goes away with her boyfriend for a weekend in New York, but she worries about leaving Rory and her boyfriend together.

3-15.title: Face-Off
3-15.overview: Tired of waiting for her boyfriend to call and make plans for the weekend, Rory goes to a hockey game with Lane, where she sees a familiar face.

3-16.title: The Big One
3-16.overview: Rory and Paris compete to give a speech at a school celebration. Meanwhile, Lorelai shares a passionate kiss with someone unexpected.

3-17.title: A Tale of Poes and Fire
3-17.overview: When a meeting of the Edgar Allan Poe Society at her inn is interrupted by a disaster, Lorelai must find rooms for the guests at homes around town.

3-18.title: Happy Birthday, Baby
3-18.overview: While Lorelai deals with the aftermath at the inn, Rory schemes to give her mom a special birthday party, complete with a gigantic surprise.

3-19.title: Keg! Max!
3-19.overview: Rory makes plans to attend the prom. Lane's rock band debuts at a big party, where longstanding animosities finally explode.

3-20.title: Say Goodnight, Gracie
3-20.overview: After the brawl at her band's debut, Lane is in trouble with her mother. Later, Jess receives a visitor at the diner.

3-21.title: Here Comes the Son
3-21.overview: Jess travels across the country for a visit. Rory helps Emily choose an outfit for Rory's graduation, resulting in a conflict with Lorelai.

3-22.title: Those Are Strings, Pinocchio
3-22.overview: Rory and Lorelai prepare for Rory's graduation from Chilton. But major developments involving the inn threaten to dampen the festivities.

4-1.title: Ballrooms and Biscotti
4-1.overview: After returning from a summer of backpacking through Europe, Rory and Lorelai frantically prepare for Rory's move to college.

4-2.title: The Lorelais' First Day at Yale
4-2.overview: Lorelai helps Rory move into her dorm, where she meets an odd new roommate, and learns that she will also be sharing her room with a familiar face.

4-3.title: The Hobbit, the Sofa, and Digger Stiles
4-3.overview: Emily redecorates Rory's dorm room without her permission. Lorelai and Sookie cater a kids' birthday party with a "Lord of the Rings" theme.

4-4.title: Chicken or Beef?
4-4.overview: While visiting Stars Hollow for the weekend, Rory encounters Dean, who awkwardly invites her to an event the next day.

4-5.title: The Fundamental Things Apply
4-5.overview: Lorelai struggles to hide details of her life from Emily. Rory discovers that college dating isn't easy. Lorelai invites Luke over for movie night.

4-6.title: An Affair to Remember
4-6.overview: Emily hires Lorelai and Sookie to cater an elaborate launch party for Richard's new company, but insists they prove that they are worthy of her trust.

4-7.title: The Festival of Living Art
4-7.overview: Rory and Lorelai participate in a Stars Hollow event in which the townspeople dress up and present tableaux imitating famous paintings.

4-8.title: Die, Jerk
4-8.overview: Rory tries to spice up her articles for the student newspaper. Luke admits to Lorelai that he is revisiting a past relationship.

4-9.title: Ted Koppel's Big Night Out
4-9.overview: Emily realizes that Richard has been secretly meeting someone for lunch for years. Lorelai accepts an invitation to dinner.

4-10.title: The Nanny and the Professor
4-10.overview: Lorelai and Sookie renovate their inn. Lorelai enjoys a romantic evening. Rory is irritated by Paris's new relationship.

4-11.title: In the Clamor and the Clangor
4-11.overview: Lorelai is upset that Luke has gotten an apartment in another town. Rory learns that a guy she likes has been spreading false information about her.

4-12.title: A Family Matter
4-12.overview: Luke is wary when his sister comes to town. Lorelai hesitates to tell her parents about her new beau. Paris's affair gets serious.

4-13.title: Nag Hammadi Is Where They Found the Gnostic Gospels
4-13.overview: Rory crosses paths with Jess in Stars Hollow. Luke's sister visits Stars Hollow and introduces her new boyfriend to her brother.

4-14.title: The Incredible Sinking Lorelais
4-14.overview: Overwhelmed by her classwork, Rory confides in Dean, who's working on the construction crew at the Dragonfly Inn.

4-15.title: Scene in a Mall
4-15.overview: Rory gets a glimpse of Dean's new life. When Lorelai and Rory spend a day at the mall, they run into Emily on a wild shopping spree.

4-16.title: The Reigning Lorelai
4-16.overview: Richard is devastated by a sudden loss. Emily receives a shock when she finds an old letter that was written to Richard.

4-17.title: Girls in Bikinis, Boys Doin' the Twist
4-17.overview: Rory and Paris head south for their first spring break in Florida, where they run into a couple of their old pals from Chilton.

4-18.title: Tick, Tick, Tick, Boom!
4-18.overview: Jason and Richard are sued. Rory is upset by a decision Dean has made. Dean is told to stop spending time with Rory.

4-19.title: Afterboom
4-19.overview: Lorelai confronts her father when she learns that he has cut business ties. Luke gives Lorelai an update on his love life.

4-20.title: Luke Can See Her Face
4-20.overview: A self-help tape helps a depressed Luke realize who his soul mate is. Lorelai is stressed as the Dragonfly Inn's opening day approaches.

4-21.title: Last Week Fights, This Week Tights
4-21.overview: Jess walks his mother down the aisle at her Renaissance-themed wedding. Luke asks his new love interest on a date. Dean confides in Rory.

4-22.title: Raincoats and Recipes
4-22.overview: Lorelai invites friends and family to do a test run of the Dragonfly Inn opening. Two suitors pursue Lorelai.

5-1.title: Say Goodbye to Daisy Miller
5-1.overview: Rory and Lorelai argue about a choice Rory made. Lorelai is happy in her new relationship. Emily and Rory plan to take a European trip.

5-2.title: A Messenger, Nothing More
5-2.overview: After Rory apologizes to Lorelai, she sends a letter from Europe, which has unintended consequences. Meanwhile, Luke returns home.

5-3.title: Written in the Stars
5-3.overview: Lorelai is a little offended that no one cares about her new relationship – until it becomes a topic of heated discussion at the town meeting.

5-4.title: Tippecanoe and Taylor, Too
5-4.overview: Rory and Dean meet alone to discuss where they stand with each other. Lorelai and Sookie manage Jackson's campaign for a town office.

5-5.title: We Got Us a Pippi Virgin!
5-5.overview: Wanting to smooth over her relationship with Dean, Lorelai suggests a night out with Luke and Rory – but the evening goes awry.

5-6.title: Norman Mailer, I'm Pregnant!
5-6.overview: Lorelai and Sookie are thrilled when a cultural icon starts frequenting the Dragonfly Inn dining room. Rory discovers an intriguing secret society.

5-7.title: You Jump, I Jump, Jack
5-7.overview: Logan takes Rory to a mysterious and elaborate event. After discovering that Lorelai has a new beau, Emily and Richard spend time with him.

5-8.title: The Party's Over
5-8.overview: When Emily and Richard throw a party to introduce Rory to their alumni friends, she has a realization about her boyfriend.

5-9.title: Emily Says Hello
5-9.overview: Rory and Lorelai plan to convince Richard and Emily to reconcile, but Emily dashes their hopes by making a bold announcement.

5-10.title: But Not as Cute as Pushkin
5-10.overview: Rory hosts a high school student who's considering the same university, but things don't go as planned. Lorelai and her beau have their first fight.

5-11.title: Women Of Questionable Morals
5-11.overview: When Christopher visits Rory at college, she rejects his attempt at reconciliation. Lorelai consoles him but doesn't tell her boyfriend where she was.

5-12.title: Come Home
5-12.overview: Rory offers to help Logan write an article. When Richard sees Emily talking to a man she dated, he has an explosive reaction.

5-13.title: Wedding Bell Blues
5-13.overview: Lorelai and Rory throw Emily a party. Richard and Emily recommit to their marriage. Rory tells Logan what she wants from him.

5-14.title: Say Something
5-14.overview: After the disastrous scene at her parents' recent social event, Lorelai begs her boyfriend not to give up on their relationship.

5-15.title: Jews and Chinese Food
5-15.overview: Lorelai is upset about the recent turn of events. Luke builds sets for the elementary school play in hopes of seeing the costume designer.

5-16.title: So... Good Talk
5-16.overview: Richard and Emily return from their second honeymoon. Miserable Luke burns food and handles complaining customers by throwing them out of the diner.

5-17.title: Pulp Friction
5-17.overview: Rory regrets agreeing with her beau to date other people. Lorelai reunites with her boyfriend but remains cold toward Emily.

5-18.title: To Live and Let Diorama
5-18.overview: Luke helps turn an old house into a museum. Lorelai says too much during an interview about the inn. Rory, Paris and Lane have boyfriend trouble.

5-19.title: But I'm a Gilmore
5-19.overview: When Rory tells her beau she can't have a casual relationship with him, he gives her an unexpected response. Sookie finds herself confined to her bed.

5-20.title: How Many Kropogs to Cape Cod?
5-20.overview: Rory begins her internship at one of Logan's father's newspapers. Emily and Richard fawn over Rory's boyfriend, but Lorelai is not as impressed.

5-21.title: Blame Booze and Melville
5-21.overview: Rory is surprised by the performance review she receives from Logan's father. Luke's plan to buy the Twickham house is threatened by a competing bid.

5-22.title: A House Is Not a Home
5-22.overview: Lorelai rescues Rory after a night of reckless behavior. Shocked to hear her daughter's plans for the future, she turns to Luke for help.

6-1.title: New and Improved Lorelai
6-1.overview: Luke responds to Lorelai. Rory faces legal consequences. Angry with Rory, Richard and Emily, Lorelai cuts off ties with them.

6-2.title: Fight Face
6-2.overview: Rory winds up in a fight while performing community service. Lorelai gets a dog. Luke and Lorelai decide to renovate Lorelai's house.

6-3.title: The UnGraduate
6-3.overview: Rory takes a job at Emily's Daughters of the American Revolution office and serves as her grandmother's spy. Lorelai won't commit to a date.

6-4.title: Always a Godmother, Never a God
6-4.overview: Sookie hopes to reconcile the estranged Gilmore girls by asking both Lorelai and Rory to be godparents to her kids, but things don't go as planned.

6-5.title: We've Got Magic to Do
6-5.overview: After two separate confrontations with the Huntzbergers at a D.A.R. party, Richard and Emily realize Lorelai was right about their treatment of Rory.

6-6.title: Welcome to the Doll House
6-6.overview: After asking Logan about Rory's future plans, Richard admits it was a mistake to let Rory make rash decisions and discusses the matter with Lorelai.

6-7.title: Twenty-One is the Loneliest Number
6-7.overview: Both Lorelai and Rory are saddened that their estrangement will keep them from spending Rory's 21st birthday the way they had always planned.

6-8.title: Let Me Hear Your Balalaikas Ringing Out
6-8.overview: When her former boyfriend visits and reveals an amazing success, Rory begins rethinking the choices she's made with her life.

6-9.title: The Prodigal Daughter Returns
6-9.overview: After months of estrangement, Lorelai and Rory make their first move toward reconciliation. Luke gets a big surprise but conceals it from Lorelai.

6-10.title: He's Slippin’ ‘Em Bread... Dig?
6-10.overview: Rory's long-absent father reappears in her and Lorelai's lives, casting uncertainty on what this will mean for Lorelai's current relationship.

6-11.title: The Perfect Dress
6-11.overview: Wanting to get to know his newly discovered relative, Luke makes a visit. Lorelai sets a date but has a feeling something's not right.

6-12.title: Just Like Gwen and Gavin
6-12.overview: Lorelai finds out about Luke's secret, but not from Luke. She tries to be supportive, but Luke's reaction hurts her. Logan tries to win over Rory.

6-13.title: Friday Night's Alright for Fighting
6-13.overview: Luke gets to know April. Rory tries to get the school newspaper published after the staff quits. All four Gilmores vent their frustrations.

6-14.title: You've Been Gilmored
6-14.overview: Lorelai brings Luke to dinner with her parents. When Rory becomes the new editor of the school paper, her roommate kicks her out of their apartment.

6-15.title: A Vineyard Valentine
6-15.overview: Rory, Lorelai and their beaus spend Valentine's Day weekend on Martha's Vineyard. During their stay, Rory's boyfriend saves the day.

6-16.title: Bridesmaids Revisited
6-16.overview: Rory dazzles the crowd at a journalism panel, but the next day, she's devastated to learn how her boyfriend behaved during their breakup.

6-17.title: I'm OK, You're OK
6-17.overview: Rory forgives her beau. Luke's girlfriend is secretly upset when he spends a few days with April. Rory does some spying on her mother's behalf.

6-18.title: The Real Paul Anka
6-18.overview: Unhappy because Rory hasn't really forgiven him, Logan takes off with his friends. Rory runs into Luke and April at a bookstore in Philadelphia.

6-19.title: I Get A Sidekick Out of You
6-19.overview: After she and her mother scramble to accommodate an unexpected visitor, Lane takes a big step in her life. Lorelai gives in to self-pity.

6-20.title: Super Cool Party People
6-20.overview: When Luke plans a birthday party for April at the diner, Lorelai wants to help and is hurt that Luke thinks it's too soon for her to meet April.

6-21.title: Driving Miss Gilmore
6-21.overview: Lorelai helps Emily while she's unable to see after minor eye surgery. Rory takes charge of Logan's recovery when he returns home.

6-22.title: Partings
6-22.overview: Rory throws a graduation party for Logan, but their time together is bittersweet. Lorelai delivers an ultimatum to Luke.

7-1.title: The Long Morrow
7-1.overview: Lorelai is mortified when she wakes up with an unexpected bedfellow. Rory is puzzled by Logan's going-away present.

7-2.title: That's What You Get, Folks, For Makin' Whoopee
7-2.overview: Rory is upset when she has to cancel a long-planned trip to Asia, so Lorelai turns her house into an Asian-themed wonderland.

7-3.title: Lorelai's First Cotillion
7-3.overview: Lorelai realizes her parents aren't as terrible as she thought. Rory's long-distance relationship proves to be a struggle.

7-4.title: 'S Wonderful, 'S Marvelous
7-4.overview: Lorelai is having trouble fully committing to her current relationship. A relative comes to stay with Luke.

7-5.title: The Great Stink
7-5.overview: Rory is thrilled when her beau comes to town on business but realizes during a dinner with his colleagues that she has no connection to his new world.

7-6.title: Go, Bulldogs!
7-6.overview: Christopher treats Rory's college newspaper co-workers to lunch, but the meal ends abruptly when Rory insists they cover a breaking story.

7-7.title: French Twist
7-7.overview: Christopher and Lorelai take Gigi to visit Sherry. Rory's tenure as editor-in-chief of the university newspaper comes to an end.

7-8.title: Introducing Lorelai Planetarium
7-8.overview: Rory initially pretends to be thrilled about Lorelai's announcement, but later lets her mother know how upset she is when they're alone.

7-9.title: Knit, People, Knit!
7-9.overview: Christopher's well-intentioned gesture at Stars Hollow's knit-a-thon brings the event to an early end.

7-10.title: Merry Fisticuffs
7-10.overview: When Christopher witnesses a sweet moment between a couple, he becomes concerned about his partner's commitment to him.

7-11.title: Santa's Secret Stuff
7-11.overview: Luke asks Lorelai to write a character reference letter for his court case. Lorelai, Christopher and Rory have a late but extravagant Christmas.

7-12.title: To Whom It May Concern
7-12.overview: Sookie acts strangely. Luke attends his court case hearing. Lorelai is confronted about the character reference letter she wrote for Luke.

7-13.title: I'd Rather Be In Philadelphia
7-13.overview: During a family emergency, Lorelai can't reach Christopher. Meanwhile, Logan and Luke drop everything to support Rory, Lorelai, Richard and Emily.

7-14.title: Farewell, My Pet
7-14.overview: Rory has a crush on the teacher filling in for Richard. Christopher and Lorelai talk about their current relationship with each other.

7-15.title: I'm a Kayak, Hear Me Roar
7-15.overview: Lorelai helps Emily organize domestic affairs but has trouble revealing the current state of her love life. Rory attends a birthday dinner for Logan.

7-16.title: Will You Be My Lorelai Gilmore?
7-16.overview: Rory has an interview. Lorelai must settle a fight between Lane and her mother. Logan reveals a failure to Rory.

7-17.title: Gilmore Girls Only
7-17.overview: Lorelai, Rory and Emily go on a road trip to attend the wedding of an old friend. Someone makes a surprise appearance, asking Rory to forgive him.

7-18.title: Hay Bale Maze
7-18.overview: Rory shows her boyfriend around Stars Hollow, while Lorelai worries he's too irresponsible. Lorelai and Luke admit they both made mistakes.

7-19.title: It's Just Like Riding a Bike
7-19.overview: After an awkward encounter, Lorelai and Luke start fighting, which Lorelai takes as a good sign. Rory gets a letter that impacts her future plans.

7-20.title: Lorelai? Lorelai?
7-20.overview: Rory has a scary dream about what lies ahead for her. A visitor discusses Rory's future with Lorelai. Lorelai pours her heart out on karaoke night.

7-21.title: Unto The Breach
7-21.overview: Emily and Richard host a graduation party for Rory. Lorelai and Christopher are relieved to find they can still be friends. Logan surprises Rory.

7-22.title: Bon Voyage
7-22.overview: In this series finale, Rory makes a sudden change in her summer plans, and Luke enlists everyone in Stars Hollow to throw her a farewell party.

77526.name: Star Trek
77526.overview: Space. The Final Frontier. The U.S.S. Enterprise embarks on a five year mission to explore the galaxy. The Enterprise is under the command of Captain James T. Kirk with First Officer Mr. Spock, from the planet Vulcan. With a determined crew, the Enterprise encounters Klingons, Romulans, time paradoxes, tribbles and genetic supermen led by Khan Noonian Singh. Their mission is to explore strange new worlds, to seek new life and new civilizations, and to boldly go where no man has gone before.

0-1.title: The Cage (Original Pilot)
0-1.overview: "The Cage" is the first pilot episode of the Star Trek: The Original Series science fiction series. It was completed in early 1965, but not broadcast on television in its complete form until late 1988. The episode was written by Gene Roddenberry and directed by Robert Butler. It was rejected by NBC in February 1965, and the network ordered another pilot episode, which became "Where No Man Has Gone Before". Much original footage from "The Cage" was later incorporated into the first season two-parter, "The Menagerie".

0-2.title: The Cage (Extended Version)
0-2.overview: Stardate not given: The United Space Ship Enterprise (NCC-1701), commanded by Captain Christopher Pike, discovers an old-style radio distress signal from the Talos star group. Upon investigation, the landing party discovers survivors of an expedition. . .

0-3.title: Star Trek's 25th Anniversary Special
0-3.overview:
A tribute to Star Trek on its 25th anniversary. This film tells the story of how the series (original and Next Generation) and the first six movies came about. Includes plenty of behind-the-scenes looks, clips from the series and movies, bloopers, and interviews with creator Gene Roddenberry, cast members, and NASA officials. 

For millions of sci-fi fans, the future began on September 8, 1966 -- the date when Star Trek first aired! Hosts William Shatner and Leonard Nimoy join orignal cast members and Next Generation performers in this 25th anniversary tribute crammed with insider info that Star Trek aficionados (and who isn't one?) would gladly travel to the end of the universe to discover. Highlights include insightful commentary from Star Trek creator Gene Roddenberry, memorable moments from the films and two TV series, bloopers, behind-the-scenes footage from Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country, a gallery of those new life forms the Enterprise crew is commissioned to seek out, a training spin on simulators at the U.S. Space Camp and much more. Beam aboard!

0-4.title: Star Trek: A Captain's Log
0-4.overview: Cast members of the television and movie series "Star Trek" reminisce about the making of the series and the films, and give their opinions on why the series has been so successful. Star Trek: A Captain's Log was originally aired on television and was edited into William Shatner's Star Trek Memories for video. Both titles are made of the same footage and are virtually the same.

0-5.title: Star Trek: 30 Years and Beyond
0-5.overview: For thirty years, Star Trek crews have boldy ventured where none have gone before--and now it's time to celebrate! Join host Ted Danson and the largest gathering of Star Trek members ever for an anniversary salute to Gene Roddenberry's visionary series. Highlights include special appearances by Joan Collins, John Larroquette, Ben Stiller, cast members from Frasier, and a musical tribute by Kenny G. Through stirring film clips and moving personal tributes, you'll relive Star Trek's most unforgettable moments with the people who created them.

0-6.title: Where No Man Has Gone Before (Rare and Unaired Alternate Version)
0-6.overview:
Presented in three parts with 1960s-style act breaks, the alternative pilot offers an entirely different version of Captain James T. Kirk’s opening monologue, music that contrasts from the famous opening theme and an extended action sequence.

This version of "Where No Man Has Gone Before" was completed in 1965 and features archived footage that was not included in the pilot episode ultimately broadcasted.

0-8.title: Kiss 'n' Tell - Romance In The 23rd Century

0-9.title: Life Beyond Trek - William Shatner
0-9.overview: This Documentary Short let us take a look at the life of William Shatner after his life with Star Trek and acting the part of James T. Kirk.

0-12.title: Spacelift: Transporting Trek Into the 21st Century
0-12.overview: Spacelift Transporting Trek Into The 21st Century, shows you how they Remastered The Special Effects from Star Trek Classic to CGI, the re recording of the theme music and the look of the Enterprise.

0-13.title: The Birth Of A Timeless Legacy

0-15.title: Billy Blackburn's Treasure Chest: Rare Home Movies & Special Memories - Part 1
0-15.overview: A collection of behind-the-scenes footage captured by Billy Blackburn

0-16.title: Star Trek - Beyond The Final Frontier

0-17.title: Billy Blackburn's Treasure Chest - Rare Home Movies & Special Memories - Part 2

0-22.title: Trials and Tribble-ations - An Historic Endeavor

0-23.title: Trials and Tribble-ations - Uniting Two Legends

0-24.title: More Tribbles, More Troubles Star Trek The Animated Series Episode 1

0-25.title: Trials and Tribble-ations - Star Trek Deep Space Nine Episode 503

0-26.title: Kirk, Spock & Bones - Star Trek's Great Trio

0-28.title: Star Trek's Divine Diva - Nichelle Nichols

0-29.title: Billy Blackburn's Treasure Chest - Rare Home Movies & Special Memories - Part 3

0-30.title: 'To Boldly Go...' Season Three
0-30.overview: A retrospective piece featuring the primary cast that looks back at the highlights of season three, from the rough and uncertain future of a potential third season to some of the highlight episodes and moments from the season.

0-31.title: A Star Trek Collector's Dream Come True

0-32.title: Life Beyond Trek - Walter Koenig
0-32.overview: A piece featuring the actor who portrayed "Chekov" intelligently and engagingly recounting how he came to be a part of "Star Trek," what the show did for his life and career (including his work on Moontrap and "Babylon 5"), and his passion for collecting memorabilia.

0-33.title: Chief Engineer's Log
0-33.overview: The late James Doohan, in a piece recorded in 2003, briefly recalling his career, participation on D-Day, his extensive work on "Star Trek," his favorite episodes, his character's influence on fans, and more.

0-34.title: Memoir From Mr. Sulu
0-34.overview: An interview with George Takei, recorded in 2004, containing the actor discussing how "Star Trek" has influenced his life, the history of Japanese-Americans, and more.

0-37.title: Captain's Log Bob Justman
0-37.overview: A collection of "Star Trek" actors and crew members recalling the crucial contributions of the longtime series producer, intercut with interview clips with Justman himself.

0-38.title: Star Trek: The Original Series on Blu-Ray

0-39.title: David Gerrold Hosts "2009 Convention Coverage"
0-39.overview: The famed "Star Trek" writer in attendance at a convention, interviewing major and minor cast members (including Chase Masterson, Robert Picardo, Nichelle Nichols, and Nana Visitor) and fans, looking through memorabilia, and more.

0-40.title: "The Anthropology of Star Trek" Comic-Con Panel 2009
0-40.overview: Anthropology Professor Daryl G. Frazetti from Lake Tahoe Community College speaking on how "Star Trek" impacts and reflects on society.

0-42.title: Star Trek Day 2020: The Original Series Panel

0-43.title: Inside the Roddenberry Vault (Part 1)
0-43.overview: The first part of a three-part "Making-of" documentary, featuring various Star Trek commentators including production staffers of the show itself, old and new, looking in detail at the recovered footage and their places in the respective episodes.

0-44.title: Inside the Roddenberry Vault (Part 2)
0-44.overview: The second part of a three-part "Making-of" documentary, featuring various Star Trek commentators including production staffers of the show itself, old and new, looking in detail at the recovered footage and their places in the respective episodes.

0-45.title: Inside the Roddenberry Vault (Part 3)
0-45.overview: The third part of a three-part "Making-of" documentary, featuring various Star Trek commentators including production staffers of the show itself, old and new, looking in detail at the recovered footage and their places in the respective episodes.

0-46.title: Star Trek: Revisiting a Classic
0-46.overview: A look back at the origins of the series, including on-set footage

0-47.title: Strange New Worlds: Visualizing the Fantastic
0-47.overview: Focusing on the special effects of the series, and including original film elements

0-48.title: Swept Up: Snippets from the Cutting Room Floor

0-49.title: Red Shirt Logs: Robert Justman Discusses "The Cage"
0-49.overview: Robert Justman describes setting up a forced perspective shot in "The Cage" in order to show the immensity of the alien area beneath the surface.

0-50.title: Red Shirt Logs: Robert Justman Discusses "The Corbomite Maneuver"
0-50.overview: Robert Justman describes the effect of hiring a child actor and then using an adult male's voice in place of the child's.

0-51.title: Red Shirt Logs: John D.F. Black on William Shatner
0-51.overview: John D.F. Black remembers an early conversation with William Shatner.

0-52.title: Red Shirt Logs: George Takei Discusses a Rumor
0-52.overview: George Takei addresses the rumor that he "went crazy" with a fencing foil.

0-53.title: Red Shirt Logs: Penny Juday Discusses Tribbles
0-53.overview: Penny Juday discusses the how tribbles were made for the episode "The Trouble with Tribbles".

0-54.title: Red Shirt Logs: William Shatner on Fighting Monsters
0-54.overview: William Shatner discusses "A Private Little War" and reveals the secret to winning fights with wooly monsters.

0-55.title: Red Shirt Logs: Bjo Trimble Discusses Censorship of Star Trek
0-55.overview: Bjo Trimble discusses the different reasons that some Star Trek scenes and entire episodes were censored in various places around the world.

0-56.title: Red Shirt Logs: Leonard Nimoy Talks Star Trek Tech
0-56.overview: Leonard Nimoy discusses Star Trek's use of non-invasive medicine.

0-57.title: Red Shirt Logs: William Shatner on Keeping Perspective
0-57.overview: William Shatner discusses the fact that while "this is just a television show", he knows it means so much to the show's fans. He honors that and talks about keeping a proper perspective for himself.

0-58.title: Red Shirt Logs: Leonard Nimoy Discusses Acting after Star Trek
0-58.overview: Leonard Nimoy talks about his working after Star Trek was cancelled. His first role was that of Paris in Mission: Impossible, and he discusses how different the work was compared to playing Spock. He talks about leaving his Mission: Impossible contract early and his acting work beyond that.

0-59.title: Red Shirt Logs: George Takei on Sulu's Career Advancement
0-59.overview: George Takei discusses his struggle to get Sulu promoted as the show and movies progressed.

0-60.title: Red Shirt Logs: George Takei on the Star Trek 25th Anniversary Convention
0-60.overview: George Takei discusses the diverse, international crowd that attended the Star Trek 25th Anniversary Convention and how it reflected Gene Roddenberry's vision of "Starship Earth".  He spoke about how moving it was to see the crowd so loudly cheer and applaud for Gene Roddenberry when he came out on stage.

0-61.title: Red Shirt Logs: Bjo Trimble Discusses "Let That Be Your Last Battlefield"
0-61.overview: Bjo Trimble discusses that when "Let That Be Your Last Battlefield" was released, it was not well-received. It was released in the 1960's, when the United States was fighting in the Vietnam War, and the fans just were not ready for the message that this episode was delivering.

0-62.title: Red Shirt Logs: Bjo Trimble Discusses "Elaan of Troyius"
0-62.overview: Bjo Trimble discusses the many fun aspects of making the episode "Elaan of Troyius".

1-1.title: The Man Trap
1-1.overview: Doctor Leonard “Bones” McCoy meets a former girlfriend when the enterprise brings supplies to a remote archaeological survey group. Still attractive to McCoy, the woman's current appearance hides a dark and deadly secret.

1-2.title: Charlie X
1-2.overview: Raised from boyhood by non-corporeal beings, 17 year old Charles Evans is picked up and transferred to the Enterprise. On board the ship, the teenager proves dangerously unable to wield his enormous psionic powers with maturity.

1-3.title: Where No Man Has Gone Before
1-3.overview: When Enterprise encounters a Force Field at the edge of the Galaxy, one of the crew members psionic abilities are accelerated to God like proportions causing him to become a powerful murderous being.

1-4.title: The Naked Time
1-4.overview: An alien virus strips the enterprise crew of their inhibitions, causing chaos as each crew member is overcome by hidden emotions. Meanwhile, the Enterprise is being pulled inexorably into a nearby planet's gravity well.

1-5.title: The Enemy Within
1-5.overview: Split by a transporter malfunction into two beings with very different personalities, the resulting twin Captain Kirk proves that neither a purely evil nor a sweetly good captain can survive without the missing half.

1-6.title: Mudd's Women
1-6.overview: Rescuing the crew of a ship from an asteroid belt, the Enterprise plays host to conman extraordinaire, the cunning Harry Mudd and his cargo: three beautiful women looking for suitors.

1-7.title: What Are Little Girls Made Of?
1-7.overview: Helping nurse Christine Chapel search for her fiancé, the Enterprise finds a detached Dr. Korby working on a plan to create Android duplicates of key figures, beginning with James Kirk.

1-8.title: Miri
1-8.overview: On a planet populated by children whose aging process has been slowed artificially. Kirk’s  landing party members contract a virus that kills adults. Despite their violent attacks, Kirk is determined to help the children.

1-9.title: Dagger of the Mind
1-9.overview: When a wild eyed maniac escaping from the Tantalus Penal Colony turns out to be one of the psychiatric staff, Kirk investigates the institution and discovers a chilling exercise in mind control.

1-10.title: The Corbomite Maneuver
1-10.overview: Threatened by the sinister captain of a powerful alien vessel, Kirk claims that the Enterprise carries a powerful explosive which will destroy both ships. The move produces unexpected actions from the alien adversary.

1-11.title: The Menagerie (1)
1-11.overview: Apparently summoned to Star Base 11, Kirk, Spock and McCoy visit a former Enterprise Commander, the paralyzed and horribly disfigured Christopher Pike. Uncharacteristically, Spock commandeers the Enterprise, then turns himself in for court martial.

1-12.title: The Menagerie (2)
1-12.overview: Spock's court martial reveals the actions of Captain Pike on his previous visit to Talos IV, where the powerful Talosians tried to persuade Pike to breed with women provided for the purpose.

1-13.title: The Conscience of the King
1-13.overview: Contacted by one of the other two witnesses to the crimes of mass murderer  “Kodos the Executioner,” Kirk is persuaded that the criminal may be disguising himself as an actor in a traveling theatrical troupe.

1-14.title: Balance of Terror
1-14.overview: Despite the earlier Romulan war, the Romulans have never been seen in person. The Enterprise, in pursuit of a Romulan aggressor, makes a discovery that causes suspicion about a senior crew member.

1-15.title: Shore Leave
1-15.overview: When McCoy sees the White Rabbit from Alice in Wonderland, the crew begins to realize that the planet they are visiting seems to have the dangerous power to turn any thought into reality.

1-16.title: The Galileo Seven
1-16.overview: Crash landing on a planet populated by hostile giants, the 7-man crew of the shuttlecraft Galileo find themselves unable to communicate with the enterprise or to escape the planet's atmosphere.

1-17.title: The Squire of Gothos
1-17.overview: Encountering an uncharted planet in an empty region of space, Kirk and his crew are entertained by Trelane, a playful being who lacks the self-control to wield his great psionic powers with discipline.

1-18.title: Arena
1-18.overview: With both their ships held captive by powerful beings, Kirk and the captain of the alien vessel are placed on an asteroid to fight for their lives and the lives of their crews.

1-19.title: Tomorrow Is Yesterday
1-19.overview: In a freak accident the Enterprise is sent back to 20th century Earth, and must find their way back without changing history.

1-20.title: Court Martial
1-20.overview: Captain Kirk's career is at stake when he is put on trial for the loss of a crewman during an ion storm.

1-21.title: The Return of the Archons
1-21.overview: The Enterprise encounters a seemingly peaceful civilization run by a "benevolent" being named Landru... who intends for them to join his people.

1-22.title: Space Seed
1-22.overview: The Enterprise picks up a crew of genetic supermen from the 20th century... and their leader, Khan, plans to create a new empire.

1-23.title: A Taste of Armageddon
1-23.overview: The Enterprise arrives at a planet to establish diplomatic relations and finds itself in the middle of a "peaceful" war that threatens to destroy the ship.

1-24.title: This Side of Paradise
1-24.overview: The Enterprise crew try to rescue colonists from deadly radiation, but instead encounter strange alien spores that seem to offer paradise.

1-25.title: The Devil in the Dark
1-25.overview: Kirk investigates a series of grisly murders on a mining planet that are the work of a seemingly hostile alien creature.

1-26.title: Errand of Mercy
1-26.overview: The Federation and the Klingon Empire teeter on the brink of war as Kirk investigates Organia, a humble planet, inhabited by pacifists, that is unwittingly caught in the middle.

1-27.title: The Alternative Factor
1-27.overview: Kirk and Spock encounter an alien named Lazarus who claims to be from an anti-matter universe.

1-28.title: The City on the Edge of Forever
1-28.overview: Kirk and Spock must travel into the past in order to correct a change that will alter history.

1-29.title: Operation: Annihilate!
1-29.overview: Kirk and the Enterprise must combat parasitic aliens threatening the lives of millions.

2-1.title: Amok Time
2-1.overview: First Officer Spock returns to his home world for a brutal Vulcan mating ritual.

2-2.title: Who Mourns for Adonais?
2-2.overview: The crew of the Enterprise are held captive by an alien who turns out to be the Greek god Apollo.

2-3.title: The Changeling
2-3.overview: The crew of the USS Enterprise deals with an indestructible planet-destroying space probe.

2-4.title: Mirror, Mirror
2-4.overview: A transporter mishap swaps Captain Kirk and his companions with their evil counterparts in a parallel universe. In the so-called Mirror Universe, the Enterprise is a ship of the Terran Empire, an organization as evil as the United Federation of Planets is benevolent.

2-5.title: The Apple
2-5.overview: The crew of the Enterprise visits a mysterious paradisical planet controlled by a computer that is served by the local inhabitants.

2-6.title: The Doomsday Machine
2-6.overview: The starship Enterprise and its heavily-damaged sister ship, the USS Constellation, must work together to stop an alien planet-killing machine headed for the heart of Federation territory.

2-7.title: Catspaw
2-7.overview: Two powerful aliens threaten the well-being of the Enterprise and her crew.

2-8.title: I, Mudd
2-8.overview: Captain Kirk has a second run-in with the conman, Harry Mudd. Mudd is now the supreme ruler of a planet of androids who cater to his every whim.

2-9.title: Metamorphosis
2-9.overview: A shuttle crew from the USS Enterprise encounters a man out of history and his mysterious alien companion.

2-10.title: Journey to Babel
2-10.overview: The Enterprise must transport dignitaries to a peace conference, with an assassin on the loose.

2-11.title: Friday's Child
2-11.overview: The crew of the Enterprise become entangled in a planet's tribal power struggle.

2-12.title: The Deadly Years
2-12.overview: Strange radiation exposes the command crew of the Enterprise to the effects of rapid aging.

2-13.title: Obsession
2-13.overview: Captain James T. Kirk becomes obsessed with destroying a deadly entity he once encountered in his youth.

2-14.title: Wolf in the Fold
2-14.overview: A series of bizarre murders points to Mr. Scott as the prime suspect.

2-15.title: The Trouble With Tribbles
2-15.overview: The Enterprise must protect a very important shipment of grain from both Klingons and some adorable creatures called tribbles.

2-16.title: The Gamesters of Triskelion
2-16.overview: Captain Kirk and his companions are abducted into slavery and trained to fight as gladiators for the gambling entertainment of three disembodied beings.

2-17.title: A Piece of the Action
2-17.overview: The Enterprise visits a planet with an Earth-like 1920s gangster culture.

2-18.title: The Immunity Syndrome
2-18.overview: The crew of the Enterprise encounters an energy-draining field which may be able to destroy the galaxy.

2-19.title: A Private Little War
2-19.overview: The crew of the Enterprise discovers Klingon interference in the development of a formerly peaceful planet and is forced to help maintain a balance of power.

2-20.title: Return to Tomorrow
2-20.overview: Ancient alien minds are given control of Captain Kirk's and First Officer Spock's bodies.

2-21.title: Patterns of Force
2-21.overview: The crew of the Enterprise tracks down a Federation observer on a planet dominated by a "Naziesque" regime.

2-22.title: By Any Other Name
2-22.overview: Beings from another galaxy commandeer the Enterprise in an attempt to return home.

2-23.title: The Omega Glory
2-23.overview: Captain Kirk must find the cure to a deadly disease and put an end to another Starfleet captain's cultural interference.

2-24.title: The Ultimate Computer
2-24.overview: A skeleton Enterprise crew are assigned to test a revolutionary computer system that is given total control of the ship.

2-25.title: Bread and Circuses
2-25.overview: The Enterprise crew investigates the disappearance of a ship's crew on a planet that is a modern version of the Roman Empire.

2-26.title: Assignment: Earth
2-26.overview: While back in time observing Earth in 1968, the Enterprise crew encounters the mysterious Gary Seven who has his own agenda on the planet.

3-1.title: Spock's Brain
3-1.overview: An alien female beams aboard the ship and, after incapacitating the rest of the crew, surgically removes Spock's brain. Kirk and the crew have just hours to locate and replace it before Spock's body dies.

3-2.title: The Enterprise Incident
3-2.overview: The crew of the Enterprise are on a secret mission to steal a Romulan cloaking device.

3-3.title: The Paradise Syndrome
3-3.overview: An alien device on a primitive planet erases Captain Kirk's memory, and he begins a new life with the planet's indigenous people.

3-4.title: And the Children Shall Lead
3-4.overview: On a distant planet, Kirk, Spock and McCoy find a scientific team dead, and their children who, unknown to the crew, have great powers at their disposal.

3-5.title: Is There in Truth No Beauty?
3-5.overview: The Enterprise travels with an alien ambassador whose appearance induces madness.

3-6.title: Spectre of the Gun
3-6.overview: Having been found trespassers into Melkotian space, Captain Kirk and his companions are sent to die in a re-enactment of the gunfight at the O.K. Corral.

3-7.title: Day of the Dove
3-7.overview: An alien force drives the crew of the Enterprise into brutal conflict with the Klingons.

3-8.title: For the World Is Hollow and I Have Touched the Sky
3-8.overview: The crew of the Enterprise rush to stop an asteroid from colliding with a Federation world, but discover the asteroid is actually an inhabited generation ship.

3-9.title: The Tholian Web
3-9.overview: Captain Kirk is caught between dimensions while the crew of the Enterprise works to retrieve him. All the while, the Tholians demand that the Enterprise leave their space.

3-10.title: Plato's Stepchildren
3-10.overview: The crew of the Enterprise encounters an ageless and sadistic race of humanoids with the power of telekinesis and who claim to have organized their society around Ancient Greek ideals.

3-11.title: Wink of an Eye
3-11.overview: Invisible "time-accelerated" aliens take over the Enterprise and attempt to abduct the crew for use as "genetic stock".

3-12.title: The Empath
3-12.overview: While visiting a doomed planet, the landing party is subject to torturous experiments by powerful aliens.

3-13.title: Elaan of Troyius
3-13.overview: The USS Enterprise ferries a spoiled princess whose betrothal to a royal Troyian is hoped will bring peace to a star system at war.

3-14.title: Whom Gods Destroy
3-14.overview: Captain Kirk faces off with a demented shape-shifting starship captain determined to control the universe.

3-15.title: Let That Be Your Last Battlefield
3-15.overview: The Enterprise encounters two duo-chromatic and mutually belligerent aliens who put the ship in the middle of their old conflict.

3-16.title: The Mark of Gideon
3-16.overview: A race of overpopulated aliens abduct Captain Kirk to solve their problem.

3-17.title: That Which Survives
3-17.overview: Kirk, McCoy, and Sulu are stranded on a barren planet where a mysterious woman attempts to kill them one at a time, while the Enterprise must travel halfway across the galaxy to rescue them.

3-18.title: The Lights of Zetar
3-18.overview: Strange incorporeal aliens threaten the Memory Alpha station and the Enterprise.

3-19.title: Requiem for Methuselah
3-19.overview: The crew of the Enterprise encounter an immortal human in this science fiction variation on Shakespeare's The Tempest.

3-20.title: The Way to Eden
3-20.overview: The Enterprise picks up a group of space "hippies" looking for Eden.

3-21.title: The Cloud Minders
3-21.overview: Captain Kirk races against time to acquire plague-fighting minerals from a world in the midst of a civil uprising against a grievous social class disparity.

3-22.title: The Savage Curtain
3-22.overview: Aliens force Captain Kirk and First Officer Spock to join forces with "Abraham Lincoln" and "Surak" to battle villains in a contest of good vs. evil.

3-23.title: All Our Yesterdays
3-23.overview: Kirk, Spock and McCoy are trapped in two parts of another planet's past - a world threatened with destruction when its sun goes supernova.

3-24.title: Turnabout Intruder
3-24.overview: The Enterprise is in danger when Janice Lester, one of Kirk's former lovers, steals his body.

78443.name: Danny Phantom
78443.overview: Danny Fenton was once your typical kid until he accidentally blew up his parents' laboratory and became ghost-hunting superhero Danny Phantom. Now half-ghost, Danny's picked up paranormal powers, but only his sister, Jazz, and best friends, Samantha and Tucker, know his secret. Danny's busy fighting ghosts, saving Casper High and hiding his new identity all while trying to graduate.

similar.name: The Adventures of Jimmy Neutron: Boy Genius
My Life as a Teenage Robot

1-1.title: Mystery Meat
1-1.overview: Danny's new ghost powers are put to the test when the school cafeteria's all-vegetarian menu arouses the ire of the ghostly Lunch Lady, a 50-foot shambling pile of mystery meat who seeks revenge and a return to high-cholesterol diets. It's up to Danny to push her back in the fridge where she belongs.

1-2.title: Parental Bonding
1-2.overview: Danny uses his "overshadowing" power to take control of his Dad during a parent-teacher conference, but the plan backfires when Jack Fenton is invited to chaperone the school dance.
