Orlo's men try to fight the invaders but are defeated. After rescuing Tera, Conan, Jimsy and Dyce hurry to the village to help the villagers organize their defense. By landing on the wrong side of the island, Monsley has lost the element of surprise, but Orlo and his men switch sides for Industria, infiltrate High Harbor's defenses and betray them from within. Lana is knocked out by a cannon blast, and when Conan sees Jimsy's pet piglet, which was entrusted to Lana, arrive on its own, he immediately rushes to save her.

1-18.title: Gunboat
1-18.overview: Conan saves Lana from Industria's soldiers but gets knocked out; Lana manages to hide him before she gets captured and taken aboard the gunboat. Industria occupies High Harbor, and Orlo is installed as a puppet governor. To deprive them of their only means of support, Conan and Gil, the only villager to escape, prepare to sink the gunboat with explosives. But after planting the charge, Conan learns that Lana is aboard and boards the vessel to retrieve her, but ends up captured. After tricking the crew into taking him out of his cell, the charge detonates, sinking the ship and allowing Conan to rescue Lana from her cell.

1-19.title: Giant Tsunami
1-19.overview: With the gunboat gone, Monsley decides to repair the Barracuda and use it in its place, while Orlo's gang is sent out to find Conan. Conan and Gil plan to blow up the Barracuda; Dyce, while getting away from the Industrians, stumbles upon Lana in the fish preserve. When the island's animals begin to act strangely, Lana knows that another earthquake is about to happen, and rushes to warn the villagers. When Orlo stops her, Lana telepathically informs Conan that a tidal wave is coming. Conan warns everybody, and they all run to higher ground as the wave rushes in. With the Barracuda stranded atop the island's forest by the flood, the soldiers give up and the villagers win the war.

1-20.title: To Industria Again
1-20.overview: The village chief lets the soldiers join their community. Conan decides to return to Industria using an old seaplane left by Dr. Lao in the fish preserve cave. Together with Jimsy, Monsley, Lana as a last-minute joiner, and Dyce as a stowaway, Conan departs High Harbor; but just upon reaching Industria, the group encounters the restored Falcon. After letting Lana, Dyce, and Jimsy disembark, Conan and Monsley distract the Falcon by leading it away from their friends.

1-21.title: The Citizens Underground
1-21.overview: Conan and Monsley crash into Industria and are captured. Under pursuit, Lana, Dyce, and Jimsy find a way into the underground barracks of Industria's lower-class citizenry. They eventually come across Luke and his friends, and learn from them that Dr. Lao managed to make a deal with the High Council to evacuate Industria, but they were all detained by Lepka, who subsequently appointed himself dictator. Monsley witnesses Lepka viciously torturing Lao and ruthlessly planning to flush Lana out of hiding by flooding the entire underground residential area. When she tries to persuade him to follow Dr. Lao's advice, but Lepka stubbornly refuses to follow a more peaceful path, Monsley openly turns against Lepka and helps Conan escape. But before she can accompany Conan, she gets shot, forcing Conan to leave her behind.

1-22.title: Rescue
1-22.overview: Conan descends to the residential area to rescue Lana. After overhearing Lepka's intentions to flood the caverns, he attempts to defuse the bombs used to create the flooding breach, but is unsuccessful. Lana gives herself up to save the residents; but after she is back in his hands, Lepka seals the exit anyway, leaving the people to drown. When he takes Lana to her grandfather, however, he is forced to learn that Dr. Lao has gone numb and blind from his tortures, rendering further threats against him useless, so he tries to force Lana to contact him by threatening to plunge her off the Triangle Tower. In the meantime Conan rejoins Dyce and Jimsy, and they exit the caverns through a flooded earthquake fissure, where they rescue Monsley, who was about to be executed. They manage to open the main shutter to the caverns, and the residents storm the Triangle Tower.

1-23.title: Solar Tower
1-23.overview: Conan continues going up the tower to confront Lepka, who attempts to flee via a flying machine, with Lana as his hostage. Conan cripples the vessel and saves Lana, while Lepka apparently perishes aboard the crashing machine. While Dyce takes Monsley away for medical treatment and keeps her company, Lana wakes Dr. Lao, and together they and the High Council scientists work to complete the Solar Tower and activate the satellite. The link-up is successfully established, and Industria gains the power it needs to facilitate the evacuation program. After preparations are initiated, Lao uses the Triangle Tower's holographic park to explain to Conan, Lana and Jimsy that the old world's dream of unlimited power - an unattainable illusion - was responsible for the great catastrophe that devastated the Earth, and that humanity shall henceforth learn to live in harmony with nature again.

1-24.title: Gigant
1-24.overview: As new earthquakes begin to herald Industria's incoming destruction, Lepka, who has survived the crash of his flyer, and a troop of loyalists secretly channel some solar power underground to charge up the Giganto, a giant warplane left over from the last war. When the power leak is discovered and cut, Lepka's forces covertly seize the control room and continue to divert power to the plane. Noticing the takeover, Lana and Monsley escape aboard the Falco to inform the others. Conan and his friends have just finished raising the sunken passenger ship when Lana and Monsley warn them about Lepka, and they return to Industria; but having completed recharging, the Giganto takes off. Conan's group attempts to stop it, but ends up crashing through the plane's surface. After pushing the Falco back out to enable Monsley and Lana to return to Industria, Conan, Jimsy and Dyce infiltrate the Giganto.

1-25.title: The End of Industria
1-25.overview: Evading Lepka's attempts to eliminate them, Conan, Jimsy, and Dyce start inflicting critical damage to the Giganto. While Dyce and Jimsy eventually end up getting jettisoned inside the tail rudder, Conan confronts Lepka as he tries to get away in an escape pod. Despite Conan's attempt to save them, Lepka and the rest of his men are left to perish aboard the doomed Giganto. A week later, as the final stage of the cataclysm arrives, all the Industrians except the High Council mount the restored passenger ship and watch Industria sink into the sea.

1-26.title: Finale
1-26.overview: On its way to High Harbor, the passenger ship recovers Conan, Dyce and Jimsy from the sea; and after asking Conan to look after Lana, Dr. Lao dies contently. Sometime later, the old and new inhabitants of High Harbor conduct a double celebration surrounding Dyce and Monsley's wedding and the relaunch of the Barracuda. Many of the new settlers, including Conan, Lana, Jimsy, Tera, Luke, Monsley and the Barracuda's crew, leave to establish a new colony on Remnant Island, now expanded by the cataclysm into a new continent.

81705.name: As Told by Ginger
81705.overview: As Told by Ginger focuses on middle schooler Ginger Foutley who, with her friends, tries to become more than a social geek.

similar.name: Saved by the Bell: The New Class
Disney's Adventures of the Gummi Bears

0-1.title: The Party
0-1.overview:
Ginger is invited to Courtney's party, but there's one problem: she has to watch Carl. She takes Carl to the party and ties him up with a hose in the backyard.

Meanwhile, Dodie and Macie have their own party at Dodie's house.

0-2.title: Summer of Camp Caprice
0-2.overview:
Courtney decides to go to Camp Caprice for the summer along with Ginger and her friends. Will the spoiled rich girl get used to roughing it or ruin Ginger's chances with a boy named Sasha she meets there?

Meanwhile, Carl and Hoodsey plot to stay at home during the summer to catch a dog thief by starting a vampire dog cleaning service while Darren and Miranda are sent to a military camp.

Note: In countries where it is shown as three different episodes, the separate episodes have different titles: 'Season of Caprice,' 'Thicker Than Bug Spray,' & 'Break A Lake.'

0-3.title: Far From Home
0-3.overview:
Ginger gets accepted to The Avalance Art Academy. It's a big honor, but it will mean that she has to spend an entire semester away from home. This doesn't sit well with Dodie, who doesn't want her best friend to leave for so long. But what does Miranda and Mipsy have to do with Ginger's acceptance into the prestigious school? And what happens when Darren realizes he's in love with Ginger?

Meanwhile, Carl discovers Noelle has telekenetic powers and enters her in the Weird Human Winter Fest.

Note: This episode was alternatively titled Foutley's On Ice.

0-4.title: Butterflies Are Free
0-4.overview:
Ginger is the only one that is  nervous about moving on to high school while all her friends are  embracing the change and deciding what their new activities will be once  they make the big switch.

Note: This episode was alternatively titled No Turning Back.

0-5.title: The Wedding Frame
0-5.overview: With Lois's wedding to Dr. Dave  nearing, Mrs. Dave and a 'network of silver-haired villains' set out to  sabotage the festivities.

0-6.title: Detention
0-6.overview: As their relationship is souring, Ginger gets detention and has to miss Darren's first football game. Instead of telling him what is really happening, she lies and says she'll be there, only making things worse.

0-7.title: Kiss Today Goodbye
0-7.overview: Dodie, trying out for the Pep Squad, is doing anything and everything she can to convince the coach to let her on the team.

0-8.title: A Lesson in Tightropes
0-8.overview: Ginger and Darren break up, and what Ginger thinks is total heartbreak ends up being a burst appendix and she's rushed to the hospital. Carl looks up to Dr. Dave as his real father after he saves Ginger's life.

0-9.title: Dodie's Big Break
0-9.overview: Dodie is made an official member of the pep squad after she exaggerates a minor injury sustained in her role as mascot. Ginger sees through the ruse, though, and convinces Dodie to try to earn the position honorably.

0-10.title: Battle of the Bands
0-10.overview: When the schools cuts the music program funding in order to finance new uniforms for the football team, Ginger plans a protest, only to be outdone by Carl and Hoodsey's hijacking of Courtney's private Port-o-Potty, and her humiliation during a game.

1-1.title: Ginger the Juvey
1-1.overview: When Ginger is invited to Courtney Gripling's party, she's under pressure to find the perfect gift, but will she resort to stealing?

1-2.title: Carl and Maude
1-2.overview: When Ginger and her friends go to the senior's home to do community service, Carl tags along and meets Maude, a granny who loves playing pranks and is every bit as disgusting as he is. Is true love blooming for Ginger's younger brother? And how will Courtney handle Carl's new flame when they both come over for dinner at the Foutley house?

1-3.title: Stealing First
1-3.overview: Why is Ginger so nervous about going on the ski trip with her school? Perhaps it's because she can't ski, or maybe it's because Carl and Hoodsey snuck along to cause mischief of their own, or maybe it's because Courtney is trying to get her to kiss that French foreign exchange student on the ski lift... Hmmm, doesn't seem like there's anything to worry about at all!

1-4.title: Sleep on It
1-4.overview: Courtney proves to be the one out of the loop when she looks to Ginger to show her how to play all the party games at the first Gripling sleep-over. Will Ginger show the popular kids the fine art of the slumber party, or will Carl and Hoodsey spoil all the fun?

1-5.title: Of Lice & Friends
1-5.overview: Dodie gets the job of making the school announcements and uses it as a forum to reveal gossip about Lucky Junior High. When a lice scare hits the school and Dodie finds out Courtney has been infected, will she make the announcement or will Ginger be able to convince her to keep her mouth shut.

1-6.title: Dare I, Darren?
1-6.overview: When Miranda suggests that Ginger and Darren are more than just friends, she begins to see him in a different way. Will Ginger and Darren bring their friendship to another level, or will these newfound feelings put a strain on their standing as best pals?

1-7.title: Hello Stranger
1-7.overview: Ginger gets a letter from her dad and decides to invite him to the arts fare at her school to hear her new poem. But the question remains... Will he show up? Meanwhile, Carl gets a dehydrated killer sea snake in the mail and Ginger's mom accidentally drinks it.

1-8.title: Cry Wolf
1-8.overview: Dodie accidentally reveals to Miranda one of Ginger's most closely guarded secrets... her mom won't let her shave her legs. Will Miranda end up spilling the beans to the rest of the school? Meanwhile, Carl becomes 'Wolf Boy' after stealing a janitors toupee.

1-9.title: The Right Stuff
1-9.overview: When Macie and Courtney take a high school French class, the older girls get jealous of the attention the boys are paying to Courtney. So when Courtney invites everyone over to Macie's for a pool party, will Macie spill the beans on some high school plans to "de-bikini" Courtney?

1-10.title: Kiss and Make Up
1-10.overview: Ginger's mom has a no make up policy... She won't allow her daughter to wear any make up at all until she's a teenager. Will she wait that long when school pictures are coming up? Meanwhile, Carl and Hoodsey take a trip with the garbage man.

1-11.title: The 'A' Ticket
1-11.overview: When Ginger and Ian Richton are paired up in chemistry class, Ginger thinks Ian is enthusiastic about it because he likes her, but Darren finds out it might be more about his grades. Meanwhile, Carl and Hoodsey compete to see who gets to play the glockenspiel for a town eccentric.

1-12.title: Come Back Little Seal Girl
1-12.overview: When Ginger has second thoughts about doing Macie and Dodie's traditional "Seal Girl" skit for the Lucky Junior High talent show, Macie decides to do it alone. Can Ginger save her from making a fool of herself, or will she be better than anyone thinks?

1-13.title: Blizzard Conditions
1-13.overview: A blizzard hits and the gang gets a day off from school. Carl and Hoodsey look after a dog named Muffin, while Ginger, Dodie and Macie try to write a report on survival. Meanwhile, Blake and Courtney get trapped in a car with their chauffer. When everyone ends up at Ginger's house with no power and no food, will they all make it out in one piece?

2-1.title: I Spy a Witch
2-1.overview: When Ginger is accused of defacing a statue at her school as a Halloween prank, she is dropped as the lead in the school musical. But will the ghost of Maude reveal who is truly guilty of the crime?

2-2.title: Deja Who?
2-2.overview: When Senator Ricci's son Michael decides to look at Lucky Junior High as a public school he might transfer to, Courtney wants to be his peer counselor to get close to what she considers "royalty". When she has an allergic reaction to cafeteria mystery meat and is bedridden, she has Ginger pretend to be her. But as Ginger starts becoming Courtney too well and ignoring Macie and Dodie, will she turn into someone else for good? Meanwhile, Hoodsey hits his head and gets amnesia.

2-3.title: An Even Steven Holiday Special
2-3.overview: When Ginger realises she's a quarter Jewish, she starts exploring her newly discovered heritage. But when she tells Dodie she won't trim her tree with her, will Ginger be turning her back on Christmas in favor of her Judaism? Meanwhile, Carl breaks the news to Hoodsey that Santa Claus doesn't exist, so Hoodsey sets out to prove him wrong by asking Santa to bring him his one Christmas wish... a visit from Carl and Ginger's father.

2-4.title: Piece of My Heart
2-4.overview: Everyone is going to the Sadie Hawkin's dance... Macie with her "Mystery Man" (actually Hoodsey), Miranda with Ian Richton, and Courtney... with Darren?!? Will Ginger get to the bottom of this and figure out why Courtney has a sudden interest in her good friend?

2-5.title: Never Can Say Goodbye
2-5.overview: Darren gets his braces removed and suddenly becomes attractive to every girl at school. Will Miranda ruin his friendship with Ginger when she becomes his girlfriend? Meanwhile, Brandon's monkey, Mr. Licorice, is missing and Carl and Hoodsey go looking for him.

2-6.title: Gym Class Confidential
2-6.overview: The girls prepare for a screening of a film about puberty in their gym class that Macie is dreading. Will she be able to sit through it or will she chicken out? Meanwhile, Hoodsey deals with being too embarassed to shower after his gym class.

2-7.title: Fast Reputation
2-7.overview: Ginger is sick of being called a "nice girl" by Courtney's friends, so she decides to sneak into a high school party with Dodie and Macie on a school night. There she meets Jake, a "cool" high schooler. When Miranda and Courtney find out and begin spreading rumors about Ginger and her new crush, can she put things right, or will the nice girl suddenly have a "bad reputation"? Meanwhile, Carl and Hoodsey set up a food cart.

2-8.title: Nurses Strike
2-8.overview: Ginger's mom is on strike and needs to bring money in, so she decides to do house cleaning. When Ginger needs $50 to go on a class trip to New York, will she end up helping out her mom without anyone finding out?

2-9.title: Trouble in Gal Pal Land
2-9.overview: When Courtney and Miranda get in a fight over which of their volleyball teams Ginger will play for, Miranda decides to replace Courtney with Ginger as her best friend. Will Ginger have to pick sides between them? Meanwhile, Carl and Hoodsey help Courtney's mom to win an election at her Country Club.

2-10.title: Sibling Revile-ry
2-10.overview: Ginger wins the student council election on the premise of having "big brothers" and "big sisters" to guide the younger elementary school trouble makers. When she assings George Magrority, a military academy kid, to her brother after he blows up the septic system at his school, will he have a positive influence on Carl, or will he go too far?

2-11.title: Losing Nana Bishop
2-11.overview: When Dodie's Nana dies, Ginger and Macie help her out, but Ginger realizes that she never knew her own grandma. Will her dad give her any insights into what she was like? Meanwhile, Hoodsey comes to terms with his own grief at Nana's funeral, but how will his family react when they find out that he has locked an iron mask around his head?

2-12.title: TGIF
2-12.overview: Friday the 13th, Carl's favorite holiday, begins with the Foutley car breaking down, Ginger's sweater getting ripped, and her school paper being blown away. Then a rare house-eating mold is discovered in Ginger's house that causes it to be condemned. Will the streak of bad luck continue, and could it get any worse? Maybe if Ginger gets completely fed up with her family...

2-13.title: Lunatic Lake
2-13.overview: Ginger, Carl and Macie go on vacation to Loon Lake with Dodie and her family, where an escaped "lunatic" from the insane asylum has been reported to be hiding. Will Carl and Hoodsey get to scare Blake, who is camping in the woods there as well, or will they be in for a scare themselves?  Meanwhile, Ginger and Macie deal with Dodie's mom Joann, who is a bit "high strung".

2-14.title: April Fools
2-14.overview:
Ginger decides to play an April Fools joke on Dodie by forging a love letter to her from Dustin, (a weirdo in her class that eats his sandwiches with chopsticks). Things get messy when Dodie admits to having a secret crush on Dustin, while Dustin reveals he really HAS sent a love letter, but to Macie! Will Ginger find a way to work it out?

Meanwhile, Carl and Hoodsey tell Blake they sold his tonsils to a witch doctor, causing him to become sick.

2-15.title: Ms. Foutley's Boys
2-15.overview: Ginger really wants her mom to start dating, but when she starts seeing Buzz the handyman (from the episode TGIF) and his three boys invade the Foutley house, Ginger mifht have second thoughts about it.

2-16.title: Love with a Proper Transfer Student
2-16.overview: Dodie has a crush on Joaquin Cortez, the new transfer student. But she may have some competition, not only from Mipsy, who likes him too, but also from Ginger. When the girls try out for the school musical "Mambo In The Catskills", and Ginger gets the lead opposite Joaquin, will the two best friends come to terms with the fact that they both have a crush on the same guy? Meanwhile, Carl and Hoodsey try to make aphrodisiacs.

2-17.title: Family Therapy
2-17.overview:
Macie thinks her parents are planning a birthday party for her because they are acting elusive, but they actually forget the date. When she confronts them about it, they throw her a birthday party suited for a 4 year old, not a 13 year old. Will Macie show her parents how to treat her like a young lady and not a little kid, or will she enjoy this trip back to her childhood?

Meanwhile, Mipsy, who has her birthday the same day, throws a giant party, and Carl gets scared of a naked mole rat.

2-18.title: New Girl in Town
2-18.overview:
A new student, Laticia Bowers, comes to Lucky Junior High. Her quirky behavior and the fact that she's a mortician's daughter makes her an outcast and target of gossip with the rest of the students. When Ginger and her pals accept her as a friend, will they get Courtney and the "dominant social group" to go to a party at her funeral home house?

Meanwhile, Carl and Hoodsey go to Brandon's birthday party.

2-19.title: Mommie Nearest
2-19.overview:
When Courtney's mother gets hospitalized from a botched plastic surgery, Courtney decides to stay with Ginger and her mom. Will she warm her way into Mrs. Foutley's heart over Ginger?

Meanwhile, Carl wants to get a chin implant.

2-20.title: Ginger's Solo
2-20.overview:
When Ginger fings out that the marching band at her school is going to play at Heathered Hills, where Sasha is a student, she joins up as the extra grande triangle player. Will she rekindle her summer love or will he end up disappointing her?

Meanwhile, Hoodsey and Carl become psychics to raise money.

2-21.title: And She Was Gone
2-21.overview:
When Ginger enters a writing competition and writes a story called "And She Was Gone", it causes Ms. Zorski to think Ginger might be suicidal. Can she convince her teacher and the school psycologist that it was just a work of fiction?

Meanwhile, Carl and Hoodsey try to make a student, Noelle Sussman, disappear with vanishing cream. When they succeed after they discover she might be the perfect girl for them, can they bring her back?

2-22.title: Next Question
2-22.overview:
When Ginger gets a crush on her English teacher and Quiz Team leader Mr. Gardner, what will he say when she asks him out on a date?

Meanwhile, Carl and Hoodsey plot to kidnap the famous Groundhog Pawtucket Pete in order to sell more of their hand-woven scarves.

2-23.title: No Hope for Courtney
2-23.overview:
Ginger and her friends decide to help a Lucky Junior High School girl named Hope to gain popularity by offering her some social and fashion tips. When she takes to the advice so well that she challenges and beats Courtney's reign as the most popular girl in school, will Courtney be able to regain her title?

Meanwhile, Carl causes his teacher Mrs. Gordon to retire and get replaced by music teacher Hepcat Hepper. Will he convince her to come back?

2-24.title: Driven To Extremes
2-24.overview:
Ginger's new substitute teacher is an elderly lady named Ms. Grimley who rules her class with an iron fist. When she assigns Ginger, Courtney and Miranda an 17,000 word essay on the cotton gin, the students decide to get even. But will their plans for revenge end up back-firing?

Meanwhile, Carl and Hoodsey try to teach Mr. Licorice an act for the upcoming pet show... by showing him how to ride a motorcycle.

3-1.title: Wicked Game
3-1.overview:
When Ginger returns from Avalanche Art Academy and ignores everyone around her but Darren, will Macie and Dodie join forces with Mipsy and Miranda to get them to break up?

Meanwhile, Noelle loses Carl in a card game to Polly Schuster, a younger kid who is obsessed with birds.

3-2.title: The Easter Ham
3-2.overview: Ginger is throwing a party for  Darren that every kid in the school wants to attend.  But when Lois and  Joann Bishop get into a fight at the grocery store over the last Easter  ham on the shelf, Joann bans Hoodsey and Dodie from seeing Carl and  Ginger.

3-3.title: About Face
3-3.overview: Joann Bishop gets a job teaching  home economics at the middle school that leaves Dodie mortified when  Joann starts hanging with the "cool girls" at school.

3-4.title: Fair to Cloudy
3-4.overview: Ginger invites Darren to the BFF  yearly tradition of going to the county fair, much to the dismay of  Dodie, who in turn invites Courtney to annoy Ginger.  Carl and Hoodsey  tag along and end up freeing a "two headed" pony from the Nature's  Oddities Tent.

3-5.title: Heat Lightning
3-5.overview: When emotions stir in Ginger upon  seeing Sasha again when she goes back to Camp Caprice, doubt creeps into  Ginger's feelings on her relationship with Darren.

3-6.title: Ten Chairs
3-6.overview: Unbeknownst to Lois, Ginger invites Jonas to Thanksgiving dinner.  Tensions mount when Carl seems to favor Dr. Dave over his natural  father, and the assembled guests, including Mrs. Dave and the Bishop  family are somewhat less than amicable.

3-7.title: Stuff'll Kill Ya
3-7.overview: Ginger, worried about her new  course load in high school, ends up getting addicted to the "Mocha Locha  Frothinator."  Carl tries to walk the straight and narrow path, and is  tricked into thinking he has an incurable disease.

81797.name: One Piece
81797.overview:
Years ago, the fearsome Pirate King, Gol D. Roger was executed leaving a huge pile of treasure and the famous "One Piece" behind. Whoever claims the "One Piece" will be named the new King of the Pirates.

Monkey D. Luffy, a boy who consumed a "Devil Fruit," decides to follow in the footsteps of his idol, the pirate Shanks, and find the One Piece. It helps, of course, that his body has the properties of rubber and that he's surrounded by a bevy of skilled fighters and thieves to help him along the way.

Luffy will do anything to get the One Piece and become King of the Pirates!

similar.name: Is It Wrong to Try to Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? On the Side: Sword Oratoria

5.name: Dreams!, The Zenny Pirate Crew Sortie!, Beyond the Rainbow

0-1.title: Contingency Plan. Complete Summary One Piece
0-1.overview: This is the first recapitulation episode, covering the first five episodes with only the difference being that the episode follows the manga storyline and begins with Luffy and Shanks at the bar. Also, in the ending, the current Straw Hats have a small conversation about their goals.

0-2.title: Adventure in the Ocean's Navel
0-2.overview: The Straw Hats encounter a city in the middle of a whirlpool, called the Ocean's Naval, that is being destroyed by giant monsters. These monsters supposedly protect a treasure capable of granting wishes, but in the process of defeating these guardians, the crew ends up releasing another evil.

0-3.title: Open Upon the Great Sea! A Father's Huge, HUGE Dream!
0-3.overview: Three children, Amanda, Milia and Holy, are being held captive on a pirate ship. Their father, who was a pro treasure hunter, told them the whereabouts of a great treasure. Luffy and crew try to save them but their opponents have a dangerous ability in their sleeves.

0-4.title: Protect! The Last Great Performance
0-4.overview: It is the last performance of a great actor and playwright, but several actors suddenly quit. Luckily, the Straw Hats offer to take their place. However, the quitting actors turns out to be more than a coincidence when they meet a Marine with a grudge against the playwright.

0-5.title: The Detective Memoirs of Chief Straw Hat Luffy
0-5.overview: In an alternate reality world that takes place in 19th century Japan, Luffy acts as a member of the secret police. The story is divided into two halves: in the first, Buggy the Clown makes trouble in the town where Detective Luffy is stationed, and in the second a mysterious girl named Vivi appears. These stories feature cameos from several minor characters in the normal series.

0-6.title: New Year Special: Special Report - Secret of the Straw Hat Pirates!
0-6.overview: This is the second recapitulation episode, covering how each member of the Straw Hat Pirates (up to Nico Robin) joined the crew. It covers events from Romance Dawn Arc, Orange Town Arc, Syrup Village Arc, Baratie Arc, Arlong Park Arc, Drum Island Arc, Arabasta Arc, and Water 7 Arc.

0-7.title: Episode of Nami: Tears of a Navigator and the Bonds of Friends
0-7.overview: Nami leaves the crew after the Baratie Arc to go back to her village. Luffy and the crew follow her, and discover that she is working for a dangerous Fish-Man pirate named Arlong.

0-8.title: Episode of Luffy: Adventure on Hand Island
0-8.overview: During a battle with several Marine warships, the Straw Hat Pirates are forced to make an emergency Coup de Burst in order to escape. Crash landing on a nearby island, after finding a town, they learn of the town's past and people while Luffy befriends a nearby wax sculptor.

0-9.title: Glorious Island
0-9.overview: An exclusive anime prologue to One Piece Film Z with an original story penned by manga creator Eiichiro Oda.

0-10.title: Episode of Merry: The Tale of One More Friend
0-10.overview: During a lull in their travel, the Straw Hats are milling around the Thousand Sunny. Usopp, Chopper, and Brook head out to explore the surrounding ocean in the Mini Merry II. Brook asks about the Merry, since he joined after the crew had acquired the Sunny.

0-11.title: 3D2Y: Overcome Ace’s Death! Luffy’s Vow to his Friends
0-11.overview: Luffy is currently in Rusukaina training to get stronger to take on the New World. However, the training is interrupted when Hancock's sisters, Marigold and Sandersonia, are kidnapped by Byrnndi World, a pirate who was locked away on Level 6 of Impel Down.

0-12.title: Episode of Sabo: Bond of Three Brothers - A Miraculous Reunion and an Inherited Will
0-12.overview: After Ace's death in the Marineford War, which is seen in flashbacks, Sabo appears at his grave. He later arrives in Dressrosa to investigate a weapon smuggling, where he is informed that Doflamingo is holding a tournament at the nearby coliseum with Ace's Flame-Flame devil fruit as a prize.

0-13.title: Adventure of Nebulandia
0-13.overview: The Straw Hat Pirates fight Foxy again in the New World, on Mushroom Island. This soon gives way to a battle against the Marines on an island called Nebulandia that can nullify Devil Fruit powers.

0-14.title: Heart of Gold
0-14.overview: The Straw Hats meet a girl named Olga and travel with her to Alchemi in the pursuit of Pure Gold, but are pursued by the Marines and the treasure hunter Mad Treasure.

0-15.title: Episode of East Blue - Luffy and His 4 Crewmates' Big Adventure
0-15.overview: As the Straw Hat Pirates prepare to leave East Blue and enter the Grand Line, each of them reminisce about their journey to that point as they reaffirm their dreams. Monkey D. Luffy, a rubber man. Roronoa Zoro aka “Pirate Hunter.” Usopp, a sniper. Sanji, a seafaring cook. Nami, “Cat Burglar”. They, the Straw Hats, all place a foot upon a barrel and make their vows before their next journey across the great ocean.

0-16.title: Episode of Sky Island
0-16.overview: The Straw Hats discover a map to Skypiea, a supposedly mythical civilization in the sky. They soon meet Mont Blanc Cricket, who directs them to a natural underwater explosion which serves as transport to the islands in the sky.

0-17.title: Barto's Secret Room
0-17.overview: Bartolomeo and Otama look back on Luffy and the Straw Hat Crew's adventures in the Land of Wano. Otama tells Bartolomeo about her meeting with Luffy, and the events leading up to the fierce battle with Kaido.

0-18.title: A Special Episode to Admire Zoro-senpai and Sanji-senpai! Barto's Secret Room 2!
0-18.overview: Bartolomeo and Law look back on Luffy and the Straw Hats’ adventures in the Land of Wano, featuring Zoro and Sanji. Law tells Bartolomeo how Zoro and Sanji thrived during the events leading up to the great battle with Kaido.

0-19.title: A Comprehensive Anatomy! The Legend of Kozuki Oden!
0-19.overview: Yamato and Momonosuke look back on Oden’s adventures and heroic actions throughout the world and in the Land of Wano. Yamato describes for Momonosuke all the joy and pain that his father went through during his days.

0-20.title: The Captain's Log of the Legend! Red-Haired Shanks!
0-20.overview: As the world anticipates the legendary diva Uta’s show in Elegia, the Red-Hair Pirates are making some disturbing moves. Koby remembers how Shanks ended the Paramount War at Marineford.

0-21.title: A Comprehensive Anatomy! Fierce Fight! The Five from the New Generation
0-21.overview: Captain Kid and Killer look back on their adventures in the Land of Wano along with the other pirates from the Worst Generation, Luffy, Zoro, and Law. They describe how hard the five of them fought against the Emperors of the Sea, Kaido and Big Mom.

0-22.title: Recapping Fierce Fights! Straw Hats vs. Tobi Roppo
0-22.overview: Zoro and Sanji look back on their friends’ battles against the Tobi Roppo, the top officers of the Animal Kingdom Pirates. They describe how hard Nami, Robin, and the others fought to defeat the formidable enemies.

0-23.title: Recapping Fierce Fights! Zoro vs. a Lead Performer!
0-23.overview: Chopper and Sanji look back on Zoro’s battle against King the Wildfire, a Lead Performer of the Animal Kingdom Pirates. They explain how Zoro struggles to find a way to defeat the seemingly invincible King.

0-24.title: Recapping Fierce Fights! The Countercharge Alliance vs. Big Mom
0-24.overview: Nami and Robin look back on Law and Kid’s battle against Big Mom, one of the Four Emperors of the Sea. They explain how the two captains suffered, were driven to the wall, and fought back against the mighty Big Mom.

0-25.title: Luffy-senpai Support Project! Barto's Secret Room 3!
0-25.overview: Bartolomeo and Tama look back on Luffy’s battle against Kaido, one of the Four Emperors of the Sea. They explain how Luffy got knocked out, got back on his feet, and became stronger to take down Kaido and free the Land of Wano.

0-26.title: Luffy-senpai Support Project! Barto's Secret Room 4!
0-26.overview: Bartolomeo and Tama look back on Luffy’s attainment of Gear Five and the battle against the formidable Kaido. They talk about the surprising features of Luffy’s new power and how the fierce battle reached its climax.

0-27.title: A Very Special Feature! Momonosuke's Road to Becoming a Great Shogun
0-27.overview: Momonosuke, Kin’emon, and Yamato look back on the Land of Wano after Kaido and Orochi were taken down. They talk about the things that happened in the country after the raid on Onigashima and how Momonosuke worked hard to become a great Shogun.

0-28.title: A Project to Fully Enjoy! 'Surgeon of Death' Trafalgar Law
0-28.overview: Chopper and Bepo look back on Trafalgar Law’s life. They explain how he met Luffy, formed an alliance, and traveled to Punk Hazard, Dressrosa, and the Land of Wano to take down the Emperors of the Sea.

0-29.title: The Log of the Rivalry! The Straw Hats vs. Cipher Pol
0-29.overview: Robin and Franky look back on the history of Lucci, Kaku, and the rest of the Cipher Pol agents who forced their way into Egghead. They talk about how the rivalry between the Straw Hats and those Cipher Pol agents evolved since they met in Water Seven.

0-30.title: Making History! The Turbulent Old and New Four Emperors!
0-30.overview: Zoro and Brook introduce the past and present Four Emperors. They talk about what kind of power each Emperor has or had, their shining moments of greatness, how some were brought down, and how others thrive.

0-31.title: The Log of the Turbulent Revolution! The Revolutionary Army Maneuvers in Secret!
0-31.overview: Bartolomeo and Cavendish introduce the Revolutionary Army. They talk about their key members, their relationship with Luffy and his crew, and how they have been working behind the scenes to overthrow the World Government.

0-32.title: Unwavering Justice! The Navy's Proud Log!
0-32.overview: Nami, Usopp, and Jinbe review the Navy. They introduce everything about the Navy’s prominent officers and soldiers from their special abilities to their conflicts, friendships, and memorable moments.

0-33.title: ONE PIECE FAN LETTER
0-33.overview: Two years after the Paramount War, the Straw Hats are about to reunite on the Sabaody Archipelago. At the same time, a girl who is head over heels for Nami is trying to hand a fan letter to her before the group leaves the island.

0-34.title: Egghead Sosyuhen Special
0-34.overview: The Straw Hats arrive on Future Island Egghead along with Jewelry Bonney, who is looking for Dr. Vegapunk. But while they are meeting the various Vegapunk Satellites, CP-0 arrives and Luffy learns of the plot to assassinate Stella and agrees to help him off the island. Meanwhile, Cobra and Sabo learn of a terrible truth at Mary Geoise and Koby escapes Beehive with the help of Vice Admiral Garp.

0-35.title: Dr. Chopper's Adventure Checkup -The Ballad of a Father and Daughter-
0-35.overview: Chopper and Carrot review the history of Bartholomew Kuma and Bonney. They talk about how they were involved with the Straw Hats in the past, the special bond between them, and the commotion they are now creating at Mary Geoise and Egghead.

0-36.title: Dr. Chopper's Adventure Checkup -Good Friends at a Crossroad-
0-36.overview: Chopper and Carrot review the history of Kizaru, Sentomaru, and Vegapunk. They talk about how good friends the three of them once were, how they came to be at odds due to their individual circumstances, and the fierce fight they got into at Egghead.

0-37.title: Dr. Chopper's Adventure Checkup -The Proud Dream of the Giants-
0-37.overview: Chopper and Carrot review the Giants. They introduce all the Giants the Straw Hats have met on their journey so far, starting from Dorry and Brogy of the Giant Pirate Crew who they came across very early on in their journey.

0-38.title: Dr. Chopper's Adventure Checkup -Traitors' Masquerade-
0-38.overview: Chopper and Carrot review Lucci and Cipher Pol “Aigis” Zero. They talk about the members of the strongest unit among Cipher Pol, the Government’s intelligence agency, and how cleverly they deceive and backstab others to carry out their missions.

0-39.title: Dr. Chopper's Adventure Checkup -The Last Records That a Genius Left Behind-
0-39.overview: Carrot gets caught up in a devious game and is forced to review Vegapunk's broadcast which had sent shock waves throughout the world. Various allies from Luffy's past appear to help her understand the final message Vegapunk left behind.

1-1.title: I'm Luffy! The Man Who Will Become the Pirate King!
1-1.overview: A group of pirates lead by Alvida plunder a ship, only to find a barrel which contains a strange boy named Luffy. Luffy is on a mission to find the legendary treasure "One Piece" and he befriends the ship's cabin-boy, Coby, who actually wants to become a marine officer. Luffy defeats Alvida and the two journey on in search of crewmates.

1-2.title: The Great Swordsman Appears! Pirate Hunter, Roronoa Zoro
1-2.overview: Luffy and Coby arrive at Shell Island, a Marine base. They meet the bounty hunter Roronoa Zoro, held under arrest by the infamous marine, Captain Morgan, and his son Helmeppo.

1-3.title: Morgan VS Luffy! Who's This Beautiful Young Girl?
1-3.overview: Luffy convinces Zoro to join his crew, but they must first defeat Captain Morgan. After freeing the island from Morgan's oppressive rule, Coby is accepted as a marine while the other two continue on their journey.

1-4.title: Luffy's Past! The Red-haired Shanks appears
1-4.overview: Out on the sea, Luffy almost loses his hat and reflects on his past, and how a pirate named Shanks influenced him. Afterwards, Luffy meets Nami, and Buggy the Clown's men.

1-5.title: Fear, Mysterious Power! Pirate Clown Captain Buggy!
1-5.overview: In order to save herself and steal a map to the Grand Line, Nami tricks Luffy into allowing her to turn him over to Buggy.

1-6.title: Desperate Situation! Beast Tamer Mohji vs Luffy!
1-6.overview: Mohji and Richie show up for revenge after Buggy's humiliating defeat in the previous episode, and Luffy meets a small dog guarding his master's store, even though he knows that he is long dead.

1-7.title: Grand Duel! Zoro the Swordsman vs Cabaji the Acrobat!
1-7.overview: Enraged by the actions of Buggy's crew, the city's mayor rushes to fight Buggy himself, but the Straw Hat Pirates come to his rescue. Zoro fights Cabaji, despite still being wounded from his previous encounter with Buggy, while Luffy faces the clown pirate himself and Nami searches for the map to the Grand Line.

1-8.title: Who Will Win? Showdown Between the True Powers of the Devil!
1-8.overview: Buggy's link to Shanks is revealed, and when he rips the straw hat Shanks gave Luffy, his rage knows no bounds. Who will win in this clash between Devil Fruit users?

1-9.title: The Honorable Liar? Captain Usopp!
1-9.overview: Nami form an alliance becoming the navigator of the crew, but not a full member yet. They arrive in Syrup Village looking for a suitable ship. On this island they know the liar Usopp, who also has ties to the Shanx.

1-10.title: The Weirdest Guy Ever! Jango the Hypnotist!
1-10.overview: When trying to convince his rich friend, Kaya, to give the Straw Hats a ship, Usopp is told to stay away from her by her caretaker, Klahadore. However, when Usopp and Luffy later see him conversing with a strange man, they learn of a plot to kill Kaya.

1-11.title: Expose the Plot! Pirate Butler, Captain Kuro!
1-11.overview: After learning of Captain Kuro's evil plan, Usopp runs back to the village to warn Kaya, only to find that after all his years of lying no one believes him.

1-12.title: Clash with the Black Cat Pirates! The Great Battle on the Slope!
1-12.overview: Usopp resolves to keep his story of pirates attacking the town a lie by making sure none reach it. Luffy, Zoro, Nami, and Usopp then try to keep the Black Cat Pirates at bay.

1-13.title: The Terrifying Duo! Meowban Brothers vs. Zoro!
1-13.overview: The Straw Hats manage to take out most of the opposing Black Cat Pirates, so Jango orders the Nyaban Brothers to attack. Meanwhile, after getting hypnotized by Jango, Luffy gets himself stuck under the collapsed mast of the Black Cat Pirates' ship.

1-14.title: Luffy Back in Action! Miss Kaya's Desperate Resistance!
1-14.overview: Captain Kuro himself arrives at the scene, and with Zoro too injured to fight, Luffy being incapacitated, and the other two being too weak to handle him, things seem hopeless. However, Kaya herself appears to bargain with Kuro.

1-15.title: Beat Kuro! Usopp the Man's Tearful Resolve!
1-15.overview: Zoro and Buchi (of the Nyaban Brothers) face off once again as Luffy and Kuro begin their fight. Usopp orders the Usopp Pirates to run away with Kaya, but Jango goes after them. A flashback reveals how Captain Kuro faked his death with Captain Morgan and how he became Kaya's butler.

1-16.title: Protect Kaya! The Usopp Pirates' Great Efforts!
1-16.overview: As the fight between Luffy and Kuro is close to an end, the Usopp Pirates do their best to avoid Jango.

1-17.title: Anger Explosion! Kuro vs. Luffy! How it Ends!
1-17.overview: Kuro's ultimate attack, "Shakushi", attacks everything in the area, whether friend or foe, and Luffy becomes enraged by his lack of regard for his crew. Will Luffy's determination overcome Kuro's sheer speed?

1-18.title: You're the Weird Creature! Gaimon and His Strange Friends!
1-18.overview: With Usopp now in the crew and a new ship, the Going Merry, under their command, the Straw Hats head to an island said to hold a fabled treasure, only to encounter a strange man stuck in a treasure box that has also been looking for this treasure.

1-19.title: The Three-Sword Style's Past! Zoro and Kuina's Vow!
1-19.overview: While Usopp & Luffy fool around with the ship's cannon one day, Zoro dreams about his childhood and the promise he made to Kuina.

1-20.title: Famous Cook! Sanji of the Sea Restaurant!
1-20.overview: The crew meets Johnny and Yosaku, Zoro's former companions, and they set sail for the Baratie restaurant in search of a cook.

1-21.title: Unwelcome Customer! Sanji's Food and Ghin's Debt!
1-21.overview: Sanji, a cook at the Baratie, helps a starving pirate named Gin. Luffy begins his job as a waiter to pay for the damage he did to the Baratie, and tries to convince Sanji to join his crew.

1-22.title: The Strongest Pirate Fleet! Commodore Don Krieg!
1-22.overview: Gin returns to the Baratie with his also-starving captain, Don Krieg, to whom Sanji once more gives food, but Don Krieg betrays the cook once he regains his energy.

1-23.title: Protect Baratie! The Great Pirate, Red Foot Zeff!
1-23.overview: It is revealed that Chef Zeff was a great pirate known as Red Leg Zeff. Gin explains the catastrophe the fleet met in Grand Line when they encountered Hawk-Eyes Mihawk, and Krieg attempts to take control of the Baratie.

1-24.title: Hawk-Eye Mihawk! The Great Swordsman Zoro Falls At Sea!
1-24.overview: As Nami steals the Going Merry, Mihawk has returned to finish the job, but Zoro challenges him to a duel in order to achieve his dream.

1-25.title: The Deadly Foot Technique Bursts Forth! Sanji vs. The Invincible Pearl!
1-25.overview: Mihawk leaves after defeating Zoro, so Krieg continues his invasion and has Pearl, one of his stronger crewmates, attack, and Sanji reveals his fighting skills. Meanwhile Johnny and Yosaku leave with Usopp and the wounded Zoro to go after Nami.

1-26.title: Zeff and Sanji's Dream! The Illusory All Blue!
1-26.overview: With Zeff held captive by Gin, Sanji has no choice but to take Pearl's hits, and he reflects on why Zeff means so much to him.

1-27.title: Cool-headed, Cold-hearted Demon! Pirate Fleet Chief Commander Ghin!
1-27.overview: Gin finishes off Pearl, claiming that he wants to kill Sanji himself. Still wounded, Sanji faces Gin while Luffy attacks Don Krieg.

1-28.title: I Won't Die! Fierce Battle, Luffy vs. Krieg!
1-28.overview: When Gin refuses to kill Sanji, Krieg uses a poison gas on him. Luffy seems to have the advantage in the fight until Krieg pulls out his explosive Battle Spear.

1-29.title: The Conclusion of the Deadly Battle! A Spear of Blind Determination!
1-29.overview: Even after taking several hits from the Battle Spear, Luffy refuses to give up.

1-30.title: Set Sail! The Seafaring Cook Sets Off With Luffy!
1-30.overview: After the battle, Gin decides to go back to the Grand Line with Krieg despite still being poisoned, and Sanji makes the difficult decision on whether to stay or to go with Luffy just as Yosaku comes back with news that he knows where Nami is.

1-31.title: The Worst Man in the Eastern Seas! Fishman Pirate Arlong!
1-31.overview: The crew chases after Nami, who stole their ship, and Yosaku takes time during the trip to explain about Arlong and his Fishmen to Luffy and Sanji. Meanwhile, Usopp, Johnny, and Zoro arrive at the island Nami docked at.

1-32.title: Witch of Cocoyashi Village! Arlong's Female Leader!
1-32.overview: Zoro is captured by the fishmen after Usopp and Johnny ditch him, and it's revealed that Nami was part of Arlong's crew the entire time. When a group of Fishmen attack Cocoyashi Village, Usopp comes to the rescue.

1-33.title: Usopp Dead?! When is Luffy Going to Make Landfall?!
1-33.overview: After Zoro escapes with Nami's help, she tries to prove her loyalty to the Arlong Pirates by appearing to kill Usopp. Meanwhile, Luffy's group finally arrives at the island.

1-34.title: Everyone's Gathered! Usopp Speaks the Truth About Nami!
1-34.overview: Johnny tells the others about Nami killing Usopp, and Luffy does not believe them until Nami appears herself and confirms it. She tells them to stay out of her business and leave without her, but Luffy stubbornly decides to stay on the island. Usopp returns, revealing that Nami only pretended to kill him, and Nami's sister, Nojiko, starts to explain why Nami is acting the way she is.

1-35.title: Untold Past! Female Warrior Bellemere!
1-35.overview: Nojiko starts her story about Nami's childhood and their adopted mother, Bellemere. Despite being poor and none of them being related by blood, they had a happy life.

1-36.title: Survive! Mother Bellemere and Nami's Bond!
1-36.overview: Nojiko continues her story, explaining how their life was ruined when the Arlong Pirates first took over the village.

1-37.title: Luffy Rises! Result of the Broken Promise!
1-37.overview: When a marine officer under Arlong's pay confiscates all the money Nami stole over the years, in order to one day buy the village from Arlong, the villagers decide that enough is enough and fight back, despite Nami's pleads that they do not and that they'd all be killed. Upon seeing Nami's sorrow, the Straw Hats head for Arlong Park.

1-38.title: Luffy in Big Trouble! Fishmen vs. The Luffy Pirates!
1-38.overview: The Straw Hats face the Fishmen themselves as the villagers watch from the sidelines.

1-39.title: Luffy Submerged! Zoro vs. Hatchan the Octopus!
1-39.overview: Arlong has trapped Luffy in the ocean and Zoro faces the six-sword wielding octopus Hatchan.

1-40.title: Proud Warriors! Sanji and Usopp's Fierce Battles!
1-40.overview: With Hatchan defeated, two of the fishmen battle Sanji and Usopp. Things look grim for Sanji as he attempts to face Kuroobi underwater, and Usopp gets the chance to prove that he too is a brave warrior.

1-41.title: Luffy at Full Power! Nami's Determination and the Straw Hat!
1-41.overview: Arlong's officers have been defeated, but Sanji and Zoro prove to be no match for Arlong in their current state. However, with Luffy finally free, he just may be able to defeat the "most wicked man in the East Blue". Meanwhile, Nami finally gathers the courage to face Arlong.

1-42.title: Explosion! Fishman Arlong's Fierce Assault From the Sea!
1-42.overview: Luffy returns to the fight, and the battle with Arlong versus Luffy begins.

1-43.title: End of the Fishman Empire! Nami's My Friend!
1-43.overview: The battle spreads into Arlong Park itself and Arlong is no longer holding back.

1-44.title: Setting Out with a Smile! Farewell, Hometown Cocoyashi Village!
1-44.overview: Arlong's reign of terror is over, and no one has anything on their mind except to party. As the crew celebrates, Nami reflects on her hometown and decides to officially join the Straw Hat Pirates.

1-45.title: Bounty! Straw Hat Luffy Becomes Known to the World!
1-45.overview: As a result of defeating Buggy, Krieg and Arlong, Luffy now has the highest bounty in all of East Blue. News quickly spreads to Shanks, who celebrates Luffy's arrival into the world of pirates by partying with Mihawk, despite already being severely hungover.

1-46.title: Chase Straw Hat! Little Buggy's Big Adventure!
1-46.overview: After his fight with Luffy, Buggy was sent flying to another island with several body parts missing. Thus, Buggy begins his journey to find his crew and his body parts, making some unlikely friends.

1-47.title: The Wait is Over! The Return of Captain Buggy!
1-47.overview: With Buggy assumed to be dead, his crew fights over who will be the new captain, only to be captured by a tribe of cannibals.

1-48.title: The Town of the Beginning and the End! Landfall at Logue Town!
1-48.overview: The crew arrives at the last large town before the entrance to the Grand Line--Loguetown, the place where Gold Roger was both born and executed, where they stock up on supplies and sightsee. As Luffy heads for the execution platform where Roger was killed, old enemies are searching for him.

1-49.title: Zoro's New Swords and the Woman Sergeant Major!
1-49.overview: While searching for new swords to replace the ones shattered by Mihawk, Zoro meets a woman named Tashigi, who looks exactly like an older Kuina, who then helps him look.

1-50.title: Usopp vs. Daddy the Parent! Showdown at High!
1-50.overview: Usopp manages to anger the daughter of bounty hunter Daddy the Father, and finds his own life at stake. When Daddy discovers that Usopp is the son of Yasopp, the only man to beat him, he challenges him to a duel.

1-51.title: Fiery Cooking Battle? Sanji vs. The Beautiful Chef!
1-51.overview: In order to win a rare fish, Sanji enters a cooking contest and faces a woman named Carmen.

1-52.title: Buggy's Revenge! The Man Who Smiles On the Execution Platform!
1-52.overview: Luffy arrives at the execution platform only to be caught in a trap by Buggy and Alvida.

1-53.title: The Legend Has Started! Head for the Grand Line!
1-53.overview: Miraculously saved from death by an unnatural green gust and a lightning bolt to Buggy, the Straw Hats rush out of Loguetown, only for Zoro to be stopped by Tashigi and Luffy to be stopped by Captain Smoker.

1-54.title: Precursor to a New Adventure! Apis, a Mysterious Girl!
1-54.overview: On a stormy night a girl called Apis escapes from the Marines and arrives at Straw hat's ship, but the girl upon knowing that they are pirates begins to hide some of the reasons which she is being wanted by the Marines. As the Straw Hats escape from the Marines, they get caught in the Calm Belt.

1-55.title: Miraculous Creature! Apis's Secret and The Legendary Island!
1-55.overview: After escaping the clutches of the Marine fleet, the Straw Hats soon find themselves in an equally dangerous predicament - stranded in the Calm Belt!

1-56.title: Eric Attacks! Great Escape From Warship Island!
1-56.overview: The Straw Hats want to return Apis's dragon to his nest, but the Marines have them surrounded. Looks like it's time for another daring escape!

1-57.title: A Solitary Island in the Distant Sea! The Legendary Lost Island!
1-57.overview: Even for Nami, finding the dragon's lost island proves to be tougher than looking for a needle in a haystack - or at the bottom of the ocean.

1-58.title: Showdown in the Ruins! Tense Zoro vs. Eric!
1-58.overview: Zoro is left fighting with Eric while Luffy and the gang run to the ship in order to get to Lost Island, but only find more problems.

1-59.title: Luffy, Completely Surrounded! Commodore Nelson's Secret Strategy!
1-59.overview: At last Admiral Nelson has seen through the ambitions of Eric, but takes it a little too personally and now the mystical dragon's life is in danger.

1-60.title: Through the Sky They Soar! The 1000 Year Legend Lives Again!
1-60.overview: With his last breath, Ryuuji calls all his fellow dragons, and the Lost Island re-surfaced. Meanwhile Luffy takes out Admiral Nelson and his gang.

1-61.title: An Angry Showdown! Cross the Red Line!
1-61.overview: After leaving Warship Island the Going Merry is now towards the Grand Line, and the crew now returns to the Great Adventure.

2-62.title: The First Line of Defense? The Giant Whale Laboon Appears!
2-62.overview: Upon entering the Grand Line, the ship is swallowed by a giant whale, inside of which they discover a strange place. In addition, they are not the only ones there.

2-63.title: A Promise Between Men! Luffy and the Whale Vow to Meet Again!
2-63.overview: After hearing the story of Laboon the whale, Luffy comes up with a clever solution to his problems. From Laboon's caretaker, Crocus, the crew learns more about the Grand Line and how to navigate through it, since compasses are useless there.

2-64.title: A Town that Welcomes Pirates? Setting Foot on Whisky Peak!
2-64.overview: Luffy and friends arrive at Whisky Peak, a town of pirate-lovers who hold them a feast.

2-65.title: Explosion! The Three Swords Style! Zoro vs. Baroque Works!
2-65.overview: Zoro battles a hundred members of Baroque Works, and discovers there is more to them than meets the eye.

2-66.title: All Out Battle! Luffy vs. Zoro, Mysterious Grand Duel!
2-66.overview: Luffy, who does not realize the town is full of bounty hunters, engages in a battle with Zoro after he discovers that Zoro attacked the townsfolk, while Mr. 5 and Miss Valentine head for Princess Vivi.

2-67.title: Deliver Princess Vivi! The Luffy Pirates Set Sail!
2-67.overview: Luffy's crew manages to become targets of Crocodile, one of the Shichibukai, and decide to help Princess Vivi. They also meet Miss All-Sunday, the second strongest member of Baroque Works and partner of Crocodile.

2-68.title: Try Hard, Coby! Coby and Helmeppo's Struggles in the Marines!
2-68.overview: As Luffy and his crew are sailing in the Grand Line, Koby and Helmeppo are stuck doing odd-jobs for the marines back in East Blue, and encounter Vice-Admiral Garp.

2-69.title: Coby and Helmeppo's Resolve! Vice-Admiral Garp's Parental Affection!
2-69.overview: Vice Admiral Garp mentors Koby and Helmeppo to become marines.

2-70.title: An Ancient Island! The Shadow Hiding in Little Garden!
2-70.overview: Luffy and friends land on Little Garden, a prehistoric island inhabited by dinosaurs and giants.

2-71.title: Huge Duel! The Giants Dorry and Broggy!
2-71.overview: Nami and Usopp meet a giant named Brogy, while Luffy and Vivi encounter Brogy's rival, Dorry. The Straw Hats little suspect that Officer Agents of Baroque Works are on their tail.

2-72.title: Luffy Gets Angry! A Dirty Trick Violates the Sacred Duel!
2-72.overview: Dorry, critically injured by exploding ale, blames the Straw Hats. Luffy is enraged that someone would pull such a cowardly trick to sabotage the giants' honorable duel.

2-73.title: Broggy's Bitter Tears of Victory! The Conclusion of Elbaf!
2-73.overview: Luffy tries in vain to convince the injured Dorry not to fight Brogy. The Officer Agents who sabotaged Dorry's ale further tamper with the giants' duel.

2-74.title: The Devilish Candle! Tears of Regret and Tears of Anger!
2-74.overview: Having subdued the giants, Baroque Works makes their move. Mr. 3 introduces Zoro, Nami, Vivi, and Brogy to the slow torture of becoming living statues of wax.

2-75.title: A Hex on Luffy! Colors Trap!
2-75.overview: Luffy attempts to rescue his friends but only accelerates the deadly waxing process. To make matters worse, Miss Goldenweek interferes and reveals her own terrifying ability.

2-76.title: Time to Fight Back! Usopp’s Quick Thinking and Fire Star!
2-76.overview: Usopp frees Luffy from Miss Goldenweek's control. With Karoo's help, Usopp and Luffy rescue the others, who take on Mr. 5 and Miss Valentine. Luffy and Karoo pursue Mr. 3 and Miss Goldenweek into the forest.

2-77.title: Farewell Giant Island! Head for Alabasta!
2-77.overview: After having a pleasant chat with Mr. 0 and encountering the "Unluckies", Sanji retrieves an Eternal Pose for Alabasta. The crew leaves Little Garden and sets sail for Alabasta.

3-78.title: Nami's Sick? Beyond the Snow Falling on the Sea!
3-78.overview: Nami is sick, but the crew doesn't have a doctor to help her.

3-79.title: A Raid! The Tin Tyrant and Tin Plate Wapol!
3-79.overview: While looking for a doctor, the crew meets the pirate Wapol, who attacks them, but only makes Luffy send him flying. Meanwhile Smoker manages to intercept the conversation between Mr. 0 and Sanji and plans to go to Alabasta. Back with the crew they arrive at last to an island only to find out they're not welcome.

3-80.title: An Island without Doctors? Adventure in a Nameless Land!
3-80.overview: The Straw Hat crew manages to gain the trust of the people that attacked them, and are taken to the village, except for Zoro and Carue, who guard the ship. Luffy and Sanji must take Nami to the island's sole doctor who lives on a mountain-top. Vivi and Usopp discover the past of the island, and about the pirate Wapol from Dalton.

3-81.title: Are You Happy? The Doctor Called Witch!
3-81.overview: While Sanji and Luffy fight off the wilderness, the islander's worst nightmare turns true, as Wapol returns to the island. The doctor is discovered to be on the other side of the island, and Usopp, Vivi and Dalton rush to find her. Dalton however returns as he hears of Wapol's return.

3-82.title: Dalton's Resolve! Wapol's Corps Lands on the Island!
3-82.overview: Dalton faces Wapol, but only gets himself hit by arrows thrown by his former comrade Chess. An avalanche stops the battle, but injures Sanji. Luffy must carry both Nami and Sanji to the doctor, and begins his ascent.

3-83.title: The Island Where Snow Lives! Climb the Drum Rockies!
3-83.overview: The Lapahn help Luffy escape from Wapol, giving him enough time to climb to the castle where doctor Kureha lives. Vivi, Usopp and Zoro deal with the king's army in order to save Dalton. The recovering Nami meets a strange creature.

3-84.title: Blue-nosed Reindeer! Chopper's Secret!
3-84.overview: Nami asks Chopper to join the crew, but he isn't interested. Kureha tells Nami some of what was Chopper's background. After realizing the abilities that Chopper has, Luffy is eager to make him join the crew.

3-85.title: An Outcast's Dream! Hiriluk the Quack!
3-85.overview: Doctorine continues to tell how Chopper lived his life and how the quack doctor Hiruluk took care of him.

3-86.title: Hiriluk's Cherry Blossoms and the Will that Gets Carried On!
3-86.overview: More of Chopper's past is revealed, including the fate of doctor Hiruluk and Wapol's cruelties as the king. Meanwhile, Wapol reaches the castle where the crew is residing.

3-87.title: Fight Wapol's Crew! The Power of the Munch Munch Fruit!
3-87.overview: Wapol is determined to bring down Hiruluk's flag, and to do that, he engages Sanji, Luffy and Chopper in a fight.

3-88.title: Zoan-type Devil Fruit! Chopper's Seven-form Transformation!
3-88.overview: Chopper demonstrates the abilities of Rumble Balls when fighting Chessmarimo. Dalton is uncovered from the avalanche.

3-89.title: When the Kingdom's Rule Ends! The Flag of Faith Flies Forever!
3-89.overview: After trying every trick in the castle, Wapol is finally hunted down by Luffy. The villagers along with Zoro, Vivi and Usopp start their ascent to the castle through a ropeway.

3-90.title: Hiriluk's Cherry Blossoms! Miracle in the Drum Rockies!
3-90.overview: After finally been convinced to join the team, Chopper announces his intentions to Dr. Kureha, who doesn't take it too well; but after escaping from the castle, she has decided to give the whole Straw Hat crew a farewell gift.

3-91.title: Goodbye Drum Island! I'm Going Out to Sea!
3-91.overview: Chopper joins the Straw Hat crew as they continue their journey to Vivi's homeland.

4-92.title: Alabasta's Hero and a Ballerina on the Ship!
4-92.overview: Crocodile appears to stop rampaging pirates. Luffy and his crew meet Mr.  2 Bon Clay who shows off his devil fruit power and Vivi sees a shocking  sight.

4-93.title: Off to the Desert Kingdom! The Rain-Summing Powder and the Rebel Army!
4-93.overview: Luffy separates from the rest of the crew, right after arriving at  Alabasta's port city of Nanohana. The crew dons disguises while Luffy  learns of Dance Powder.

4-94.title: The Heroes Reunion! His Name is Fire Fist Ace!
4-94.overview: While in Nanohana, the Straw Hats encounter Smoker and Tashigi. A powerful pirate named Portgas D. Ace appears.

4-95.title: Ace and Luffy! Hot Emotions and Brotherly Bonds!
4-95.overview: Ace fights Smoker while the Straw Hats run for their ship. Luffy  reunites with his brother, who has joined the Whitebeard Pirates after  leaving home, and is searching for a former crewmate named Blackbeard  who killed a fellow member.

4-96.title: Erumalu, The City of Green and the Kung Fu Dugongs!!
4-96.overview: Ace decides to travel with the Straw Hats, as he is hunting for a man known as Blackbeard.

4-97.title: Adventure in the Country of Sand! The Monsters that Live in the Scorching Land!
4-97.overview: After leaving Erumalu, the Straw Hats plus Vivi & Ace continue through the desert, facing the many dangers of it.

4-98.title: Enter the Desert Pirates! The Men Who Live Freely!
4-98.overview: Nami and Vivi found themselves an easier way to travel in the desert and leave all men behind.

4-99.title: False Fortitude! Camu, Rebel Soldier at Heart!
4-99.overview: After hearing that a small village has fake Rebel Army bodyguards that  have been keeping peace, Vivi asks the men of the crew to test if  they're worthy of staying.

4-100.title: Rebel Warrior Koza! The Dream Vowed to Vivi!
4-100.overview: Still trekking through the Alabasta desert, the crew beats up a giant  desert scorpion for lunch, while Vivi tells Nami about her past and her  friendship with Kohza.

4-101.title: Showdown in a Heat Haze! Ace vs. the Gallant Scorpion!
4-101.overview: Ace fights against a bounty hunter, who claims to have defeated  Blackbeard, although this was a lie to lure Ace out and challenge him in  order to inspire his children to follow their dreams.

4-102.title: Ruins and Lost Ways! Vivi, Her Friends, and the Country's Form!
4-102.overview: Zoro, Chopper and Luffy manage to get themselves lost and stumble across some huge underground ruins.

4-103.title: Spiders Café at 8 o'Clock! The Enemy Leaders Gather!
4-103.overview: Baroque Works plan starts to take effect, and for that, the Number Agents gather to meet Mr. 0. Meanwhile, the crew finds out that the Rebel Army has moved out of Yuba and headed to Katorea, and the rebel leader Kohza is determined to attack.

4-104.title: Luffy vs. Vivi! The Tearful Vow to Put Friends on the Line!
4-104.overview: In Yuba, Luffy learns that Toto was entrusted by Cobra to watch over the land and figures out a way to stop the sandstorm.

4-105.title: The Battlefront of Alabasta! Rainbase, the City of Dreams!
4-105.overview: After the struggle, Vivi decides to go after Crocodile with the Straw  Hats. The crew travels to the city of Rainbase, but run afoul of Smoker  and Tashigi.

4-106.title: The Trap of Certain Defeat! Storming Raindinners!
4-106.overview: Most of the Straw Hats, along with Smoker, are trapped by Crocodile.  Vivi reunites with the royal guardian Pell, but is captured by Miss  All-Sunday. Crocodile reveals his invincible Devil Fruit power.

4-107.title: Operation Utopia Commences! The Swell of Rebellion Stirs!
4-107.overview: Baroque Works' plan to take over Alabasta is set in motion.

4-108.title: The Terrifying Banana Gators and Mr. Prince!
4-108.overview: Most of the Straw Hats are helplessly trapped as Vivi tries desperately  to get the key to their cage. but fails. Crocodile is contacted by  someone known as "Mr. Prince."

4-109.title: The Key to a Great Comeback Escape! The Wax-Wax Ball!
4-109.overview: The identity of "Mr. Prince" is revealed.

4-110.title: Merciless Mortal Combat! Luffy vs. Crocodile!
4-110.overview: After escaping from Rain Dinners, the Straw Hats and Vivi cross the desert to Alubarne, where the final battle will take place.

4-111.title: Dash For a Miracle! Alabasta Animal Land!
4-111.overview: Luffy is left for dead by Crocodile, but is helped by the mysteríous  Miss All-Sunday. The rest of the Straw Hats reach Alubarna.

4-112.title: Rebel Army vs. Royal Army! Showdown at Alubarna!
4-112.overview: The revolution is on the verge of starting and the crew comes out with a plan that could stop it.

4-113.title: Alubarna Grieves! The Fierce Captain Karoo!
4-113.overview: Vivi tries to call out to the Rebel Army, but fails because of a Baroque Works infiltrator in the Royal Army interferes.

4-114.title: Sworn on a Friend's Dream! The Battle of Molehill, Block 4!
4-114.overview: Things look hopeless for Usopp & Chopper as they continue to suffer from every attack that the Mr.4 team makes. However, the tides may be beginning to turn as Usopp learns what it truly means to be a man.

4-115.title: Big Opening Day Today! The Copy-Copy Montage!
4-115.overview: Albeit severely beaten and bruised, Usopp and Chopper have finally defeated the Mr.4 team. However, Mr. 2 has figured out Sanji's weakness.

4-116.title: Transformed into Nami! Bon Clay's Rapid-Fire Ballet Kenpo!
4-116.overview: Though Mr. 2 discovers Sanji's weakness, Sanji still defeats his opponent after an evenly-matched fight. Meanwhile, before Vivi could give the word to blow up the palace, Crocodile appears.

4-117.title: Nami's Cyclone Advisory! Clima Takt Burst!
4-117.overview: Nami faces off against Miss Doublefinger and tries to figure out her new weapon that Usopp made, the Clima-Tact.

4-118.title: Secret Passed Down in the Royal Family! The Ancient Weapon Pluton!
4-118.overview: While Crocodile reveals to Vivi about the ancient weapon Pluton, Nami attempts to defeat Miss Doublefinger with her most powerful attack: The Tornado Tempo.

4-119.title: Secret of Powerful Swordplay! Ability to Cut Steel and the Rhythm Things Have!
4-119.overview: While Miss. Doublefinger's fight with Nami was challenging, Zoro is having an even more difficult time fighting Mr.1: A man who can change his entire body into steel - something that Zoro cannot cut. As Zoro nears death, he must discover the secret to "the breath of all things".

4-120.title: The Battle is Over! Koza Raises the White Flag!
4-120.overview: When Vivi reveals Crocodile's plan to Koza, he attempts to stop the fighting, but is shot. Crocodile reveals that he has set up a massive bomb in the city.

4-121.title: Where Vivi's Voice Gets Heard! The Hero Descends!
4-121.overview: As Koza tries to stop the Rebel Army, both sides are once more fighting due to the intervention of Baroque Works. Vivi is thrown to her certain death when Luffy saves her and challenges Crocodile to a second round.

4-122.title: Sand Croc and Water Luffy! The Second Round of the Duel
4-122.overview: Luffy fights Crocodile with more success this time by using water, but still loses this round. Meanwhile, the other Straw Hats hurry to locate the bomb before it goes off. Nico Robin forces the king to take her to the tomb where the Pluton Poneglyph is hidden.

4-123.title: That Looks Croc-ish! Luffy, Run to the Royal Tomb!
4-123.overview: Crocodile joins Robin in the tomb, and orders her to translate the Poneglyph. Robin tells him that Pluton was not mentioned and that it was only about history, but Crocodile figures out that she was lying and stabs her in response. When Luffy recovers from the last round of fighting, he chases after Crocodile into the tomb.

4-124.title: The Nightmare Draws Near! This is the Sand-Sand Clan's Secret Base!
4-124.overview: Luffy fights with Crocodile by using blood on his fists. Meanwhile Vivi finds the bomb, and calls the Straw Hats together.

4-125.title: Magnificent Wings! My Name is Pell, Guardian Deity of the Country!
4-125.overview: Vivi finds the bomb inside of the clock tower, but the Mr. 7 pair of Baroque Works are there to protect it. Vivi defeats them, but she realizes the bomb cannot be stopped so easily. It has a timer, and right before it blows up, Pell shows up and takes it into the atmosphere, where he sacrifices himself to save Alabasta.

4-126.title: I Will Surpass You! Rain Falls in Alabasta!
4-126.overview: Luffy defeats Crocodile by punching him through solid bedrock. When Crocodile falls, the rain-drops calm the soldiers.

4-127.title: A Farewell to Arms! Pirates and Different Ideas of Justice!
4-127.overview: Now that the battle has ended, the outcome is tallied. Igaram appears with proof of Cobra's innocence, as well as Koza telling everything. Tashigi and Smoker both are rewarded for taking on Crocodile, but neither one of them believes that is right, considering the Straw Hat pirates did all the work.

4-128.title: The Pirates' Banquet and Operation Escape from Alabasta!
4-128.overview: Luffy is rescued from the collapsed tomb where he fought Crocodile and brought into Cobra's palace to rest. When he awakens, a magnificent banquet is thrown for the pirates, then, the Straw Hats are invited to enjoy the hot spring steam room inside the palace.

4-129.title: It All Started On That Day! Vivi Tells the Story of Her Adventure!
4-129.overview: It's the day for Vivi's speech and her decision whether or not to continue to be with the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, Bon Kurei and his crew attempt to protect the Straw Hats from Hina.

4-130.title: Scent of Danger! The Seventh Member is Nico Robin!
4-130.overview: The Marines fail again to catch the Straw Hats. After escaping from Marines, Nico Robin (Ms. All Sunday) appears from inside of Straw Hats ship. She manages to persuade the crew to let her join. Pell is seen at the end standing over his own grave.

5-131.title: The First Patient! The Untold Story of the Rumble Ball!
5-131.overview: After their adventures in Alabasta, the crew come upon another deserted island and split up tasks amongst themselves. Chopper is left in charge of guarding the ship, and he reminisces about the day he first made the rumble ball and his first patient, Dr. Kureha, while spending some time with the newest crewmember: Nico Robin.

5-132.title: Uprising of the Navigator! For the Unyielding Dream!
5-132.overview: A weird salesman is fished out of the water and onto the Going Merry, and Nami buys a ton of "1000 year paper" from him to draw her sea maps. However, that's not going to be easy with the rest of the crew goofing off as usual.

5-133.title: A Recipe Handed Down! Sanji, the Iron Man of Curry!
5-133.overview: The Going Merry runs into several Marine ships in some fog, and the Straw Hats meet a trainee Marine chef named Tajiyo. Sanji helps him out of a bit of cooking trouble.

5-134.title: I Will Make it Bloom! Usopp, the Man, and the Eight-Foot Shell!
5-134.overview: The crew stops on an island that's having its annual fireworks festival; Usopp meets a young fireworks-maker named Kodama and helps her achieve her dream.

5-135.title: The Fabled Pirate Hunter! Zoro, the Wandering Swordsman!
5-135.overview: Zoro has a flashback about the time when he first met Johnny and Yosaku, and faced off against Bandits and, Dick.

5-136.title: Zenny of the Island of Goats and the Pirate Ship in the Mountains!
5-136.overview: After escaping from several Marine ships, the Straw Hats land on an uncharted island and meet an old man named Zenny. Chopper finds out that, because of his bad heart, Zenny probably only has three days to live.

5-137.title: How's Tricks? The Designs of Zenny the Moneylender!
5-137.overview: The Straw Hats help Zenny out, hoping to make his last days good ones; they learn about Zenny's past as a money lender, and his dream of becoming a pirate. But Zoro realizes that Zenny has outlived Chopper's predictions and so the straw hats decide that, after helping him finish his pirate ship, they will leave the island.

5-138.title: Whereabouts of the Island Treasure! Attack of the Zenny Pirates!
5-138.overview: Zenny decides to follow his dream and become a pirate, despite his age. He helps the Straw Hats out of trouble with the Marines, and then they part ways.

5-139.title: Legend of the Rainbow Mist! Old Man Henzo of Luluka Island!
5-139.overview: On Ruluka Island, some of the Straw Hats make enemies of the Mayor and his men, who have placed high taxes on everything. Robin, Usopp, and Luffy meet Professor Henzo, who's doing research on the island's rainbow mist. When some of the mist shows up, Henzo borrows the Going Merry to go explore it.

5-140.title: Residents of the Land of Eternity! The Pumpkin Pirates!
5-140.overview: The inside of the Rainbow Mist full of wrecked ships and treasure, and is guarded by five kids. The kids are actually friends of Henzo's that got lost in the mist over 50 years ago.

5-141.title: Thoughts of Home! The Pirate Graveyard of No Escape!
5-141.overview: Henzo, his friends, and the others try to find a way out of the ship graveyard. Meanwhile, the Mayor and his men let the information about the Rainbow Mist slip to the remaining Straw Hats still on Ruluka.

5-142.title: An Inevitable Melee! Wetton's Schemes and the Rainbow Tower!
5-142.overview: Luffy accidentally propels himself and Rapanui to the end of the mist. Nami appears in the ship graveyard with a rowboat full of treasure and a string connected to the real world, which are both stolen by Wetton's subordinate. The Mayor uses the Rainbow Tower to make a bridge to the Rainbow Mist.

5-143.title: And so, the Legend Begins! To the Other Side of the Rainbow!
5-143.overview: The Going Merry escapes from the Rainbow Mist, getting badly damaged on the way. The Mayor gets arrested by a bunch of powerful marines that turn out to be older versions of Henzo's friends, who were thrown 50 years into the past by the Rainbow Mist's collapse.

6-144.title: The Log is Taken! Salvage King, Masira!
6-144.overview: Nami's log pose begins to point to the sky, and the crew finds a map of an island named 'Skypiea' on a 200-year-old ship. They compete with the monkey-like Masira's salvage crew while they search for more clues on how to get there.

6-145.title: Monsters Appear! Don't Mess with the Whitebeard Pirates!
6-145.overview: The Straw Hats decide to go to Jaya island to look for information on Skypeia. Meanwhile, Ace suddenly shows up on Buggy's ship; Buggy does not let any of his men attack Ace, fearing Whitebeard's retribution.

6-146.title: Quit Dreaming! Mock Town, the Town of Ridicule!
6-146.overview: Jaya's main town is full of famous pirates that are constantly brawling with each other. Luffy and Zoro have a run-in with a pirate known as 'Bellamy the Hyena,' who ridicules their dreams and beats them up.

6-147.title: Distinguished Pirates! A Man Who Talks of Dreams and the King of Undersea Search!
6-147.overview: After refusing to fight Bellamy, Luffy, Zoro and Nami run into a certain cherry pie lover. They leave Mock Town, and get into a fight with Masira's brother Shoujou, another salvage monkey.

6-148.title: Legendary Family! Noland, the Liar!
6-148.overview: The Straw Hats meet with Mont Blanc Cricket on another part of Jaya; Cricket is a descendant of Montblanc Noland, an infamous "liar" who told of a gold city on Jaya, and Cricket was outcast for looking for artifacts of the gold city. He may be the only person who knows how to get to Skypiea.

6-149.title: Steer for the Clouds! Capture the South Bird!
6-149.overview: Cricket explains how the Straw Hats can ride a dangerous vertical current called the Knock-Up Stream to get to Skypeia. However, they first have to catch a southbird to point them toward the point where the stream will erupt from the ocean.

6-150.title: Dreams Don't Come True?! Bellamy Versus the Saruyama Alliance!
6-150.overview: While the Straw Hats are looking for a Southbird, Bellamy and his crew attack Cricket's house, and steal the gold artifacts he'd collected over the years from his salvage work. When the Straw Hats return and see what happened, Luffy decides to take a side trip back to Mock Town.

6-151.title: 100 Million Man! World's Greatest Power and Pirate Black Beard!
6-151.overview: Luffy takes out Bellamy with a single punch. Meanwhile, the world government heads are concerned over Whitebeard, Shanks, and Luffy. The marines try to decide who will replace Crocodile as a Shichibukai - one of Blackbeard's crew shows up uninvited and nominates his captain.
