10-375.title: Not Out of Danger Yet! Orders to Annihilate the Straw Hat Crew
10-375.overview: Despite nearly being vaporized, Luffy, Zoro, Sanji, Robin, and the Rolling regain their shadows at the last second along with the rest of Moriah's victims. As Hogback informs Absalom of their leader's defeat, the Straw Hats surround the still unconscious Luffy with Usopp worries that Luffy might hurt himself from facing stronger enemies in the future. As the Rolling Pirates offer to lead Nami to Moriah's treasure, she remembers Kuma before seeing him on the collapsed tower. Contacting his superiors via Transponder Snail, Kuma receives orders from the World Government to kill the Straw Hats and everyone else on Thriller Bark to prevent Moriah's defeat from becoming public. After taking out some of the Rolling Pirates with a strange move that sends several people flying backwards, Kuma turns his attention to Zoro.

10-376.title: It Repels Everything! Kuma’s Paw-Paw Power!
10-376.overview: Zoro attacks Kuma, who reveals that he has eaten the Paw Paw fruit, and shows his ability to repel attacks, move considerable distances almost instantly and repel the air to attack his opponents. Zoro is quickly outmatched, and Sanji and Usopp's attempts to help him are rendered futile by Kuma's hard body and ability to block projectiles. Kuma then creates a giant paw print that he compresses, offering all the pirates a chance to survive if they turn over Luffy. But they all unanimously refuse and Kuma detonates his paw print with the explosion from compressed air devastating Thriller Bark.

10-377.title: The Pain of My Crewmates Is My Pain! Zoro's Desperate Fight!
10-377.overview: While almost everyone on the island is knocked out in the blast, Zoro slashes Kuma with Shishi Sonson, but sees that it is ineffective, as Kuma is a Pacifista, a cyborg whose body is harder than steel. Seeing that he can no longer fight, Zoro offers his life to save Luffy, saying that he cannot hope to become the world's best swordsman if he cannot protect his captain. Sanji attempts to take Zoro's place, but Zoro knocks him out. As part of his agreement with Kuma, Zoro takes in all of Luffy's pain and fatigue, which Kuma says would kill him if he suffered it on top of his already severe wounds. Zoro takes in the pain, and Kuma leaves, remarking on how Luffy has a loyal crew. Luffy regains consciousness, surprisingly energetic, while Zoro emerges from his sacrifice near death.

10-378.title: The Promise from a Distant Day! The Pirates' Song and a Small Whale!
10-378.overview: Hogback and Absalom escape Thriller Bark with the unconscious Moria, revealing that Blackbeard's Warlord status from defeating Ace. The next day, the Straw Hats celebrate their victory over Moria, but do not know why Zoro is so badly wounded. Sanji hears the story from the Risky Brothers, but prevents them from telling anyone else, saying it would trouble Luffy greatly to hear that Zoro suffered for his sake, but Robin eavesdrops on the conversation. Luffy tells Brook that Laboon is alive, and he is overjoyed to hear it, and begins to think about the time 50 years ago when he and his pirate crew first met Laboon.

10-379.title: Brook's Past! A Sad Farewell with His Cheerful Comrade!
10-379.overview: Brook recalls his past, when the whale Laboon started following his pirate ship and befriended the crew. When the crew headed toward the Grand Line, they had no choice but to leave Laboon behind because the danger the sea would present to a young whale like him, but Laboon followed them over Reverse Mountain, anyway. Brook and his captain convince Laboon to stay behind, promising that after they traveled through the entire Grand Line and he grew strong enough to follow them, they would come back and bring him on their adventures. They were unable to fulfill the promise, though.

10-380.title: Bink's Booze! The Song that Connects the Past with the Present!
10-380.overview: Brook recalls the Rumbar Pirates' journey through the Grand Line, where they faced many dangers but still managed to enjoy themselves. The captain contracted an illness and attempted to leave the Grand Line through the Calm Belt with the other infected crew, leaving Brook in charge of the remaining pirates. The journey continued until some powerful enemies defeated the Rumbar Pirates in the Florian Triangle, fatally poisoning them. As they were dying, they sang Binks's Brew one last time, recording it in a Tone Dial in the hopes that Brook would revive with his Devil Fruit power and deliver the shell to Laboon. Back in the present, Brook silently hopes Laboon will wait just a little longer for his return.

10-381.title: A New Crewmate! The Musician, Humming Brook!
10-381.overview: Brook tells Luffy that he is glad to be alive and asks if he can join the crew, which Luffy approves of. All the Straw Hats are shocked by this, except for Zoro, who is sleeping, and Robin, who knew Luffy would accept him no matter what, but they nevertheless welcome him to the crew. Two days later, Usopp and Franky make a grave for the dead Rumbar Pirates, and Zoro lays the broken Yubashiri at the grave. Nami gets a Vivre Card from Lola, which points the way to Lola's mother, a pirate in the New World. Luffy takes out the piece of paper he received from Ace, which is also a Vivre Card, and learns that as it is burning and shrinking, Ace's life is in danger. Believing that Ace can get out of trouble on his own, Luffy decides to head onward rather than go to rescue him, and the Straw Hats sail away from Thriller Bark. As the Luffy and his crew sail away, three enormous and mysterious figure appears in the fog, looking over Thriller Bark.

11-382.title: The Slow-Slow Menace! 'Silver Fox' Foxy Returns!
11-382.overview: The Straw Hats encounter two young girls who are looking for their father, and Luffy has another run in with the devious Captain Foxy!

11-383.title: The Great Scramble for Treasure! Collapse! Spa Island!
11-383.overview: Luffy and the Straw Hats attempt to destroy a floating resort in order to reunite two sisters who possess a blueprint for making jewels!

11-384.title: Brook's Great Struggle! Is the Path to Becoming a True Comrade Rigorous?
11-384.overview: Brook struggles to adjust to life among the living after so many years alone in the darkness. Can the Straw Hats survive his chaotic attempts to fit in?

11-385.title: Arriving at Halfway Through the Grand Line! The Red Line
11-385.overview: After surviving a terrible storm to reach the entrance to the Red Line, Luffy slugs a mysterious sea monster and Sanji may finally get to meet a mermaid!

11-386.title: Hatred for the Straw Hats! Iron Mask Duval Appears!
11-386.overview: Luffy and the Straw Hats agree to help a mermaid rescue her friend, but the mission gets dangerous when a gang of flying fish dive bomb their boat!

11-387.title: The Fated Reunion! Save the Imprisoned Fish-man
11-387.overview: The Straw Hats agree to join Camie’s rescue mission, but her captured friend turns out to be a dangerous enemy from the past!

11-388.title: Tragedy! The Truth of the Unmasked Duval
11-388.overview: The Straw Hats wage a death-defying battle with a group of flying fish, and Luffy is shocked by the familiar face of their latest enemy!

11-389.title: Explosion! The Sunny's Super Secret Weapon: Gaon Cannon
11-389.overview: Sanji squares off against his lookalike, Camie shows off just how fast a mermaid can swim, and Luffy defeats a giant bull without even landing a blow!

11-390.title: Landing to Get to Fish-man Island – The Sabaody Archipelago
11-390.overview: After their showdown with Duval, Luffy and the Straw Hats enjoy a hearty meal before proceeding to the site of their next adventure – an island bursting with bubbles!

11-391.title: Tyranny! The Rulers of Sabaody, the Celestial Dragons
11-391.overview: Luffy and his crew stop at an island overflowing with bubbles to get their ship modified for underwater travel, but it’s not long before they stumble upon an outrageous explosion and attract unwanted attention.

11-392.title: New Rivals Gather! The 11 Supernovas
11-392.overview: Shakky explains why Sabaody Archipelago seems to be crawling with bounty hunters – eleven of the Grand Line’s most wanted pirates are currently ashore and two of them are in Luffy’s crew!

11-393.title: The Target is Camie! The Looming Clutches of a Professional Kidnapper
11-393.overview: A mysterious stranger keeps Zoro from tangling with a powerful Celestial Dragon, and Chopper goes bonkers when Camie disappears from the amusement park.

11-394.title: Rescue Camie! The Archipelago’s Lingering Dark History
11-394.overview: Camie was abducted by a dastardly gang of kidnappers, and her next stop is the auction house unless the Straw Hats can rescue her. To make it in time, they’ll have to hitch a ride on some flying fish!

11-395.title: Time Limit – The Human Auction Begins
11-395.overview: With a little help from their fishy mates, the Straw Hats make it to the auction house in time to save Camie, but explosive elements prevent them from taking her back by force. Luckily, Nami’s concocted a very generous plan!

11-396.title: The Fist Explodes! Destroy the Auction
11-396.overview: Nami’s plan to save Camie goes belly up when a snot-nosed Celestial Dragon outbids the Straw Hats. Luffy and Zoro make an explosive arrival at the auction house and promptly open up a deadly can of worms.

11-397.title: Major Panic! Desperate Struggle at the Auction House
11-397.overview: Luffy turns a mermaid auction into a pirate-style brawl when he knocks the snot out of a Celestial Dragon. With a fleet of marines out to get them, the Straw Hats will have to fight their way off the island!

11-398.title: Admiral Kizaru Takes Action! Sabaody Archipelago Thrown into Chaos
11-398.overview: They saved Camie from the auction block, but now the Straw Hats are surrounded by a fleet of marines. Lucky for Luffy, Eustass “Captain” Kidd and Trafalgar Law are ready to join the fight!

11-399.title: Break Through the Siege! The Navy vs. the Three Captains
11-399.overview: The Straw Hats join forces with Kidd’s crew and Trafalgar’s mates to make short work of the marines, but they’re in for a surprise when they encounter a Warlord of the Sea!

11-400.title: Roger and Rayleigh – the King of the Pirates and His Right Hand Man
11-400.overview: Luffy and his crew duck the marines by hiding out at Rayleigh’s house. While Chopper tends to Hachi, Rayleigh entertains the Straw Hats with tales of his days as first mate on Gold Roger’s ship.

11-401.title: No Escape!? Admiral Kizaru’s Light Speed Kick!!
11-401.overview: Admiral Kizaru has arrived to lead the marines on a mission to wipe out all pirates. Meanwhile, Luffy and his crew prepare for a deadly battle with one of the Warlords of the Sea!

11-402.title: Overwhelming! The Navy’s Fighting Weapons, the Pacifistas
11-402.overview: A groovy pirate belts out a tune that leaves Kizaru in pieces, but the admiral pulls himself together in time for a crushing Light Speed Kick. Luffy and Sanji try to protect the injured Zoro from a Warlord lookalike.

11-403.title: An Even Stronger Enemy Appears! The Battle Axe-Carrying Sentomaru
11-403.overview: Luffy and the Straw Hats narrowly defeat a robot that resembles one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea. But before the dust settles on the field of battle, a far deadlier foe comes looking for a fight.

11-404.title: Admiral Kizaru's Fierce Assault! The Straw Hats Face Certain Death!
11-404.overview: Zoro's barely breathing, and Admiral Kizaru is ready to stomp him into oblivion. The battered and beaten Straw Hats could certainly use a powerful friend right about now.

11-405.title: Eliminated Friends – The Final Day of the Straw Hat Crew
11-405.overview: One by one, the mighty paw-print of Bartholomew Kuma makes the Straw Hats disappear until only Luffy remains. To where did his mates vanish? And will he ever see them again?

11-406.title: Feudal Era Side Story – Boss Luffy Appears Again
11-406.overview: Yesterday, the Straw Hats valiantly battled a Warlord of the Sea. Today, Boss Luffy and his friends at the Pinwheel Diner prepare to compete in the Great Portable Shrine Race!

11-407.title: Feudal Era Side Story – Defeat Thriller Company's Trap
11-407.overview: Thriller Company sabotages the race for a sacred treasure, and the displaced Straw Hats must pull an all-nighter to rebuild their shrine and score some ancient gold!

12-408.title: Landing! The All-Female Island, Amazon Lily
12-408.overview: Luffy finds himself stranded and starving on a strange island. The rubber-man's amazing appetite puts his manhood in danger when he devours an array of exotic mushrooms!

12-409.title: Hurry Back to Your Friends! The Maiden Island Adventure
12-409.overview: An army of scantily-clad women warriors want to investigate Luffy’s family jewels, but the captain of the Straw Hats is more interested in reuniting with his lost mates.

12-410.title: Everyone Falls in Love! Pirate Empress Hancock
12-410.overview: The women chasing Luffy are loyal subjects of Boa Hancock, the curvaceous Warlord of the Sea. This stone-cold beauty is deadly, and she’s about to pick a fight with an entire fleet of marines!

12-411.title: The Secret Hidden on the Backs – Luffy and the Snake Princess Meet
12-411.overview: Luffy's search for a seaworthy vessel leads to a “drop-in” on the Snake Princess during the royal bathing hour. The view is world-class, but it might turn the rubber-man to stone!

12-412.title: Heartless Judgment! Margaret is Turned to Stone!!
12-412.overview: Boa Hancock makes Luffy mad when she turns Margaret into a statue. The Snake Princess may have bitten off more than she can chew by challenging the captain of the Straw Hats!

12-413.title: A Difficult Fight for Luffy! The Snake Sisters' Haki Power!!
12-413.overview: The Snake Princess pits Luffy’s Gum-Gum abilities against the incredible Haki power of her serpentine sisters in a fight to the death. Will Luffy survive long enough to save his statuesque friends?

12-414.title: All-Out Special Power Battle!! Gum-Gum vs. Snake-Snake
12-414.overview: Luffy kicks his attack mode into Second Gear to save a precious statue, and the snake sisters start to feel the Straw Hat heat. At the battle’s climax, Luffy makes an impression on his opponents.

12-415.title: Hancock's Confession – The Sisters' Abhorrent Past
12-415.overview: News of Luffy's run-in with the Celestial Dragons impresses the Snake Princess, so she tells him the story of her tortured past. Will his honorable nature speed Luffy toward a reunion with his crew?

12-416.title: Saving Ace! The Next Stop: the Great Prison!
12-416.overview: Luffy is mobbed by a hoard of pretty Kuja women eager to touch a real live man. Granny Nyon offers him safe haven, but what she has to say might sink his plans for a Straw Hat reunion.

12-417.title: Love is a Hurricane! Hancock Madly in Love!
12-417.overview: Boa Hancock’s illness threatens to sabotage Luffy’s rescue mission. However, the Snake Princess just can’t say “no” to the rubber-man, so a plan to save Ace is quickly hatched.

12-418.title: The Friends' Whereabouts – The Science of Weather and the Mechanical Island
12-418.overview: While Luffy races to save Ace, Nami tries to survive life on Sky Island, and Franky dances up a snowstorm before making the switch from cola to tea!

12-419.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! An Island of Giant Birds and a Pink Paradise!
12-419.overview: Chopper narrowly avoids being served for dinner in a land inhabited by giant birds, and Sanji’s refined tastes land him a role as a leading lady on the island of girlish hearts.

12-420.title: The Friends' Whereabouts – Bridging the Islands and Vicious Vegetations!
12-420.overview: Nico Robin finds herself trapped on the island of Tequila Wolf: a miserable land where children are forced to work as slaves. Elsewhere, Usopp tries to survive a run-in with a man-eating plant!

12-421.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! A Princess Negativity and the King of Demons!
12-421.overview: Zoro is held against his will by the pink-haired princess of bad vibes, Brook gets mistaken for the king of darkness, and Luffy continues to eat his way toward a reunion with Fire-Fist Ace!

13-422.title: A Deadly Infiltration! The Underwater Prison Impel Down
13-422.overview: Luffy and Boa arrive at Impel Down, but only thirty-three hours remain until Ace's execution. To save him, the Snake Princess must find a way to hide Luffy during her full-body search!

13-423.title: A Reunion in Hell?! The Man Who Ate the Chop-Chop Fruit!
13-423.overview: Time is running out on Ace, so Luffy teams up with a scoundrel who's going to pieces trying to escape Impel Down. There's no love lost between Buggy the Clown and the Straw Hat captain, but they'd better work together if they want to survive.

13-424.title: Break Through the Crimson Hell! Buggy's Chaos-Inducing Plan
13-424.overview: Luffy must part ways with a priceless treasure map before Buggy the Clown agrees to lead him through the bloody tangle of Blade Trees and Spike Needle Grass that make up Impel Down's Crimson Hell!

13-425.title: The Strongest Man in the Prison! Poison Man Magellan Appears
13-425.overview: Luffy and Buggy the Clown could end up as hippo food if they aren’t careful in Impel Down’s Wild Beast Hell. Of course, the rubberman might find that a better fate than dealing with the prison’s putrid warden!

13-426.title: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie! A Gold Lion's Ambition on the Move
13-426.overview: A special flashback episode to prepare for the movie release! The countdown is on to Luffy's showdown with Shiki the Golden Lion! It all begins when the Straw Hat crew tails a large, mysterious beetle to an even more interesting island!

13-427.title: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie! Little East Blue in Danger
13-427.overview: The citizens of Little East Blue throw a feast in honor of the Straw Hats, but when the Amigo Pirates try to capture Boss the beetle, Luffy and his crew will have to defend their new friends.

13-428.title: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie! The Fierce Onslaught of the Amigo Pirates
13-428.overview: Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji prepare to do battle on behalf of Boss the beetle, but Captain Largo of the Amigo Pirates counters with a deadly arsenal of nets to put the Straw Hat brawlers on lock down!

13-429.title: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie! The Battle Is On! Luffy vs. Largo
13-429.overview: Luffy kicks into second gear for his rematch with Largo, and Nami leads the islanders as they lay waste to the Amigo Pirates. Boss the Beetle may be safe for now, but someone sinister lurks behind the scenes.

13-430.title: A Warlord in Prison! Jimbei, the Honorable Pirate
13-430.overview: Luffy struggles to stay a step ahead of a prison patrol made up of hungry lions and poisonous scorpions! Meanwhile, Ace spends what could be his final hours swapping stories with a pirate who hates pirates.

13-431.title: Chief Guard Saldeath's Trap! Level 3 - Starvation Hell
13-431.overview: While the guards struggle to squelch a violent prison uprising, Luffy and his fellow fugitives try to keep their cool in a level of Impel Down known as Starvation Hell!

13-432.title: The Unleashed Swan! A Reunion with Bon Clay
13-432.overview: Boa Hancock uses her ample assets to buy some private time for a clandestine chat with Ace. Meanwhile, Luffy needs help from a graceful friend to escape the jaws of a hungry Sphinx!

13-433.title: Warden Magellan's Strategy! Straw Hat Entrapment Completed!
13-433.overview: Luffy and Bon are on the verge of reaching Level 4, but they didn’t count on fighting a demonic, lightning-fast, devastatingly powerful Minotaur! To defeat this beast, they’ll need help from a human candle and a deranged clown!

13-434.title: All Forces Have Gathered! The Battle on Level 4, the Burning Heat Hell!
13-434.overview: Luffy narrowly avoids a deadly dip in a boiling pool of blood, only to find himself face to face with Warden Magellan. Meanwhile, outside the prison walls, the marine fleet prepares for Whitebeard’s onslaught!

13-435.title: Mighty Magellan! Bon Clay Bugs Out
13-435.overview: Warden Magellan is a monster of a man with a penchant for poisoning prisoners. To rescue Ace, Luffy must go toe to toe with this toxic terror, but how do you defeat a foe who's deadly to the touch?

13-436.title: The Showdown Has Come! Luffy's Desperate Last Attack!
13-436.overview: Luffy’s daring assault on the venomous warden of Impel Down leaves him struggling to stand up, but despite the lethal poison breaking down his body, the rubber-man kicks his rescue mission into second gear!

13-437.title: For His Friend! Bon Clay Goes to the Deadly Rescue!
13-437.overview: While Luffy hovers perilously on the verge of death, Bon Clay embarks on a suicidal rescue mission plagued by sub-zero temperatures and bloodthirsty wolves with a supremely savage disposition!

13-438.title: A Paradise in Hell! Impel Down Level 5.5!
13-438.overview: No existing antidote can save Luffy from the poison coursing through his veins, yet Bon Clay refuses to give up. His final, fleeting hope is a mysterious miracle-worker rumored to have vanished into the Gates of Hell!

13-439.title: Luffy's Treatment Begins! Ivan-san's Miraculous Power!
13-439.overview: Bon is overjoyed to hear that Luffy is still alive, but his happiness quickly turns to shock when he learns that Ivan’s agonizingly painful “Healing Hormones” will cost the rubber-man ten years of his life!

13-440.title: Believe in Miracles! Bon Clay's Cries from the Heart
13-440.overview: Ace is scheduled to be executed in a matter of hours, and Luffy’s still hovering on the verge of death. It will take a miracle to save them both, but Bon would rather die than give up on his friend!

13-441.title: Luffy's Back! Ivan-san Begins the Breakout Plan!
13-441.overview: Luffy miraculously survived his brush with death, but he’s far too weak to finish rescuing Ace. Ivan is reluctant to lend a hormonal hand to the doomed rescue mission – until he learns of Luffy’s lineage!

13-442.title: Ace's Convoy Begins! Battle on the Lowest Floor, Level 6!
13-442.overview: The quest to rescue Ace tuckers out thanks to a blast of sleeping gas! Ivan’s scissor-handed sidekick puts an end to nap time, but Luffy will have to join forces with a scar-faced foe from the past if he wants to complete his mission!

13-443.title: The Ultimate Team Has Formed! Shaking Impel Down!
13-443.overview: Luffy’s desperate attempt to rescue Ace is bolstered by two powerful new allies: the murderous Crocodile and the honorable fishman Jinbei. Meanwhile, Ivan sparks a prison riot to create a diversion for the rubber-man.

13-444.title: Even More Chaos! Here Comes Blackbeard Teech!
13-444.overview: Luffy and his gang of outlaws cause a commotion on Level Four, Blackbeard’s arrival leads to the release of the prison’s most feared inmate, and Ace gazes upon the great blue sky for what could be the very last time!

13-445.title: The Dangerous Encounter! Blackbeard and Shiryu of the Rain!
13-445.overview: Three battles are raging throughout Impel Down - Luffy tackles the demon guards, Ivankov squares off against Sadie-chan, and Shiryu reaches the gate of Impel Down to meet Blackbeard and his crew. But are things really as they seem? Meanwhile, Buggy's bright ideas are close to freeing him and Mr. 3 from Impel Down.

13-446.title: No Price Too High! Serious Hannyabal!
13-446.overview: Luffy’s bone-crushing battle with the Vice Warden of Impel Down is interrupted by the sudden appearance of Blackbeard. When the rubber-man hears what the warlord has to say – heads will roll!

13-447.title: Jet Pistol of Anger! Luffy vs. Blackbeard!
13-447.overview: Even in Second Gear, Luffy is no match for Blackbeard’s vortex, but the rubber-man rebounds by knocking out a Demon Guard with one ferocious pistol-punch. Elsewhere, Warden Magellan vows to finish Luffy once and for all!

13-448.title: Stop Magellan! Ivan-san's Esoteric Technique Explodes
13-448.overview: Ace is to be executed in a matter of hours, and Magellan’s toxic breath is singeing the back of Luffy’s neck. Ivan uses a devastating Death Wink to buy some time, but the warden’s Poison Hydra may be more than he can handle!

13-449.title: Magellan's Tricky Move! A Foiled Escape Plan!
13-449.overview: Buggy and the others can taste freedom on just the other side of the door to Impel Down, but their escape is thwarted by Magellan's secret plan. Meanwhile, Luffy has a chance to face Magellan again - and avenge the Ivankov and Inazuma.

13-450.title: The Escapee Team in Trouble! The Forbidden Move: Venom Demon!
13-450.overview: Magellan takes his toxic attack to the next level by unleashing the hideous and deadly Venom Demon! If Jimbei and Crocodile don’t return with a rescue ship soon, Luffy won’t survive long enough to save Ace!

13-451.title: Come, Final Miracle! Break Through the Gate of Justice!
13-451.overview: Luffy and his merry band of escapees are safely onboard the rescue ship, but they’re not out hot water just yet. A fleet of marines is bombarding them with cannon balls, and an impenetrable gate looms on the horizon!

13-452.title: To the Navy Headquarters! Off to Rescue Ace!
13-452.overview: Luffy and Ivan mourn the loss of Bon Clay, and Captain Buggy’s reputation gets a boost when a phone call from the Marines reveals the secrets of his past.

13-453.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! The Weatheria Report and the Cyborg Animals!
13-453.overview: While Luffy continues his rescue mission, Nami learns a lesson about how to turn rain into cash, and Franky wakes up in a freezing forest full of ferocious cyborg animals!

13-454.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! A Cheeper of Giant Birds and a Pink Showdown!
13-454.overview: Sanji tries to fight his way off a most peculiar island, but his frilly battle costume threatens to awaken his inner maiden. Elsewhere, Chopper tries to avoid being served in a hot pot!

13-455.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! Revolutionaries and the Gorging Forest's Trap!
13-455.overview: Nico Robin lends her many hands to an overmatched gang of revolutionaries in a frigid land of eternal suffering, and Usopp bulks up to avoid becoming a snack for a hungry, hungry island!

13-456.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! A Huge Tomb and the Panty Debt!
13-456.overview: Zoro’s attempt to reunite with his friends leads him a massive tomb and a host of shadowy swordsmen. Elsewhere, Brook uses his status as Satan to get an eyeful of undergarments!

13-457.title: A Special Retrospective Before Marineford! The Vow of the Brotherhood!
13-457.overview: While the marines prepare for Ace’s execution, Luffy looks back on all the good times he shared with his brother, and Jimbei reveals the shocking details of the day Fire Fist Ace went down in defeat!

13-458.title: A Special Retrospective Before Marineford! The Three Navy Admirals Come Together!
13-458.overview: Luffy and his gang continue on their way to Marineford, but once he arrives, the rubber-man must defeat both Navy Admirals and Warlords of the Sea before he can save Ace!

13-459.title: Ticking Down to the Time of Battle! The Navy's Strongest Lineup in Position!
13-459.overview: Citizens and soldiers alike prepare for all-out war as Ace is led to the site of his execution. While the world watches, the true identity of the condemned man’s father is shockingly revealed!

13-460.title: A Vast Fleet Appears! Here Come the Whitebeard Pirates!
13-460.overview: Flashbacks reveal the agonizing sacrifice made by Ace’s mother in order save his life – and the secret behind his connection to Luffy. Back in the present, Whitebeard makes an unexpected entrance!

13-461.title: The Beginning of the War! Ace and Whitebeard's Past!
13-461.overview: As a massive seaquake rocks Marineford, Ace recalls the ups and downs of his life as a pirate, including his first encounter with Whitebeard – and the unthinkable betrayal that led to his capture!

13-462.title: The Force That Could Destroy the World! The Power of the Tremor-Tremor Fruit!
13-462.overview: Whitebeard begins his attack with a tsunami-spawning sea quake, but the marines counter with a blast of frigid air that turns the tidal wave into an iceberg! Will Luffy and his crew arrive in time to join the battle?

13-463.title: An All-Consuming Inferno!! Admiral Akainu's Power!
13-463.overview: Fire meets ice as mythical warriors, erupting admirals, legendary pirates, and a giant giant go head to head in the biggest, baddest battle of all time! There’s only one thing missing: Monkey D. Luffy!

13-464.title: A Descendent of the Beast! Little Oars Jr. - Full Speed Ahead!
13-464.overview: A towering giant of a giant known as Little Oars Jr. carves a path of death and destruction as he fights to save Ace. The monstrous mauler is within arm’s reach of his friend when he’s intercepted by the seven warlords of the sea!

13-465.title: Justice for the Winners! Sengoku's Strategy in Action!
13-465.overview: In the wake of Little Oars Junior’s tragic defeat, Admiral Sengoku hatches a devious plan to speed up the countdown to Ace’s execution. The situation looks beyond bleak until a hero enters the fray from on high!

13-466.title: Straw Hat Team Arrives! Tension Grows at the Battlefield
13-466.overview: Luffy appears on the field of battle with a ferocious sense of urgency. Ace could be executed at any minute, and the rubber-man’s refusal to back down impresses even the most feared men in all the world!

13-467.title: Even If It Means Death! Luffy vs. the Navy; The Battle Starts!
13-467.overview: Luffy leaps into action, attacking the Naval forces with a frantic display of brutality. Meanwhile, Ace watches in horror as an army of zombies rises up to attack his brother!

13-468.title: Hard Battles, One After Another! Devil Fruit Eaters vs. Devil Fruit Eaters!
13-468.overview: Supernatural powers take center stage in the battle to save Ace as Luffy and his uniquely talented allies throw down with the Navy’s own arsenal of Devil Fruit Eaters!

13-469.title: Kuma's Transformation! Ivan-san's Blow of Anger!
13-469.overview: A gift from Boa Hancock and Ivan-san’s Galaxy Wink get Luffy closer to Ace than ever, but a sword-wielding foe from the past threatens to derail the rescue mission!

13-470.title: The Great Swordsman Mihawk! Luffy Comes Under the Attack of the Black Sword!
13-470.overview: Luffy runs into a lethal roadblock in the form of Hawk-Eye Mihawk. The legendary swordsman is determined to halt Luffy’s onslaught, but Ivan-san, Boa Hancock, and Jimbei aren’t ready to give up the fight!

13-471.title: The Extermination Strategy in Action! The Power of the Pacifistas!
13-471.overview: Luffy and his pirate brethren have their hands full with an ominous army of unbeatable Kumas! While the inhuman minions march onward, Whitebeard encounters a former ally!

13-472.title: Akainu's Plot! Whitebeard Entrapped!
13-472.overview: Whitebeard is betrayed – and brutally stabbed – by one of his own men! In the wake of this unthinkable act of treason, allegations about the legendary pirate bring the battle to a halt!

13-473.title: The Encircling Walls Activated! The Whitebeard Pirates backed into a corner!
13-473.overview: Whitebeard shrugs off his injuries and leads a ferocious charge into the heart of the enemy’s defenses, but three deadly Admirals join forces to silence his shock wave attack as the pirates find themselves surrounded by impenetrable walls!

13-474.title: Execution Order Issued! Break Through the Encircling Walls!
13-474.overview: With the ice melting beneath his feet, Luffy begins a desperate final charge towards his soon-to-be-executed brother. Should his rescue attempt fail, death will surely embrace them both!

13-475.title: Moving into the Final Phase! Whitebeard's Trump Card for Recovery!
13-475.overview: Crocodile’s unexpected assistance creates and opening for Luffy to advance, and Whitebeard has a surprise lurking beneath the ice that might swing the momentum in favor of the pirates!

13-476.title: Luffy at the End of His Tether! An All-out Battle at the Oris Plaza!
13-476.overview: The battle rages on and the bodies pile up as Whitebeard squares off against an Admiral, Luffy gets knocked cold, and the legendary Vice-Admiral Garp finally enters the fray!

13-477.title: The Power That Will Shorten One's Life! Energy Hormone, Redux!
13-477.overview: While awaiting his execution, Ace flashes back to a trouble youth spent seeking the truth about his father. Meanwhile, Luffy begs Ivan for a potentially-deadly treatment that will allow him to continue fighting!

13-478.title: To Live Up to a Promise! Luffy and Coby Collide!
13-478.overview: Luffy makes short work of face from his past, and Whitebeard struggles to withstand the full force of the Marine onslaught. With the executioner’s swords hovering above Ace’s head, Straw Hat Luffy discovers a new ability!

13-479.title: The Scaffold at Last! The Way to Ace Has Opened!
13-479.overview: Whitebeard orders his men to help Luffy clear a path to the execution scaffold, but someone close to the Rubber-man rises up to derail the rescue mission at the last second!

13-480.title: Each on Different Paths! Luffy vs. Garp!
13-480.overview: Luffy must defeat the man who taught him how to fight – his own grandfather – in order to save Ace. Battling his own flesh and blood won’t be easy, but a waxy ally is there to provide back up!

13-481.title: Ace Rescued! Whitebeard's Final Order!
13-481.overview: Ace is finally free from the execution scaffold! Luffy and his brother make a fearsome team as they blaze a path toward salvation. Ravaged by the war, Whitebeard wistfully commands his men to make the journey to the New World without him!

13-482.title: The Power That Can Burn Even Fire! Akainu's Ruthless Pursuit!
13-482.overview: Despite Whitebeard’s order to retreat, Ace is drawn back to the battlefield by the cruel taunts of a Marine adversary. Luffy watches in horror as his brother makes what could be his last stand!

13-483.title: Looking for the Answer!
13-483.overview: An eerie silence falls over the battlefield as Luffy and Ace share a heartbreaking final moment together. With his dying breath, Ace begs his brother to convey a message to his fellow pirates.

13-484.title: The Navy Headquarters Falls! Whitebeard's Unspeakable Wrath!
13-484.overview: Anguished cries echo across the battlefield in the wake of Ace’s tragic death. Luffy – paralyzed by grief – must be carried to safety, but Whitebeard summons the strength for one last ferocious attack!

13-485.title: Ending the Matter! Whitebeard vs. The Blackbeard Pirates!
13-485.overview: Whitebeard’s children watch in horror as the old man faces off against the villainous Blackbeard pirates. Though his injuries are mounting and the odds are stacked against him, Whitebeard never, ever runs away from a fight!

13-486.title: The Show Begins! Blackbeard's Plot is Revealed!
13-486.overview: The world reacts to Whitebeard’s death with shock and awe. Meanwhile, Jimbei risks his life to save Luffy and Blackbeard reveals the depraved depths of his nefarious nature!

13-487.title: Akainu's Tenacity! The Fist of Magma Attacks Luffy
13-487.overview: While Blackbeard and his men seek to sink Marineford, Jimbei and Luffy’s desperate attempt to flee is thwarted by Akainu’s fiery fists. The situation appears dire until a former enemy lends a sandy hand!

13-488.title: The Desperate Scream! Courageous Moments that Will Change the Future
13-488.overview: Trafalgar Law and the Heart Pirates offer Luffy a submarine escape route, Blackbeard continues his reckless rampage, and a puny pink-hair marine changes the world with a scream!

13-489.title: Here Comes Shanks! The War of the Best is Finally Over!
13-489.overview: The Heart Pirates head for the bottom of the ocean as Trafalgar Law prepares to operate on Luffy and Jimbei. Meanwhile, the arrival of Shanks brings the bloodshed to a sudden halt!

13-490.title: Mighty Leaders Face Each Other Down! Heralding the 'New Era'!
13-490.overview: The world rejoices in the wake of Whitebeard’s death, and a host of powerful pirates vie for his position. Meanwhile, Luffy’s friends fear that Ace’s death may be more than the rubber-man can handle – if he ever wakes up!

13-491.title: Landing at the Maiden Island! The Harsh Reality Falls upon Luffy!
13-491.overview: Power-hungry pirates terrorize innocent citizens once protected by Whitebeard, and Luffy’s nightmarish awakening sends him on a reckless rampage that could land him in an early grave!

13-492.title: The Strongest Tag-Team! Luffy and Toriko's Hard Struggle! (II)
13-492.overview:
After eating the Hungrila Bird that they captured, Luffy and Toriko team up again to save Nami and Komatsu who have been kidnapped by the Cocoalas.

The crossover starts on Toriko E01 Arrival on Gourmet Island! The Gourmet Hunter Toriko Appears! (I).

13-493.title: Luffy and Ace! The Story of How the Brothers Met!
13-493.overview: A flashback to the younger days of Luffy and Ace reveals their unusual upbringing under the not-so-watchful eye of villainous mountain bandits!

13-494.title: Here Comes Sabo! The Boy at the Gray Terminal!
13-494.overview: The flashback continues as Ace robs a ruthless gang of pirates, and Luffy is left to take the fall! Will Ace and his friend Sabo let Luffy be tortured to death – or will they risk their high seas dreams to save him!

13-495.title: I Won't Run! Ace's Desperate Rescue Operation!
13-495.overview: Ace and Sabo race to rescue Luffy from the clutches of a murderous gang of pirates! Sabo wants to grab Luffy and make a break for it, but Ace refuses to back down from a fight – even when he’s outnumbered!

13-496.title: To The Sea Someday! The Pledge of the Three Brats!
13-496.overview: When a nobleman recognizes Sabo in the streets, Luffy and Ace learn the painful secret of their friend’s past. As a sign of solidarity, the three boys pledge to become pirates, and hoist a toast to brotherhood!

13-497.title: Leaving the Dadan Family for Good?! The Kids' Hideout Has Been Built!
13-497.overview: After another beating from Garp, Luffy and his friends take to the jungle and build a pirate hideout at the top of an enormous tree. First order of business: booby trap the new place!

13-498.title: Luffy Becoming an Apprentice?! A Man Who Fought Against the King of the Pirates!
13-498.overview: Luffy and his friends vow to defeat the giant tiger that’s been stealing their food, Ace gets angry when his father’s identity is revealed, and Sabo’s parents hire pirates to track down their son!

13-499.title: The Battle against the Big Tiger! Who is Going to be Captain?!
13-499.overview: Luffy, Ace, and Sabo take pirate lessons from a mysterious old scallywag who just might know the secret to defeating the big tiger – and becoming a good captain!

13-500.title: Freedom Taken Away! The Nobles' Plot Closing in on the Brothers!
13-500.overview: The brothers are captured by a gang of pirates, and Sabo is handed over to his noble father, where the boy quickly discovers a sinister plot to destroy Gray Terminal forever!

13-501.title: The Fire Has Been Set! The Gray Terminal in Crisis!
13-501.overview: While flames spread across Gray Terminal, Sabo makes a desperate attempt to escape the trappings of his noble birth and save his brothers. Meanwhile, Luffy and Ace must fight to avoid an untimely end!

13-502.title: Where can freedom be found? A Sad Departure of a Boy!
13-502.overview: Luffy is spared from a fiery death by an unlikely rescuer, but Ace refuses to leave Gray Terminal until he settles the score with Bluejam. Meanwhile, Sabo makes waves with a last ditch escape attempt!

13-503.title: Take Good Care of Him! A Letter from the Brother!
13-503.overview: Luffy and Ace receive troubling reports of a Celestial attack on Sabo’s ship. Ace is eager to seek out the responsible parties and extract revenge, but a letter from his absent brother tempers his eagerness to fight!

13-504.title: To Live Up to the Promise! Departures of Their Own!
13-504.overview: Through all the trials and tribulations of their life in the Goa Kingdom; East Blue, the brother Ace and Luffy are finally set to go out on their own. Have they gained the strength they need? With the ghost of Sabo looking on, the two begin the next chapter in their life!

13-505.title: I Want to See Them! Luffy's Mournful Cry!
13-505.overview: After the War of the Best, Garp finds that he has to answer to Dadan for not having been able to stop Ace’s death, while Luffy, who has lost his will to fight on, is reminded by a close ally that he still has something worth fighting for!!

13-506.title: Straw Hats in Shock! The Bad News Has Reached Them!
13-506.overview: Luffy finally realizes that, though he has lost his brother, Ace, he still has a lot to live for! Meanwhile, other members of the Straw Hat crew begin to hear news of the tragic events of the War of the Best -- and their thoughts turn immediately to Luffy!

13-507.title: Reunited with Dark King Rayleigh! Decision Time for Luffy!
13-507.overview: Luffy is determined to reassemble his scattered crew, but a powerful old friend forces him to rethink his plans. Meanwhile, Usopp fights to escape an island that wants to have him for lunch!

13-508.title: Back to Our Captain! A Jail Break at the Sky Island and the Incident on the Winter Island!
13-508.overview: Nami tries to escape the Sky Island - Weatheria in order to be reunited with Luffy, but it proves more difficult than she planned. Meanwhile Franky tries to escape Winter Island, but there is only one boat to take…

13-509.title: Encounter! The Great Swordsman Mihawk! Zoro's Self-Willed Deadly Struggle!
13-509.overview: Zoro’s escape attempt is thwarted by a gang of sword-slinging baboon bullies, and Brook uses music to end a feud between irate islanders with unequal arms!

13-510.title: A Disaster for Sanji! The Queen's Return to the Kingdom!
13-510.overview: Chopper hitches a ride on a giant bird, Luffy makes a shocking return to Marineford, and Sanji finds himself fighting the most beautiful man he’s ever seen!

13-511.title: Unexpected Relanding! Luffy, to Marineford!
13-511.overview: Luffy, along with Jimbei and Dark King Rayleigh, causes quite the commotion upon his return to Marineford. Meanwhile, powerful pirates all across the globe wreak havoc on the innocent!

13-512.title: With Hopes It Will Reach My Friends! Big News Spreading Fast!
13-512.overview: Luffy hopes to send a message to his mates by way of a clue hidden in a newspaper article. Meanwhile, the Flying Fish Riders protect the Straw Hat’s ship from scandalous scavengers!

13-513.title: Pirates Get on the Move! Astounding New World!
13-513.overview: Trafalgar Law waits for the right moment to make his move, Blackbeard is pursued by powerful marines, and Chopper makes a surprising return to the land of gargantuan birds!

13-514.title: Living through Hell! Sanji's Fight for His Manhood!
13-514.overview: Nami uses her feminine charms to learn about the New World weather, Franky moves into Dr. Vegapunk’s laboratory, and Sanji must fight to stay out of a cute dress!

13-515.title: I Will Get Much, Much Stronger! Zoro's Pledge to His Captain!
13-515.overview: The Straw Hats continue preparations for their voyage to the New World as Robin heads for a meeting with the Revolutionary Dragon, Usopp aspires to become King of the Snipers, and Zoro begs his mortal enemy to train him!

13-516.title: Luffy's Training Begins! To the Place We Promised in 2 Years!
13-516.overview: Dark King Rayleigh takes Luffy to a deadly, deserted island for two years of intense battle training! If the Straw Hat captain wants to survive in the New World, he’ll have to hone his hidden powers!

13-517.title: The Beginning of The New Chapter! The Straw Hats Reunited!
13-517.overview: After two years of rigorous training, the new and improved Straw Hats make their way to Sabaody Archipelago, but their long-awaited reunion is spoiled by a villainous gang of imposters!

13-518.title: An Explosive Situation! Luffy vs. Fake Luffy!
13-518.overview: Luffy picks a fight with himself, Chopper falls in with a dubious crowd of imitation pirates, and Zoro causes a commotion when he falls asleep on the wrong ship!

13-519.title: The Navy Has Set Out! The Straw Hats in Danger!
13-519.overview: Chopper struggles to make sense of the changes his “friends” have undergone in the last two years, and the Navy mobilizes in an attempt to stop the pirate posers. Will the real Straw Hats please stand up?

13-520.title: Big Guns Assembled! The Danger of the Fake Straw Hats!
13-520.overview: Chopper and Usopp flip over Franky’s new body, Brook must choose between rock-n-roll stardom and the life of a pirate, and Luffy wanders into a very dangerous crowd!

13-521.title: The Battle is on! Show Them What You Got From Training!
13-521.overview: Things get pretty hectic as the Navy finally confronts Fake Luffy's amassed pirate army - and the real Straw Hats prepare to set sail! Things don't go smoothly for either, however, and the real Luffy gets to show off what he has learned in the past two years!

13-522.title: Everyone Together! Luffy, Setting Out for the New World!
13-522.overview: Luffy and his crew are finally reunited, but before they can set sail, they’ll need help from Dark King Rayleigh, Boa Hancock, and all the friends they’ve made in the last two years!

14-523.title: A Surprising Fact! The Man Who Guarded the Sunny!
14-523.overview: As word of the Straw Hat resurrection spreads through the Navy, Luffy and his crew get acclimated to their underwater environment, and Franky reveals the startling identity of the man who protected their ship!

14-524.title: Deadly Combat under the Sea! The Demon of the Ocean Strikes!
14-524.overview: The Caribou Pirates attack the Straw Hats. While Caribou manages to get on the Thousand Sunny, the rest of his crew gets pulled away by Mohmoo, who gets frightened when he recognizes the Straw Hats from his time in Arlong Park. Caribou is left alone and, as a result, is captured by the Straw Hats. The Straw Hats come across the Kraken, which destroys the ship of the Caribou Pirates, who returned to save their captain, and then attacks Thousand Sunny. The Straw Hats manage to avoid its attacks and Luffy, along with Zoro and Sanji, are getting ready to fight it.

14-525.title: Lost in the Deep Sea! The Straw Hats Get Separated!
14-525.overview: After their quarrel with the Kraken, the Straw Hats find themselves in hot water as Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji turn up missing, and the rest of the crew runs short on air!

14-526.title: Undersea Volcanic Eruption! Drifting to the Fish-Man Island!
14-526.overview: The Flying Dutchman shows up and Vander Decken tells Wadatsumi to crush the Thousand Sunny, but then the Kraken beats Wadatsumi. The volcano erupts, and the pirates run from it. Surume jumps off a cliff and some big stones are about to crush them but Usopp stops them for a while with his new move, called Sargasso. But, when they are celebrating their survival, a rock hit Surume's head, made it faints as they are descending to the depth of the cliff. At the bottom of the cliff, they find Fishman Island but when they are about to enter, they are stopped by a group of sea monsters and someone riding it.

14-527.title: Landing at the Fish-Man Island! Beautiful Mermaids!
14-527.overview: The Straw Hat Pirates encounter Hammond, some sea-beasts and other fishmen from the New Fishman Pirates. Franky launches the Coup de Burst towards Fishman Island to escape the pirates. Unfortunately the Straw Hats get separated from the Sunny and from each other. Luffy wakes up after a while only to reunite with Keimi, Usopp, Sanji and Chopper. They leave Keimi's house and go to a higher level of the island where they meet other mermaids. Meanwhile, Hammond informs their leader about the Straw Hats entering Fishman Island.

14-528.title: Excitement Blow-out! Sanji's Life Under Threat!
14-528.overview: When Sanji gets up close and personal with a mesmerizing mermaid, his extreme fondness for the female form lands him in a life and death situation. Could the Straw Hat chef die from a nosebleed?!

14-529.title: The Fish-Man Island Will Be Annihilated?! Sharley's Prophecy!
14-529.overview: As blood donors are finally found, the recovering Sanji stays at the Mermaid Cafe while Luffy, Usopp and Keimi meet Pappug and Brook. The five of them head for Pappug's home. In the meantime, Ishilly and her friends vanish after opening the barrel that was washed up together with the Straw Hats and the episode ends with Madam Sharley predicting that Luffy would destroy Fishman Island.

14-530.title: The King of the Fish-Man Island! Neptune, the God of the Sea!
14-530.overview:
The episode starts with Gyro escaping from Hody Jones who in turn goes after him. The Straw Hat Pirates are in a town on Fishman Island and King Neptune and Megalo appear to invite the Straw Hats to Ryugu Palace.

Hody destroys Gyro's ship with handcuffs on to show how powerful he is. He defeated them all but left them still conscious so that they can tell about what is happening under sea to the people on earth.

14-531.title: Ryugu Palace! Taken by the Shark that They Saved!
14-531.overview: A trio of unsuspecting mermaids find themselves in hot water after releasing a bad guy from his barrel of a prison. Over at the royal palace, Luffy gets up close and personal with the Mermaid Princess!

14-532.title: A Coward and a Crybaby! The Princess in the Hard Shell Tower!
14-532.overview: Luffy’s lightning reflexes spare the Mermaid Princess from a grisly death, Neptune’s army attempts to apprehend the Straw Hats, and Captain Vander Decken forges a sinister undersea alliance!

14-533.title: It's An Emergency! The Ryugu Palace Is Occupied!
14-533.overview: With their backs against the wall, the Straw Hats are forced to take King Neptune and his men hostage. On the other side of the palace, Luffy and the Mermaid Princess make plans to visit the Sea Forrest!

14-534.title: The Ryugu Palace in Shock! the Kidnapping of Shirahoshi!
14-534.overview: Luffy accidentally “kidnaps” the Mermaid Princess, an old friend issues a grave warning to Chopper and Sanji, and the New Fish-Man Pirates prepare for a raid on Ryugu Palace!

14-535.title: Hordy's Onslaught! The Retaliatory Plan Set Into Motion!
14-535.overview: Captain Vander Decken and Hordy Jones manage to successfully breach the defenses of Ryugu Palace. Meanwhile, Jimbei waits patiently for Luffy to arrive at the Sea Forest.

14-536.title: The Ryugu Palace Fight! Zoro vs. Hordy!
14-536.overview: Robin ventures into the forest in search of ancient secrets, Zoro takes to the water for a slicing, dicing showdown with Hordy Jones, and Luffy is branded a royal kidnapper by an angry mob of fish folk!

14-537.title: Keep Shirahoshi Safe! Decken Close Behind!
14-537.overview: Luffy, Chopper, and Sanji are taken prisoner by a fish mob just as Vander Decken launches an attack the princess! Elsewhere, Zoro continues his battle with Hordy, and Nami hitches a ride on a mermaid to escape the crumbling palace!

14-538.title: The Straw Hats Defeated!? Hordy Gains Control of the Ryugu Palace!
14-538.overview: Zoro and Neptune fight bravely, but they’re no match for Hordy and his pill-popping minions. Back at the ship, Luffy reunites with Jimbei, who reveals something sinister about his past.

14-539.title: The Haunting Ties! Nami And The Fish-Man Pirates! The Resurrected Destiny! Nami and the Fishman Pirate Crew!
14-539.overview: The New Fish-Man Pirates continue their bloody and violent uprising, and Jimbei begins the story of how he unleashed the monster known as Arlong on the unsuspecting citizens of the East Blue.

14-540.title: A Hero Who Freed The Slaves! An Adventurer Tiger!
14-540.overview: Jimbei continues his story with tales of fish-men taken as slaves, Queen Otohime’s fierce devotion to her people, the legend of Fisher Tiger, and the sinister rise of Arlong.

14-541.title: Kizaru Appears! A Trap To Catch Tiger!
14-541.overview: Arlong’s violent tendencies are condemned by Fisher Tiger, and the arrival of a young human girl teaches the Fish-Man Pirates a lesson in compassion.

14-542.title: A Team Is Formed! Save Chopper (II)
14-542.overview:
Toriko and Luffy continue their search for the ingredients to save Chopper on To-Chuka Island.

The crossover starts on Toriko E51 The Reunion of Toriko and Luffy! Find the Seafood Fruit! (I).

14-543.title: The Death of the Hero! A Shocking Truth of Tiger!
14-543.overview: The great pirate Fisher Tiger keeps his promise to a young slave girl, but the adults in her village are determined to make him pay for his act of honor.

14-544.title: The Sun Pirates Split! Jimbei vs. Arlong!
14-544.overview: After the death of Fisher Tiger, Arlong's abuse of humans lands him in jail, Jimbei becomes the captain of the Sun Pirates, and Queen Otohime's passion to see her vision come true is renewed!

14-545.title: Shaking Fish-Man Island! A Celestial Dragon Drifts In!
14-545.overview: Tensions run high when a slave-owning Celestial Dragon washes up on Fish-Man Island. His former captives cry for out for blood, but Queen Otohime sees it as a chance to mend fences between the gilled and non-gilled!

14-546.title: A Sudden Tragedy! A Gunshot Shuts Down the Future!
14-546.overview: After an agonizing absence, Queen Otohime returns to her people with exciting news. Unfortunately, a horrific act of violence derails the queen’s mission and changes life on Fish-Man Island forever.

14-547.title: Back to the Present! Hordy Makes a Move!
14-547.overview: Jimbei reaches the heartbreaking conclusion in the story of Queen Otohime, Nami does something completely unexpected, and Hordy Jones makes a foreboding appearance!

14-548.title: The Kingdom in Shock! An Order to Execute Neptune Issued!
14-548.overview: Hordy announces his sinister plans for Fish-Man Island. Luffy and Shirahoshi are ready to fight, but Jimbei wants to wage this war on his own!

14-549.title: A Rift Opens Up! Luffy vs. Jimbei!
14-549.overview: Luffy and Jimbei come to blows over how to handle Hordy’s uprising. Back at the palace, Brook embarks on an out of body experience with hopes of saving his mates!

14-550.title: Something Has Happened to Hordy! The True Power of the Evil Drug!
14-550.overview: Jimbei and Luffy continue their standoff, the New Fish-Man pirates go on a rampage, and Hordy begins to experience startling side effects from his pill-popping habit!

14-551.title: The Battle is on! At Conchcorde Plaza!
14-551.overview: Hordy’s rampant use of the energy steroid makes him bigger, stronger, and scarier than ever before! The Fish-Man princes join the battle, but even they may not be strong enough to stop Hordy’s onslaught!

14-552.title: Surprising Confession! The Truth Behind the Assassination of Otohime!
14-552.overview: Jimbei and Shirahoshi are captured by the enemy, and Hordy makes a shocking revelation to the population of Fish-Man Island!

14-553.title: Shirahoshi's Tears! Luffy Finally Shows Up!
14-553.overview: Shirahoshi reveals that she knew the truth about her mother’s murder all along, and Luffy makes a bone-crushing entrance when the princess needs him most!

14-554.title: A Great Clash! The Straw Hat Crew vs. 100,000 Enemies
14-554.overview: Hordy announces his plan for turning humans into slaves, the people of Fish-Man Island throw their support behind a new champion, and Luffy amazes even his own friends!

14-555.title: Deadly Attacks One After Another! Zoro and Sanji Join The Battle!
14-555.overview: Luffy and the gang show off how much stronger they’ve become by issuing a brutal beat down to Hordy and his ferocious Fish-Man Pirates! Can anything stop the Hats?

14-556.title: Unveiled! The Secret Weapons of the Sunny!
14-556.overview: Hordy’s men keep attacking, but the Straw Hats have new weapons at their disposal! Franky unleashes the fury of the Black Rhino, and Luffy turns the tables on Hordy with a little help from his Kraken!

14-557.title: Iron Pirates! General Franky Appears
14-557.overview: Franky dazzles Usopp and Chopper by transforming into a gigantic fighting robot, Hordy tries to blackmail the Kraken, and Luffy introduces his fist to the Fish-man’s face!

14-558.title: Noah Approaches! The Crisis of Fishman Island's Destruction!
14-558.overview: Luffy shows off even more new powers as he brutally pummels Hordy, but the main attraction proves to be an ancient and immense pirate ship that’s heading straight for Fish-Man Island!

14-559.title: Hurry Up, Luffy! Shirahoshi's Desperate Situation
14-559.overview: Shirahoshi summons the courage to risk everything to save her world, Luffy puts his own life in peril by venturing into the ocean, and Hordy’s devious nature fully comes to the surface.

14-560.title: The Battle Begins! Luffy Vs. Hordy!
14-560.overview: Luffy sets the stage for a final battle with Hordy, Sanji kicks a giant in defense of Nami’s honor, and Zoro puts his blades to the ultimate test against a steroid-powered fighting fish!

14-561.title: A Massive Confused Fight! The Straw Hats vs. The New Fish-Man Pirates!
14-561.overview: While Luffy and Shirahoshi try to prevent Fish-Man Island from being crushed, the rest of the Straw Hats square off against the meanest Fish-Man Pirates in the deep blue sea!

14-562.title: Luffy Loses the Fight?! Hordy's Long Awaited Revenge!
14-562.overview: Luffy is the only one who can stop Hordy, but he’ll need air to survive the fight, so Shirahoshi’s big brother risks his own life in heroic attempt to get Luffy a bigger bubble!

14-563.title: A Shocking Fact! The True Identity of Hordy!
14-563.overview: While the rest of the Straw Hats continue to fight bravely, Luffy tries to find a way to save the island, and the horrible truth about Hordy’s hatred for humans is finally revealed!

14-564.title: Back to Zero! Ernest Wishes for Luffy!
14-564.overview: Hordy’s twisted past takes center stage in a Fish-man flashback. Meanwhile, Shirahoshi’s brother begs Luffy to save his beloved homeland and wipe out the anti-human element!

14-565.title: Luffy's All-out Attack! Red Hawk Blasts!
14-565.overview: Luffy’s fist of fire puts Hordy down for the count, and the rest of the Straw Hats try to make short work of the remaining Fish-Man Pirates. Meanwhile, a very big boat looms overhead!

14-566.title: Coming to an End! The Final Decisive Battle Against Hordy
14-566.overview: While the rest of the Straw Hats try to make short work of their enemies, Luffy summons the strength for one last brutal attack on Hordy. Now, about that giant boat…

14-567.title: Stop, Noah! Desperate Elephant Gantling!
14-567.overview: After defeating Hordy, Luffy turns his attention to stopping the Noah from crushing Fish-Man Island. Straw Hats and Fish-Men alike watch as Luffy tries to obliterate a boat with a barrage of brutal blows!

14-568.title: To the Future! The Path to the Sun!
14-568.overview: Fish-Man Island was saved by the timely arrival of the Sea Kings, but all is not well. Luffy lost a lot of blood in his battle with Hordy, and fish-to-human transfusions are strictly forbidden!

14-569.title: The Secret Revealed! The Truth About the Ancient Weapon!
14-569.overview: Jimbei must decide whether or not to join the Straw Hats, and the grateful citizens of Fish-Man Island host a fabulous banquet in honor of their human heroes!

14-570.title: The Straw Hats Stunned! The New Fleet Admiral of the Navy!
14-570.overview: Luffy and his crew learn of epic battle between Aokiji and Akainu, a forgotten foe tries to kidnap the mermaid princess, and Hordy’s gang finally gets what’s coming to them!

14-571.title: She Loves Sweets! Big Mom of the Four Emperors!
14-571.overview: When Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji stumble upon a couple of Big Mom’s henchmen extorting sweets from the peaceful people of Fish-Man Island, the Straw Hats make a new – and very powerful – enemy!

14-572.title: Many Problems Lie Ahead! A Trap Awaiting in the New World!
14-572.overview: The Straw Hats prepare to depart Fish-Man Island, a lion and a caribou come to blows over booby-trapped treasure, and Vice Admiral Smoker makes his presence felt in the New World!

14-573.title: Finally Time to Go! Goodbye, Fish-Man Island!
14-573.overview: Luffy and his crew bid farewell to their new friends before setting off in search of the greatest adventures the New World has to offer!

14-574.title: To the New World! Heading for the Ultimate Sea!
14-574.overview: Luffy and Usopp’s extreme deep sea fishing adventure lands the crew in the middle of a deadly whirlpool, but an unexpected encounter with a pod of giant whales may bail the Straw Hats out of hot water!

14-575.title: Z's Ambition! Lily the Little Giant!
14-575.overview: Luffy’s arrival in the New World is marked by violent weather and the discovery of a tiny stowaway. When the Straw Hats agree to help their new friend, it could lead to big trouble with the Marines!

14-576.title: Z's Ambition! A Dark and Powerful Army!
14-576.overview: Nami hatches a plan to save Lily’s father, but the arrival of an ex-marine madman throws a monkey wrench into the rescue mission.

14-577.title: Z's Ambition! A Great and Desperate Escape Plan!
14-577.overview: Luffy and Zoro find themselves locked in battle with their latest foes, but Nami’s knowledge of the sea may be the key to escaping this scrum alive!

14-578.title: Z's Ambition! Luffy vs. Shuzo!
14-578.overview: Shuzo and his clan are in hot pursuit of the Straw Hats after using a Vivre Card to track them. Shuzo puts up a good fight displaying strong Haki, but Luffy and Lily are able to combine attacks in a surprising way to level the playing field!

14-579.title: Arriving! A Burning Island - Punk Hazard!
14-579.overview: A desperate cry for help leads the Straw Hats to Punk Hazard, an island engulfed in flames and inhabited by a mythic beast that could make short work of Luffy and the gang!

14-580.title: A Battle in the Heat! Luffy vs. The Giant Dragon!
14-580.overview: Luffy, Robin, Usopp, and Zoro face down a powerful dragon as the battle heats up on Punk Hazard! And Luffy finds himself on the dragon's back during the attack, a mysterious discovery adds to the mystery of the island! Meanwhile, danger closes in for the rest of the Straw Hats on the Sunny...

15-581.title: The Straw Hats Stunned! Enter: A Samurai's Horrifying Severed Head!
15-581.overview: Luffy gets up close and personal with a torso-less Samurai! Elsewhere, Nami, Sanji, Chopper, and Franky find themselves imprisoned with the pieces of a human face!

15-582.title: Startling! The Secret of the Island Is Finally Revealed
15-582.overview: Luffy makes friends with a Centaur, Franky uses a cola-powered laser to break out of the clink, and Sanji takes a chance on a body-less Samurai!

15-583.title: Save the Children! The Straw Hats Start to Fight!
15-583.overview: Nami’s soft spot for children prompts her to call off the escape and declare war on anyone who makes a kid cry. Meanwhile, Luffy and the gang take a banana boat to the icy side of the island!

15-584.title: A Swordplay Showdown! Brook Vs. The Mysterious Torso Samurai!
15-584.overview: Luffy’s group finds themselves up against a gang of centaurs, Brook battles the torso of a surly samurai, and Captain Smoker encounters someone highly unexpected!

15-585.title: The Warlord! Trafalgar Law
15-585.overview: Nami and Chopper seek a safe exit for the children, Luffy’s group hopes to avoid a perilous plunge into icy waters, and Captain Smoker faces off against Trafalgar Law!

15-586.title: In a Real Pinch! Luffy Sinks into the Ice-cold Lake!
15-586.overview: Luffy’s group takes a deadly plunge into icy waters, and Trafalgar Law uses his unique abilities to rearrange Nami’s group and cast our heroes into chaotic confusion!

15-587.title: A Collision! Law vs. Vice Admiral Smoker!
15-587.overview: Nami and the others are subject to Law's bizarre powers, but have to put the shocking results behind them as they make a break out of the facility. Meanwhile, the battle heats up between Law and the G-5; and the mystery of Punk Hazard deepens!

15-588.title: Meeting Again After Two Years! Luffy and Law!
15-588.overview: Luffy is excited to once again cross paths with Trafalgar Law, but a reunion with his mixed up crew – and the loss of his extra legs – quickly dampens the captain’s enthusiasm!

15-589.title: The Worst in the World! A Scientist of Terror - Caesar!
15-589.overview: While Captain Smoker determines his next move, a very large pirate with alligator legs tells Luffy and the Straw Hats the true story of Punk Hazard’s mysterious transformation!

15-590.title: History's Strongest Collaboration vs. Glutton of the Sea (II)
15-590.overview:
While Luffy and his friends enjoy some tasty meat, a powerful creature attacks the dinner party, leading to a showdown with Luffy, Toriko and Goku.

The crossover starts on Toriko E99 Run, Strongest Team! Toriko, Luffy, and Goku! (I).

15-591.title: Chopper's Fury! The Master's Inhumane Experiment!
15-591.overview: The giant children fly into a mysterious rage, and Chopper discovers the true reason for their unusual condition! Meanwhile, Zoro, Brook, and Sanji cross paths with a dangerous duo!

15-592.title: To Annihilate the Straw Hats! Legendary Assassins Descend!
15-592.overview: The story of how Trafalgar Law arrived at Punk Hazard is revealed, and the Yeti Cool Brothers set their sights on a showdown with the Straw Hats!

15-593.title: Save Nami! Luffy's Fight on the Snow-Capped Mountains!
15-593.overview: Luffy tries to chase down the Yetti Cool Brothers, but Franky – still trapped in Chopper’s Body – makes his mission extremely difficult. Just when all appears lost, an unexpected ally lends a hand!

15-594.title: Formed! Luffy and Law's Pirate Alliance!
15-594.overview: Luffy agrees to an alliance with Trafalgar Law, but the Straw Hats refuse to leave the island until the children are safe. Meanwhile, the gaseous master unleashes something very deadly!

15-595.title: Capture M! The Pirate Alliance's Operation Launches!
15-595.overview: Zoro, Sanji, and Brook continue their search for the samurai, Trafalgar tries to sneak Chopper into the laboratory, and Luffy boldly challenges the Master!

15-596.title: On the Verge of Annihilation! A Deadly Monster Comes Flying In!
15-596.overview: Luffy’s battle with his old nemesis Smoker is interrupted by the arrival of a terrifying toxic blob – and the evil genius who created the monster!

15-597.title: An Intense Battle! Caesar Exercises His True Power!
15-597.overview: The Straw Hats make a valiant push to capture Caesar Clown - Luffy matches his Armament Haki with Clown's powerful Gas-Gas Fruit powers! The battle turns in favor of the Straw Hats, but underestimating Clown's abilities may have deadly consequences! Meanwhile, Law's plan to infiltrate Clown's facility hits a snag when an unseen guest complicates things!

15-598.title: The Samurai that Cuts the Fire! Kin'emon of Foxfire!
15-598.overview: Trafalgar Law finds trouble in the form of an old acquaintance, Chopper investigates the Master’s lab, and the mysterious Samurai shows what he can do with a full body!

15-599.title: Shocking! The True Identity of the Mystery Man Vergo!
15-599.overview: The Master gathers his young test subjects, shocking secret identities are finally revealed, and the poisonous purple blob continues its march across the island!

15-600.title: Save the Children! The Master's Evil Hands Close in!
15-600.overview: Nami and Usopp get an unexpected helping hand in their fight to save the children, Chopper plots a daring escape attempt, and the Master markets his greatest weapon!

15-601.title: Shaking Up the New World! Caesar's Horrendous Experiment!
15-601.overview: A desperate need for candy leads the children to return to the lab, and Caesar plans to show the world the new and improved version of Smiley!

15-602.title: The Deadliest Weapon of Mass Destruction in History! Shinokuni!
15-602.overview: Luffy and the Straw Hats find themselves pursued by a deadly cloud of purple gas that turns everything living thing in its path into petrified statues of ash!

15-603.title: Launching the Counter Attack! Luffy and Law's Great Escape!
15-603.overview: Law’s got a trick up his sleeve that could mean the difference between life and death. Zoro and company reunite with Nami and Sanji, but can they reach safety before being swallowed by a poisonous cloud?!

15-604.title: Get to Building R! The Pirate Alliance's Great Advance!
15-604.overview: Finally reunited and returned to their proper bodies, the Straw Hats fall in line as Luffy and Law lead the charge to settle the score with Caesar – and save the children!

15-605.title: Tashigi's Tears! G-5's Desperate Breakthrough Plan!
15-605.overview: Caesar hatches a plan to forever silence his enemies, Chopper races through the compound in search of the drugged children, and Tashigi’s men make the ultimate sacrifice!

15-606.title: The Treacherous Vice Admiral! Demon Bamboo Vergo!
15-606.overview: Luffy races toward Caesar in the hopes of delivering a beating, Sanji saves a damsel in distress, and Chopper tries to prevent the children from eating the drugged candy!

15-607.title: A Fierce Battle Gets Heated! Luffy vs. Caesar!
15-607.overview: Sanji and Vergo slug it out in a cloud of toxic gas, Law finds the room that could ruin the New World, and Luffy hopes to bring Caesar’s reign of terror to a brutal end!

15-608.title: A Mastermind Underground! Doflamingo Makes His Move!
15-608.overview: With Law's true ambitions revealed, Doflamingo goes into action in order to protect his criminal operation! Caesar slips away from Luffy leaving him to face off with the frigid Monet, and the rest of the crew face down a menacing dragon!

15-609.title: Luffy Dies from Exposure?! The Spine-chilling Snow Woman Monet!
15-609.overview: Luffy goes down fast after Monet puts a chill into him, and Trafalgar Law makes a desperate attempt to reclaim his heart during an electric battle with Vergo!

15-610.title: Fists Collide! A Battle of the Two Vice Admirals!
15-610.overview: Smoker attacks Vergo for assaulting his men, Luffy meets something strange in the trash heap, and a flashback reveals the true depths of Caesar’s madness!

15-611.title: A Small Dragon! Momonosuke Appears!
15-611.overview: Luffy befriends a dragon that used to be a human boy, and Captain Smoker continues his brutal battle with the villainous Vergo!

15-612.title: A Deadly Fight in a Blizzard! The Straw Hats vs. the Snow Woman!
15-612.overview: Luffy hitches a ride on a dragon, Mocha tries to keep the Master’s candy away from her friends, and Zoro pits his steel against snow in a battle with Monet!

15-613.title: Showing Off His Techniques! Zoro's Formidable One-Sword Style!
15-613.overview: It's Zoro vs. Monet in a duel to the death - or is it? Tashigi comes to lend a hand, and she'll need to bring her full might to compensate for Zoro's weakness! Meanwhile, Mocha is running out of options for keeping the candy away from the children.

15-614.title: To Save Her Friends! Mocha Runs at the Risk of Her Life!
15-614.overview: Chopper, Nami, and Robin watch in horror as Mocha makes a heartbreaking sacrifice in a courageous attempt to save the lives of her friends!

15-615.title: Brownbeard in Grief! Luffy Lands a Furious Blow!
15-615.overview: Brownbeard heroically attempts to expose Caesar as a villain, the horrific truth about Punk Hazard is finally revealed, and Luffy puts the hurt on his gaseous enemy!

15-616.title: A Surprising Outcome! White Chase vs. Vergo!
15-616.overview: Luffy makes Caesar pay for his crimes against the children, and Smoker risks his life for a chance to see Vergo fall in battle!

15-617.title: Caesar's Defeat! The Powerful Grizzly Magnum!
15-617.overview: Law reaches the end of his epic battle with Vergo, and Luffy looks to land a devastating final blow on the murderous gasbag Caesar!

15-618.title: Raid! An Assassin from Dressrosa!
15-618.overview: Word of Luffy and Law’s alliance spreads throughout the world, Chopper and Brook race to stay ahead of the deadly gas, and Joker sends a team to rescue Caesar!

15-619.title: Running Wild! Invincible General Franky!
15-619.overview: The laboratory crumbling around them, and time running out, Luffy, the Straw Hats, the G-5, the children and all the others make a final desperate sprint towards the one exit left off the island - but Joker has one more trick up his sleeve, and a deadly secret kept deep in the island spells doom for everyone!

15-620.title: A Critical Situation! Punk Hazard Explodes!
15-620.overview: As the Straw Hats and company flee the crumbling laboratory, Caesar’s desperate act of vengeance thwarts Joker’s plan to forever silence his enemies!

15-621.title: Capture Caesar! General Cannon Blast!
15-621.overview: Franky continues his battle with Buffalo and Baby 5, Nami uses a mighty gust of wind to save the children from a deadly cloud of gas, and Usopp takes a shot at capturing Caesar!

15-622.title: A Touching Reunion! Momonosuke and Kin'emon!
15-622.overview: A dragon regains his boyish form, a noble warrior once feared dead makes a shocking resurrection, and bitter enemies set aside their differences to enjoy a well-deserved feast!

15-623.title: It's Time to Say Goodbye! Leaving Punk Hazard!
15-623.overview: The weary marines and the rescued children get teary-eyed as they say goodbye to the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, Law enters into treacherous negotiations with Joker!

15-624.title: The G-5 Wiped Out! Doflamingo's Sudden Attack!
15-624.overview: On their way after having set out from Punk Hazard, the Straw Hats find out their next destination - just as a huge wave comes crashing down on the Sunny! But it's rough sailing for the G-5 as well, as Donflamingo - a.k.a. the Joker - arrives on the scene and wreaks havoc!

15-625.title: Intense! Aokiji vs. Doflamingo!
15-625.overview: Aokiji’s intercession saves Smoker and sends Joker off to rethink his strategy, leaving unanswered questions about Aokiji's current status. Meanwhile, the Straw Hats catch their breath as the Sunny makes its way through the rough seas of the New World -- where even a bit of hail portends doom!

15-626.title: Caesar Goes Missing! The Pirate Alliance Makes a Sortie!
15-626.overview: Smooth seas stretch out before the Straw Hats as they leave Punk Hazard far behind -- but while they fear Donflamingo's return and prepare to face him, another foe lies in wait, whose powers could be their downfall!

15-627.title: Luffy Dies at Sea?! The Pirate Alliance Comes Apart!
15-627.overview: Breed has Luffy, Trafalgar, and Chopper firmly in his grasp with his Peto-Peto power! Breed dreams of a world in which he has enslaved all the humans, but Luffy's stubborn persistence and unwillingness to cooperate may have landed him in hot water for the last time!

15-628.title: A Major Turnaround! Luffy's Angry Iron Fist Strikes!
15-628.overview: After Law discovers the secret to Breed’s power, Luffy and his old friend the Kung Fu Dugong give the animal-abusing madman a beasty beat down!

15-629.title: Startling! The Big News Shakes Up the New World!
15-629.overview: The world is in shock from Doflamingo's sudden resignation from the Seven Warlords. In the midst of all this, Law gives him information about the location and conditions for handing over Caesar, but hides his true intent - to destroy the SMILE manufactory. As the rendez-vous draws near, Doflamingo summons his executives and sets his own plan into motion!

15-630.title: Explore! A Kingdom of Love and Passion: Dressrosa!
15-630.overview: Dressrosa! Luffy and the Straw Hats divide into teams and set about their business on this passionate, enchanting island! But here, in the heart of enemy territory, danger lurks around every corner. Luffy and the others encounter a mysterious blind man whose luck has just run out...

15-631.title: Full of Enthusiasm! The Corrida Colosseum!
15-631.overview: Out and about in Dressrosa, Luffy and his team encounter a mysterious and powerful blind gambler - and run into trouble while his shocking powers distract everyone! Meanwhile, a major event in the Colosseum draws huge crowds, all eager to see the amazing prize Doflamingo has for his champion!

15-632.title: A Dangerous Love! The Dancer Girl: Violet!
15-632.overview: Zoro, Sanji, and Kin'emon strike off in search of the thieving fairy who has taken Zoro's sword, but Sanji finds himself mesmerized by the beautiful dancing of a gorgeous Dressrosa woman - with a deadly secret! Meanwhile, the prize of a Devil Fruit derived from Ace's powers draws Luffy and Franky to the Colosseum, but if they want to win the prize, they'll have to face some of Dressrosa's most powerful villains!

15-633.title: A Formidable, Unknown Warrior! Here Comes Lucy!
15-633.overview: Luffy enters the Corrida Colosseum in order to compete for Ace's Flare-Flare Fruit! But with the mightiest warriors of the New World assembled and standing in his way, the competition will not be easy. The first stage of the competition is a battle royal - a free-for-all in which only the mightiest left standing will pass on to the next stage!

15-634.title: A Pirate Noble! Cavendish!
15-634.overview: While the deadly battle of Block A winds down, all the onlookers in the stadium are shocked to discover the secret identity of the winner! Meanwhile, Luffy's cover may be blown as another voice from the past returns; and we find out that the secret plot of the Straw Hats might not be the only covert action taking place in Dressrosa!

15-635.title: The Fateful Reunion! Bellamy the Hyena!
15-635.overview: Luffy meets an unexpected acquaintance from the past, Bellamy, who seems to be up to no good! Meanwhile, Caesar Handover Team encounters a snag when they learn just how dangerous Green Bit is! Meanwhile, on the Sunny, the four who remained to watch the ship get a fright as they discover - they aren't alone!

15-636.title: A Super Rookie! Bartolomeo the Cannibal!
15-636.overview: The battle heats up and the widely despised Bartolomeo takes the ring! But he'll have to contend with both the Prodence Kingdom contingent, and Dressrosa's own local favorite, Bellamy! Meanwhile, watching the battle for Block B from up above, Luffy risks having his cover blown!

15-637.title: Big Names Duke It Out! The Heated Block B Battle!
15-637.overview: Don Chinjao continues to provoke Luffy, hoping to gain revenge against the grandson of his sworn enemy, Garp! But as the argument continues, Luffy risks having his cover blown, and his identity revealed! Meanwhile, the battle in Block B rages as mighty competitors - some favorites of the Colosseum, and other faceless unknowns rising through the ranks - continue to clamor for the chance to move on to the next round!

15-638.title: A Deadly Blow! The Astonishing King Punch!
15-638.overview: The battle for Block B hits a crescendo as King Elizabello II prepares his devastating King Punch! But as the powerful attack becomes imminent, the Prodence Kingdom faction unravels! All that may be pointless, though, as the king's powerful attack will take out all the competitors - or will it?

15-639.title: The Fishing Fish Strike! Across the Deadly Iron Bridge!
15-639.overview: As the handover team approaches Green Bit, they are attacked by the fearsome fish that live off the coast of Dressrosa. But that's the least of their problems as they find the bridge to Green Bit has collapsed!
