1-9.overview: Anslo Garrick, the newest person on the blacklist, tries to capture Red; Liz is caught in an elevator.

1-10.title: Anslo Garrick (2)
1-10.overview: Liz infiltrates the blacksite and disarms the signal jammers to call in backup but runs into trouble along the way. The fate of Ressler hangs in the balance as Red tries to bargain with Anslo Garrick. Meanwhile, Tom becomes increasingly worried about Liz’ situation and the fate of Red is unknown.

1-11.title: The Good Samaritan
1-11.overview: A serial killer from Liz's past strikes again while Red hunts for whoever betrayed him.

1-12.title: The Alchemist
1-12.overview: Red informs the team that "The Alchemist" - a man who relies upon science to transform a person’s DNA - has been contracted to protect a well-known mob informant and his wife. As the team goes undercover to catch him, Liz finds herself on the hunt for an unlikely couple. Meanwhile Liz and Tom find themselves at another bump in their relationship and Ressler debates whether or not he should give his ex-girlfriend his blessing.

1-13.title: The Cyprus Agency
1-13.overview: After a recent spate of abductions of babies from their mothers, Red informs Liz that the "Cyprus Agency" is the illegal adoption organization responsible. Coincidentally, Liz and Tom contemplate adoption of their own which fuels Liz to track down the organizations CEO, Owen Mallory.

1-14.title: Madeline Pratt
1-14.overview: Liz helps Tom adjust to the impending adoption; Red reveals a woman from his past is a target; Red convinces Liz to pull of a heist at the Syrian Embassy.

1-15.title: The Judge
1-15.overview: Red believes he knows who was responsible for a prominent prosecutor's 12 year disappearance; Red investigates the woman who tempts Tom.

1-16.title: Mako Tanida
1-16.overview: One of Red's former associates, a crime lord, becomes the next target; Tom decides to confront Jolene.

1-17.title: Ivan
1-17.overview: After a cyber defense asset is stolen by a terrorist only known as Ivan, Red and Liz discover a cover-up; new evidence regarding Jolene's disappearance unravels some of the mystery surrounding Tom.

1-18.title: Milton Bobbit
1-18.overview: Red and the team search for a life insurance claim adjuster who talks people into becoming contract killers; Liz and Red try to uncover Tom's secrets.

1-19.title: The Pavlovich Brothers
1-19.overview: As the team tries to protect a target of the Pavlovich brothers -- specialists in abductions -- Red has a job of his own for the duo; Liz patiently pursues the truth about Tom.

1-20.title: The Kingmaker
1-20.overview: Red thinks the Kingmaker (Linus Roache), a strategist, is responsible when a politician in Prague is framed for murder; Liz uncovers a secret Red has been hiding.

1-21.title: Berlin (1)
1-21.overview: After discovering the truth behind her father's death, Liz refuses to work with Red, just as his situation grows desperate.

1-22.title: Berlin: Conclusion (2)
1-22.overview: Liz is forced to reunite with Red in order to track down Berlin.

2-1.title: Lord Baltimore
2-1.overview: While continuing to battle Berlin, Red faces a new threat in the form of Lord Baltimore. A figure from Red's past returns. Liz tries to move on after her showdown with Tom.

2-2.title: Monarch Douglas Bank
2-2.overview: A robbery provides Red with an opportunity to take down a questionable bank. Liz questions Red's intentions during the course of her investigation. An impressive addition is made to Cooper's team.

2-3.title: Dr. James Covington
2-3.overview: When a body is found missing a heart, Liz and Ressler join forces with Samar Navabi to investigate Dr. Covington's operation. Red and an associate try to take advantage of an opportunity in Indonesia.

2-4.title: Dr. Linus Creel
2-4.overview: Red thinks a dangerous sociopsychological experiment may be taking place when several previously nonviolent citizens become killers. Red has a complicated proposition for Naomi and her husband.

2-5.title: The Front
2-5.overview: The team targets an eco-terrorist cell seeking a deadly weapon. Liz attempts to lose her guardian. Red resorts to manipulation to pursue a special someone.

2-6.title: The Mombasa Cartel
2-6.overview: Liz asks Red for information about deadly wildlife poachers after a mutilated corpse washes ashore. Ressler forms a dangerous habit.

2-7.title: The Scimitar
2-7.overview: A plot for revenge emerges after an Iranian nuclear scientist is assassinated. Liz and Ressler wind up in a predicament.

2-8.title: The Decembrist
2-8.overview: Red's plans for Berlin take a sudden turn after he finds out that he was manipulated by the latest Blacklister to avenge Red.

2-9.title: Luther Braxton (1)
2-9.overview: When Red is arrested and taken to a secret detention facility, Liz and the task force set out to save him before he disappears forever. At the facility, Red encounters a thief with whom he shares a complicated history.

2-10.title: Luther Braxton: Conclusion (2)
2-10.overview: As chaos ensues at the Factory, leaving the fate of Red and the task force unknown, Cooper struggles to rescue his team from the detention facility. It’s a race against time to prevent Luther Braxton attaining confidential information.

2-11.title: Ruslan Denisov
2-11.overview: When an undercover CIA agent is kidnapped by a band of separatists in Uzbekistan, the task force sets a rescue mission in motion. Red informs Liz and Ressler that they are up against a very dangerous former associate.

2-12.title: The Kenyon Family
2-12.overview: When Red tips Liz off about the disappearance of a polygamous cult leader with dangerous shipping containers buried on his property, the task force sets out to investigate. Red utilizes his sources to appease Fitch’s last words and tries to track down his hidden safe.

2-13.title: The Deer Hunter
2-13.overview: Red helps Liz and the task force find a killer -- the Deer Hunter -- who tracks victims like prey.

2-14.title: T. Earl King VI
2-14.overview: A former paramour involves Reddington in a deadly game with a wealthy, powerful family dynasty whose ill-begotten fortune was amassed from an underground auction of human and material contraband. Meanwhile, Tom takes on a new mission.

2-15.title: The Major
2-15.overview: When Agent Keen is questioned in court as a suspect in the murder of the DC Harbormaster, her unusual relationship with Red and their task force falls under scrutiny. Meanwhile, Red enlists Cooper and Ressler to locate "The Major," a dangerous former associate who is key in keeping Liz out of prison.

2-16.title: Tom Keen
2-16.overview: Evidence mounts against Liz in a murder case, triggering Red and Ressler's efforts to clear her name by tracking down the recently vanished Tom Keen.

2-17.title: The Longevity Initiative
2-17.overview: The task force tracks a scientist who abducts disabled patients to conduct experiments on immortality. Now back in Washington, DC, Tom scrambles to save himself from new enemies.

2-18.title: Vanessa Cruz
2-18.overview: The task force tracks a provocative female Blacklister, a frame-up artist who targets the wealthy elite. Tom pleads for Liz's help. Red pressures Liz for the Fulcrum, claiming it's now a matter of life and death.

2-19.title: Leonard Caul
2-19.overview: Red fights for his life while the task force races to track down a mysterious figure from his past while Tom provides help in an unexpected way.

2-20.title: Quon Zhang
2-20.overview: After decoding the information that is embedded in The Fulcrum, Red is determined to stop the imminent threat. Meanwhile, the task force discovers that deceased bodies of Chinese-American women are being smuggled out of the country under false identities. Liz continues to search for answers about her past after discovering a picture hidden in Red's secret flat.

2-21.title: Karakurt
2-21.overview: Following intel from Red, the FBI find themselves one-step behind the most dangerous Russian Assassin, Karakurt, an enemy on U.S. soil. To avoid catastrophe, Liz and Ressler meet with Russian Counter-Intelligence who offer insight not only on Karakurt, but also on the identity of Liz’s mother. Cooper finds himself in a compromising position.

2-22.title: Tom Connolly
2-22.overview: Liz realizes she is being framed by The Cabal forcing Red to use his connections to help her clear her name. As Cooper receives shocking news, Ressler, Samar, and Aram must decide who on the task force can still be trusted.

3-1.title: The Troll Farmer
3-1.overview: With the FBI hunting Liz for the murder of the attorney general, she and Red go on the run. Red reaches out to a contact for help fleeing the city.

3-2.title: Marvin Gerard
3-2.overview: With Ressler in hot pursuit, Liz only has Red to trust; Red asks a lawyer named Marvin Gerard for help with a hostage situation. The FBI wants to force Cooper out of the task force.

3-3.title: Eli Matchett
3-3.overview: Liz and Red take a detour to the Midwest. Ressler, Aram and Samar accidentally uncover what could turn into a global food crisis. Cooper seeks help from an unexpected source.

3-4.title: The Djinn
3-4.overview: Red enlists a task force to locate the Djinn, an enigmatic woman who fulfills revenge fantasies. Red and Liz believe the Djinn can lead them to the Cabal and help them exonerate Liz.

3-5.title: Arioch Cain
3-5.overview: Red and the FBI come together to protect Liz when a huge reward for her capture attracts attention from assassins.

3-6.title: Sir Crispin Crandall
3-6.overview: Red and Liz catch wind that Andras Halmi, a trusted advisor of The Director, has gone missing. In pursuit of Halmi, Red and Liz narrowly escape a violent confrontation. Meanwhile, Tom ends up in a brutal "Fight Club" to find the one man he thinks will be able to exonerate Liz.

3-7.title: Zal Bin Hasaan
3-7.overview: A family tragedy in Samar's past resurfaces when the Task Force hunt for an elusive international terrorist. The FBI and the Cabal gain significant ground in their search for Liz and Red. Meanwhile, Tom encounters complications in his plan to exonerate Liz.

3-8.title: Kings of the Highway
3-8.overview: Red and Liz are unexpectedly separated from each other when Red falls into a dangerous situation. Samar makes a risky decision to help Liz while Tom and Cooper continue on their expedition to exonerate Liz.

3-9.title: The Director (1)
3-9.overview: Liz awaits trial as Red and Aram take risky measures to protect her.

3-10.title: The Director: Conclusion (2)
3-10.overview: The Cabal prepares to assassinate Liz, triggering Red's call to the task force to outmaneuver the Cabal in a bid to exonerate her. Red delivers a final ultimatum.

3-11.title: Mr. Gregory Devry
3-11.overview: With her name finally cleared, Liz attempts to reclaim her former life. Red works with the task force to infiltrate an assembly of high-level criminals at large in a rare, risky opportunity to capture the heads of the world's most lethal organized crime syndicates.

3-12.title: The Vehm
3-12.overview: When an associate of Red's is killed with a rare medieval device, Red realizes a lethal vigilante group from the Middle Ages has been resurrected; Liz considers her next move after receiving shocking news.

3-13.title: Alistair Pitt
3-13.overview: Red and Liz work with the taskforce to stop a negotiator who has resurfaced to unite two rival crime families. Tom reconnects with a former flame.

3-14.title: Lady Ambrosia
3-14.overview: After a missing child that has been presumed dead turns up alive, Red and Liz work with the taskforce to search for a dangerous woman who may be kidnapping children. Meanwhile, Tom faces shocking consequences after his plan to help Liz goes awry.

3-15.title: Drexel
3-15.overview: After the founder of a successful internet start-up is found dead, Red recognizes the crime scene as the work of a notorious killer. Liz and the task force work with Red to track the murderer through a dangerous underground news source. Meanwhile, Tom faces a life threatening situation, while Liz considers options for her baby.

3-16.title: The Caretaker
3-16.overview: After a State Department official is found dead in Beijing, Red and Liz link the murder to a secret keeper known as "The Caretaker," who maintains an impenetrable safety deposit vault for criminals. Red and Liz work with the task force to find the Caretaker and his collection of lethal and classified secrets. Meanwhile, Tom makes a risky decision, while Liz persists on her quest to find out more about her mother.

3-17.title: Mr. Solomon (1)
3-17.overview: After Red learns that a tactical nuclear weapon is being targeted by thieves, it's a race against the clock as the task force struggles to stop them -- and prevent an imminent nuclear disaster. Meanwhile, Tom and Liz make a decision that will change their relationship forever.

3-18.title: Mr. Solomon: Conclusion (2)
3-18.overview: A team member falls into grave danger due to a tragedy, leading the task force to rely on Red and his unorthodox methods. Meanwhile, an unforeseen complication impacts Tom and Liz.

3-19.title: Cape May
3-19.overview: When a mysterious woman running from unknown assailants accidentally crosses paths with Reddington, he assists her in fighting her attackers.

3-20.title: The Artax Network
3-20.overview: After an unexpected loss devastates the FBI task force, they must track down their assailants; a mysterious group whose agents operate using a worldwide satellite network. Meanwhile, Reddington is forced to confront a ghost from his past -- one who knows many of Red's secrets.

3-21.title: Susan Hargrave
3-21.overview: When Reddington links an elegant, powerful and extremely dangerous woman to the recent tragic events, the task force is forced to play a deadly cat and mouse game to stop her before she strikes again.

3-22.title: Alexander Kirk (1)
3-22.overview: The FBI task force's hunt for revenge nears its endgame. As Reddington and the team close in on the mysterious arch-criminal responsible for recent tragic events, they're forced to operate outside their comfort zone – and outside the law – in order to take down their enemy once and for all.

3-23.title: Alexander Kirk: Conclusion (2)
3-23.overview: As Reddington and the task force close in on the person responsible for Liz's death, a shocking betrayal leaves them racing to save one of their own.

4-1.title: Esteban
4-1.overview: After Liz is abducted by a man claiming to be her father, Red sets out to find her at any cost.  Meanwhile, the Task Force grapples with the shocking news that Liz is still alive.

4-2.title: Mato
4-2.overview: Red enlists Tom and the Task Force to help track a notorious bounty hunter who may know Alexander Kirk's next move. Meanwhile, Liz struggles to decide if Kirk is trustworthy.

4-3.title: Miles McGrath
4-3.overview: Red and the Task Force take extreme measures to hunt down one of Alexander Kirk's allies, Miles McGrath, a "criminal incubator" who finances crimes for profit. Meanwhile, Liz learns more about her family.

4-4.title: Gaia
4-4.overview: As Red sets Liz and the Task Force on the trail of an eco-terrorist with a mysterious connection to Alexander Kirk, Tom takes matters into his own hands.

4-5.title: The Lindquist Concern
4-5.overview: Liz's loyalties are tested as Red takes action on an operation to intercept Alexander Kirk. Meanwhile the Task Force races to find a killer who targets inventors of revolutionary technology.

4-6.title: The Thrushes
4-6.overview: When Alexander Kirk contracts a mysterious group that specializes in hacking the world's most secure computer systems, Red and Liz see an opportunity to make a move on Kirk's organization.

4-7.title: Dr. Adrian Shaw (1)
4-7.overview: Red directs the Task Force to track down an individual who provides new identities to criminals on the run. Meanwhile, as Alexander Kirk's medical condition worsens, Liz seeks guidance from Cooper on a crucial decision.

4-8.title: Dr. Adrian Shaw: Conclusion (2)
4-8.overview: Red pressures Dr. Shaw to locate a former patient. Liz contemplates the implications of her ties to an increasingly desperate and dangerous Alexander Kirk. Mr. Kaplan comes to a critical realization about her future.

4-9.title: Lipet's Seafood Company
4-9.overview: An investigation into an international terrorist operating on American soil tests the allegiances of the Task Force. As Aram faces the consequences of his girlfriend hacking into the FBI computer systems, Red cashes in on a favor.

4-10.title: The Forecaster
4-10.overview: A new case arrives at Liz's doorstep, where someone has left a diorama depicting a crime soon to be committed. Meanwhile, Red explores a new business opportunity.

4-11.title: The Harem
4-11.overview: Liz must prove herself to the leader of an elite group of female thieves in order to infiltrate their organization as they prepare for their next heist. Meanwhile, Red contends with unexpected problems in his operations, and Tom channels his energy into fatherly duties.

4-12.title: Natalie Luca
4-12.overview: After discovering his criminal empire is under attack, Red turns to the task force for help, leading the team to hunt an assassin who kills her victims by infecting them with a lethal disease. Meanwhile, Red enlists Tom in an undercover operation.

4-13.title: Isabella Stone
4-13.overview: As another member of Red's team is targeted, the task force races to stop the sophisticated criminal who has been attacking Red and his businesses. Meanwhile, a shocking event sends Tom on the hunt for information about his past.

4-14.title: The Architect
4-14.overview: Aram goes under cover as a hacker to find a criminal who designs and executes crimes for a price.

4-15.title: The Apothecary
4-15.overview: After being dosed with poison, Red must retrace his steps to discover which of his closest allies has betrayed him, while the task force races against the clock to find an antidote that will save him.

4-16.title: Dembe Zuma
4-16.overview: After weeks of hunting for Dembe, Red and the Task Force finally get a lead on his whereabouts when Aram goes missing. Meanwhile, Dembe takes a calculated risk as Red closes in.

4-17.title: Requiem
4-17.overview: Memories of the past set Red on a dangerous collision course with an enemy determined to destroy his criminal empire.

4-18.title: Philomena
4-18.overview: The Task Force chases an artful bounty hunter employed to target Red's closest associates. Meanwhile, Ressler faces a moral dilemma when he takes on a new assignment with a former colleague.

4-19.title: Dr. Bogdan Krilov
4-19.overview: Red sets the Task Force on the trail of a Blacklister with the tools to manipulate memories, causing Liz to question her own experiences. As Gale intensifies his investigation, Ressler receives a new lead on the disappearance of Justice Department official Reven Wright.

4-20.title: The Debt Collector
4-20.overview: When Liz becomes the target of a mercenary known as the Debt Collector, Red turns to an unlikely source for help. Meanwhile, Ressler faces an unexpected complication in his efforts to stay ahead of Agent Gale's investigation.

4-21.title: Mr. Kaplan (1)
4-21.overview: Red tracks a high-end thief enlisted by Mr. Kaplan for a mysterious assignment. Aram faces a tough decision when agent Gale goes to extreme measures in his investigation into the Task Force's conduct.

4-22.title: Mr. Kaplan: Conclusion (2)
4-22.overview: Red sets a dangerous plan in motion to save himself and the Task Force as Kaplan engages in the final phase of her assault on his criminal empire. With the future of the Task Force in jeopardy, Liz confronts the biggest questions about her past.

5-1.title: Smokey Putnum
5-1.overview: With his criminal empire in ruins, Red enlists Liz in a plan to earn cash and deliver a new Blacklister to the Task Force.

5-2.title: Greyson Blaise
5-2.overview: Liz and the Task Force join Red on an international adventure in pursuit of a billionaire who moonlights as a high end art thief. Meanwhile, Dembe chases a lead and Tom seeks outside help in identifying the remains in the suitcase.

5-3.title: Miss Rebecca Thrall
5-3.overview: While the Task Force investigates a series of suspicious police shootings, Agent Ressler is distracted by increasing external pressures. With his back up against the wall, Red drafts Tom in executing an elaborate plan to help re-establish his criminal reputation.

5-4.title: The Endling
5-4.overview: Liz and the Task Force hunt for an elusive criminal who will stop at nothing to destroy some of the world's most precious treasures. Meanwhile, a surprise encounter leads a cash-strapped Red toward a new business opportunity, and Tom takes action to investigate the bones in the suitcase.

5-5.title: Ilyas Surkov
5-5.overview: When Red provides exclusive intel on an international terrorist, it puts Liz and the Task Force on a collision course with a rival unit from the CIA. Meanwhile, Red and Hawkins lay the groundwork for their new business venture, and Tom goes undercover in search of information.

5-6.title: The Travel Agency
5-6.overview: While Cooper enlists Red on a case of personal importance, Ressler leads the Task Force on a mission to stop the resurgence of once-dormant murder-for-hire ring. Determined to find answers, Tom disregards a warning to halt his investigation into the suitcase.

5-7.title: The Kilgannon Corporation
5-7.overview: Red and the Task Force place Dembe undercover to infiltrate an international human smuggling organization, but when communication is lost, they must intervene. Meanwhile, Tom's investigation into the suitcase lands him in grave danger.

5-8.title: Ian Garvey
5-8.overview: Tom goes missing and Liz desperately retraces his steps to find him. Red's hunt for the suitcase of bones leads to lives being changed forever.

5-9.title: Ruin
5-9.overview: Liz abandons her old life and seeks out a fresh start in a place where no one knows her history, her name, or the depths of her grief. When an unexpected threat finds her, she is forced to draw on her emotional and physical strength in a brutal fight for survival.

5-10.title: The Informant
5-10.overview: When Red directs the Task Force to find a Blacklister who uses his position of power to sell sensitive information, Ressler finds himself at risk of exposure. Meanwhile, Liz plans her next move.

5-11.title: Abraham Stern
5-11.overview: When Red goes on the hunt for a legendary treasure, he draws the attention of Abraham Stern, a cunning manipulator who has devoted his life - and the lives of many innocents - to recovering the fortune that is his birthright. Meanwhile, Liz's quest sends her down a dark path, leading her to study the methods of one of the Blacklist's most dangerous criminals.

5-12.title: The Cook
5-12.overview: As Liz works with Red to hunt for Tom's killers, she begins to question his motives. The Task Force enlists the help of one arsonist to catch another.

5-13.title: The Invisible Hand
5-13.overview: When bodies are discovered in abandoned woods, Red points the Task Force toward The Invisible Hand, a group that targets those whose actions are morally reprehensible yet fully legal. Meanwhile, Red steps in to assist one of his employees, and Liz discovers a major clue about Tom's investigation.

5-14.title: Mr. Raleigh Sinclair III
5-14.overview: Red assists the Task Force in tracking a mysterious Blacklister who carefully develops airtight alibis for murderous clients. Meanwhile, Liz's reinstatement at the FBI hinges on an evaluation with a psychotherapist.

5-15.title: Pattie Sue Edwards
5-15.overview: As Liz continues tracking Tom's killers, Red tries to solve a tax issue in his money laundering. Meanwhile, Aram goes out to the field when the Task Force investigates a viral outbreak.

5-16.title: The Capricorn Killer
5-16.overview: As Liz investigates new details in a cold case from her early work as an FBI profiler, she explores her darker impulses in therapy with Dr. Fulton. The Task Force takes action to bring down Tom's killers within the legal system, while Red takes a different approach to closing in on Ian Garvey.

5-17.title: Anna-Gracia Duerte
5-17.overview: When an associate of the Nash Syndicate is murdered, Red sets Liz and the Task Force on the case in order to recover evidence crucial to bringing down Ian Garvey. Meanwhile, Aram considers a step forward in his relationship with Samar.

5-18.title: Zarak Mosadek
5-18.overview: In an attempt to apply pressure to Ian Garvey, Red and the Task Force head to Paris to track down a prominent heroin supplier for the Nash Syndicate. Distrustful of Red's agenda, Liz takes her own path in going after Garvey.

5-19.title: Ian Garvey: Conclusion
5-19.overview: Liz uses intel from an unexpected source to force Red to uncover the secrets he holds. Red initiates a plan to retrieve the duffel bag of bones.

5-20.title: Nicholas T. Moore
5-20.overview: An unidentified young girl reappears and the team tries to find her connection to the secret Red is hiding. When her family steps in to protect their own secrets, the investigation turns into a race to save the girl's life.

5-21.title: Lawrence Dane Devlin
5-21.overview: Samar lands in the crosshairs of an unconventional Blacklister, and Aram and the task force spring into action to find her before it's too late. Red journeys to Costa Rica to prevent the duffel bag of bones from being sold at an underground auction.

5-22.title: Sutton Ross
5-22.overview: Liz and Red face off in a climactic race to find a Blacklister in possession of the duffel bag of bones, forcing the truth about the bones to finally come to light.

6-1.title: Dr. Hans Koehler
6-1.overview: Red presents the Task Force with a Blacklist case searching for a plastic surgeon who creates new identities for wanted criminals. Liz and her sister, Jennifer, secretly investigate the events that took place the night the real Raymond Reddington died.

6-2.title: The Corsican
6-2.overview: As Liz and the Task Force race to stop an imminent bombing by an elusive Blacklister, Red has an encounter that will change the trajectory of his life forever.

6-3.title: The Pharmacist
6-3.overview: While Liz and the Task Force track a notorious underground biohacker, Red initiates a strategy to extricate himself from a problematic position. Meanwhile, Cooper's integrity is tested with a difficult choice.

6-4.title: The Pawnbrokers
6-4.overview: Red acclimates to his new surroundings in federal prison, where he is challenged by an old rival. Samar goes undercover to stop a black market organization that fronts cash to criminals. Meanwhile, Liz and Jennifer continue their investigation into Red's past.

6-5.title: Alter Ego
6-5.overview: While Red argues in court to uphold the validity of his immunity agreement, Liz and the Task Force question a man whose recent inheritance seems too good to be true and Dembe offers Red some advice.

6-6.title: The Ethicist
6-6.overview: When Red is sent to a federal medical institution following his request to the court for a psychiatric evaluation, Liz and Jennifer use his time away to search for a Blacklister they believe may have valuable information about Red's past.

6-7.title: General Shiro
6-7.overview: While Red and Dembe enlist Glen's help in stacking the jury to Red's advantage for his upcoming trial, the task force investigates a series of mysterious deaths resulting from weaponized insects.

6-8.title: Marko Jankowics
6-8.overview: Liz and Jennifer's pursuit of a lead on the truth about Reddington puts them in unexpected danger. Red steps in to help mediate a brewing prison gang war.

6-9.title: Minister D
6-9.overview: As his trial begins, Red puts Liz and the task force on the case of a Blacklister who uses incriminating evidence to extort people -- and who Red believes can prove his innocence.

6-10.title: The Cryptobanker
6-10.overview: The Task Force delves into the unregulated world of cryptocurrency in order to stop an impending attack, while Red undertakes a risky endeavor in order to secure his freedom.

6-11.title: Bastien Moreau (1)
6-11.overview: Liz and the task force make a play to uncover the truth about an international assassination in a last-ditch effort to save Red's life.

6-12.title: Bastien Moreau: Conclusion (2)
6-12.overview: Cooper puts his reputation on the line to appeal to the White House on Red's behalf, as Liz and the task force resume their search for The Corsican, a Blacklister with ties to an international conspiracy. Samar's abilities in the field are tested.

6-13.title: Robert Vesco
6-13.overview: Red and the task force hunt for legendary fugitive Robert Vesco, one of history's most notorious con men. Samar makes a life-changing decision.

6-14.title: The Osterman Umbrella Company
6-14.overview: Red directs Liz to investigate a secret organization of assassins hired by global intelligence agencies to eliminate former agents, a case with ramifications that will change the task force forever.

6-15.title: Olivia Olson
6-15.overview: The Task Force searches for a woman who specializes in hostile takeovers of criminal organizations, and may have intelligence connected to an international conspiracy involving presidential advisor Anna McMahon. Meanwhile, Aram enacts a daring plan to gain leverage over Red.

6-16.title: Lady Luck
6-16.overview: Liz and Ressler investigate a Blacklister who offers to erase gambling debts -- at a deceptively high price. Dembe grows concerned as Red tests loyalties of their business associates in search of the individual who turned him in to the police.

6-17.title: The Third Estate
6-17.overview: Red and the task force spring into action to stop an anti-capitalist terrorist group from kidnapping and torturing the children of the one percent. Ressler goes behind Liz's back to find out what happened to her mother, Katarina Rostova.

6-18.title: The Brockton College Killer
6-18.overview: The task force is drawn into the investigation of an old case that has gained notoriety due to a popular true crime podcast. Red visits Dom Wilkinson for help making a difficult decision. Ressler makes a discovery about Katarina Rostova's past.

6-19.title: Rassvet
6-19.overview: Alone in a foreign country after a mission goes catastrophically wrong, Katarina Rostova goes on the run to avoid the forces trying to hunt her down.

6-20.title: Guillermo Rizal
6-20.overview: When multiple children are abducted under similar circumstances, the Task Force rushes to find the kidnapper. Meanwhile, Red goes on the hunt for a man who can find anything, while Liz considers a big change.

6-21.title: Anna McMahon
6-21.overview: Presidential adviser Anna McMahon faces off with Cooper and the task force in a winner-takes-all race to locate the missing dossier containing details of a conspiracy against America.

6-22.title: Robert Diaz
6-22.overview: As the president's true plan comes into focus, Liz and the task force fight to avert disaster. Red meets in secret with a man who holds information about his past.

7-1.title: Louis T. Steinhil (1)
7-1.overview: After being abducted by Katarina Rostova, Raymond "Red" Reddington finds himself alone in hostile territory unsure of who, if anyone, he can trust. With few leads to go on, Liz and the Task Force venture into unknown danger as they race to find him.

7-2.title: Louis T. Steinhil: Conclusion (2)
7-2.overview: Liz, Dembe and the Task Force continue to search for Red. Red attempts to escape his abductors with help from a surprise ally, but discovers he is not Katarina Rostova's only target in her hunt for information.

7-3.title: Les Fleurs du Mal
7-3.overview: Aram goes undercover to infiltrate a secret society of wealthy thrill-seekers, whose entertainment hinges upon spectacular acts of violence. Meanwhile, Red tries to negotiate with a former associate involved in the Townsend Directive, while Katarina Rostova takes steps to insinuate herself into Liz's life.

7-4.title: Kuwait
7-4.overview: Cooper's moral compass is tested when an officer whom he served with as young man, long presumed to be dead, resurfaces as a POW.

7-5.title: Norman Devane
7-5.overview: Liz and the Task Force investigate an infamous assassin who has a long history of weaponizing diseases, but has now turned to even more insidious activities. Meanwhile, Red and Dembe travel to Cuba in search of a lead, and Aram considers a new relationship.

7-6.title: Dr. Lewis Powell
7-6.overview: Red alerts the FBI to the suspicious death of a scientist specializing in artificial intelligence research. Meanwhile, Francesca Campbell further entangles herself in Red's criminal activities

7-7.title: Hannah Hayes
7-7.overview: The Task Force investigates the unexplained disappearance and sudden re-emergence of a governor. Meanwhile, Red and Dembe surveil someone close to Katarina Rostova, as she inadvertently involves Agnes in an operation of her own.

7-8.title: The Hawaladar
7-8.overview: Desperate for information about the whereabouts of a longtime friend, Red directs the Task Force to find a blacklister who specializes in untraceable money transfers. Meanwhile, Liz receives some disturbing news from her daughter Agnes.

7-9.title: Orion Relocation Services
7-9.overview: Red and Liz investigate Orion Relocation Services, an organization that surreptitiously facilitates the disappearance and relocation of criminals. Meanwhile, Katarina delves into the memories of an old friend in order to get additional information about the Townsend Directive.

7-10.title: Katarina Rostova
7-10.overview: Red and the Task Force pay a visit to a former blacklister, as an explosive confrontation leads Liz to make a critical choice

7-11.title: Victoria Fenberg
7-11.overview: With the help of the Task Force, Red tracks a gifted art forger who has thwarted his plans to sell stolen pieces. Aram’s love life becomes increasingly complicated. Liz and Ressler confide in each other.

7-12.title: Cornelius Ruck
7-12.overview: Secluded on a private island, Red reunites with an old flame and a ring of thieves in a plot to make millions off stolen art. Plans are quickly derailed, however, when guests on the island mysteriously show up dead.

7-13.title: Newton Purcell
7-13.overview: The Task Force investigates a series of attacks on data centers perpetrated by a blacklister with a peculiar condition, as Liz conducts a secret investigation on the side. Meanwhile, Glen desperately tries to prove his value to Red after a shipping mishap.

7-14.title: Twamie Ullulaq
7-14.overview: A Blacklist case becomes personal for Agent Park when the team investigates a mysterious disappearance in the Alaska Triangle. Meanwhile, Aram enlists Red’s help to find out what really happened to Elodie’s husband.

7-15.title: Gordon Kemp
7-15.overview: A blacklist case forces Liz to choose sides between Red and the Task Force. Meanwhile, Red tries to calm a panicked Ilya Koslov, who believes he is under surveillance.

7-16.title: Nyle Hatcher
7-16.overview: Liz and the Task Force take on a cold case that may have some new victims. Meanwhile, Red tries to help a friend of Dembe who is in danger.

7-17.title: Brothers
7-17.overview: Ressler is forced to confront past trauma and family secrets when his brother takes him back home for a risky job.

7-18.title: Roy Cain
7-18.overview: As the Task Force investigates a kidnapping executed by seemingly impossible abductors, Dembe lands in a perilous situation. Meanwhile, a recent health scare causes Red to think about a successor.

7-19.title: The Kazanjian Brothers
7-19.overview: The Task Force investigates an accountant who works for lucrative criminals in order to find the violent and thuggish brothers hired for his protection. Meanwhile, Liz must make a momentous decision.

8-1.title: Roanoke
8-1.overview: Red directs the task force to investigate Roanoke, a legendary criminal who orchestrates elaborate extractions. Meanwhile, Liz works to hatch a secret plan with her mother, Katarina Rostova.

8-2.title: Katarina Rostova: Conclusion
8-2.overview: As Liz pushes a source for answers, Red and the task force grapple with the implications of her actions. Tensions boil over and a drastic action is taken, which will change Red and Liz's relationship forever.

8-3.title: 16 Ounces
8-3.overview: Fueled by his betrayal, Elizabeth Keen seeks vengeance on Reddington.

8-4.title: Elizabeth Keen
8-4.overview: As Red and the task force search for Liz, she sets a new plan in motion that has catastrophic consequences.

8-5.title: The Fribourg Confidence
8-5.overview: The task force investigates an organization of bank robbers with a special expertise in stealing from other criminals. An old blacklist case resurfaces.

8-6.title: The Wellstone Agency
8-6.overview: Red and Dembe go to great lengths to fulfill the final wishes of a dear friend. Aram goes undercover as an interpreter to a company that provides services to criminals, while Park helps a friend in trouble.

8-7.title: Chemical Mary
8-7.overview: The task force must race to stop simultaneous danger presented by two blacklisters. Cooper approaches a congressman for intel.

8-8.title: Ogden Greeley
8-8.overview: The task force investigates the apparent disappearance of a defense contractor. Cooper receives an unexpected offer and Red makes a connection.

8-9.title: The Cyranoid
8-9.overview: The task force is thrown for a loop when they encounter a nefarious enterprise that provides doppelgängers for criminals. Red scrambles to counteract a bold move by Liz.

8-10.title: Dr. Laken Perillos
8-10.overview: Red and Dembe land in peril when Townsend deploys a torture specialist who uses unorthodox methods to interrogate her victims.

8-11.title: Captain Kidd
8-11.overview: The task force attempts to stop an abduction by searching for a "treasure man" who uses geocaching to hide illicit goods and facilitate transactions between otherwise warring criminal factions.

8-12.title: Rakitin
8-12.overview: The task force's determination to identify a Russian asset in the U.S. government puts Cooper and Reddington in increasingly treacherous positions.

8-13.title: Anne
8-13.overview: Red enjoys a quiet visit with a friend at her home in rural America.

8-14.title: Misère
8-14.overview: In a retrospective look at key turning points, steps are retraced that lead Elizabeth Keen to align with a powerful enemy.

8-15.title: The Russian Knot
8-15.overview: The Task Force hatches a plan to steal a Soviet-era cipher machine needed to decrypt coded messages. Townsend puts Liz's loyalty to the test. Red and Dembe are called to an unexpected meeting.

8-16.title: Nicholas Obenrader
8-16.overview: Liz and the Task Force track new leads in their investigation of N-13, while Red takes steps to infiltrate Townsend's criminal organization.

8-17.title: Ivan Stepanov
8-17.overview: Red tries desperately to rescue an old friend at all costs, while Liz and Townsend conduct an interrogation.

8-18.title: The Protean
8-18.overview: The Task Force springs into action to stop an elusive assassin on Liz's trail.

8-19.title: Balthazar "Bino" Baker
8-19.overview: Hoping to move some precious cargo quietly, Red enlists the assistance of an enforcer who specializes in transporting items through an underground network.

8-20.title: Godwin Page
8-20.overview: Liz, Red and Dembe are forced to work together to survive an attack from Townsend. Cooper and the Task Force attempt to de-escalate the increasing danger to all.

8-21.title: Nachalo
8-21.overview: When Reddington takes Liz to the mysterious epicenter of his empire, their shared past reveals itself and long buried secrets are divulged.

8-22.title: Konets
8-22.overview: Reddington makes a disturbing request to Liz in exchange for the truth about his identity.

9-1.title: The Skinner (1)
9-1.overview: In the two years following the death of Elizabeth Keen, Raymond Reddington and the members of the FBI Task Force have disbanded with Reddington's whereabouts unknown. When one of their own is injured in the line of duty, however, the Task Force is drawn back together to bring down a conspiracy that could shatter global security.

9-2.title: The Skinner: Conclusion (2)
9-2.overview: A kidnapping poses a test for the capabilities of the Task Force as they contend with a mysterious pirating organization.

9-3.title: The SPK
9-3.overview: A new case involving stolen artifacts reunites Red with a former blacklister. Aram faces a difficult decision.

9-4.title: The Avenging Angel
9-4.overview: The Task Force races to locate a blacklister who uses any means necessary to return what has been unjustly stolen. Ressler asks Park for a favor. Cooper tries to piece together an event for which he has no memory.

9-5.title: Benjamin T. Okara
9-5.overview: Dembe's position as an FBI agent causes complications for Red as the Task Force handles a case involving military technology. Cooper and Park each find their personal lives increasingly complicated.

9-6.title: Dr. Roberta Sand, Ph.D.
9-6.overview: The Task Force investigates a therapist who may be the key to the resurgence of an organized crime family. Red conducts an investigation of his own.

9-7.title: Between Sleep and Awake
9-7.overview: In a series of flashbacks, Ressler recalls his actions in the aftermath of Elizabeth Keen's death.

9-8.title: Dr. Razmik Maier
9-8.overview: The death of a professional tennis player leads the Task Force to a doctor who may be fixing the odds for a major sports betting syndicate. Red digs deeper into Dembe's betrayal. Ressler struggles with sobriety.

9-9.title: Boukman Baptiste
9-9.overview: A spate of coordinated attacks on Red's lieutenants puts Dembe in imminent danger, prompting him to relive the events that led him to join the FBI two years earlier.

9-10.title: Arcane Wireless
9-10.overview: The task force's investigation into Arcane Wireless, an untraceable cellular network for criminals, leads to unexpected consequences. Red races against the clock to get a colleague out of trouble.

9-11.title: The Conglomerate
9-11.overview: An investigation into the Conglomerate, a group of former government-sponsored assassins, becomes complicated when the Task Force learns one of their own may have ties to the group. Red digs deeper into the events leading up to Liz's death.

9-12.title: The Chairman
9-12.overview: The Task Force pursues their latest target, the Chairman, who operates a dark web stock market trading shares of criminal organizations. Red takes extreme measures to locate a tracking device, which sends Ressler into a spiral. Cooper makes contact with his blackmailer.

9-13.title: Genuine Models, Inc.
9-13.overview: The Task Force is led to an unusual suspect when the wealthy clients of an apparent escort service start turning up dead. Red and a friend attempt to recover an item after reuniting at a friend's memorial. Cooper heads to Atlanta to follow a lead on his blackmailer.

9-14.title: Eva Mason
9-14.overview: While searching for Sen. Panabaker's missing daughter-in-law, the Task Force learns there may be a larger pattern of abductions. Red continues piecing together the mystery behind Liz's death.

9-15.title: Andrew Kennison
9-15.overview: Tensions rise when Cooper’s search for his blackmailer overlaps with the Task Force’s latest Blacklist case.

9-16.title: Helen Maghi
9-16.overview: Red chases a lead that could shed light on both Liz’s death and Cooper’s blackmailing. The Task Force experiences a major shakeup when one of their own is taken into custody.

9-17.title: El Conejo
9-17.overview: When a member of The Task Force is captured by the leader of a cartel, they turn to Red for guidance. Red investigates a seemingly impossible heist.

9-18.title: Laszlo Jankowics
9-18.overview: Red questions the whereabouts of a former associate. The Task Force hunts down a criminal dealing in illegal psychedelics.

9-19.title: The Bear Mask
9-19.overview: Feeling the weight of recent pressures, Aram turns to an unusual outlet for release.

9-20.title: Caelum Bank
9-20.overview: In an effort to reveal his true enemy, Red turns to the Task Force to help ground a flying fortress bank.

9-21.title: Marvin Gerard: Conclusion (1)
9-21.overview: Red and the Task Force spring into action after learning who betrayed them.

9-22.title: Marvin Gerard: Conclusion (2)
9-22.overview: Red and Cooper square off with conflicting endgames for their mutual traitor. A major secret about the Task Force falls into the wrong hands.

10-1.title: The Night Owl
10-1.overview: Six months after Wujing's escape from custody, Reddington mysteriously resurfaces in Manhattan amidst an explosion. When a former Blacklister is found at the scene, the Task Force begins to investigate a larger conspiracy at play.

10-2.title: The Whaler
10-2.overview: The Task Force works to infiltrate a high-stakes poker game tied to Wujing with the help of new team member Siya Malik. Red and Cooper have opposing tactics when Agnes is bullied at school.

10-3.title: The Four Guns
10-3.overview: An assassination attempt on Sen. Panabaker leads the Task Force to a group of renowned pickpockets. Red sends a dangerous gift to an old friend in custody.

10-4.title: The Hyena
10-4.overview: Red attempts to secure a late financier's fortune locked by a series of challenging clues. When a deadly assassin pursues the money, the Task Force bands together to protect the endowment's rightful heirs.

10-5.title: The Dockery Affair
10-5.overview: An investigation surrounding the murder of a judge sheds new light on an unsolved case. Red's relationship with a trusted colleague is put in a precarious position when his cooperation with the FBI is disclosed.

10-6.title: Dr. Laken Perillos: Conclusion
10-6.overview: When Dr. Laken Perillos resurfaces to join Wujing's crusade against Red, a member of The Task Force is put in danger.

10-7.title: The Freelancer (2)
10-7.overview: The return of The Freelancer unveils a conspiracy involving a local photographer. Ressler hits a personal milestone.

10-8.title: The Troll Farmer (2)
10-8.overview: The Task Force investigates a series of social media conspiracies that simulate dangerous public attacks. When a top-secret government program is stolen, the team works to uncover the Troll Farmer's involvement.

10-9.title: The Troll Farmer (3)
10-9.overview: The Task Force races against the clock to recover a valuable asset stolen from the US government. Red hatches a plan to help track down the perpetrators.

10-10.title: The Postman
10-10.overview: After an inmate opens fire at a high-security prison, the Task Force investigates a contraband smuggler known as The Postman. Cooper revisits his past ties to the suspect.

10-11.title: The Man in the Hat
10-11.overview: When Red is identified as a possible hostage during a deli robbery in Philadelphia, Dembe and Ressler take action. Back in D.C., Sen. Panabaker evaluates The Task Force's dealings with Red while Siya digs deeper into her mother's past.

10-12.title: Dr. Michael Abani
10-12.overview: Dembe reflects on his complicated past when he receives a concerning call from an old connection. An ambitious Congressman begins to question the Task Force's operations.

10-13.title: The Sicilian Error of Color
10-13.overview: While accompanying Red on a series of unusual tasks, Siya learns more about Meera's past. Congressman Hudson attempts to persuade a powerful friend to join his crusade against The Task Force.

10-14.title: The Nowhere Bride
10-14.overview: The task force investigates the whereabouts of a missing newlywed. Red offers his help to a powerful cartel leader. Siya visits a connection from her mother's past.

10-15.title: The Hat Trick
10-15.overview: In an effort to prove their worth to Congressman Hudson, Red provides the task force with three criminal cases that are deeper than they appear. Ressler helps a friend make amends.

10-16.title: Blair Foster
10-16.overview: When a corrupt lawyer is linked to a string of corporate cover-ups, Red helps the team investigate her operation. Sen. Panabaker and Cooper await a judge's decision on the fate of the task force.

10-17.title: The Morgana Logistics Corporation
10-17.overview: The Task Force encounters a ring of fraudulent companies shipping contraband around the world. Congressman Hudson's investigation escalates when he recruits help from within the FBI.

10-18.title: Wormwood
10-18.overview: Red's attempt to mediate a meeting between two rival families takes a deadly turn. When an elusive criminal is linked to the incident, the task force races against time to save Red and his associates.

10-19.title: Room 417
10-19.overview: A cryptic tip from Red leads the Task Force to uncover a security breach within the US government. Congressman Hudson takes major steps to uncover the inner workings of the Task Force.

10-20.title: Arthur Hudson
10-20.overview: Cooper is caught on the defensive when summoned by the Attorney General. Red visits dear friends.

10-21.title: Raymond Reddington (1)
10-21.overview: It's the task force versus Hudson and his agents as they chase down Red — who stays one step ahead of them. Zuma's transgression is caught on camera.

10-22.title: Raymond Reddington: Good Night (2)
10-22.overview: The future of the FBI's Reddington Task Force is decided.

269689.name: The Leftovers
269689.overview: When 2% of the world's population abruptly disappears without explanation, the world struggles to understand just what they're supposed to do about it. This is the story of the people who didn't make the cut.

0-1.title: Making The Leftovers
0-1.overview: Go behind-the-scenes of the highly anticipated HBO drama series 'The Leftovers' which follows the people left behind after a global rapture.

0-2.title: Living Reminders - The Guilty Remnant
0-2.overview: Damon Lindelof and Tom Perrotta reveal the origins of the series' most mysterious antagonists. Justin Theroux, Amy Brenneman, Liv Tyler and Ann Dowd describe the acting challenges presented by playing scenes in which characters do not speak or reveal their motives.

0-3.title: I Remember - A Season One Conversation with Damon Lindelof and Tom Perrotta
0-3.overview: In this informal, entertaining discussion, Executive Producers Damon Lindelof and Tom Perrotta share insights about the challenges of telling a complex, daring story that blends sci-fi, religion, and social commentary to tackle universal themes.

0-4.title: Beyond the Book - Season Two
0-4.overview: Damon Lindelof, Tom Perrotta, Justin Theroux and others provide a tantalizing preview of some of the twists and turns ahead in The Leftovers' Season Two.

1-1.title: Pilot
1-1.overview: Three years after millions of people – some 2% of the world’s population – vanished into thin air, residents of Mapleton, NY weigh the pros and cons of a “Heroes Day” tribute to the local “Departed.” Attempting to maintain a sense of normalcy in his strained community, police chief Kevin Garvey faces additional challenges at home with his daughter, Jill, who’s lost in a cloud of apathy with her friend Aimee, and son, Tom, who has gravitated to a cult led by the charismatic Holy Wayne. Also of concern is a silent, white-clad group of chain-smoking men and women called the Guilty Remnant, who team up in pairs to stake out people and places around town. As tension in Mapleton escalates, the lives of Laurie, an unexpected member of the Guilty Remnant, and Meg, a recently engaged young woman, converge.

1-2.title: Penguin One, Us Zero
1-2.overview: In the wake of a series of disturbing encounters, Kevin pays a visit to a therapist. Tom finds himself in a precarious situation with Christine, a favorite of Wayne’s. A frustrated Meg is asked to part with pieces of her past. Jill and Aimee tail Nora Durst, who became a local celebrity when her entire family disappeared in the Departure.

1-3.title: Two Boats and a Helicopter
1-3.overview: In the face of dwindling church attendance and threats on his life, Reverend Matt Jamison continues to preach his gospel: that many who disappeared in the Departure were sinners and not saints. Matt’s campaign is detoured when he learns he may lose the church to foreclosure, forcing him to launch a desperate, last-minute plan to come up with the cash to keep it.

1-4.title: B.J. and the A.C.
1-4.overview: A holiday display goes wanting, sending Kevin scurrying to find out who is responsible. Tom and Christine run into trouble at a hospital and on the road. Kevin retrieves a surprise detainee from a neighboring police station, and receives unexpected visitors at home. The Guilty Remnant put its stamp on the holiday season.

1-5.title: Gladys
1-5.overview: Laurie’s resolve is put to the test in the wake of a brutal hate crime. After his latest initiatives to maintain the peace in Mapleton fall short, Kevin turns down an outside offer to rid the town of its problems. Matt brings his pulpit to the street. Meg takes on a new role.

1-6.title: Guest
1-6.overview: Nora goes to New York for the second annual Departure Related Occupations and Practices (DROP) conference, but discovers that someone else has her ID badge, so she searches the convention as a "Guest," and has encounters with a salesman, an author and a rogue attendee.

1-7.title: Solace for Tired Feet
1-7.overview: After learning his father has escaped the psychiatric hospital, Kevin orders an APB to track him down. Jill attempts to break an endurance record. Holed up in Indiana, a disillusioned Tom makes an unsettling discovery.

1-8.title: Cairo
1-8.overview: Kevin fears he’s losing touch with reality after inexplicably finding himself in a difficult situation involving Patti Levin, a leader of the Guilty Remnant. Meg loses control during another encounter with Matt; Jill confronts Aimee about her relationship with Kevin; Nora stands up to Laurie, and finds her privacy invaded.

1-9.title: The Garveys at Their Best
1-9.overview: Kevin tries to suppress his bad habits while tracking down a marauding deer in Mapleton. Laurie receives not-unexpected news amidst a rising sense of foreboding. Tom connects with his past, against his better judgment. Nora has a job interview; Kevin Senior receives an honor.

1-10.title: The Prodigal Son Returns
1-10.overview: An unexpected ally helps Kevin get out of a jam near the town of Cairo. Meanwhile, an elaborate Memorial Day initiative by the Guilty Remnant plunges the town of Mapleton into chaos. Holy Wayne grants a final wish, Tom copes with his new reality. Nora makes a life-changing decision.

2-1.title: Axis Mundi
2-1.overview: Jarden, Texas was renamed “Miracle” after it was discovered that no one had departed. The town has since become a magnet for tourists and people who are convinced it is special and can keep them safe. Among the local families is the Murphys: the father, John, the mother, Erika, and their twins, Evie and Michael. While trying to protect his town from frauds and charlatans, John gets an ominous warning from a man who claims to have psychic powers. Soon afterwards, Kevin Garvey, Nora Durst and Jill Garvey show up in Miracle. This newly formed “family” left Mapleton to start over, but Kevin cannot seem to escape his past. The Murphy family and Kevin subsequently experience a mysterious event that will that change their lives forever.

2-2.title: A Matter of Geography
2-2.overview: Kevin, Nora and Jill try to pick up the pieces in the aftermath of the Mapleton riots, but problems from the past keep resurfacing. The new Garvey clan finds a fresh start in the safety of Miracle. Nora makes an impulsive choice, while Kevin gets entangled in the Murphy family’s problems.

2-3.title: Off Ramp
2-3.overview: Laurie and Tom Garvey’s work to rescue lost souls takes a toll on theirs. Laurie seeks to spread the word about the Guilty Remnant’s dangers, while Tom’s infiltration of the cult uncovers a whole new nest of problems.

2-4.title: Orange Sticker
2-4.overview: In the midst of an earthquake, Nora awakens to find Kevin missing and her hopes of safety in their new town dashed. The Murphys are left reeling after Evie’s disappearance. Kevin returns home, but without his memory of the night before or his cell phone, which would link him to the missing girls. Meanwhile, an old enemy makes her return in an unexpected way.

2-5.title: No Room at the Inn
2-5.overview: Rev. Matt Jamison takes his vegetative wife, Mary, outside Miracle to seek answers about her condition, but their lives take a dangerous detour when he is barred from returning to town. Racing to get her back into Miracle, he struggles to keep Mary safe from desperate tourists squatting just outside the town’s gates.

2-6.title: Lens
2-6.overview: Some unexpected visitors get under Nora's skin, and she becomes preoccupied with a burning question about herself. Kevin's predicament becomes impossible to ignore. Erika finds an unlikely ally and reveals some haunting secrets.

2-7.title: A Most Powerful Adversary
2-7.overview: Nora gives Kevin and Jill news they weren't expecting. Laurie makes a rash decision that affects the Garveys. Kevin deals with the fallout of Nora's news, and explores his options re: tackling his Patti problem head-on.

2-8.title: International Assassin
2-8.overview: In the wake of Kevin's desperate decision to vanquish Patti, questions and answers emerge as the world adjusts to the repercussions of what comes next.

2-9.title: Ten Thirteen
2-9.overview: A personal loss and subsequent pilgrimage to Miracle offer clues on why Meg embarked on her path as a Remnant crusader. After a fallout with Laurie, Tom seeks to reunite with Meg.

2-10.title: I Live Here Now
2-10.overview: Kevin comes clean to a skeptical John about his connection to Evie's disappearance, as Miracle faces an unexpected threat on the fourth anniversary of The Departure. Season Two Finale.

3-1.title: The Book of Kevin
3-1.overview: Three years after Miracle, Texas was overrun by the Guilty Remnant, Kevin Garvey has returned to his role as chief of police. Although he seems to have moved past the incredible events surrounding his “resurrection,” the Seventh Anniversary of the Sudden Departure is just two weeks away and many believe another apocalyptic event may come with it.

3-2.title: Don't Be Ridiculous
3-2.overview: In her official capacity as fraud investigator for the Department of Sudden Departure (D.S.D.), Nora travels to St. Louis to investigate a possible scam that involves convincing the family members of The Departed there’s a way to see their loved ones again.

3-3.title: Crazy Whitefella Thinking
3-3.overview: With the clock ticking towards the anniversary of the Departure and emboldened by a vision that is either divine prophecy or utter insanity, Kevin Garvey, Sr. wanders the Australian Outback in an effort to save the world from apocalypse.

3-4.title: G'Day Melbourne
3-4.overview: Kevin and Nora travel to Australia, where she continues to track down the masterminds of an elaborate con, while he catches a glimpse of an unexpected face from the past, forcing him to confront the traumatic events of three years earlier.

3-5.title: It's a Matt, Matt, Matt, Matt World
3-5.overview: Convinced it is Kevin’s destiny to be in Miracle for the coming seventh anniversary of the Departure, Matt Jamison impulsively heads to Australia in an effort to bring Kevin home. Unfortunately, God gets in the way.

3-6.title: Certified
3-6.overview: Laurie Garvey, a former therapist, must become one again as she heads to Australia to help Nora and Kevin along their paths.

3-7.title: The Most Powerful Man in the World (and His Identical Twin Brother)
3-7.overview: On a mission of mercy, Kevin assumes an alternate identity.

3-8.title: The Book of Nora
3-8.overview: Nothing is answered. Everything is answered. And then it ends.

270633.name: True Detective
270633.overview: An American anthology police detective series utilizing multiple timelines in which investigations seem to unearth personal and professional secrets of those involved, both within or outside the law.

0-1.title: Making True Detective
0-1.overview: HBO's making of True Detective, a crime drama centered around two Louisiana State PD detectives, and their 17-year hunt for a ritual killer, starring Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson.

0-2.title: Up Close With Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson
0-2.overview: Exclusive interviews with the heroes of the series.

0-3.title: Conversation with Nic Pizzolatto and T Bone Burnett
0-3.overview: Long discussion with the creator of the series/executive producer/screenwriter and the legendary composer about the series and the central role of music.

0-4.title: A Look Inside True Detective
0-4.overview: Interviews with Colin Farrell, Vince Vaughn, Rachel McAdams, Taylor Kitsch and Executive Producer Scott Stephens as they discuss making the new season of "True Detective".

0-5.title: Making the Vinci Massacre
0-5.overview: An exclusive and detailed 30-minute look at the production for the pivotal scene of Episode 4.

1-1.title: The Long Bright Dark
1-1.overview: Former Louisiana State CID partners Martin Hart and Rustin Cohle give separate statements to a pair of investigators about the murder of a prostitute, Dora Lange, 17 years earlier. As they look back, details of the crime, replete with occult overtones, are accompanied by insights into the detectives’ volatile partnership and personal lives.

1-2.title: Seeing Things
1-2.overview: Under pressure to land a suspect in the Lange murder, Quesada warns Hart and Cohle that they might be replaced by three detectives from a new task force. The pair lobbies for extra time to follow up on a lead that takes them from a rural cathouse to an incinerated church. With his marriage to Maggie already strained by work, Hart finds respite away from home.

1-3.title: The Locked Room
1-3.overview: A hidden image at the burned-out church leads Cohle and Hart to Joel Theriot, a tent-revival minister whose parishioners finger a scarred “tall man” seen with Dora Lange. Brought in for interrogation, a sex offender matching the description is quickly dismissed by Cohle, despite offering a confession. Hart gets sidetracked after Maggie sets Cohle up with a friend at a C&W bar. Looking to establish a pattern of murder, Cohle pores over old case files, finding a connection with a woman assumed to have drowned years earlier.

1-4.title: Who Goes There?
1-4.overview: Hart and Cohle hunt for their newly identified suspect, Reggie Ledoux, a meth cooker who shared a cell with Dora Lange's husband and recently skipped parole. As Hart's personal life collapses around him, Cohle immerses himself in an old criminal identity from his narco days, contacting an East-Texas biker gang known to deal with their primary suspect.

1-5.title: The Secret Fate of All Life
1-5.overview: A violent denouement in the forest clears the Dora Lange case and turns Cohle and Hart into local heroes. Each man settles into a healthier rhythm of living as Hart returns to his family, and Cohle starts a relationship while gaining a reputation as a closer in interrogations. As time passes and his daughters grow older, Hart faces new tensions and temptations, and Cohle learns from a double-murder suspect that there could be much more to an old case than he'd once thought. In 2012, Gilbough and Papania put their cards on the table, presenting new intelligence that threatens Cohle and causes Hart to reassess everything he thought he knew about his former partner.

1-6.title: Haunted Houses
1-6.overview: Maggie reveals Cohle's activities in 2002, when his relationship with Hart fractured and he quit the force.

1-7.title: After You've Gone
1-7.overview: Hart and Cohle call a truce to investigate a series of disappearances that may be related to the Dora Lange murder and the Tuttle family.

1-8.title: Form and Void
1-8.overview: An overlooked detail provides Hart and Cohle with an important new lead in their 17-year-old case.

2-1.title: The Western Book of the Dead
2-1.overview: The disappearance of a city manager disrupts a lucrative land scheme and ignites an investigation involving three police officers and a career criminal who is moving into legitimate business.

2-2.title: Night Finds You
2-2.overview: Ben Caspar's autopsy reveals the gruesome details of his demise, and Ray and Ani wonder if it has anything to do with his fondness for prostitutes. Meanwhile, Frank looks into what might have happened to his missing fortune.

2-3.title: Maybe Tomorrow
2-3.overview: The repercussions from Caspar's murder are felt by Frank and the Vinci Mayor's office. Ray and Ani are involved in a close call with the killer.

2-4.title: Down Will Come
2-4.overview: The detail works a pawn-shop lead to close in on a suspect in the Caspere case. Frank revisits his past to pay for his present. Velcoro, Bezzerides and Woodrugh struggle to keep the case straight in the face of corruption.

2-5.title: Other Lives
2-5.overview: Ray and Frank contemplate new life choices. Ani and Paul follow a lead up the coast.

2-6.title: Church in Ruins
2-6.overview: Desperate to locate a missing woman with intel about Caspere, Frank meets with Mexican drug dealers; Ani infiltrates an exclusive inner circle, with Ray and Paul keeping close tabs.

2-7.title: Black Maps and Motel Rooms
2-7.overview: Ray, Ani and Paul take precautionary measures to elude detection and untangle a dark mystery; Frank deals with the fallout of his betrayal.

2-8.title: Omega Station
2-8.overview: Frank, Ray and Ani weigh their options as Caspere's killer and the scope of corruption is revealed.

3-1.title: The Great War and Modern Memory
3-1.overview: The disappearance of a young Arkansas boy and his sister in 1980 triggers vivid memories and enduring questions for retired detective Wayne Hays, who worked the case 35 years before with partner Roland West. What started as a routine case becomes a long journey to dissect and make sense of the crime.

3-2.title: Kiss Tomorrow Goodbye
3-2.overview: Hays looks back at the aftermath of the 1980 Purcell case in West Finger, Arkansas, including possible evidence left behind at the Devil's Den. As attention focuses on two conspicuous suspects--Brett Woodard, a solitary vet and trash collector, and Ted LaGrange, an ex-con with a penchant for children--the parents of the missing kids, Tom and Lucy Purcell, receive a cryptic note.

3-3.title: The Big Never
3-3.overview: Hays recalls his early romance with Amelia, as well as cracks in their relationship that surfaced after they married and had children. Ten years after the Purcell crimes, new evidence emerges, giving him a second chance to vindicate himself and the investigation.

3-4.title: The Hour and the Day
3-4.overview: Hays and West see a possible connection between the local church and the Purcell crimes. As the detectives search for one suspect and round up another for interrogation, Woodard is targeted by a vigilante group.

3-5.title: If You Have Ghosts
3-5.overview: Wayne finds himself in a no-win situation as new clues emerge in the Purcell case. Roland wrestles with how to keep evidence secure as lawyers demand a new investigation. Amelia finds her relationship with Wayne imperiled by her writing aspirations and his jealousy.

3-6.title: Hunters in the Dark
3-6.overview: Wayne and Roland revisit discrepancies in the Purcell case that were hidden or forgotten over the years. Among those being reevaluated is Tom Purcell, as well as Lucy Purcell’s cousin, Dan O’Brien. The glitter of Amelia’s book release is tarnished by a voice from the past.

3-7.title: The Final Country
3-7.overview: Following up on new leads, Wayne and Roland track down a man who left the police force in the midst of the Purcell investigation. Meanwhile, Amelia visits Lucy Purcell’s best friend in hopes of gaining insights into the whereabouts of the mysterious one-eyed man.

3-8.title: Now Am Found
3-8.overview: Wayne struggles to hold on to his memories, and his grip on reality, as the truth behind the Purcell case is finally revealed.

4-1.title: Night Country: Part 1
4-1.overview: When eight researchers at Tsalal Station vanish without a trace, Danvers orders a search. After handling a workplace dispute, Navarro tries to convince a skeptical Danvers that the men's disappearance is connected to the murder of a local activist.

4-2.title: Night Country: Part 2
4-2.overview: As Danvers and Prior learn more about Tsalal – and find an unlikely location for the physical evidence – Captain Connelly threatens to move the case to Anchorage. Later, Navarro and Danvers find a connection between one of the Tsalal men and Annie.

4-3.title: Night Country: Part 3
4-3.overview: While Hank leads the search for Clark, Prior asks Danvers about the murder-suicide case that drove a wedge between her and Navarro. Then, Navarro and Danvers seek out a local hairdresser for insight on Annie -- which leads to a tip.

4-4.title: Night Country: Part 4
4-4.overview: When Julia's mental health struggles resurface, Navarro brings her to a local facility, promising that this time will be better. Later, Danvers and Navarro confirm the location of Annie's murder, and Danvers levies a harsh punishment on Leah.

4-5.title: Night Country: Part 5
4-5.overview: As Prior digs into the links between Tsalal and mining company Silver Sky, Navarro rescues Leah from a local protest that has turned violent. At a meeting with Silver Sky exec Kate McKitterick, Danvers is warned not to pursue the case any further.

4-6.title: Night Country: Part 6
4-6.overview: In the midst of a brutal storm, Danvers and Navarro find themselves stuck at Tsalal with no electricity or means of contact. As the truth about what happened to Annie and the Tsalal men unfolds, Navarro and Danvers each confront the demons from their past.

275583.name: Tonari no Seki-kun: The Master of Killing Time
275583.overview: In the middle of class at a certain school, Rumi Yokoi, a diligent student, has her in-class life turned upside down when her desk mate Toshinari Seki begins to play by himself at his desk in class. Although Rumi is irked by Toshinari's distracting yet intricate playtime, she finds herself being drawn into his interesting hobby. Never being able to focus, Rumi observes Seki's stunning ways of slacking off in class.

0-1.title: Topple the Flag / Cat
0-1.overview: An OVA bundled with the special edition of the fifth manga volume.

0-2.title: School Camp
0-2.overview: An OVA bundled with DVD box volume 1.

0-3.title: Snow Play
0-3.overview: An OVA bundled with DVD box volume 2.

1-1.title: Dominos
1-1.overview: Yokoi-san is trying her best to listen in class, but she can't help but watch as Seki-kun is lining up erasers next to her. Seki-kun! Are those dominoes?!

1-2.title: Shogi (1)
1-2.overview: Yokoi-san is trying to pay attention as usual. And then Seki-kun starts playing shogi next to her and it turns into something rather unexpected.

1-3.title: Desk Polishing
1-3.overview: Seki-kun starts shining his desk during class. Amazed at the effect of his work, Yokoi-san finds herself being dragged into his want to shine more desks.

1-4.title: Go
1-4.overview: Seki-kun starts playing Go on his desk. Yokoi-san tries to ignore this since she doesn't know the rules, but this yet again turns into something rather unexpected.

1-5.title: Eraser Stamp
1-5.overview: During science class, Seki's attempts at constructing a hanko stamp from his eraser are hindered by his laid-back classmate, Akiyasu Uzawa.

1-6.title: Disaster Drill
1-6.overview: Whilst participating in a disaster drill, Rumi notices that a robot family that Seki has brought into class is taking the drill more seriously than Seki himself, prompting her to take responsibility for them.

1-7.title: Note Passing
1-7.overview: Seki creates an elaborate post office system for passing notes around the class; with many protocols that prevent Rumi from giving him a note of her own.

1-8.title: Shogi (2)
1-8.overview: Seki crafts another shogi tale, this time depicting a princess who marries a pawn but is soon kidnapped.

1-9.title: Knitting
1-9.overview: As Seki knits in class, Rumi watches him as an expert, but is surprised by some of his maneuvers as well as the final product.

1-10.title: Golf
1-10.overview: During art class, Seki plays a miniature-sized game of golf on his worn-out desk, whilst Rumi's classmate, Sakurako Gotō, misinterprets the interactions between Rumi and Seki as romantic gestures.

1-11.title: Mountain Climbing
1-11.overview: Rumi watches in harrowing anticipation as Seki has a group of miniature bears do a mountain climbing expedition on the back of their classmate, Takahiro Maeda.

1-12.title: RC Car
1-12.overview: Seki studies a set of driving rules, takes a written driving test, and then makes a driving course on his desk for a remote-controlled car, which he takes very seriously.

1-13.title: Pool
1-13.overview: During water safety lessons, Rumi once again becomes invested in the diligence of the robot family, becoming panicked when the child robot is thrown into the pool by Uzawa.

1-14.title: Lunch
1-14.overview: During lunch break, Rumi is a little disturbed by the manner in which Seki eats the octopus weiners he made for his lunch.

1-15.title: Paper Sumo
1-15.overview: Whilst Rumi is off school with a cold, Goto observes Seki as he plays a game of paper sumo involving a robot opponent, assuming he had a fight with Rumi.

1-16.title: Shogi vs. Chess
1-16.overview: As the class watches an instructional video, Seki plays a game of "Shogi vs. Chess" in the dark, with Rumi eager to help the shogi pieces as they struggle against the black chess pieces hidden in the darkness.

1-17.title: Fukuwarai
1-17.overview: Seki puts on a blindfold and plays a game of fukuwarai, which soon evolves into a twisting story about family life.

1-18.title: Magic
1-18.overview: With their desks pushed together in order to share a printout, Rumi attempts to ignore Seki as he performs some card tricks, hoping to prompt a reaction from her.

1-19.title: Glasses
1-19.overview: Seki brings various pairs of glasses to see which pair looks the best on him.

1-20.title: Flipbook
1-20.overview: Seki draws a flip book comic in his textbook, which he even records sound effects to, leaving Rumi curious about the finished result.

1-21.title: Bag Inspection
1-21.overview: Rumi learns of a surprise belongings inspection, believing it to be the perfect chance for Seki to get busted. However, she becomes concerned about the robot family, especially when Seki seems to make no attempts to hide them properly.

295685.name: Lucifer
295685.overview: Bored and unhappy as the Lord of Hell, Lucifer Morningstar abandoned his throne and retired to Los Angeles, where he has teamed up with LAPD detective Chloe Decker to take down criminals. But the longer he's away from the underworld, the greater the threat that the worst of humanity could escape.

0-1.title: 2015 Comic-Con Panel
0-1.overview: Executive Producer Joe Henderson and star Tom Ellis strap on some devilish horns as the cast shares why they were dying to be a part of LUCIFER.

0-2.title: Unaired Pilot
0-2.overview: Lucifer has left hell to take up a life on Earth. When a friend of his is murdered, Lucifer joins forces with the good side of the law to discover who the perpetrators are and to give them what they rightfully deserve.

0-5.title: Reinventing Lucifer: In the City of Angels

0-6.title: Off Script with Tom & Tom, Part 1

0-7.title: Off Script with Tom & Tom, Part 2

0-8.title: Off Script with Tom & Tom, Part 3

0-9.title: Lucifer Returns! Bringing the Hit Show to L.A.

1-1.title: Pilot
1-1.overview: Upon leaving hell, Lucifer Morningstar retreats to Los Angeles for a more exciting life. When the murder of a friend connects him with LAPD detective Chloe Decker, Lucifer becomes intrigued with the idea of punishing criminals, sending the devil himself into a struggle between good and evil.

1-2.title: Lucifer, Stay. Good Devil.
1-2.overview: When a movie star's son is killed after being chased by the paparazzi, Chloe takes a deep look into the case with a little help from Lucifer. Meanwhile, Maze and Amenadiel continue to encourage Lucifer to go back to hell.

1-3.title: The Would-Be Prince of Darkness
1-3.overview: When a 22-year-old future superstar quarterback wakes up to find a dead girl floating in his swimming pool, he turns to his friend, Lucifer, for help. Lucifer enlists Chloe to investigate the case, which leads to the world of big money sports and people who will literally kill to be number one.

1-4.title: Manly Whatnots
1-4.overview: In an effort to get over his infatuation with Chloe, Lucifer decides that he must seduce her. Meanwhile the two team up on a missing girl case and Amenadiel confronts Maze about his concerns about Lucifer.

1-5.title: Sweet Kicks
1-5.overview: After a shooting occurs at a fashion show and a young woman is killed, Lucifer becomes intrigued by the danger of the situation and begs Chloe to get in on the case. Meanwhile, when Maze admits to Amenadiel that she wants to go back to hell, he sets his sights on Dr. Linda.

1-6.title: Favorite Son
1-6.overview: Lucifer bails on Chloe when he becomes bored with her investigation into a ruthless biker gang murder. However, when he discovers something was stolen during the crime that was very personal to him, he demands that Chloe let him rejoin the case.

1-7.title: Wingman
1-7.overview: In attempt to find the contents of his stolen container, Lucifer enlists the help of an unlikely ally. Meanwhile, Chloe digs deeper into the Palmetto case, uncovering a lead that might finally expose the truth.

1-8.title: Et Tu, Doctor?
1-8.overview: When a therapist is murdered, Lucifer and Chloe enlist the help of Dr. Linda to look into possible suspects. Meanwhile, Malcolm confronts Chloe about the night he was shot, and Lucifer experiences his first bout of jealousy.

1-9.title: A Priest Walks Into A Bar
1-9.overview: A priest seeks out Lucifer's help when he suspects an underground drug operation has set up shop at a neighborhood youth center. Meanwhile, Malcolm manipulates a way to keep an eye on Dan.

1-10.title: Pops
1-10.overview: Lucifer and Chloe are tasked with solving the murder of a prominent restaurateur. When they meet his son, they suspect he played a part in the death. Meanwhile, Chloe's mom returns home, sending Chloe's life into upheaval, as Lucifer learns his own dysfunctional family isn't nearly as unique as he thought.

1-11.title: St. Lucifer
1-11.overview: When philanthropist Tim Dunlear is found dead, Lucifer explores his good side by becoming a benefactor for Tim’s glitzy Los Angeles charity.

1-12.title: #TeamLucifer
1-12.overview: When a woman is found dead on the Hollywood Walk of Fame - with her body  twisted into the shape of a pentagram - the investigation leads Lucifer  and team into the world of Satanists, where they soon realize, evil  doesn't always live where we expect it to.

1-13.title: Take Me Back To Hell
1-13.overview: When Lucifer is framed for murder, he and Chloe must work together to clear his name and prove the identity of the true killer.

2-1.title: Everything's Coming Up Lucifer
2-1.overview: Lucifer is distracted by his mother’s escape from hell, as he and Chloe investigate the murder of a stand-in actress. Meanwhile, Chloe’s faith in Lucifer is tested by the new medical examiner, Ella. Also, Amenadiel hopes to rein in Lucifer’s wild side, as they both deal with the absence of Maze.

2-2.title: Liar, Liar, Slutty Dress on Fire
