2-86.title: The Cathedral
2-86.overview: The Mighty Nein race to the cathedral of the Dawnfather in a desperate effort to stop Obann's sinister plot...

2-87.title: Punishment and Politics
2-87.overview: Running on fumes, the Mighty Nein face down the new form of their old threat, but it is diplomacy that proves to be an even greater challenge...

2-88.title: Unwanted Reunions
2-88.overview: The Mighty Nein must deal with the political ramifications of their choices as they wade further into the depths of the war between the Empire and Xhorhas...

2-89.title: Lingering Wounds
2-89.overview: The Mighty Nein take a couple days of downtime in Rexxentrum to research, train, and reconnect with faces from the past...

2-90.title: Bathhouses and Bastions
2-90.overview: The Mighty Nein continue their research and relaxation in Rexxentrum before returning to Xhorhas in hopes of convincing the Bright Queen to parley...

2-91.title: Stone to Clay
2-91.overview: The Mighty Nein spend some time at home connecting with an ally, while the answer to a once-distant goal comes rapidly into view...

2-92.title: Home is Where the Heart Is
2-92.overview: The Mighty Nein chase a lead on Nott's curse, but that lead brings Beau face to face with a past she would rather leave behind.

2-93.title: Misery Loves Company
2-93.overview: The Mighty Nein find themselves on the hunt for the entity responsible for Nott's predicament, but neither the journey nor the quarry are quite what they expected...

2-94.title: With Great Power...
2-94.overview: The Mighty Nein take stock after their tangle with a dealmaker but their arrival at a new destination holds unexpected answers...

2-95.title: Blessing in Disguise
2-95.overview: Now in the jungles of the White Dawn Lagoon, the Mighty Nein find themselves challenged not just by Caduceus's journey of faith, but by Jester's as well...

2-96.title: Family Shatters
2-96.overview: The Mighty Nein, having arrived at the oasis menagerie, must now protect both themselves and the fragile garden denizens from the danger barreling toward them...

2-97.title: The Fancy and the Fooled
2-97.overview: Live from Chicago! The Mighty Nein return to Nicodranas, where happy reunions and fantastic makeovers are shadowed by revelations about someone close to the party...

2-98.title: Dark Waters
2-98.overview: The Mighty Nein reset after their intense interactions at the party to prepare for their voyage to the peace talks, but nothing can prepare them for the danger that awaits on the high seas...

2-99.title: High Seas, High Stakes
2-99.overview: Slowly recovering from the midnight attack, the Mighty Nein continue their course for the long-awaited peace talks between warring nations...

2-100.title: Hunted at Sea
2-100.overview: The Mighty Nein are back! Faced with a pursuing dragon turtle, the Mighty Nein must rely on luck and cunning in order to battle their enormous, determined foe...

2-101.title: Mysteries, Memories, and Music
2-101.overview: The Mighty Nein explore the island village of Vo, uncovering strange mysteries about the island itself and its unusual inhabitants...

2-102.title: Ghosts, Dinosaurs, and Stuff
2-102.overview: The Mighty Nein must traverse a dangerous path while seeking an audience with the mysterious being that claims dominion over the island of Rumblecusp…

2-103.title: Maritime Mysteries
2-103.overview: Wrestling with the dangers of spending too much time on Rumblecusp, the Mighty Nein travel to the Heaven Falls, seeking a weak point in the island that could be used against Vokodo...

2-104.title: The Ruined Sliver
2-104.overview: Seeking answers, the Mighty Nein continue to delve into forbidden areas of Rumblecusp in order to learn more about their powerful foe...

2-105.title: Rumble at Rumblecusp
2-105.overview: Armed with knowledge and an amorphous plan, the Mighty Nein prepare to confront Rumblecusp's dangerous overlord...

2-106.title: A Fog Lifted
2-106.overview: The Mighty Nein must now face the ramifications of their fight with Vokodo, both within the dangerous cavern itself and amongst the villagers of Vo...

2-107.title: Devoutness and Dicks
2-107.overview: With less than a week until Traveler Con, the Mighty Nein put on their party planning hats to prep Rumblecusp for the unruly event.

2-108.title: Traveler Con
2-108.overview: With their preparations finished and the day upon them, it's time for the Mighty Nein's greatest challenge yet... the celebration of Traveler Con!

2-109.title: Frigid Propositions
2-109.overview: The Mighty Nein return to the mainland where mysteries, shopping, job offers, and family reunions await their attention...

2-110.title: Dinner with the Devil
2-110.overview: The Mighty Nein attend a dinner hosted by a monstrous figure from Caleb's past, where both revelations and questions arise in multitude...

2-111.title: New Homes and Old Friends
2-111.overview: The Mighty Nein explore a new magical haven before heading to Zadash to investigate some theories and reach out to previous connections...

2-112.title: The Chase Begins
2-112.overview: While preparing to journey to Eiselcross, the Mighty Nein find themselves torn as they uncover a pressing mystery about a friend thought lost...

2-113.title: A Heart Grown Cold
2-113.overview: While sailing upon icy seas, the Mighty Nein must contend with an unexpected familiar foe that's come to enact revenge...

2-114.title: An Open Window
2-114.overview: Having arrived in Eiselcross, the Mighty Nein get acquainted with their allies even as threads and fates begin to cross...

2-115.title: Fetching Fables & Frosty Friends
2-115.overview: The Mighty Nein head into the frozen tundra of Foren, led by their grizzled guide, and must contend with more than a few dangerous elements of the landscape...

2-116.title: Under Timeless Ice
2-116.overview: The Mighty Nein delve into their first of Eiselcross's excavation sites, hot on the heels of their mysterious quarry...

2-117.title: The Tortoise and The Dare
2-117.overview: Hard choices await the Mighty Nein, who must decide whether to follow the current path of their former friend or deviate and forge a new one...

2-118.title: Solace Between the Secrets
2-118.overview: The Mighty Nein forge their own way across the tundra to another Aeorian excavation site, but things far more dangerous than frozen relics await them under the snow...

2-119.title: Malice and Mystery Below
2-119.overview: Deep within the mysterious Aeorian ruin, the Mighty Nein must first face a terrifying abomination before they can venture further into the strange and unknown...

2-120.title: Contentious Company
2-120.overview: The Mighty Nein locate their prize but quickly learn that adversaries and conflict can come from even the most unexpected corners...

2-121.title: Ice and Fire
2-121.overview: Forced to navigate a strange new relationship with the Tombtakers, the Mighty Nein continue their trek to Aeor, where both fiery and magical dangers await any wrong moves...

2-122.title: Nothing Ventured, Nothing Gained
2-122.overview: With secrets and mysteries ever growing, the Mighty Nein must navigate the rising tension between themselves and their ersatz allies as their travel to Aeor continues...

2-123.title: Fair-weather Faith
2-123.overview: The Mighty Nein must contend with eye-opening revelations and ever-shifting power dynamics as they continue to forge towards Aeor...

2-124.title: A Walk to Warmer Welcomes
2-124.overview: Exhausted and hunted, the Mighty Nein search for sanctuary in Aeor while contemplating their own potential chess moves...

2-125.title: The Neverending Day
2-125.overview: Having escaped the frozen fields of Eiselcross, the Mighty Nein search for allies and assets to help them in their fight against the nine eyes...

2-126.title: Worth Fighting For
2-126.overview: Faced with unsettling visions and a leering countdown, the Mighty Nein take stock of supplies, of lingering wounds, and of matters of the heart.

2-127.title: Sarsaparilla, Licorice, and Red Hot
2-127.overview: The Mighty Nein enact a heist on the storage vaults of the Vergesson Sanatorium, but their quick caper proves more difficult and dangerous than they'd anticipated...

2-128.title: Cat and Mouse
2-128.overview: With their heist uncovered and danger closing in around them, the Mighty Nein must make tough decisions to keep themselves and their loved ones safe...

2-129.title: Between a Ball and a Hot Place
2-129.overview: Split into two teams, the Mighty Nein must contend with the dangerous surroundings of two very different planes while trying to get back home...

2-130.title: The Calm Before the Storm
2-130.overview: Reunions abound as the Mighty Nein find a momentary refuge among family and friends, but their uncertain and dangerous future casts a pall on their time together...

2-131.title: Into the Eye
2-131.overview: After wrapping up with family and steeling their nerves, the Mighty Nein return to the frozen peaks and valleys of Eiselcross to weigh allies and plot their next course of action...

2-132.title: Aeor
2-132.overview: Having located the secret entrance to Aeor, the Mighty Nein take stock of what waits for them both above and below the ice...

2-133.title: Hunter and Hunted
2-133.overview: As the Mighty Nein tentatively explore the edges of Aeor, they debate whether to delve further into mystery or hold the line and set traps for their rapidly approaching enemies...

2-134.title: The Streets of the Forgotten
2-134.overview: Now following the Tombtakers’ trail, the Mighty Nein converse with voices of the past for clues and meet some of Aeor’s creations...

2-135.title: The Genesis Ward
2-135.overview: The Mighty Nein plunge deeper into both Aeor's ruined depths and its endless mysteries as they continue to chase after the elusive remaining Tombtakers...

2-136.title: Hell or High Water
2-136.overview: The Mighty Nein fight against time as they search for the Immensus Gate, but their quarry has his own tricks up his sleeve...

2-137.title: Welcome to Cognouza
2-137.overview: Floating through the Astral Sea, the Mighty Nein arrive at their unsettling destination and begin exploring the living city that has haunted their dreams...

2-138.title: Where There Is a Will...
2-138.overview: The Mighty Nein wrangle with Cree as they attempt to stop Lucien's plan, but the Nonagon still has a few surprises in store for them all...

2-139.title: Rebirth
2-139.overview: The Mighty Nein prepare for an intense confrontation with their transformed former friend, but the Nonagon who awaits them above the streets of Cognouza is more powerful than any of them anticipated...

2-140.title: Long May He Reign
2-140.overview: Deep in the heart of Cognouza, the Mighty Nein face the second form of the Neo-Somnovem in hopes of bringing an end to his nightmarish dominion.

2-141.title: Fond Farewells
2-141.overview: The Mighty Nein return to the Blooming Grove to process what they've endured and to take their first steps towards embracing whatever the future holds in store...

3-1.title: The Draw of Destiny
3-1.overview: Disparate souls collide in the mountain spires of Jrusar when three different groups of adventurers meet during a battle against an unusual array of enemies...

3-2.title: Trial by Firelight
3-2.overview: The three groups of adventurers slowly begin to form a cohesive unit as a tentative alliance is forged with the vigilant and mysterious Lord Eshteross...

3-3.title: The Trail and the Toll
3-3.overview: While investigating a series of thefts at the behest of their potential patron, the group stumbles onto something much more dangerous than they anticipated, with lasting consequences...

3-4.title: On the Trail of a Killer
3-4.overview: Determined to avenge a tragic loss, the group takes to the streets in search of answers, but their probing into Jrusar's secrets could have dangerous ramifications...

3-5.title: The Threat Between the Walls
3-5.overview: After stumbling into a literal den of thieves, the group picks up their quarry’s trail and seek the end of the thread they’ve pulled…

3-6.title: Growing Bonds and Teasing Threads
3-6.overview: The group celebrates their success by getting to know each other better and looking into the background of Orym's contact in the city, but the past is following one of them closely...

3-7.title: Behind the Curtain
3-7.overview: After a performance goes slightly awry, the group begins investigating the strange disappearances that have all taken place in and around the Dreamscape Theater...

3-8.title: A Woodworker's Quandary
3-8.overview: The group gets to know a very unusual new friend who requests their help in a missing person's case while Dorian receives some unwelcome tidings from a beloved family member...

3-9.title: Thicker Grows the Meal and Plot
3-9.overview: The group continues their search for Chetney's missing friend, even as their discoveries yield stranger and stranger reports about the man they're looking for...

3-10.title: Ghosts, Dates, and Darker Fates
3-10.overview: After a successful but interrupted burglary, the party splits in order to follow leads, go on a date, and investigate the machinations of the mysterious Nightmare King...

3-11.title: Chasing Nightmares
3-11.overview: The group comes face to face with the terrifying entity known as the Nightmare King but the interaction leaves only questions to an increasingly perplexing puzzle...

3-12.title: Make It Fashion
3-12.overview: The group readies themselves for the ball while beginning to piece together a cryptic puzzle of criss-crossing threads of fate...

3-13.title: A Dance of Deception
3-13.overview: With a heist somewhat planned, the group attends the masquerade ball but have trouble keeping a low profile as various complications arise...

3-14.title: In Too Deep
3-14.overview: The ball takes several unexpected twists and turns when dancing shifts to fighting and fighting shifts to fleeing...

3-15.title: The Tunnels Below
3-15.overview: Bells Hells awaken to the repercussions of their antics at the ball, but the unwanted attention of certain parties could be the key to unraveling some of Jrusar’s mysteries…

3-16.title: The Shade Mother
3-16.overview: With a new alliance made, Bells Hells discover an unsettling entity within the mines beneath the city whose terrors are more potent than any of them bargained for...

3-17.title: Heart-to-Heartmoor
3-17.overview: With a strange job to take and stranger mysteries to chase, Bells Hells prepares for their journey into the Oderan Wilds while opening up about their lives and their secrets...

3-18.title: A Hungry Jungle
3-18.overview: While traveling to the Heartmoor Hamlet, Bells Hells find their night's rest interrupted by an enormous fey plant creature intent on devouring them whole...

3-19.title: Omens Above
3-19.overview: Newly arrived in the Heartmoor Hamlet, Bells Hells seek answers to long-sought questions and prepare for the midnight museum heist...

3-20.title: Breaking and Entering...
3-20.overview: With the heist underway, Bells Hells explore the traps and trinkets of the Twilight Mirror Museum, finding unexpected dangers as they venture deeper into the vault...

3-21.title: Fight at the Museum...
3-21.overview: Bells Hells may have located their quarry, but the heist is far from over as they face down freshly formed formidable foes...

3-22.title: Promise and Potential
3-22.overview: Now returned to Jrusar, Bells Hells meet with old and new allies to catch up on the city news and determine their next mission...

3-23.title: To The Skies
3-23.overview: Bells Hells finish their business in Jrusar and take to the skies on The Silver Sun skyship, where wonders and dangers lurk among the clouds…

3-24.title: The Hellcatch Valley
3-24.overview: Bells Hells’ fantastical flight takes them to the lawless town of Bassuras, where danger, deception, and delight lurk behind every corner…

3-25.title: A Taste of Tal'Dorei
3-25.overview: Bells Hells explore Bassuras and the Paragon's Call stronghold while getting to know their new friend Dusk, whose past strangely intersects with one of their own...

3-26.title: Hidden Truths
3-26.overview: Bells Hells seek out allies and options in their evolving plan to infiltrate Paragon’s Call…

3-27.title: A Race for the Prize
3-27.overview: Bells Hells tend to their inner relationships before returning to the Seat of Disdain, but a surprising face in Paragon's Call rattles several members of the group...

3-28.title: The Deathwish Run
3-28.overview: Bells Hells enter the deadly crawler race known as Deathwish, where survival is the only rule and winning is the only option...

3-29.title: Dark Portents
3-29.overview: With a mother-daughter reunion interrupted by deception, Bells Hells must decide who they can trust and how to navigate the tides of dangerous new knowledge...

3-30.title: Reunion & Revelation
3-30.overview: Bells Hells entangle themselves further in dangerous Fey business as they ride across the treacherous Hellcatch Valley to find answers to a growing mystery…

3-31.title: Breaking Point
3-31.overview: Bells Hells process their feelings as they work through moon mysteries, family conflict, and a shocking revelation about one of their own...

3-32.title: A Stage Set
3-32.overview: Bells Hells tinker with former friendships and robotic inner workings before returning to Paragon's Call, this time as newly minted members...

3-33.title: Blood and Dust
3-33.overview: Surrounded by chaos, Bells Hells act quickly to secure their quarry, but their attempted escape leads to an unexpected confrontation with a deadly foe...

3-34.title: What Dreams May Come
3-34.overview: Bells Hells grapple with a devastating loss, refusing to accept fate's machinations as they attempt to stay a step ahead of Paragon's Call...

3-35.title: Pyrrhic Return
3-35.overview: Bells Hells sail the stormy skies as they return to Jrusar and reconnect with allies in a race to keep hope alive...

3-36.title: A Desperate Call
3-36.overview: Bells Hells magically arrive in the city of Whitestone and meet a few legendary heroes in their search to save Laudna, but discover that her soul is not so easily retrieved...

3-37.title: From the Boughs
3-37.overview: Bells Hells traverse a dark and corrupted Whitestone and face twisted traumatic shadows of the past in their effort to save Laudna's soul...

3-38.title: A Dark Balance
3-38.overview: Bells Hells return to safety from the treacherous shadow realm with renewed hope to save their lost friend...

3-39.title: The Momentum of Murder
3-39.overview: Bells Hells must contend with the bureaucracy of being murder suspects before they can begin their turbulent travels to southern Marquet...

3-40.title: Compulsions
3-40.overview: Bells Hells reflect upon the latest and strangest moon developments as they near the Gloomed Jungles and prepare for a potential rendezvous with the Gorgynei lycans...

3-41.title: Call of the Wild
3-41.overview: Bells Hells travel deep into the Gloomed Jungles with the Gorgynei to seek a godly trial that may help Chetney's plight...

3-42.title: The City of Flowing Light
3-42.overview: Bells Hells depart from their new allies and head to Yios, where they are quickly dazzled by the lake-top metropolis' glamor and gambling...

3-43.title: Axiom Shaken
3-43.overview: Bells Hells seek out answers about the stolen texts from members of the Grim Verity, but the knowledge revealed could change everything they know about the gods of Exandria…

3-44.title: Bawdy Basement Belligerence
3-44.overview: Trapped in the basement of a fugitive, Bells Hells turn to chaos in an effort to escape their hunters and learn more about who leads their adversaries...

3-45.title: Ominous Lectures
3-45.overview: Bells Hells return to the Aydinlan Seminary to speak with two professors about the mysteries affecting their friends, but an unexpected guest complicates everything...

3-46.title: Night at the Ligament Manor
3-46.overview: Bells Hells travel to the Fey Realm, where they meet Fearne's curious Nana Morri and learn more about Fearne's unconventional upbringing...

3-47.title: The Fey Key
3-47.overview: Bells Hells carefully traverse the shadowy side of the Fey Realm and dodge numerous dangers in their attempt to destroy the first Malleus Key…

3-48.title: An Exit Most Fraught
3-48.overview: Bells Hells need to leave the Fey Realm behind, but the threats on their scent are extremely unkind...

3-49.title: The Aurora Grows
3-49.overview: Bells Hells travel the aurora-filled skies of the Hellcatch Valley, concocting plans and gathering allies as the days tick down to the apogee solstice...

3-50.title: Red Moon Rising
3-50.overview: With the apogee solstice imminent, Bells Hells begin their infiltration of the Tishtan ruins, where they encounter new faces in the fight against the Ruby Vanguard...

3-51.title: The Apogee Solstice
3-51.overview: Bells Hells race against time and lifelong plotting as they attempt to stop the Ruby Vanguard from releasing the god-eater Predathos and potentially dooming the world...

3-52.title: Far From The Others
3-52.overview: With the magic of the apogee solstice having split the party across Exandria, half of Bells Hells must contend with the dangers and surprising connections of Northern Wildemount...

3-53.title: Ripples
3-53.overview: The Team Wildemount half of Bells Hells arrive in Uthodurn, where they get a wider sense of how magic is responding to the events of the apogee solstice...

3-54.title: Treacherous Toys
3-54.overview: Bells Hells' Team Wildemount tangles with the pasts of some of their own through enigmatic dreams and illuminating confrontations...

3-55.title: Hope Within History
3-55.overview: Bells Hells' Team Wildemount meets with the King and Queen of Uthodurn, where insight on Ludinus Da'leth reveals a new focus and destination for the group...

3-56.title: By Goat or By Boat
3-56.overview: Bells Hells' Team Wildemount travel through the cursed Savalirwood as they attempt to locate the ruins of the corrupted city Molaesmyr...

3-57.title: The Sorrow of Molaesmyr
3-57.overview: Bells Hells’ Team Wildemount venture deeper into the haunted ruins of Molaesmyr and search for the tower that once belonged to the imperious mage Ludinus Da’leth…

3-58.title: Escape From The Past
3-58.overview: Bells Hells' Team Wildemount are assailed by the corrupted creatures of Molaesmyr as they attempt to flee with the secrets they've obtained from the ruins...

3-59.title: Somewhere Out There
3-59.overview: Orym, Ashton, and Laudna find themselves in an unfamiliar land, meeting unfamiliar people, as they attempt to piece together why they were separated from their friends and where exactly they are in the world...

3-60.title: Faith or Famine
3-60.overview: Team Issylra makes their way towards civilization, where a small town's troubles with an overbearing temple offers a new perspective on how helpful the gods can be...

3-61.title: Crisis of Faith
3-61.overview: Team Issylra battles agents of the Dawnfather as they attempt to release the temple's unwanted and autocratic rule over the town of Hearthdell...

3-62.title: A Long Walk of Reflection
3-62.overview: Team Issylra trek towards the mountains of the Demithore Valley in search of a teleport spell while taking time to bond as friends and as a team...

3-63.title: A Haunted Past
3-63.overview: Team Issylra must battle a strange shadow entity in order to find a way home, but plans stall when a shocking revelation rocks the group to its core...

3-64.title: Reunited
3-64.overview: Though split across the continents of Exandria and separated by the constraints of weird magic, both teams of Bells Hells converge in Jrusar to finally reconvene with their companions...

3-65.title: A Path of Vengeance
3-65.overview: Bells Hells settle into their reunion, comparing notes between experiences and dealing with the consequences of past actions...

3-66.title: Aid of the Tempest
3-66.overview: Bells Hells arrive in Orym's hometown of Zephrah and learn of a possible solution to Keyleth's lingering wounds, but acquiring the key ingredient is a dangerous endeavor...

3-67.title: Bloody Flowers
3-67.overview: Bells Hells search for a way to cure Keyleth and confront the demonic denizens that have made the cursed Grey Valley their homebase...

3-68.title: For The Tempest
3-68.overview: Bells Hells race to return to Zephrah with faith that their gains in the Grey Valley will save Keyleth and return hope to their fight...

3-69.title: Nice
3-69.overview: Bells Hells take some time to enjoy Zephrah before resuming their search for answers and aid in their fight against Ludinus and the Ruby Vanguard...

3-70.title: Embattled in Bassuras
3-70.overview: Bells Hells return to Bassuras, seeking their friend Imahara Joe's assistance, but they quickly discover that Joe needs their aid first... and fast...

3-71.title: Mist and Whimsy
3-71.overview: Bells Hells travel to the fog shrouded islands of the Shattered Teeth and meet several of the unusual denizens of the chaotic land...

3-72.title: Phantasmal Parley
3-72.overview: Bells Hells engage with a cursed pirate ship filled with ghosts, seeking passage across the waters of the Shattered Teeth, but a parley is not easily granted...

3-73.title: Kindling the Spirits
3-73.overview: Bells Hells continue their journey through the fog-shrouded ocean of the Shattered Teeth with the skeletal crew of the Crimson Abyss, where surprising requests lead to surprising results...

3-74.title: Roots Between Worlds
3-74.overview: Bells Hells explore the island of Kalutha and prepare themselves to take counsel from the fated wisdom of the Great Tree of Atrophy...

3-75.title: An Ancient Flame
3-75.overview: Bells Hells delve into the claustrophobic caverns of Athos Peak, seeking the resting place of an ember of the great fire primordial Emperor Rau'shan...

3-76.title: A Gathering of Heroes
3-76.overview: Bells Hells return to Whitestone in search of allies and refuge, taking time to reflect on the weight of their choices and the path ahead...

3-77.title: The Promise and the Price
3-77.overview: Bells Hells' resident witches delve into the hidden horrors of Whitestone Castle and a choice is made regarding the shard of Rau'shan...

3-78.title: Fractures
3-78.overview: Bells Hells face interparty turmoil as they grapple with the consequences of choices made and broken trust at a crucial crossroads...

3-79.title: To Hurt Is to Heal
3-79.overview: Bells Hells find respite in the Fey Realm while they seek ways to mend their broken trust and rebuild their friendships...

3-80.title: A Test of Trust
3-80.overview: Bells Hells put their trust in each other to the test as they tackle Nana Morri's final task for them among tangled and lost ruins within the Fey Realm...

3-81.title: The Eve of the Red Moon
3-81.overview: Bells Hells ponder fey bargains and prepare for their dangerous race through Ruby Vanguard territory...

3-82.title: Rush for the Bloody Bridge
3-82.overview: With their Fey Realm tasks complete, Bells Hells turn their attention to the ruddy moon and the foes that block the bridge…

3-83.title: Ruidus
3-83.overview: Bells Hells take their first steps on Ruidus and begin their investigation of the mysterious ruddy moon…

3-84.title: Red Rural Revelations
3-84.overview: Bells Hells are introduced to a village on Ruidus and learn about the way of life on the moon…

3-85.title: Intense Interrogations
3-85.overview: Bells Hells question their captured enemies, but their search for information is interrupted by the pursuing hunt from another foe...

3-86.title: Doorways to Darker Depths
3-86.overview: Bells Hells stumble upon a secret entrance to Exandria from Ruidus, but this lucky portal leads to a place just as dangerous as the one waiting for them in the sky...

3-87.title: Arrival at Kreviris
3-87.overview: Bells Hells reach the city of Kreviris, where they explore the surface details of the Ruidian capital…

3-88.title: Seeking Sedition
3-88.overview: While seeking contact with the Volition rebellion, Bells Hells find themselves cornered with no way out of their underground hideaway as enemies close in...

3-89.title: Divisive Portents
3-89.overview: Bells Hells join the Volition rebellion, where they learn about the inner workings of Kreviris and its leaders known as the Weave Mind...

3-90.title: Mission Improbable
3-90.overview: Bells Hells split the party in order to take on two different missions to prove themselves to the Volition, but as the stakes rise, so does the danger...

3-91.title: True Heroism
3-91.overview: Chaos reigns as Bells Hells attempt to find each other and leave Kreviris, but an old enemy complicates their attempted escape...

3-92.title: Broken Roads
3-92.overview: Rattled and reeling, Bells Hells prepare to leave Ruidus and return to Exandria, where tensions are escalating and pressure is building…

3-93.title: Bittersweet Reunions
3-93.overview: The Crown Keepers endure a battle for their lives and the very heart of their team, with dire consequences for every move...

3-94.title: Where The Red Fearne Glows
3-94.overview: Bells Hells begin their hunt for Ludinus' whereabouts and how to slow his plot, but not before an old foe arrives to test one of their own to the brink...

3-95.title: Gathering of Needs
3-95.overview: Bells Hells take time to focus inwards on their grief and their healing, but inner demons threaten the harmony of their bond...

3-96.title: Shadows New and Old
3-96.overview: Bells Hells work to fortify their bonds and friendship in the face of darkness before engaging in a whirlwind of travel stops on the way to Aeor...

3-97.title: Ancient Sins
3-97.overview: Bells Hells encounter Aeorian terrors as they explore the ruined city and seek out the wrinkle in Ludinus' plans...

3-98.title: The Nox Engine
3-98.overview: Live at the Greek Theatre! Bells Hells battle the creeping terror of an unleashed demon, but their own darkest thoughts may prove to be the real enemy...

3-99.title: Downfall (1)
3-99.overview: In the midst of a lull in the Calamity, a group of powerful individuals embark on a divine mission to the flying city of Aeor...

3-100.title: Downfall (2)
3-100.overview: The Divine continue their infiltration of Aeor, looking deeper into the city's flaws and virtues as they seek out the center of its hubris...

3-101.title: Downfall (3)
3-101.overview: All of the Divine planning and improvising comes to a head in the final battle within Aeor's underbelly...

3-102.title: Reconciliation
3-102.overview: Bells Hells contemplate the revelations of the Occultus Thalamus while one of their own is brought low by darkness and desire...

3-103.title: Cages
3-103.overview: Bells Hells seek a way to cut Delilah's puppet strings once and for all...

3-104.title: The Cradle's Convocation
3-104.overview: Bells Hells meet with the Exandrian Accord in Vasselheim, where plans begin to form and connections begin to solidify...

3-105.title: Collecting Legends
3-105.overview: Bells Hells take center stage in the Platinum Sanctuary, where they must prove themselves as worthy potential heroes to the Exandrian Accord...

3-106.title: Unseelie Interrupted
3-106.overview: Bells Hells return to the Fey Realm in an attempt to tangle an upcoming meeting between Ludinus and the Unseelie Court...

3-107.title: Under the Arch Heart's Eye
3-107.overview: Bells Hells endure rocky combat and fey wiles within a temple of the Arch Heart, but come face to face with a surprising eavesdropper with plans of their own..

3-108.title: Looming
3-108.overview: Bells Hells learn just how resilient the Fey can be when it comes to matters of the mind and seek answers from Fearne's estranged, strange father...

3-109.title: A Test of Fate
3-109.overview: Bells Hells make haste to the Raven's Crest temple in Vasselheim by invitation from the Matron of Ravens, but the welcome they receive puts them all on the edge...

3-110.title: In the Shadow of War
3-110.overview: Bells Hells reel from their recent conversations with the divine and seek out calmer heads and resolute monoliths within the city of Vasselheim...

3-111.title: The Nein Hells
3-111.overview: Bells Hells meet their new allies on the road to Kreviris and learn just what makes this team so mighty...

3-112.title: The Assembling of Legends
3-112.overview: Bells Hells introduce the Mighty Nein to the moon before flashing backwards to the reunion of Exandria's most legendary heroes...

3-113.title: Assault on the Malleus Key
3-113.overview: With allies in tow and an army at their backs, Vox Machina begin their assault on the Malleus Fortress...

3-114.title: Fight for the Bloody Bridge
3-114.overview: Vox Machina assail the Malleus Key, intent on rescuing the trapped Vax’ildan as enemies attack from all sides…

3-115.title: To the Arx Creonum
3-115.overview: Bells Hells and the Mighty Nein wait in the shadows of the moon city before launching an explosive attack on the Weavemind’s stronghold…

3-116.title: The Weave Mind
3-116.overview: The Mighty Nein steal their way through the Arx Creonum to confront the psychic minds that control the Ruidian populace...

3-117.title: Race to the Ruidian Core
3-117.overview: Bells Hells delve into the fungal network of Ruidus, seeking Ludinus, Liliana, and the Hallowed Cage...

3-118.title: The Hallowed Cage
3-118.overview: Bells Hells face Ludinus Da'leth, attempting to stop his infiltration of Predathos' glass prison...

3-119.title: Predathos Awakened
3-119.overview: With one of their own absorbed and threats from all directions, Bells Hells bring the fight to Predathos itself...

3-120.title: The Red End
3-120.overview: Bells Hells face Predathos and its terrifying second form as they attempt to bring a god-eater to heel...

3-121.title: A New Age Begins
3-121.overview: Bells Hells return to Exandria with a proposal for the gods and their own visions for the future to come...

4-1.title: The Fall of Thjazi Fang
4-1.overview: A politically suspicious execution brings the friends, family, and enemies of noted war hero Thjazi Fang to the city of Dol-Makjar to celebrate a life well-adventured…

4-2.title: Broken Wing
4-2.overview: The loved ones of Thjazi Fang must contend with the ramifications of his past plots and schemes still reverberating across Dol-Makjar and their own lives…

4-3.title: The Snipping of Shears
4-3.overview: With the true source of the Candescent Creed's magic revealed and the search for Occtis pressing in from all sides, lines of trust must quickly be drawn amongst the allies…

4-4.title: Stone-Faced
4-4.overview: The Houses of Royce and Davinos are attacked by the focused might and undead horror of House Tachonis, while the secrets Bolaire has kept for years tumble into the light…

4-5.title: Branching Paths
4-5.overview: Decisions are made about how to keep Occtis safe from his family while the Soldiers embark on a hunt for friend and foe alike…

4-6.title: Knives and Thorns
4-6.overview: Tyranny struggles with her crueler instincts as the Soldiers discover a safe haven for fairies that may hold clues about Cyd's whereabouts...

4-7.title: On the Scent
4-7.overview: The Soldiers arrive in the Kingdom of Timmony, where local customs are bending against the religious influence of the Candescent Creed...

4-8.title: Fanged Revenge
4-8.overview: A battle for vengeance ensues in Castle Sloke as the Soldiers face the traitorous Baron Casimir Gavendale and his new knights...

4-9.title: To the Hounds!
4-9.overview: The search for Teor's brother Cyd continues as the Soldiers are guided by the Hounds of the King down a mysterious fey shortcut...

4-10.title: Blood for Blood
4-10.overview: Deep in the hidden dungeon of Castle Delawney, the Soldiers must fight for their lives against the cruel allies of House Tachonis...

4-11.title: Make Merry
4-11.overview: The Schemers reckon with the swift changes coming to Dol-Makjar while the Soldiers ponder stone, blood, and blade...

4-12.title: The Giant's Belt
4-12.overview: The Seekers arrive in Riesingürtle, where they explore the city and parley with Lord Einfasen, the head of the mighty and intimidating House Einfasen...

4-13.title: Seeking Sanctuary
4-13.overview: As the walls close in on the Seekers, they are forced to decide if Einfasen's castle is truly as safe as its lord claims or if they should pursue another haven...

4-14.title: A Bridge Too Far
4-14.overview: The druids of Shaungarten question Thaisha's decision to bring the undead Occtis to their sanctuary and debate their continued aid...

4-15.title: Flight to Castle Torch
4-15.overview: The Seekers take to the skies via an eagle ally, bonding in the clouds as they head to the home of the Barrowguard...

4-16.title: Visions of Shadow & Stone
4-16.overview: While searching for Alogar, the Seekers stop at Shadowlight Waypoint, where they learn of an unearthed prophecy and those who hold fast to its meaning...

4-17.title: The Place of Wings
4-17.overview: The Seekers arrive in Tannesar, where stranger and stranger revelations await them within this ancient place of power...

4-18.title: Vindicta & Vale
4-18.overview: Vaelus speaks with a deceased ally of Thaisha's while Occtis grapples with his family's plans... and what was left behind...

4-19.title: Hand & Wheel
4-19.overview: In Dol-Makjar, the Schemers juggle jobs and subterfuge as they reckon with the ascent of the Sundered Houses...

4-20.title: The Vanishing
4-20.overview: Azune is summoned to the Palazzo Davinos to investigate the disappearance of House Royce as Murray, Bolaire, and Hal realize other arcanists have gone missing...

4-21.title: King of Cards
4-21.overview: A visit to The Seven Stars yields important meetings and a nudge in the direction of their disappeared illusionist...

4-22.title: The Point of No Return
4-22.overview: With nowhere to go and no choice but forward, the Schemers put their wits and tricks to the test in a confrontation with the Crow Keepers...

4-23.title: Buried Truths
4-23.overview: Murray learns more than she bargained for while investigating the belongings of House Tachonis while Bolaire and Hal are caught in a crime they can't explain...

4-24.title: Good Tidings
4-24.overview: The Schemers make headway with their own plots, but Thjazi's secrets remain a mystery to unravel...

4-25.title: Targeted
4-25.overview: When two political figures are attacked at the gala, the Schemers must jump into action to save as many lives as they can...

4-26.title: Council of Heroes
4-26.overview: The Schemers contend with the aftermath of a miracle while the Soldiers and Seekers secretly return to Dol-Makjar...

4-27.title: Complicated Questions
4-27.overview: Thirteen voices rise as the three groups reconvene to seek each other's aid as the Houses tighten their grip on the city...

4-28.title: Chasing Shadows
4-28.overview: With opening night approaching and Thjazi's designs still obscured, a plan is formed for safety, rescue, and information...

4-29.title: Opening Night
4-29.overview: Everyone takes their places across Dol-Makjar as the Hallowed Round presents a show that promises to be unforgettable...

4-30.title: Here in the Dark
4-30.overview: Vaelus is faced with an impossible choice, Kattigan is taken to the demonic tailors, and a team split has devastating consequences...

4-31.title: Trick of the Light
4-31.overview: The teams attempt to reunite at the Rookery with varying cheerful and devastated attitudes as the consequences of their ventures begin to ebb throughout the city...

297271.name: We Bare Bears
297271.overview: Three brother bears awkwardly attempt to find their place in civilized  society, whether they're looking for food, trying to make human friends,  or scheming to become famous on the internet. Grizzly, Panda and Ice  Bear stack atop one another when they leave their cave and explore the  hipster environs of the San Francisco Bay Area, and it's clear the  siblings have a lot to learn about a technologically driven world. By  their side on many adventures are best friend Chloe (the only human  character in the cast), fame-obsessed panda Nom Nom, and Charlie, aka  Bigfoot.

0-1.title: We Bare Bears - Pilot
0-1.overview: The Pilot, which was plainly titled "We Bare Bears", is the first produced episode of We Bare Bears. This pilot is separate from the main series and isn't considered the first episode.

0-2.title: Bear Cleaning
0-2.overview: Ice Bear vacuums the cave and accidentally rips out a patch of Grizz's fur. He tries to fix Grizz's bald spot before he notices.

0-3.title: Nom Nom vs. Hamster
0-3.overview: Behind the scenes with popular viral video star Nom Nom - this time, he's trying to work with an uncooperative hamster co-star.

0-4.title: Panda's Dream
0-4.overview: Panda gets cut in line while waiting to buy a video game and fantasizes about ways of heroically standing up for himself.

0-5.title: Log Ride
0-5.overview: The Bears become obsessed with taking the perfect "action shot" picture on a log ride at an amusement park.  They go on the ride over and over again until they've got the best shot.

0-6.title: Goodnight Ice Bear
0-6.overview: Ice Bear tries to fall asleep but the door to his fridge won't close. He tries to come up with a fix for it in any manner possible, no matter how elaborate.

0-7.title: Potty Time
0-7.overview: The Baby Bears search for people to adopt them is disrupted by Panda's need to find a bathroom.

0-8.title: Panda's Profile Pic
0-8.overview: Panda frets over not having a good photo of himself to send to a girl online. Luckily, his brothers offer their photo editing skills to help.

0-9.title: Grizz: Ultimate Hero Champion
0-9.overview: Grizz records his audition tape for his favorite athletic game show.

0-10.title: Dreamium
0-10.overview: Panda uses a relaxation app to help him get to sleep. But the the app's different sounds do more harm than good!

0-11.title: Charlie's Opus
0-11.overview: Charlie plays some abandoned instruments in the woods. But when other animals seem interested in the music, Charlie switches from player to conductor.

0-12.title: Bear Stack
0-12.overview: The Bears travel to the video game store to buy the last copy of a coveted new game. They encounter video game-like obstacles along the way.

0-13.title: Frozen Ice
0-13.overview: Grizz and Panda find Ice Bear frozen in a block of ice and attempt to save him.

0-14.title: Assembly Required
0-14.overview: The Bears have trouble assembling some recently purchased furniture.

0-15.title: Cooking with Ice Bear
0-15.overview: Ice Bear has a Korean-style cooking show and teaches the audience how to cook authentic Korean dishes.

0-16.title: The Cave
0-16.overview: The Bears try to get rid of a bat in their cave.

1-1.title: Our Stuff
1-1.overview: After the bears play a little pickup basketball (they're very bad), they go back to grab their stuff by the side of the court only to find it's been stolen! The Bears race across town trying to track down their stuff and end up cracking a giant case in the process.

1-2.title: Viral Video
1-2.overview: The Bears think they have what it takes to make and star in a viral video, but when Nom-Nom decides that they don't, Grizz breaks into the koala's limo in an effort to change his mind.

1-3.title: Food Truck
1-3.overview: The Bears open up a food truck after being disappointed by the food options available to them. In an effort to drum up business, they start selling their food to animals until the animals go a little crazy.

1-4.title: Chloe
1-4.overview: Chloe spends time with the Bears in an effort to research them for an upcoming presentation. But when the Bears sneak a peek at her very dry report, the Bears decide to jazz it up with exaggerated "facts" about themselves and their lifestyle.

1-5.title: Panda's Date
1-5.overview: When a vendor at the Farmer's Market (LUCY) sticks Panda with an EpiPen reviving him after an allergic reaction, Panda comes to in the arms of his dream girl. Panda tries to woo this woman of his dreams but his brothers and his own insecurities get in the way.

1-6.title: Everyday Bears
1-6.overview: It's a normal day for the Bears. This means that Ice gets in a fight with a Roomba, Panda's life gets turned upside down when a mouse invades his room and Grizz gets stuck in a tree. You know, everyday stuff for a bear.

1-7.title: Burrito
1-7.overview: Grizz likes Burritos. A lot. So much so that after a restaurant makes a Bear-Sized Burrito, Grizz can't bring himself to eat such a majestic work of art. He carries the burrito everywhere making it a new and increasingly smelly part of his life.

1-8.title: Primal
1-8.overview: Have the Bears lost their survival instincts by living in the modern world? Grizz wants to know so he purposefully gets the Bears lost in the deep forest.

1-9.title: Jean Jacket
1-9.overview: The Bears find a bedazzled jean jacket in a dumpster. It's just about the coolest thing they've ever seen and seems to make the wearer of the jacket extremely lucky. But after the Bears fight over who gets control of the jacket, they have to consider that their denim blessing has become a curse.

1-10.title: Nom Nom
1-10.overview: When Nom Nom shows up on the Bears' doorstep, disheveled and deposed from his spot as cutest internet star ever after a recent meltdown, he enlists the Bears to help him regain his title.

1-11.title: Shush Ninjas
1-11.overview: The Bears are fed up with the decay of etiquette at today's theaters. Aren't you? The Bears take it upon themselves to be the police of the theater sneaking up like ninjas to shush people who ruin the movie for others with their bad manners.

1-12.title: My Clique
1-12.overview: Chloe, a child prodigy, finds it difficult to connect with her much older classmates. The Bears take her under their wing showing her how to make great college friends.

1-13.title: Charlie
1-13.overview: You know that one annoying friend who just can't get the hint? That's Charlie, and he's Bigfoot. The Bears meet him when Charlie signs up on a home-sharing website to spend a weekend with the Bears. Charlie is the worst possible house guest for the Bears and nearly destroys their house.

1-14.title: Brother Up
1-14.overview: After Panda stumbles and accidentally scares a pack of wolves away in the process, the hierarchy of the Bears is disrupted. Suddenly, Panda has become the alpha bear, and he and Grizz have to deal with the consequences of an emotional Panda being the leader of the three Bears.

1-15.title: Occupy Bears
1-15.overview: When the city plans to destroy the Bears' cave in order to make way for a new cell phone tower, Grizz and Panda must find evidence from their past that proves they have rights to their land. And in case that fails, Ice Bear protests and tries to sabotage the construction crew.

1-16.title: Panda's Sneeze
1-16.overview: Panda bears have a very adorable (and violent!) sneeze, and our Panda is no exception. When a Vine video of his very cute sneeze goes viral, Panda becomes a "cute" sensation, which causes Nom Nom to try to fend off of this new challenger to his throne.

1-17.title: The Road
1-17.overview: This episode takes place when the Bears are young cubs! The three bears, on their way through the desert, come upon a giant warehouse. It's like an Amazon fulfillment center. The Bears try to make this box-filled paradise their home.

1-18.title: Emergency
1-18.overview: When Grizz comes home with a live crab, he thinks it can become a pet for the brothers to share. However, after the crab pinches Ice Bear's ear and won't let go, Panda and Grizz have to get their injured brother to the hospital, and fast!

1-19.title: Tote Life
1-19.overview: When a hipster grocery store clerk shames the Bears for asking for plastic grocery bags, the Bears realize that eco-friendly tote bags are their way of gaining acceptance amongst the progressive people of the Bay Area. But in their effort to gain popularity, the Bears let the culture of tote bags take over their lives.

1-20.title: Charlie and the Snake
1-20.overview: Charlie is a solo guy who, like the Bears, would love to find a place for himself in the world. In an effort to do so, Charlie throws a party, but ends up going on an adventure with the unlikeliest of animals, a wild snake.

1-21.title: Video Date
1-21.overview: Panda is an avid e-dater, and when a lovely French woman matches with him and agrees to a video chat date, Panda and his brothers engineer the situation so Panda is able to show the best side of himself on the video chat, even if that side of him is completely exaggerated.

1-22.title: Pet Shop
1-22.overview: Pet Shop tells the tale of where the Baby Bears once lived, and after a run-in with a video crew shooting a Sarah McLachlan-type animal adoption video, almost seized an opportunity to find a home separated from each other.

1-23.title: Chloe and Ice Bear
1-23.overview: On a day out with just Ice Bear, Chloe realizes Ice Bear only runs errands for his brothers. Determined to show him a fun day in the city, Chloe promises to help Ice Bear have a good time, even if it means staying in a museum after it closes.

1-24.title: Cupcake Job
1-24.overview: When the Bears' beloved laptop breaks, they finally have the need to do something they've never done before: get jobs. Working at a trendy cupcake shop, the Bears find that the working world is much tougher than they realized.

1-25.title: Hibernation
1-25.overview: Grizz drives his brothers crazy preparing for winter hibernation.

2-1.title: Charlie Ball
2-1.overview: After Panda gets injured on the basketball court, the Bears invite Charlie to be on their basketball team. But when Charlie gets too good, he starts to ruin all the fun of the game.

2-2.title: Yard Sale
2-2.overview: Each of the Bears get offbeat items at a local yard sale. Their new possessions send them on their own separate adventures.

2-3.title: Slumber Party
2-3.overview: A thunderstorm forces Chloe to spend the night at the Cave with the Bears. When Chloe's parents tell the Bears to protect Chloe, they take the task a bit too seriously.

2-4.title: Bear Cleanse
2-4.overview: A doctor tells the Bears to go on a cleanse to improve their health. But when Grizz realizes he can only eat what grizzly bears eat, he starts to lose his mind.

2-5.title: Nom Nom's Entourage
2-5.overview: Nom Nom recruits the Bears to act as his entourage of friends. But when the Bears realize Nom Nom doesn't understand friendship, they decide to kick their day of bonding into high gear.

2-6.title: Ranger Tabes
2-6.overview: To recover a missing package, the Bears get help from Ranger Tabes, an eccentric forest ranger. But her overblown sense of justice might be too much for the Bears to handle.

2-7.title: Rooms
2-7.overview: The Bears switch bedrooms for the night and get a glimpse of the living space of one of their brothers. But the deeper they go, hidden secrets are revealed.

2-8.title: Losing Ice
2-8.overview: Feeling unappreciated, Ice Bear leaves his brothers to be the chef of a restaurant. Desperate to fill the void, Grizz and Panda look for Ice Bear's replacement.

2-9.title: Cellie
2-9.overview: Fed up with sharing, Panda forbids his brothers from using his cellphone any longer. But when the brothers get their own super advanced smartphones, Panda starts to succumb to crippling jealousy.

2-10.title: Fashion Bears
2-10.overview: In order to abide by the clothing policy of their favorite Boba shop, the Bears get some new outfits. But with new looks come new lives including office work, fashion modeling and even falling in love!

2-11.title: The Island
2-11.overview: While trying to sail to Japan, the Baby Bears get stranded on an island. Luckily, they meet Dave and Karla, who help with survival on the island while looking for an escape.

2-12.title: Bear Flu
2-12.overview: The Bears become terribly ill and Chloe takes it upon herself to take care of them. But things get tricky when word of the Bears' sickness goes viral.

2-13.title: Chicken and Waffles
2-13.overview: Panda needs to meet his brothers at the most exclusive restaurant in town. But when he loses his contacts lenses and can't see, Panda needs Charlie's help to get him into the city.

2-14.title: The Audition
2-14.overview: The Bears audition to be the next mascot for their favorite cereal. They get so caught up in the process that their competitiveness gets the best of them.

2-15.title: Captain Craboo
2-15.overview: The Bears are reunited with their pet crab, Captain Craboo. But after an unfortunate run-in with Nom Nom, the Bears may lose their pet forever.

2-16.title: Baby Bears on a Plane
2-16.overview: The Baby Bears have an adventure in the sky while aboard a plane to Sweden. But when the baby Bears are forced to sit in different sections of the plan, things get a bit haywire for everyone on board.

2-17.title: Yuri and the Bear
2-17.overview: Baby Ice Bear lives alone in the arctic and meets a mysterious man named Yuri. Together they help each other survive the cold environment.

2-18.title: Icy Nights
2-18.overview: Ice Bear rides his custom vacuum into the city. But when a gang of techies steal the vacuum, Ice Bear goes on a rescue mission that takes him through the underground world of the city.

2-19.title: Everyone's Tube
2-19.overview: Through a standard video browsing session online, we get a glimpse of the different kinds of videos the Bears have posted.

2-20.title: Creature Mysteries
2-20.overview: Ranger Tabes tells the Bears she's been investigating a mysterious creature. But when the Bears realize she's actually investigating their friend Charlie, they split up to ensure Charlie's safety.

2-21.title: The Library
2-21.overview: The Bears find Chloe in the library exhausted from studying for an exam all day. The Bears stay to help Chloe study but make things worse in the process.

2-22.title: Grizz Helps
2-22.overview: When his brothers don't need his help for the day, Grizz leaves the cave to assist anyone he can throughout the city.

2-23.title: Christmas Parties
2-23.overview: The Bears have been invited to all their friends' Christmas parties. In an effort to have time to crash Nom Nom's huge star-studded bash, the Bears first try to make quick stops at all their friends' parties throughout the night.

3-1.title: Grizzly the Movie
3-1.overview: Grizz gets cast in a movie about a Grizzly Bear! But Grizz soon realizes the movie's depiction of grizzly bears is not what he had in mind.

3-2.title: Subway
3-2.overview: The bears become stranded on a subway platform after missing their train, but while waiting, they must recover some lost items.

3-3.title: Anger Management
3-3.overview: In order to appear on a successful kids show, Nom Nom must complete anger management- with Grizz as his therapist.

3-4.title: Panda's Friend
3-4.overview: Panda uses an app to find a friend with whom he has more in common, but things take a turn for the worse when the new friend gets too possessive.

3-5.overview: The baby bears' dreams come true when they discover a $100 bill; but when they can't bear to spend it, they have difficulty letting go.

3-6.title: Neighbors
3-6.overview: New neighbors set up camp next to the cave. The bears love it at first, but when Grizz overhears them talking about their questionable previous bear encounters, he begins an investigation.

3-7.title: Professor Lampwick
3-7.overview: When Chloe’s professor is too mean to give her any face time to talk over her failing grade, the bears take matters into their own hands by kidnapping him. However, this professor turns out to be rather conniving and has the bears turn on each other.

3-8.title: Ralph
3-8.overview: Charlie meets a creature just like him named Ralph (voiced by John DiMaggio) and befriends him, but Ralph turns out to be a cruel prankster which troubles the bears.

3-9.title: Planet Bears
3-9.overview: In a BBC-style nature documentary, an omniscient narrator covers the bears' morning when they run out of food and must head to the grocery store.

3-10.title: Coffee Cave
3-10.overview: When they learn that Ice Bear is a talented barista, the bears turn the cave into a popular coffee shop. However, things go awry when in order to keep up their coffee's quality, Grizz and Panda give Ice Bear some caffeine despite his warnings.

3-11.title: Charlie's Big Foot
3-11.overview: When Charlie hurts his foot while trying to adjust the bears' satellite dish, the bears must sneak him into a hospital for medical assistance.

3-12.title: The Demon
3-12.overview: While playing with a potato gun, Chloe and Ice Bear lose her prized hoodie to the dog, nicknamed The Demon, next door so they set out on a mission to retrieve it.

3-13.title: Panda's Art
3-13.overview: For his community college art project, Panda is inspired to paint a picture of Charlie. Panda gives the painting to Charlie, but when he is offered a chance to showcase his art, Panda must get the painting back.

3-14.title: Poppy Rangers
3-14.overview: Ranger Tabes leads a troop of young girls into a cave expedition, and brings Grizz as their cave expert. However, things get intense when Tabes and Grizz butt heads.

3-15.title: Lucy's Brother
3-15.overview: While Grizz and Ice Bear help Lucy with her deliveries, Panda tries to impress Lucy by taking care of her allergic younger brother, Clifford.

3-16.title: The Fair
3-16.overview: The baby bears become prizes for a carnival game in hopes of being won and taken to a new home, but the game owner will do anything to keep the Bears from leaving.

3-17.title: Private Lake
3-17.overview: When the local lake is overcrowded with tourists, the Bears have fun at Charlie’s private lake. However, trouble rises when the Bears mistakenly make its presence known on social media.

3-18.title: Lunch with Tabes
3-18.overview: The Bears have lunch with Ranger Tabes, but when Tabes's lunch gets stolen, Tabes goes into full on detective mode to find the culprit.

3-19.title: Road Trip
3-19.overview: Chloe and the Bears take a road trip to see a meteor shower. Ice Bear, the only one licensed to drive, is put in charge, which becomes harder than he thought, especially when they pick up a hitchhiker.

3-20.title: Summer Love
3-20.overview: Panda goes on a mission to return a lost phone to the girl of his dreams and encounters various obstacles along the way including the Mad Scientist from "Grizz Helps".

3-21.title: The Kitty
3-21.overview: The Bears encounter a kitten that they decide to adopt and name Thunderbolt, however they quickly discover that the kitten is actually a cougar cub and that its cougar family have made themselves at home in the cave.

3-22.title: Crowbar Jones
3-22.overview: Grizz screens an epic amateur movie he just made for a focus group, but when he notices people and animals are leaving he must figure out ways to keep the audience engaged.

3-23.title: Kyle
3-23.overview: After talking about his lost family on a talk show, Nom Nom is met with another Koala named Kyle who claims to be his brother. However, Nom Nom's bodyguard begins to have his suspicions.

3-24.title: Citizen Tabes
3-24.overview: After Ranger Tabes accidentally breaks a deer's antler, she quits her job and turns to an online craft service, the Bears do what they can to coax her out of retirement when they realize nature's not the same without her.

3-25.title: Dance Lessons
3-25.overview: Panda volunteers to be Lucy's partner for a dance contest to win a produce truck. But Panda doesn't have the heart to tell Lucy that she's a terrible dancer. His attempts to forfeit the contest soon hurt his friend’s feelings.

3-26.title: Icy Nights II
3-26.overview: Ice Bear gets a sinister message from Barry (from "Icy Nights") and must rescue his friend Yana. He falls into a trap and both he and Yana must escape.

3-27.title: Dog Hotel
3-27.overview: While their cave gets fumigated for a cockroach infestation, the Bears check into the Waggington Dog Hotel for the night. Panda and Ice Bear leave due to disliking the hotel's rules, but Grizzly wants to stay. When he gets mistaken for a rabid dog, his brothers must save him.

3-28.title: Bear Lift
3-28.overview: To raise money to save Darrell's store, the Bears use the stack as a taxi through a ride share app, eventually they run into Darrell's landlord and the Bears must outrun him before the landlord gets to Darrell's store and tears it down.

3-29.title: The Nom Nom Show
3-29.overview: During Nom Nom's new TV show, all his special guests end up unable to appear, so Nom Nom hires the Bears as the replacements, but each act gets ruined by their antics.

3-30.title: Ice Cave
3-30.overview: After being excluded from a board game with the Bears and Charlie because of his additude, Ralph takes over the Bear's cave overnight and turns it into a snowy fortress where he reigns as king over everybody.

3-31.title: Spa Day
3-31.overview: The Bears have a relaxing day at the spa. Grizz tries to get everything the spa has to offer, Panda gets trapped in the steam room with an old man, and Ice Bear plays ping pong.

3-32.title: Charlie's Halloween Thing
3-32.overview: Charlie tells a group of trick or treaters two scary stories for Halloween: The Bears buy three dolls that look like them that come to life and try to murder them and Grizz accidentally bites Chloe who slowly transforms into a werebear.

3-33.title: Bunnies
3-33.overview: While the baby bears are on their way to the Denver Chocolate Fest, they encounter a burrow of bunnies who are constantly under attack by crows. Grizz and Ice Bear want to help them, but Panda is determined to get to the festival.

3-34.title: Pigeons
3-34.overview: Grizz befriends a single footed pigeon named Brenda and her friends. When they ask him to help break out more of their pigeon brethren, Grizz is willing to help, only to discover that her fellow pigeons are the pigeon cartel from "Our Stuff".

3-35.title: Panda 2
3-35.overview: Baby Panda happily lives in a closed off environment for study. But when he's given a new friend, Panda 2, his worldview is shaken, which sets him off on a great adventure.

3-36.title: Tubin
3-36.overview: In search of some adventure, the Bears ride a tube down a dangerous river.

3-37.title: Lazer Royale
3-37.overview: The Baby Bears sign up for a game of laser tag, hoping to win some ice cream. But, the round of laser tag turns out to be less of a game and more like a war zone.

3-38.title: Ranger Games
3-38.overview: Ranger Tabes once again leads the Poppy Rangers in a kick ball tournament against their rivals Ranger Jao and the Ivy Rangers. Grizz comes along as a cheerleader, but when Wallace hurts her ankle he gets promoted to player.

3-39.title: The Perfect Tree
3-39.overview: Chloe and Ice Bear drive up north to find the perfect Christmas tree and while looking for one, they stumble upon a wild turkey while Grizz and Panda are left in charge to decorate Chloe’s house but have a lot of trouble.

3-40.title: Bearz II Men
3-40.overview: The Baby Bears help a teenager named Nate accomplish his dream of being a famous singer, but when he wants to enter a talent show and can only enter with the accompany of a guardian, the Baby Bears disguise themselves as Nate’s father.

3-41.title: Bro Brawl
3-41.overview: The Bears participate in a brother-themed game show against Panda's BFF, Tom and his roommates Griff and Isaac for a brand new luxury apartment, but when Panda hears that Tom can’t afford his current apartment anymore and that him and his roommates might split up, Panda might have to sacrifice the game.

3-42.title: Hurricane Hal
3-42.overview: Professor Lampwick covers how everything is connected to the Bears when a hurricane rolls in. When the Bears are in three different locations, Grizz looks after Ranger Tabes' Poppy Rangers, Panda is stuck with Charlie in his car in the forest, and Chloe and Ice Bear are in the Bay Area seeking a ride home.

3-43.title: Vacation
3-43.overview: Nom Nom's stress levels spike due to an unexpected resurgence in his popularity. At the suggestion of his doctor, Nom Nom decides to take a vacation at a eucalyptus spa. His doctor assigns Grizz as his "comfort pet", who must protect him from his ravid fans or else his stress levels will cause him to die.

3-44.title: Beehive
3-44.overview: The Bears and Ranger Tabes find a beehive. When Tabes leaves so she can remove it safely, the Bears taste the honey and become entranced. They turn their cave into a large beehive and start serving the queen bee for more honey forcing Tabes to come to their rescue in removing the hive.

3-45.title: The Park
3-45.overview: The Bears spend a day at the park. Grizz works out, but has his bag stolen by someone, Panda attempts to sell his artwork and gets picked up by a police officer on a horse and Ice Bear trains some kids at a playground his martial arts knowledge.

3-46.title: I am Ice Bear
3-46.overview: After Ice Bear hits his head, he suddenly takes on a more social, talkative and "cooler" personality which pleases Grizz and Panda, but when he begins to abandon them and become a jerk, they must find a way to turn their brother back to normal.

3-47.title: Baby Bears Can't Jump
3-47.overview: In order to win a pizza, the Baby Bears play basketball against a ragtag gang of kids. They end up getting help in the form of a Charles Barkley card who teaches them teamwork and in the process, the Bears learn their signature "Bearstack".

4-1.title: Go Fish
4-1.overview: While on a fishing trip, the Bears get attacked by a giant legendary fish.

4-2.title: Teacher's Pet
4-2.overview: The Bears win a tour of the infamous Googs corporate headquarters.

4-3.title: Googs
4-3.overview: The Bears win a tour of the infamous Googs corporate headquarters.

4-4.title: Paperboyz
4-4.overview: The Baby Bears get jobs as paper boys.

4-5.title: Bear Squad
4-5.overview: Tabes deputizes the Bears so they can go to the city and catch a thief.

4-6.title: Lil' Squid
4-6.overview: The Baby Bears build a submarine and explore the depths of an aquarium so they can bring a lost squid to its family.

4-7.title: I, Butler
4-7.overview: The Bears use a robot bear to help around the house. But things get tricky when they lose control of the robot.

4-8.title: Family Troubles
4-8.overview: Baby Grizz lives on the set of a sitcom in which he stars. But when a cooler kid joins the cast, Grizz feels threatened.

4-9.title: Best Bears
4-9.overview: The Bears must complete their Best-Man duties on the day of Darrell's wedding.

4-10.title: Crowbar Jones: Origins
4-10.overview: Grizz pitches his Crowbar Jones prequel film to Nom Nom, hoping Nom Nom will agree to appear in the movie.

4-11.title: Hot Sauce
4-11.overview: A quest for their favorite hot sauce causes the Bears to get involved with a sting operation.

4-12.title: Mom App
4-12.overview: Hoping to finally get the mom-experience, the Bears use an app that'll bring a mom right to their door.

4-13.title: The Limo
4-13.overview: To help distract Panda from his girl problems, Grizz and Ice Bear treat him to a ride in a limo.

4-14.title: More Everyone's Tube
4-14.overview: Through another video browsing session online, we get more videos uploaded by the Bears and their friends.

4-15.title: Money Man
4-15.overview: The Bears help Chloe present her project for a college science contest, but Chloe’s rival makes things difficult.

4-16.title: Rescue Ranger
4-16.overview: Tabes helps the Bears rescue Charlie after a villainous game hunter captures him.

4-17.title: El Oso
4-17.overview: In a flashback to long ago, Charlie has an adventure in the Mexican desert.

4-19.title: Escandalosos
4-19.overview: The Baby Bears enter a Mexican wrestling tournament.

4-20.title: Pizza Band
4-20.overview: The Bears get pizza at Papa Bear's Pizza Cave and wind up replacing the place's animatronic band. They're such a hit that they go on tour!

4-21.title: Adopted
4-21.overview: The Baby Bears get adopted by an eccentric millionaire and get to live in his mansion.

4-22.title: Wingmen
4-22.overview: In order to get some sleep, the Bears help an annoying bird find a new mate.

4-23.title: Braces
4-23.overview: When the Bears go to the dentist, Panda gets braces. But, Panda finds out his braces grant him super abilities and the power goes to his head.

4-24.title: Christmas Movies
4-24.overview: On Christmas Eve, the Baby Bears defend a video store from getting robbed.

4-25.title: Imaginary Friend
4-25.overview: The Baby Bears invent an imaginary friend, but the trouble he causes is all too real.

4-26.title: The Mall
4-26.overview: The Bears go the mall and encounter their human counterparts.

4-27.title: Tunnels
4-27.overview: The Bears discover a network of tunnels underneath the cave. Are they prepared to discover where they lead to and who dug them?

4-28.title: Ramen
4-28.overview: The Baby Bears help a struggling ramen chef perfect her ramen and save her shop.

4-29.title: The Gym
4-29.overview: At the suggestion of a member, the Bears decide to go to Mystique Physique Gym in see if they are "gym material". Grizz takes part in rock wall climbing only to be outdone by a child, Panda takes up virtual biking that goes from calm to terrifying and Ice Bear takes a tai-chi class where he goes up against some intimidating old ladies.

4-30.title: Bubble
4-30.overview: After watching a horror movie called Germs, Panda becomes a severe germaphobe. To solve the problem, he purchases a bubble for him to maneuver around in. Grizz and Ice Bear become annoyed, especially when he starts acting rude towards Charlie, but when Panda gets stuck in a waste dump and unable to escape, Charlie risks everything to save him.

4-31.title: Baby Orphan Ninja Bears
4-31.overview: While navigating the New York City sewers, the Baby Bears encounter ninja master Cheddar (Dante Basco) who must stop the Boot Crew, lead by his former ally Slice (Greg Chun), from causing mayhem in the city. The Baby Bears decide to become his pupils and learn the ways of the ninja while also having to deal with an alligator in the sewers.

4-32.title: Fire!
4-32.overview: While enjoying some picnickers' cooking, a small fire accidentally is set in a bush. Grizz uses his quick thinking to put it out and is made an honorary fire marshal by the local fire department. Grizz soon becomes obsessed with putting out fires and in his manic haste ends up starting one by accident at a local fish diner.

4-33.title: Ranger Norm
4-33.overview: Tabes, Martinez and Kirk leave for RangerCon, leaving the Bears with Ranger Norm (Rob Huebel). Norm comes off as nice though the Bears already detest him. When they finally decide to apologize for acting coldly towards him, Norm reveals himself to be an agent for the wealthy to tear down the forest for a golf course.

4-34.title: Shmorby
4-34.overview: The Bears get a home assistance device from Googs, due to the events of the titular episode, in the form of Shmorby who fulfills all of their home needs. However, this ends up making the Bears incredibly lazy and they become large and fat. Shmorby becomes tiresome of having to take care of them and leaves when they end up needing him most.

4-35.title: Snake Babies
4-35.overview: While the Bears are playing "corn hole", a visit from Charlie results in him finding six snake eggs. When they hatch, Charlie adopts them as his own and tries to raise them as a single parent. This ends up being more difficult as the Bears think he is unfit and the baby snakes end up tiring Charlie out.

4-36.title: Sandcastle
4-36.overview: The Baby Bears find themselves at the beach and decide to build a luxurious sandcastle as their new home. Panda falls in love for the first time with a girl named Darla (Vivienne Rutherford) who takes an interest in their home, but soon they have to protect it from her vengeful older sisters and cousins who have come to take Darla back.

4-37.title: Bros in the City
4-37.overview: The Bears join the Bros on the hit reality show Bros in the City. Panda tries to win the affection of their neighbor Nina (Christine Marie Cabanos) who grows close to Tom, Griff and Grizz try to dominate as the "Alpha Bro", and Isaac and Ice Bear come across the perfect stove and try to get it into the apartment.

4-38.title: Cousin Jon
4-38.overview: The Bears get invited to Chloe's Park Family Reunion where they are warned about her Cousin Jon, a sinister prankster who always gets away with his jokes. After the Bears suffer a series of pranks firsthand, they decide to up the ante by getting back at Jon and giving him a taste of his own medicine.

4-39.title: Lord of the Poppies
4-39.overview: Grizz, Tabes and the Poppy Rangers head out to an island for their island camping badge. When they forget the lunches, Tabes leaves Grizz in charge while she heads back to the mainland to get food. Grizz, in his usual careless self, misleads the rangers to the point that they become insane savages from hunger and attempt to devour Grizz.

4-40.title: The Mummy's Curse
4-40.overview: As the Baby Bears are walking down a road in the middle of nowhere, a mummy falls out of the back of a truck. The amulet it has says that they will be cursed if they do not return it by midnight, so the Baby Bears must get to the museum as fast as they can. However, a couple of shady figures in hats and coats start following them.

4-41.title: Band of Outsiders
4-41.overview: Following "Yuri and the Bear", Baby Ice Bear finds himself in the lower parts of London, struggling to get food and mourning over the loss of Yuri. He eventually encounters a trio of rebel rousers named Badger, Jo, and Ashley, who like to cause trouble. He joins their gang due to his ability with his axe, but soon things begin to take a turn for the worse.

4-42.title: Tabes & Charlie
4-42.overview: When Kirk goes missing, Tabes leaves the Bears at the ranger station and runs into Charlie. She convinces him to aid in finding her canine friend, but she has to wear a chicken costume to blend in as they enter the "shadier" parts of the woods for information. Meanwhile, the Bears are having trouble helping a couple of hikers when the printer starts going haywire.

4-43.title: Panda's Birthday
4-43.overview: To make Panda's birthday better, Grizzly and Ice Bear take him to the hotel where K-Pop group Monsta X is staying. In their usual antics, Grizzly disguised himself as a bellhop, runs afoul of another bellhop who is hungry for tips, Panda finds himself hanging onto dear life outside the hotel and Ice Bear tries to protect the group from crazy fans.

317004.name: Yuri!!! on Ice
317004.overview: While on the verge of retirement, skater Yuri Katsuki meets Yuri Plisetsky and Victor Nikiforov, two skaters who rekindle his competitive fire.

0-1.title: Welcome to The Madness
0-1.overview: A special included with the 6th DVD/BD volume of Yuri!!! on ICE. It focuses on an exhibition routine performed by Yuri Plisetsky.

1-1.title: Easy as Pirozhki!! The Grand Prix Final of Tears
1-1.overview: Katsuki Yuuri is at a crossroads after suffering a miserable defeat at the Grand Prix Finals. Uncertain whether to retire or to continue, Yuuri holes up in his family home. However, a chance circumstance causes him to catch the eye of five-time world champion Victor Nikiforov...

1-2.title: Two Yuris?! Drama at Yu-topia
1-2.overview: Out of nowhere, five-time world champion Victor Nikiforov declares himself Yuuri's coach. When world junior champion Yuri Plisetsky follows Victor to Hasetsu so that he can bring Victor back to Russia, the chaos only deepens...

1-3.title: I Am Eros, and Eros is Me?! Face-Off! Hot Springs on Ice
1-3.overview: The two Yuris are to face off in Hot Springs on Ice. where they will each debut a short program choreographed by Victor—one to Eros, and one to Agape. Victor claims he will do whatever the winner wants, but...

1-4.title: Love Yourself...Achieved!! The Free Program
1-4.overview: The two Yuris begin to choreograph their free skate programs at their respective rinks. In Japan, Yuuri feels hesitant to pursue what it means to be uniquely him, but he begins to untangle his past by talking to Victor.

1-5.title: Face Beet-Red!! It's the First Competition! The Chugoku, Shikoku, and Kyushu Championship
1-5.overview: It is time for Yuuri's first competition of the season, but Victor's the center of attention as his first competition as a coach. Already anxious, Yuri's nerves don't get a break when Minami Kenjirou, the skater who beat Yuri at last year's nationals, confronts him...

1-6.title: China's On! The Grand Prix Series Opening Event!! The Cup of China Short Program
1-6.overview: The Cup of China, a Grand Prix Series event, is here! Realizing that he is the man who took Victor from the world, Yuuri gets worked up before his performance. Victor is concerned to see Yuuri this way for the first time...

1-7.title: China's On! The Grand Prix Series Opening Event!! The Cup of China Free Skate
1-7.overview: Having finished the short program in first place—a first-time feat—Yuuri falters under the massive pressure. Can his fragile heart withstand Victor's roughshod intervention?

1-8.title: Yuri vs Yuri! The Horror!! Rostelecom Cup, Short Program
1-8.overview: Yuuri is determined to show his love to all of Russia in the Rostelecom Cup, the final event of the Grand Prix Series. In contrast, Yurio feels bogged down by his ties to Moscow, and tries to shrug them off. Before them, however, rises JJ, a rising star from North America...

1-9.title: Yuri vs Yuri! The Horror!! Rostelecom Cup, Free Skate
1-9.overview: Katsuki Yuuri has already obtained "love." With Victor's fading warmth in his heart, Yuri goes out to the rink for his free skate that will determine whether he'll qualify for the Grand Prix Final. Yurio firms his own resolve after eating special pirozhki, the epitome of love in Moscow.

1-10.title: Gotta Supercharge it! Pre-Grand Prix Final Special!
1-10.overview: Barcelona is where the fated final battle will take place. Sightseeing during their free time, Victor is oblivious to Yuuri's resolve. Then, a chance remark reveals a nightmarish event at the banquet last year for Yuuri...

1-11.title: Gotta Super-Supercharge It!! Grand Prix Final Short Program
1-11.overview: Now armed with the light of love on his finger along with Victor, Yuuri goes for the gold in the Grand Prix Final as the chosen six competitors clash in the short program.

1-12.title: Gotta Super-Super-Supercharge It!! Grand Prix Final Free Skate
1-12.overview: "Let's end this." Yuri's words trigger a debate that results in Yuri appearing at the free skate event in his worst condition ever. Can Yuri succeed in skating a program with the highest technical difficulty at their last event together to show the world the love he shares with Victor? What will each conclude once the program is over and it is time to decide their paths after the Grand Prix Final?

325047.name: Ernest and Célestine, The Collection
325047.overview: The adventures of a big offbeat bear and a mischievous mouse.

similar.name: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball

1-24.title: The Blizzard
1-24.overview: As Ernest prepares to hibernate, Celestine goes in search of the perfect ingredients to make him a batch of yummy cookies.

2-8.title: The Return of the Beast from the Lake

326288.name: Manhunt
326288.overview: Inspired by actual events, this true crime anthology series takes a deep dive into the dark, twisted minds of terrorists and follows the brave souls who hunt them down.

1-1.title: UNABOM
