1-1.overview: In 1995, FBI profiler Jim "Fitz" Fitzgerald joins the Unabom Task Force. Fitz recommends new methods of profiling but finds no allies among the agents in charge. In 1997, Fitz is tasked with confronting Ted Kaczynski, the Unabomber.

1-2.title: Pure Wudder
1-2.overview: When the elusive Unabomber threatens to blow up a jetliner, Fitz must determine if the threat is real.  In 1997, Fitz confronts Ted for the first time.

1-3.title: Fruit of the Poisonous Tree
1-3.overview: Linguist Natalie Rogers helps Fitz find clues about the Unabomber's identity in the Manifesto, but their findings face skepticism at the UTF. In 1997, Ted claims he can invalidate all of the evidence against him.

1-4.title: Publish or Perish
1-4.overview: The Unabomber will stop bombing if his Manifesto is published. Fitz pushes for publication with S.A.C. Ackerman, who presents Fitz's argument to Attorney General Janet Reno.

1-5.title: Abri
1-5.overview: Fitz receives linguistic proof that Ted is the Unabomber. He tracks down Ted's brother David, who is astonished at the accuracy of Fitz's profile.

1-6.title: Ted
1-6.overview: In a letter to his brother, Ted recounts the key events from his past that informed his decision to engage in terrorist activities.

1-7.title: Lincoln
1-7.overview: Fitz races to find a linguistic connection that will secure an arrest warrant while the FBI closes in on Ted's cabin in Montana.

1-8.title: USA vs. Theodore J. Kaczynski
1-8.overview: When Ted fails to have the evidence against him invalidated, Fitz makes one last appeal to him to plead guilty.

2-1.title: Centbom
2-1.overview: Security guard Richard Jewell saves hundreds of lives when he discovers a bomb at the 1996 Atlanta Olympics. But his heroic act quickly comes under the scrutiny of law enforcement as pressure mounts to catch the killer.

2-2.title: Unabubba
2-2.overview: When the media gets wind of the FBI's "hero-bomber" theory, a media firestorm erupts, engulfing Richard and his family. Meanwhile, ATF agents raise doubts as bombings continue.

2-3.title: Bombingham
2-3.overview: While Richard fights back against the FBI and the media, ATF Agent Embry investigates a serial bomber terrorizing the Southeast and discovers a crucial link to the Olympic bomb.

2-4.title: Run Rudolph Run
2-4.overview: The FBI identifies serial bomber Eric Rudolph and gives chase, but Eric escapes into the forest. Richard and Watson discover powerful evidence that could exonerate Richard and contemplate turning to the press for help.

2-5.title: Land of the Noonday Sun
2-5.overview: The FBI search for Eric spins out of control as anti-government locals and Eric's family push back. Meanwhile, Richard must confront his inner demons as he prepares for a pivotal press conference.

2-6.title: Army of God
2-6.overview: Viewing him as a freedom fighter under siege, local militias rally around Eric and attack the FBI. As Embry continues to investigate, he learns that Eric is not who he claims to be.

2-7.title: Eric
2-7.overview: Eric manipulates locals, militia, and FBI alike as he plans a major counterattack. Meanwhile, Richard appears on "60 Minutes" in a high-stakes gamble to save his reputation once and for all.

2-8.title: Join or Die
2-8.overview: FBI agent Brennan realizes he needs to change course radically to catch Eric and allies with Embry to do so. In Atlanta, Kathy Scruggs comes face to face with Richard for the first time ever.

2-9.title: Don't Tread on Me
2-9.overview: Risking everything, Brennan and Embry appeal to a powerful local militia leader with the truth about Eric, and a call for unity and moral courage.

2-10.title: Open Season
2-10.overview: Eric, starving and bereft of allies, is finally captured. But as his day in court—and Richard's exoneration—approaches, he has another dangerous secret in store for law enforcement.

328708.name: MINDHUNTER
328708.overview: An agent in the FBI's Elite Serial Crime Unit develops profiling techniques as he pursues notorious serial killers and rapists.

1-1.title: Episode 1
1-1.overview: In 1977, frustrated FBI hostage negotiator Holden Ford finds an unlikely ally in veteran agent Bill Tench and begins studying a new class of murderer.

1-2.title: Episode 2
1-2.overview: Holden interviews the eerily articulate murderer Ed Kemper, but his research provokes negative feedback at the Bureau.

1-3.title: Episode 3
1-3.overview: Dr. Wendy Carr joins Holden and Tench in their first success, when their insights lead to an arrest.

1-4.title: Episode 4
1-4.overview: Bill and Holden consult with Dr. Wendy Carr to begin classifying their subjects. They receive surprising news.

1-5.title: Episode 5
1-5.overview: Holden and Bill return to a perplexing case in Pennsylvania where a set of clues leading in multiple directions leaves no shortage of suspects.

1-6.title: Episode 6
1-6.overview: Wendy considers an offer. Holden and Bill struggle to communicate the meaning of their findings to the judicial system in the baffling Altoona case.

1-7.title: Episode 7
1-7.overview: Wendy takes a career risk to relocate and join the team full time. Holden and Bill find it harder to keep the emotional intensity of work at bay.

1-8.title: Episode 8
1-8.overview: Bill and Wendy interview candidates for a fourth member of the team. Holden is intrigued by complaints about a school principal's odd habit.

1-9.title: Episode 9
1-9.overview: Holden's methods during a disturbing interview with mass murderer Richard Speck create dissension among the team and kick off an internal FBI probe.

1-10.title: Episode 10
1-10.overview: The team cracks under pressure from an in-house review. Holden's bold style elicits a confession but puts his career, relationships and health at risk.

2-1.title: Episode 1
2-1.overview: Amid sweeping changes at the BSU, Holden deals with severe repercussions from his close encounter with Ed Kemper.

2-2.title: Episode 2
2-2.overview: To glean insight into the elusive BTK killer, Bill and Holden interview the Son of Sam, who makes a startling admission.

2-3.title: Episode 3
2-3.overview: Bill gets drawn into a horrifying crime that hits close to home. Holden receives an intriguing offer while in Atlanta to interview a pair of killers.

2-4.title: Episode 4
2-4.overview: Holden develops a controversial profile in the Atlanta slayings. Wendy conducts her first interview and finds being on the front lines suits her well.

2-5.title: Episode 5
2-5.overview: Bill's devastating family situation spills over during his interview with Holden's holy-grail subject: Charles Manson. Wendy's new romance heats up.

2-6.title: Episode 6
2-6.overview: The FBI officially sends the BSU to Atlanta to investigate the missing and murdered children. Wendy second-guesses her interview methods.

2-7.title: Episode 7
2-7.overview: Hitting a dead end, Holden suggests a bold plan to draw the killer out. Bill's family faces more scrutiny. Wendy chafes as her job begins to shift.

2-8.title: Episode 8
2-8.overview: Red tape hinders Holden's plan to narrow his suspect pool. A weary and heartsick Bill tries to connect with his son. Wendy rethinks her relationship.

2-9.title: Episode 9
2-9.overview: The investigation zeroes in on a prime suspect who proves surprisingly adept at manipulating a volatile situation to his advantage.

328724.name: Young Sheldon
328724.overview: The early life of child genius Sheldon Cooper, later seen in The Big Bang Theory.

0-1.title: An Origin Story
0-1.overview: Cast and creators share how this show not only explores the backstory of one of television's funniest characters but also his wonderfully hilarious family that helped make Sheldon, well, Sheldon..

0-2.title: Sibling Revelry
0-2.overview: Iain Armitage (Sheldon), Raegan Revord (Missy), and Montana Jordan (Georgie) sit down together and discuss the fun of being a part of the show playing siblings and their favourite moments from Season One.

0-3.title: The Coopers, East Texas, and the 80's
0-3.overview: Join the show's cast and design team as they share the processes involved in crafting the look of 1980's Texas and how the period plays an essential storytelling role.

0-4.title: Time Flies When You're Having Fun: Young Sheldon at 100
0-4.overview: The cast and crew look back at the series after 100 episodes.

0-5.title: Sheldon's Secret Origins and Easter Eggs
0-5.overview: A behind the scenes look at the series included with the Blu-ray release of the final season.

1-1.title: Pilot
1-1.overview: 9-year-old Sheldon Cooper is a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science but learns that isn’t always helpful growing up in East Texas, a land where church and football are king.

1-2.title: Rockets, Communists, and the Dewey Decimal System
1-2.overview: To appease his worried mother, Sheldon employs the techniques of a self-help book to try and make a friend.

1-3.title: Poker, Faith, and Eggs
1-3.overview: When George Sr. is rushed to the emergency room, Connie comes to babysit, and the kids have an adventure getting to the hospital on their own.

1-4.title: A Therapist, a Comic Book, and a Breakfast Sausage
1-4.overview: After choking on a breakfast sausage, Sheldon wrestles with his fear of solid foods and discovers comic books for the first time.

1-5.title: A Solar Calculator, a Game Ball, and a Cheerleader's Bosom
1-5.overview: Sheldon struggles with newfound popularity after utilizing statistics to help the football team.

1-6.title: A Patch, a Modem, and a Zantac
1-6.overview: When a NASA representative visits Sheldon’s school and dismisses his science, Sheldon is set on a mission to prove him wrong.

1-7.title: A Brisket, Voodoo, and Cannonball Run
1-7.overview: The kids brainstorm ways to resolve a family feud when Connie refuses to give George Sr. her brisket recipe.

1-8.title: Cape Canaveral, Schrödinger's Cat, and Cyndi Lauper's Hair
1-8.overview: While Mary, Connie and Missy have their girls night at the salon, the three Cooper men plan their road trip to see the space launcher, but it doesn't go as well as they plan.

1-9.title: Spock, Kirk, and Testicular Hernia
1-9.overview: George Sr. strikes a deal with Sheldon to tutor Georgie when poor grades threaten to keep him from playing football. While Sheldon's tutoring attempts are ultimately unsuccessful, he does learn some skills from his brother.

1-10.title: An Eagle Feather, a String Bean, and an Eskimo
1-10.overview: When Sheldon moves to Dallas to attend a school for gifted children, the family struggles to cope with his absence.

1-11.title: Demons, Sunday School, and Prime Numbers
1-11.overview: A worried Mary sends Sheldon to Sunday school after she finds him playing Dungeons and Dragons with his friends, Tam and Billy.

1-12.title: A Computer, a Plastic Pony, and a Case of Beer
1-12.overview: Sheldon asks for a computer and unknowingly sparks a heated argument between Mary and George Sr. over the family’s finances.

1-13.title: A Sneeze, Detention, and Sissy Spacek
1-13.overview: When flu season hits Medford, Sheldon takes extreme measures to remain healthy.

1-14.title: Potato Salad, a Broomstick, and Dad's Whiskey
1-14.overview: When Mary takes a job as church secretary, she finds herself becoming Pastor Jeff's marriage counselor. Also, Sheldon and Missy spend their first afternoon home alone.

1-15.title: Dolomite, Apple Slices, and a Mystery Woman
1-15.overview: Sheldon makes friends with an upperclassman who introduces him to a new field of science. Also, Mary and George disagree on how to handle Sheldon's blossoming social life.

1-16.title: Killer Asteroids, Oklahoma, and a Frizzy Hair Machine
1-16.overview: A disappointing loss at the science fair sends Sheldon’s life in a new direction.

1-17.title: Jiu-Jitsu, Bubble Wrap, and Yoo-hoo
1-17.overview: Sheldon is bullied by an unlikely character, and Mary and George disagree on how to handle the situation.

1-18.title: A Mother, A Child, and a Blue Man's Backside
1-18.overview: Mary bans Sheldon from reading a mature comic book. Sheldon decides it's time to stop living under Mary's thumb.

1-19.title: Gluons, Guacamole, and the Color Purple
1-19.overview: When Sheldon is no longer academically challenged at Medford High, he audits a college class taught by Dr. John Sturgis.

1-20.title: A Dog, a Squirrel, and a Fish Named Fish
1-20.overview: A battle erupts between the Coopers and Sparks when the Sparks' new dog terrorizes Sheldon.

1-21.title: Summer Sausage, a Pocket Poncho, and Tony Danza
1-21.overview: While Sheldon is busy keeping tabs on Connie’s budding relationship with Dr. Sturgis, George Sr. and Mary attempt to bond with their other children.

1-22.title: Vanilla Ice Cream, Gentleman Callers, and a Dinette Set
1-22.overview: When Connie is pursued by two gentlemen callers, Sheldon interferes, forcing her to set some ground rules.

2-1.title: A High-Pitched Buzz and Training Wheels
2-1.overview: After Sheldon dismantles the refrigerator to stop an annoying hum, he gets a paper route to pay for the repairs.

2-2.title: A Rival Prodigy and Sir Isaac Neutron
2-2.overview: When Dr. Sturgis bonds with Paige, another 10-year-old genius, Sheldon’s jealousy leads Connie to intervene. Mary invites Paige’s family over for a play date.

2-3.title: A Crisis of Faith and Octopus Aliens
2-3.overview: When Mary’s faith is shaken by a tragedy in the community, Sheldon becomes an unlikely ally.

2-4.title: A Financial Secret and Fish Sauce
2-4.overview: When George Sr. asks Sheldon to keep a secret from Mary, the stress of not being honest drives Sheldon to hideout at Tam’s for his first sleepover.

2-5.title: A Research Study and Czechoslovakian Wedding Pastries
2-5.overview: When Dr. Sturgis recommends Sheldon and Missy for a university research study on twins, Mary is unhappy when the test results go to Sheldon's head.

2-6.title: Seven Deadly Sins and a Small Carl Sagan
2-6.overview: Mary clashes with Sheldon's drama teacher over plans for a Halloween fundraiser for the church. Georgie falls for a rebellious teenage girl whom Sheldon is tutoring.

2-7.title: Carbon Dating and a Stuffed Raccoon
2-7.overview: Sheldon gets into trouble with fellow child genius, Paige at the science museum. George is forced to play therapist to Paige’s bickering parents. Mary, Georgie and Missy help Connie with a garage sale.

2-8.title: An 8-Bit Princess and a Flat Tire Genius
2-8.overview: A video game takes over Sheldon and Connie’s life. George Sr. is jealous when Georgie bonds with Herschel at the auto shop.

2-9.title: Family Dynamics and a Red Fiero
2-9.overview: Sheldon studies his family for a psychology project. Thanksgiving dinner turns into a family fight when George Sr. is offered a job in Oklahoma.

2-10.title: A Stunted Childhood and a Can of Fancy Mixed Nuts
2-10.overview: When Sheldon learns that people with stunted childhoods can turn into social outcasts, he tries to act. Connie and Dr. Sturgis' relationship is tested when she teaches him how to drive.

2-11.title: A Race of Superhumans and a Letter to Alf
2-11.overview: Sheldon experiments on Missy, and Georgie joins Mary’s bible study to spend more time with his crush, Veronica.

2-12.title: A Tummy Ache and a Whale of a Metaphor
2-12.overview: When Sheldon has to spend a few days in the hospital, he turns into the world’s worst patient. Also, Missy gets a taste of what life would be like without her twin.

2-13.title: A Nuclear Reactor and a Boy Called Lovely
2-13.overview: Sheldon attempts to build a nuclear reactor. Also, a university cocktail party gets heated when Dr. Sturgis’ colleague, Dr. Linkletter, flirts with Connie, and Georgie is heartbroken when he learns Veronica has a boyfriend.

2-14.title: David, Goliath and a Yoo-hoo from the Back
2-14.overview: Sheldon uses his new friendship with the school bully to boss Georgie around. Also, Missy steals Connie's makeup for picture day.

2-15.title: A Math Emergency and Perky Palms
2-15.overview: Sheldon and Dr. Sturgis have their first fight when Dr. Sturgis marks a question wrong on Sheldon's test. Also, Mary takes over for Pastor Jeff when he's out sick.

2-16.title: A Loaf of Bread and a Grand Old Flag
2-16.overview: Things spiral out of control when Sheldon boycotts his favorite bread company. Also, Georgie offers Veronica a shoulder to cry on when she's dumped by her boyfriend.

2-17.title: Albert Einstein and the Story of Another Mary
2-17.overview: Inspired by his hero, Albert Einstein, Sheldon tries his hand at the violin. Also, Mary and Connie secretly buy a pregnancy test when Mary thinks she's pregnant

2-18.title: A Perfect Score and a Bunsen Burner Marshmallow
2-18.overview: Sheldon moves in with Dr. Sturgis for the weekend to see what his life will be like in college. Also, a lonely Mary tries to bond with the other Coopers during Sheldon's absence.

2-19.title: A Political Campaign and a Candy Land Cheater
2-19.overview: Unhappy that school funds are going towards football rather than academics, Sheldon decides to run for class president.

2-20.title: A Proposal and a Popsicle Stick Cross
2-20.overview: Georgie is thrilled when Veronica stays at the Coopers' house for a few days. Also, Connie and Dr. Sturgis celebrate their one-year anniversary.

2-21.title: A Broken Heart and a Crock Monster
2-21.overview: The Coopers help Pastor Jeff through a rough patch in his marriage. Also, Sheldon pressures church members for donations when Mary takes him to work for a day.

2-22.title: A Swedish Science Thing and the Equation for Toast
2-22.overview: Sheldon invites the entire school to a party for the Nobel Prize announcements. Also, Connie learns more about Dr. Sturgis' past, and Georgie's desire for cable TV leads to a standoff between him and George Sr.

3-1.title: Quirky Eggheads and Texas Snow Globes
3-1.overview: After Dr. Sturgis experiences a nervous breakdown, Mary worries Sheldon is headed down a similar path. Also, Georgie discovers he has a knack for sales.

3-2.title: A Broom Closet and Satan's Monopoly Board
3-2.overview: Without Dr. Sturgis’ university class, Sheldon must find a new way to stay academically challenged. Also, Mary helps Pastor Jeff avoid temptation with his girlfriend.

3-3.title: An Entrepreneurialist and a Swat on the Bottom
3-3.overview: Sheldon takes matters into his own hands when Connie refuses to drive him to a lecture with Dr. Linkletter. Also, Georgie tries to impress Veronica with his new business venture

3-4.title: Hobbitses, Physicses and a Ball with Zip
3-4.overview: Sheldon is forced to take a break from science when his new obsession with "The Lord of the Rings" leads to an unhealthy habit. Also, Missy asks George Sr. to teach her how to play catch.

3-5.title: A Pineapple and the Bosom of Male Friendship
3-5.overview: After being released from the mental hospital, Dr. Sturgis unexpectedly breaks up with Connie.

3-6.title: A Parasol and a Hell of an Arm
3-6.overview: A church carnival leads Missy to try out for the baseball team. Also, Connie struggles after her breakup with Dr. Sturgis.

3-7.title: Pongo Pygmaeus and a Culture that Encourages Spitting
3-7.overview: Sheldon starts an internet flame war, and Missy stands up to the boys on her baseball team. Also, Connie is unhappy when George Sr. spends time with her new boyfriend.

3-8.title: The Sin of Greed and a Chimichanga from Chi-chi's
3-8.overview: The University makes George Sr. a lucrative job offer in the hopes of recruiting Sheldon. Also, Georgie gets a job working for Connie's new boyfriend, and Mary is determined to rid her home of greed.

3-9.title: A Party Invitation, Football Grapes and an Earth Chicken
3-9.overview: Mary gets Pastor Jeff involved when Sheldon isn't invited to Billy's birthday party. Also, George Sr. has "male-bonding time" with Dr. Sturgis.

3-10.title: Teenager Soup and a Little Ball of Fib
3-10.overview: Sheldon fakes being sick to avoid a swim test at school. Also, Dr. Sturgis spies on Connie's new boyfriend.

3-11.title: A Live Chicken, a Fried Chicken and Holy Matrimony
3-11.overview: George Sr. and Connie struggle to manage the Cooper household while Mary plans Pastor Jeff’s wedding.

3-12.title: Body Glitter and a Mall Safety Kit
3-12.overview: Sheldon learns to listen when an emotional Paige struggles with her parents’ divorce. George Sr. is furious when Georgie tries to buy his way out of chores.

3-13.title: Contracts, Rules and a Little Bit of Pig Brains
3-13.overview: George Sr. and Georgie go camping with Connie's new boyfriend, Dale, but things get complicated when her ex-boyfriend, Dr. Sturgis, tags along. Also, Sheldon and Missy invent a super-game.

3-14.title: A Slump, a Cross and Roadside Gravel
3-14.overview: Sheldon and Georgie mine for platinum in roadside gravel. Mary is concerned when Missy misuses religion to help with a batting slump.

3-15.title: A Boyfriend's Ex-Wife and a Good Luck Head Rub
3-15.overview: Connie meets Dale’s ex-wife, June. Sheldon is forced to work on a group project with reluctant college students.

3-16.title: Pasadena
3-16.overview: Sheldon visits CalTech for the very first time. Also, Georgie is furious when Mary listens in on a phone call with his girlfriend, and Connie tries to cheer up a jealous Missy.

3-17.title: An Academic Crime and a More Romantic Taco Bell
3-17.overview: Dr. Sturgis is furious when Sheldon accuses him of plagiarism. Also, Mary sets out to find a “girl trophy” for Missy’s end-of-season baseball ceremony, and Georgie has an awkward run-in with Veronica while on a date with his new girlfriend, Jana.

3-18.title: A Couple Bruised Ribs and a Cereal Box Ghost Detector
3-18.overview: When George Sr. accidentally lands the school librarian in the hospital, the Cooper family must nurse her back to health. Connie gives Georgie relationship advice.

3-19.title: A House for Sale and Serious Woman Stuff
3-19.overview: When Sheldon learns the house next door is for sale, he takes it upon himself to find the perfect neighbors. Missy is torn when she’s forced to pitch against her boyfriend at the baseball game.

3-20.title: A Baby Tooth and the Egyptian God of Knowledge
3-20.overview: Sheldon has a scientific breakthrough at the dentist's office. Also, Dale and Connie go to the casino, and Georgie makes a big mistake when Dale leaves him in charge of the store

3-21.title: A Secret Letter and a Lowly Disc of Processed Meat
3-21.overview: Sheldon discovers that Mary's been keeping a secret about his future. Also, Connie is furious when she learns Dale fired Georgie.

4-1.title: Graduation
4-1.overview: After graduating high school, Sheldon has a breakdown when he realizes he may not be ready for college. Dale tries to make amends with Connie.

4-2.title: A Docent, A Little Lady and a Bouncer Named Dalton
4-2.overview: Sheldon gets a summer job at the local train museum. Also, George and Missy bond when Missy embarks on a new stage of womanhood, and Georgie discovers Mary's guilty pleasure.

4-3.title: Training Wheels and an Unleashed Chicken
4-3.overview: With college in sight, Sheldon is determined to ride his bike without training wheels. Also, Mary and George Sr. argue over parenting styles.

4-4.title: Bible Camp and a Chariot of Love
4-4.overview: When their mothers force them to attend Vacation Bible School. Also, George is furious after Georgie makes a questionable purchase.

4-5.title: A Musty Crypt and a Stick to Pee On
4-5.overview: Dale and Connie work out relationship issues while playing Dungeons and Dragons with Sheldon and Missy. Also, Mary and George take a trip with Coach Wilkins and his wife, and Georgie freaks out when his girlfriend thinks she's pregnant.

4-6.title: Freshman Orientation and the Inventor of The Zipper
4-6.overview: College orientation does not go as Sheldon planned. Also, Mary is invited to a party when she's mistaken for a university student, and George Sr. helps Pastor Jeff set up a children's nursery.

4-7.title: A Philosophy Class and Worms That Can Chase You
4-7.overview: Sheldon's first day of college is derailed by his new philosophy teacher, Professor Ericson. Also, Mary and Brenda live vicariously through Missy's first day of middle school.

4-8.title: An Existential Crisis and a Bear That Makes Bubbles
4-8.overview: Connie takes matters into her own hands when Sheldon's philosophy teacher, Professor Ericson, sends him into a tailspin. Also, George Sr. learns Georgie has been cutting class.

4-9.title: Crappy Frozen Ice Cream and an Organ Grinder's Monkey
4-9.overview: Sheldon and George Sr. dine with President Hagemeyer and a university benefactor. Also, Georgie gives Missy some brotherly advice when Mary won't let her go to the school dance, and Dale and June convince Connie to attend their son's wedding.

4-10.title: Cowboy Aerobics and 473 Grease-Free Bolts
4-10.overview: Sheldon campaigns to become Dr. Linkletter's lab assistant. Also, Georgie enlists the help of Mr. Lundy, the drama teacher, for a surprising business venture.

4-11.title: A Pager, a Club and a Cranky Bag of Wrinkles
4-11.overview: Dr. Linkletter pushes Sheldon to make friends with his fellow students at college. Also, Georgie gets a pager.

4-12.title: A Box of Treasure and the Meemaw of Science
4-12.overview: Sheldon, Dr. Linkletter and Connie team up on a science experiment. Also, Mary is jealous that Pastor Jeff and Brenda are spending time together, and Georgie has a new side hustle.

4-13.title: The Geezer Bus and a New Model for Education
4-13.overview: Sheldon refuses to ride in a car after getting into an accident with Connie. Also, Missy uses their trauma to her advantage at school and Connie is forced to take the church shuttle while her car is in the shop.

4-14.title: Mitch's Son and the Unconditional Approval of a Government Agency
4-14.overview: When the IRS accuses Sheldon of making a mistake, he'll stop at nothing to prove them wrong. Also, Dale is forced to get a colonoscopy and tries to convince Connie to join him.

4-15.title: A Virus, Heartbreak and a World of Possibilities
4-15.overview: Sheldon is caught in a moral dilemma when offered a bootleg copy of a computer game he can't afford. Also, Mary and Connie take Brenda out for girls' night while George Sr. and the guys watch Billy, and Missy asks Georgie to take her and Marcus on a secret date.

4-16.title: A Second Prodigy and the Hottest Tips for Pouty Lips
4-16.overview: Sheldon finds himself at odds with Paige once again when she considers enrolling at East Texas Tech. Also, Mary seeks June's advice when looking for a change.

4-17.title: A Black Hole
4-17.overview: The Coopers discuss the possibilities of black holes and alternate universes when Dr. Sturgis comes over for dinner.

4-18.title: The Wild and Woolly World of Nonlinear Dynamics
4-18.overview: Missy's first heartbreak triggers a series of events that lead the Cooper family to the brink.

5-1.title: One Bad Night and Chaos of Selfish Desires
5-1.overview: Sheldon and Missy both run away from home, and Mary gets upsetting news about George Sr.

5-2.title: Snoopin' Around and the Wonder Twins of Atheism
5-2.overview: Sheldon encourages Missy to question the Bible. Also, Connie is determined to catch George Sr. in a lie, and Mary helps Pastor Jeff search for a youth pastor.

5-3.title: Potential Energy and Hooch on a Park Bench
5-3.overview: Sheldon tries to convince Dr. Sturgis to return to the university. Also, Georgie upsets the family when he makes a life-changing decision.

5-4.title: Pish Posh and a Secret Back Room
5-4.overview: Sheldon, Missy and Georgie adapt to new living arrangements. Also, Connie opens a gambling room.

5-5.title: Stuffed Animals and a Sweet Southern Syzygy
5-5.overview: Sheldon and Dr. Linkletter struggle to solve an equation. Also, Georgie has a solution for Connie's business woes, and George Sr. gives advice on Missy's love life.

5-6.title: Money Laundering and a Cascade of Hormones
5-6.overview: Missy asks some uncomfortable questions at church, and Connie and Georgie go into business together.

5-7.title: An Introduction to Engineering and a Glob of Hair Gel
5-7.overview: Sheldon takes his first engineering class with Professor Boucher. Also, Meemaw and Dale help take care of his ex-wife, June.

5-8.title: The Grand Chancellor and a Den of Sin
5-8.overview: Sheldon battles President Hagemeyer's mysterious boss over the university's science requirements. Also, Mary discovers that Georgie is working at Connie's illegal gambling room.

5-9.title: The Yips and an Oddly Hypnotic Bohemian
5-9.overview: Sheldon gets the science yips and has to learn how to not think. Also, George Sr. plays handyman at Brenda Sparks' house.

5-10.title: An Expensive Glitch and a Goof-Off Room
5-10.overview: Sheldon gets a dorm room all to himself. Also, Connie gains an unwanted business partner.

5-11.title: A Lock-In, a Weather Girl and a Disgusting Habit
5-11.overview: Sheldon acts as Mary's spy during a youth lock-in at church. Also, Georgie is attracted to an older woman, Mandy.

5-12.title: A Pink Cadillac and a Glorious Tribal Dance
5-12.overview: Sheldon attends his first comic book convention; Mary tries selling makeup.

5-13.title: A Lot of Band-Aids and the Cooper Surrender
5-13.overview: Sheldon makes friends with his dorm neighbors; George Sr. learns his job is in jeopardy.

5-14.title: A Free Scratcher and Feminine Wiles
5-14.overview: Sheldon butts heads with Dr. Lee, a new scientist in the lab. Also, Mary is given a lotto ticket.

5-15.title: A Lobster, an Armadillo and a Way Bigger Number
5-15.overview: Sheldon joins Dr. Linkletter and Dr. Sturgis on a science road trip. Also, Georgie continues to lie about his age.

5-16.title: A Suitcase Full of Cash and a Yellow Clown Car
5-16.overview: Connie's gambling room is a success, and Sheldon dips his toe in the stock market. Also, Missy starts a business.

5-17.title: A Solo Peanut, a Social Butterfly and the Truth
5-17.overview: Sheldon gets an odd request from an old friend, Paige. Also, George Sr. and Mary are caught in the middle of Connie and Dale's breakup, and Georgie comes clean to Mandy.

5-18.title: Babies, Lies and a Resplendent Cannoli
5-18.overview: Sheldon copes with the death of a hero. Also, Missy wants to babysit, and Georgie struggles with his big secret.

5-19.title: A God-Fearin' Baptist and a Hot Trophy Husband
5-19.overview: George and Mary insist on meeting the new woman in Georgie's life. Also, Sheldon and Missy have suspicions about what's going on with their family.

5-20.title: Uncle Sheldon and a Hormonal Firecracker
5-20.overview: Sheldon and Missy learn about Georgie's pregnancy, and the whole family promises to keep it a secret.

5-21.title: White Trash, Holy Rollers and Punching People
5-21.overview: As the church congregation gossips about Georgie, Missy stands up for her brother, and Sheldon is distracted by the family drama.

5-22.title: Clogged Pore, a Little Spanish and the Future
5-22.overview: Sheldon struggles to cope with the first signs of puberty. Also, Mary and George Sr. hunt for new jobs, and Georgie and Meemaw take a business trip across the border.

6-1.title: Four Hundred Cartons of Undeclared Cigarettes and a Niblingo
6-1.overview: George Sr. bails Connie and Georgie out of jail. Also, Sheldon and Missy meet Mandy, and Mary feels unwelcome at church.

6-2.title: Future Worf and the Margarita of the South Pacific
6-2.overview: Sheldon and Missy try to help the family’s finances. Also, Mary struggles to find her footing without the church.

6-3.title: Passion's Harvest and a Sheldocracy
6-3.overview: Sheldon must choose sides in an ethical dilemma. Also, Mary tries her hand at writing and Mandy needs a new place to live.

6-4.title: Blonde Ambition and the Concept of Zero
6-4.overview: Sheldon makes a terrifying mathematical discovery while tutoring Billy. Also, Mary is jealous of Missy's relationship with Mandy and Connie.

6-5.title: A Resident Advisor and the Word 'Sketchy'
6-5.overview: At college, Sheldon decides to expand his responsibilities and become a dorm resident advisor. Also, Connie and Dale make a sketchy business deal, and Mary and George Sr. rekindle their romance.

6-6.title: An Ugly Car, an Affair and Some Kickass Football
6-6.overview: George Sr. is asked to help with the football team. Also, Mandy discovers Georgie and Connie's secret business.

6-7.title: A Tougher Nut and a Note on File
6-7.overview: Sheldon's search for a comic book leads him to a breakthrough. Also, Georgie and Mandy have an uncomfortable first encounter with her parents, Jim and Audrey.

6-8.title: Legalese and a Whole Hoo-Ha
6-8.overview: Sheldon's database invention puts him at odds with the university. Also, the church takes issue with Connie's video store.

6-9.title: College Dropouts and the Medford Miracle
6-9.overview: Sheldon considers dropping out of college to focus on building his database. Also, George Sr. is frustrated when someone else gets credit for his football wins.

6-10.title: Pancake Sunday and Textbook Flirting
6-10.overview: Mary struggles to make new friends while Mandy pushes Georgie to date another woman.

6-11.title: Ruthless, Toothless and a Week of Bed Rest
6-11.overview: Sheldon learns the university is building a database without him. Also, Mary takes care of a bedridden Mandy and Meemaw.

6-12.title: A Baby Shower and a Testosterone-Rich Banter
6-12.overview: Mary butts heads with Mandy's mother, Audrey, and Sheldon attempts male bonding.

6-13.title: A Frat Party, a Sleepover and the Mother of All Blisters
6-13.overview: Paige drags Sheldon to a college party and Missy gets caught in a lie.

6-14.title: A Launch Party and a Whole Human Being
6-14.overview: The Coopers can't be found as Mandy goes into labor. Also, Sheldon is excited about the launch of his database.

6-15.title: Teen Angst and a Smart-Boy Walk of Shame
6-15.overview: Sheldon confronts the failure of his database. Also, Georgie and Mandy struggle as new parents and Missy feels forgotten.

6-16.title: A Stolen Truck and Going on the Lam
6-16.overview: Missy steals her dad's truck and hits the road with her friend Paige.

6-17.title: A German Folk Song and an Actual Adult
6-17.overview: Georgie goes on a birthday date and Mary confronts Brenda about her relationship with George. Also, Sheldon takes an interest in Missy's favorite TV show.

6-18.title: Little Green Men and a Fella's Marriage Proposal
6-18.overview: Sheldon wants to search for life on other planets and Mandy answers Georgie's marriage proposal. Also, Missy is caught between two friends.

6-19.title: A New Weather Girl and a Stay-at-Home Coddler
6-19.overview: Mandy gets an exciting job opportunity and Sheldon worries that he's falling behind. Also, Georgie takes his daughter to work.

6-20.title: German for Beginners and a Crazy Old Man with a Bat
6-20.overview: The gambling room gets broken into and Sheldon wants to study abroad. Also, Missy makes a new friend.

6-21.title: A Romantic Getaway and a Germanic Meat-Based Diet
6-21.overview: Mandy surprises Georgie with a spa weekend and Sheldon prepares for his summer in Germany.

6-22.title: A Tornado, a 10-Hour Flight and a Darn Fine Ring
6-22.overview: Sheldon and Mary head to Germany while the rest of the Cooper family braves a tornado that is heading straight for Medford.

7-1.title: A Wiener Schnitzel and Underwear in a Tree
7-1.overview: News of the tornado reaches Sheldon and Mary in Germany. Also, with the Cooper house in chaos, Missy steps up.

7-2.title: A Roulette Wheel and a Piano Playing Dog
7-2.overview: Sheldon realizes he is the weakest student in his class; Meemaw is looking to expand her gambling business.

7-3.title: A Strudel and a Hot American Boy Toy
7-3.overview: Sheldon explores Germany behind Mary's back, Missy attempts to pull a fast one on George Sr. and Meemaw and Dale adjust to living together.

7-4.title: Ants on a Log and a Cheating Winker
7-4.overview: Missy steps up, Mary has a surprise for George, and Sheldon finds his dorm occupied.

7-5.title: A Frankenstein's Monster and a Crazy Church Guy
7-5.overview: Sheldon helps his roommate try to beat the stock market, Missy and Billy Sparks throw a party, and Mary finds a new church.

7-6.title: Baptists, Catholics and an Attempted Drowning
7-6.overview: Georgie and Mandy's wedding plans pit Mary against Mandy's mom, Audrey, with baby CeeCee caught in the middle.

7-7.title: A Proper Wedding and Skeletons in the Closet
7-7.overview: Georgie and Mandy get married! Meanwhile, Meemaw's gambling room gets raided.

7-8.title: An Ankle Monitor and a Big Plastic Crap House
7-8.overview: Sheldon studies to be Meemaw's lawyer when she is put on house arrest, and the Coopers have a plumbing emergency.

7-9.title: A Fancy Article and a Scholarship for a Baby
7-9.overview: Sheldon's published paper leads to a frenzy of grad school recruiting, and Georgie tries to speak more properly in front of his daughter.

7-10.title: Community Service and the Key to a Happy Marriage
7-10.overview: Connie gets assigned a tough probation officer, and Georgie takes marriage advice from his father-in-law.

7-11.title: A Little Snip and Teaching Old Dogs
7-11.overview: George Sr. is worried that Mary wants another baby and gets a vasectomy behind her back. Meanwhile, Drs. Linkletter and Sturgis go to Sheldon for science tutoring.

7-12.title: A New Home and a Traditional Texas Torture
7-12.overview: George Sr. gets an exciting job offer, and Sheldon prepares for his move to California.

7-13.title: Funeral (1)
7-13.overview: The Cooper family grapples with the death of George Cooper Sr.

7-14.title: Memoir (2)
7-14.overview: Sheldon leaves East Texas for the California Institute of Technology following the death of his father.

331980.name: Marvel's The Punisher
331980.overview: A former Marine out to punish the criminals responsible for his family's murder finds himself ensnared in a military conspiracy.

1-1.title: 3AM
1-1.overview: Former Marine Frank Castle takes the law into his own hands while struggling to come to terms with his traumatic past.

1-2.title: Two Dead Men
1-2.overview: A mysterious phone call forces Frank's hand. Meanwhile, Madani goes digging for suspects and Curtis delivers a message.

1-3.title: Kandahar
1-3.overview: Frank skips the subtlety while interrogating Micro. Brutal memories of top-secret missions shed light on Frank's past.

1-4.title: Resupply
1-4.overview: Madani and Sam plan a delicate operation, Curtis tries to connect with Lewis, and Frank encourages Micro to get his hands dirty.

1-5.title: Gunner
1-5.overview: Frank and Micro go looking for answers from a reluctant witness. Madani and Sam learn of a looming investigation. Rawlins sees a ghost.

1-6.title: The Judas Goat
1-6.overview: With Frank in bad shape, Micro calls on Curtis for help. Madani and Russo continue to mix business with pleasure. Lewis stands up for his rights.

1-7.title: Crosshairs
1-7.overview: Lewis struggles with the ramifications of his actions. Frank and Micro pursue another face from the past. Madani and Sam go bug hunting.

1-8.title: Cold Steel
1-8.overview: Russo opens up to Madani about his past, Sarah shares her concerns about her son with Frank, and a decoy operation takes a turn.

1-9.title: Front Toward Enemy
1-9.overview: Following a deadly explosion, Karen lands in a bomber's crosshairs -- and Frank isn't happy about it. Meanwhile, Curtis makes a grisly discovery.

1-10.title: Virtue of the Vicious
1-10.overview: An attack on a high-profile politician is examined (and reexamined) through different perspectives. Madani faces a painful truth.

1-11.title: Danger Close
1-11.overview: As danger knocks on Sarah's door, Frank takes his quest for vengeance to the next level with some help from an unexpected ally.

1-12.title: Home
1-12.overview: Frank makes a damning confession. A shootout leaves Sarah wondering what to believe. Rawlins goes in for the kill, once and for all.

1-13.title: Memento Mori
1-13.overview: As the authorities close in, an exhausted but unbroken Frank vows to put an end to the war that has consumed his life.

2-1.title: Roadhouse Blues
2-1.overview: While driving through Michigan, Frank stops for a beer at a roadside bar. But staying out of trouble has never been his strong suit.

2-2.title: Fight or Flight
2-2.overview: Frank and a reluctant Rachel go on the run as a menacing adversary gives chase. Meanwhile, Madani pays Russo an unwelcome visit.

2-3.title: Trouble the Water
2-3.overview: As Pilgrim's past comes into focus, Frank and Rachel find themselves in police custody, where they're anything but safe.

2-4.title: Scar Tissue
2-4.overview: Rachel recalls the night everything changed and lets Frank in on the truth about her name. Russo sits down with a face from his childhood.

2-5.title: One-Eyed Jacks
2-5.overview: It's not a trap if you know it's coming: That's Frank's philosophy. Madani opens up and Pilgrim plans a visit to an unholy land.

2-6.title: Nakazat
2-6.overview: Amy (formerly Rachel) develops photographs that point to a conspiracy. Russo reads his own report. Madani's story about Russo comes under fire.

2-7.title: One Bad Day
2-7.overview: Madani's quest to ID Pilgrim hits a wall. Russo and his crew put their plan into action. Frank encounters someone from the past.

2-8.title: My Brother's Keeper
2-8.overview: Painful memories take ahold of Russo. Frank's frustration frightens those closest to him. Madani receives a visitor bearing a warning.

2-9.title: Flustercluck
2-9.overview: A big bounty inspires New York's worst to pursue the Punisher. A restless Amy seeks help from a fellow grifter. Russo and Krista consider the future.

2-10.title: The Dark Hearts of Men
2-10.overview: As Madani and Krista debate who's worth saving, Frank prepares to storm Russo's territory. A brutal encounter pushes Pilgrim back into old habits.

2-11.title: The Abyss
2-11.overview: Amy rushes to protect Frank, who lies defenseless in a hospital. Pilgrim gets some crushing news, and Karen Page calls in a favor.

2-12.title: Collision Course
2-12.overview: Buckle up -- Mahoney and Frank are about to take a ride to remember. Amy makes an entrance, Russo cashes out, and Madani comes clean to Krista.

2-13.title: The Whirlwind
2-13.overview: Frank, Pilgrim, Madani, Russo, Amy, Curt and the Schultz family. No bullet is left unspent as season two comes to an explosive conclusion.

342858.name: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
342858.overview: The Boss Baby brings his big brother Tim to the office to teach him the art of business in this animated series sprung from the hit film.

similar.name: The Adventures of Jimmy Neutron: Boy Genius

1-1.title: Scooter Buskie
1-1.overview: The constantly crying "worst baby in the world" is making life miserable for all of his neighbors.  Can Boss Baby's field team turn things around?

1-2.title: Cat's in the Cradle
1-2.overview: Competition for cuteness heats up when a stray kitten appears on the Templetons' doorstep and the family decides to take him in.

1-3.title: Family Fun Night
1-3.overview: Family Fun NIght turns into Baby Work Night when trouble follows the Templetons to the grand opening of a seemingly purr-fect restaurant.

1-4.title: Formula for Menace: A Dekker Moonboots Mystery
1-4.overview: Tim's alter ego, space detective Dekker Moonboots, steps in to solve a Baby Corp mystery -- and mounting clues suggest it's an inside job.

1-5.title: Monster Machine
1-5.overview: The Field team enters one of their own in the prestigious Lil' Dumpling Pageant to make sure the winner is someone Baby Corp can trust.

1-6.title: The Constipation Situation
1-6.overview: A backed-up Boss Baby is forced to take a sick day when his system stalls -- and he can't go boom-boom. Now it's up to tim ti take over.

1-7.title: The Boss Babysitter
1-7.overview: The brothers stay home with a babysitter while their parents go out for the night.  Boss Baby wants to make her look bad -- but she's just too good.

1-8.title: Into the Belly of the Den of the House of the Nest of Cats
1-8.overview: While Tim works overtime to do good in the neighborhood, Staci and Boss Baby go undercover to rescue Jimbo from a house that's crawling with cats.

1-9.title: Spirit Day
1-9.overview: The team suits up to stop Mega FAT CEO Baby from winning an office spirit day contest that's totally rigged.  Because nobody likes a bully.

1-10.title: Par Avion
1-10.overview: A "free" family vacation comes at a cost when Tim's tasked with keeping a plane full of babies calm on an eight-hour flight to Paris.

1-11.title: Cat Cop!
1-11.overview: The Templetons cross paths with a "Cat Cop" with connections to cunning villain Bootsy Calico.  Tim masters the art of negotiation.

1-12.title: Hang in There, Baby
1-12.overview: An after-hours break-in to save Boss Baby's job transforms a do-gooding Tim into the daring Tim Templeton: Unleashed.

1-13.title: Six Well-Placed Kittens
1-13.overview: With Bootsy Calico's plan in full swing, Boss Baby rallies his co-workers to bring Calico and his kittens down and save the town.

2-1.title: As the Diaper Changes
2-1.overview: The new Baby Corp CEO gives Boss Baby a big assignment. Meanwhile, Tim's feisty grandmother moves in, turning the brothers into temporary roommates.

2-2.title: Super Cool Big Kids Inc.
2-2.overview: After declaring war on old people, Boss Baby focuses the field team's efforts on Frederic Estes. Tim starts his own big-kid business.

2-3.title: P.U.
2-3.overview: When Baby Corp's lead scientist accidentally turns the stinkless serum into a stink enhancer, Boss Baby needs Tim's help to freshen things up.

2-4.title: Hush, Little Baby
2-4.overview: An innocent trip to the library for toddler story hour sparks a turf war between babydom and Frederic Estes's Consortium of Ancients.

2-5.title: Night of the Frodarg
2-5.overview: On a dark and stormy night, Tim and Boss Baby set traps for two wildly different threats: a mythical monster and a Puppy Co. agent named Bug the Pug.

2-6.title: Fugitive's Day Out
2-6.overview: After being framed for the Puppy Co. leak, a fugitive Boss Baby goes on the lam and comes face to face with an old corporate rival.

2-7.title: The Passionate Nanny Business
2-7.overview: When Frederic Estes and his friends monopolize Marisol's talents for elder care, Boss Baby and Tim team up to get their babysitter back.

2-8.title: Plushythingy
2-8.overview: The Consortium of Ancients floods the market with an irresistibly fluffy new toy that has babies going gaga -- a little too gaga.

2-9.title: Number One Problem
2-9.overview: Gigi's potty training strategy has a diaperless Boss Baby hanging out in the buff. But a horrified Tim can't handle all the nakey time.

2-10.title: Picture Perfect
2-10.overview: With the Templeton men away on a "Dudes Weekend," Staci and Jimbo join forces to return a blankie to its rightful owner.

2-11.title: Play It Again, Tim
2-11.overview: Tim's parents enroll him in piano lessons for the rest of the summer. But Boss Baby suspects Tim's "lessons" are part of a larger Frederic Estes plot.

2-12.title: Research & Development
2-12.overview: With Baby Corp's stinkless serum in enemy hands, Turtleneck Superstar CEO Baby issues a challenge to deliver a new formula by 5 p.m.

2-13.title: Wrinkles & Stinkles
2-13.overview: In the wake of Tim's discovery, a newly crowned Boss Baby seizes the chance to show his team what a real leader looks like.

3-1.title: Bossa Nova
3-1.overview: Ousted from the office and desperate for direction, an unemployed Boss Baby joins a mommy/daddy and me playgroup. But he isn't the only new member.

3-2.title: The Museum Job
3-2.overview: A long line at the museum's family bathroom sends baby love into the toilet. Can the field team evict the potty squatter and get things moving?

3-3.title: Ga Ba Goo Ba Ga (The Babblist)
3-3.overview: While the Boss Baby helps Tim sell magazines for a school fundraiser, a suspicious baby whisperer is breaking up the playgroup ... but why?

3-4.title: The Coo Chi Coup
3-4.overview: The stage is set for corporate sabotage when Staci sends the Boss Baby undercover to take down Baby Corp's latest leader at a company retreat.

3-5.title: Lights, Camera, Org Chart!
3-5.overview: Unruly baby Scooter Buskie sends shockwaves through the playgroup org chart — and all of babydom — when he lands the cover of the Bubbeezee catalog.

3-6.title: The Big Break
3-6.overview: A broken bone sends the Boss Baby to a wisecracking doctor who fancies himself a comedian. In other news, Tim's lucky pencil is cursed.

3-7.title: Escape from Krinkle's
3-7.overview: Boss Baby has an interview at Baby Corp — but first, he'll need to break out of a high-tech Bubbeezee playroom. Can the field team help him escape?

3-8.title: Puppy Party
3-8.overview: A party in the park drags the Boss Baby into a dogfight with his old nemesis, Puppy Co.'s Bug the Pug — and the loser must don the "Collar of Shame."

3-9.title: Mega Fat
3-9.overview: A flashback episode reveals everything that happened to Mega Fat between getting fired from Baby Corp and getting adopted by a famous journalist.

3-10.title: Halloween
3-10.overview: Halloween is the perfect cover for the Boss Baby and his costumed field team to sneak into the belly of the beast. But Staci's got plans to stop them.

3-11.title: Who's a Good Baby?
3-11.overview: Baby love has never been higher. But a crash is coming, and the Boss Baby and his crew are determined to bring Bubbeezee down for good.

4-1.title: Yellow 100
4-1.overview: As the newly named CEO, the Boss Baby sets a goal for baby love to hit 100%. But now everyone's working overtime to please him.

4-2.title: Pyg & Tam
4-2.overview: The Boss Baby declares war on a new threat: a popular TV show starring a pygmy goat, a tamandua and their human handler.

4-3.title: Conference Room B
4-3.overview: Company morale is so low that the Boss Baby throws a last-minute cupcake party, then sends a manager to help Tim handle some family business.

4-4.title: Game Plan
4-4.overview: Boss Baby's next scheme to increase baby love? A petition to change the local soccer team's name from the Hive to the Babies.

4-5.title: Night Owls
4-5.overview: After sneaking into a grown-up movie, Tim decides he's mature enough for the adult world. Meanwhile, Boss Baby sleeps over at a friend's house.

4-6.title: OCB
4-6.overview: It's the Boss Baby's worst nightmare when a consultant comes to Baby Corp with zany ideas, then sets his sights on the CEO's job.

4-7.title: Chicago
4-7.overview: On a trip to the Windy City to see Gigi and Grandpa, the Boss Baby comes face to face with an ambitious infant who's masquerading as an adult.

4-8.title: Baby Boss
4-8.overview: The Boss Baby's away at a checkup, so it's up to interim manager Staci to fend off three wars: one from Pyg & Tam, one from OCB and one from Bug the Pug.

4-9.title: Boom Baby
4-9.overview: Boss Baby discovers an old Mega Fat initiative called Project Boom — and it's threatening to ruin baby rights everywhere.

4-10.title: The Fumbling of Football Mike
4-10.overview: After the Boss Baby accidentally sells Tim's favorite toy at a yard sale, he uses company resources to try and get it back.

4-11.title: Teambuilding
4-11.overview: Baby Corp is dismantled and comms are down, but that won't stop the Boss Baby from rallying to reunite his employees. Tim spends one last day with Danny.

4-12.title: Theo 100
4-12.overview: With diapers piling up in the Templetons' basement, the Boss Baby crafts a plan to break into Baby Corp, kick out his enemies and take his business back.

343074.name: Immortals
343074.overview: Driven by revenge, human-turned-vampire Mia sets out to vanquish Dmitry, a ruthless vampire leader who seeks an artifact that grants immortality.

1-1.title: Episode 1
1-1.overview: Turned into a vampire against her will in the 19th century, Mia arrives in present-day Istanbul to kill the man who took away her humanity.

1-2.title: Episode 2
1-2.overview: Karmen helps Numel find Mia, who sees Sercan's group as a possible ally. Mia comes to Dmitry's aid.

1-3.title: Episode 3
1-3.overview: Dmitry captures the Guild's leader, and Mia faces a moral dilemma. Numel anticipates a power struggle over the dagger when the planets finally align.

1-4.title: Episode 4
1-4.overview: Mia helps Sercan's followers hunt down one of Dmitry's people -- with grave consequences for Karmen. Someone close to Sercan decides to switch sides.

1-5.title: Episode 5
1-5.overview: Melisa asks Zehra to help take out Mia. Dmitry traces a shipment connected to the dagger and clashes with Numel in a violent showdown.

1-6.title: Episode 6
1-6.overview: Karmen's tragic history comes to light. Dmitry seals Melisa's fate. Mia and Karmen choose their sides in the looming war between mortals and vampires.

348545.name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba
348545.overview: After a demon attack leaves his family slain and his sister cursed, Tanjiro embarks upon a perilous journey to find a cure and avenge those he's lost.

similar.name: The Rising of the Shield Hero
That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime

0-1.title: Kimetsu Academy: Special Edition #1 Introductions
0-1.overview: Junior High and High School!!  Demon Slayer Banquet - Special Arc

0-2.title: Kimetsu Academy: Special Edition #2 PE
0-2.overview: Junior High and High School!! Demon Slayer Banquet - Special Arc

0-3.title: Kimetsu Academy: Special Edition #3 One Morning
0-3.overview: Junior High and High School!! Demon Slayer Banquet - Special Arc

0-4.title: Junior High and High School!! Kimetsu Academy Story: Valentine Edition #1
0-4.overview: It’s Valentine’s Day. Zenitsu is full of excitement and unable to calm down revisits an incident from half a year ago.

0-5.title: Junior High and High School!! Kimetsu Academy Story: Valentine Edition #2
0-5.overview: Due to his strong desire to receive chocolates, Zenitsu seeks advice from teachers Mr. Rengoku and Mr. Tomioka on how to be more popular.

0-6.title: Junior High and High School!! Kimetsu Academy Story: Valentine Edition #3
0-6.overview: Zenitsu continues to seek in advice on how to be more popular and approaches teacher Mr. Uzui next.

0-7.title: Junior High and High School!! Kimetsu Academy Story: Valentine Edition #4
0-7.overview: For the past few days, there are rumors of a suspicious person lurking around the school premises. Upon seeing an illustration of the alleged perpretator, Tanjiro notices something…

1-1.title: Cruelty
1-1.overview: It is the Taisho Period (i.e. 1912-1926). Tanjiro Kamado is living a modest but blissful life in the mountains with his family. One day, when he returns from selling charcoal in town, he finds the remains of his slaughtered family in pools of blood after a demon attack. Tanjiro rushes down the snowy mountain with the sole survivor, his sister Nezuko, on his back. But on the way, Nezuko suddenly snarls, turning on Tanjiro.

1-2.title: Trainer Sakonji Urokodaki
1-2.overview: At Giyu Tomioka's urging, Tanjiro heads for Mt. Sagiri with his sister Nezuko who's been turned into a demon. During the night, Tanjiro catches the smell of blood from inside a temple. He enters, thinking that someone might be hurt, only to come upon a man-eating demon. When the demon attacks, Tanjiro manages to fight back with his hatchet, but the demon's strength is overwhelming. Just as the demon is about to finish him off, Tanjiro is saved by none other than.

1-3.title: Sabito and Makomo
1-3.overview: The Demon Slayer Corps... An organization that's been hunting down demons since ancient times. Sakonji Urokodaki starts training Tanjiro for Final Selection, the test for joining the unit. Navigating a mountain riddled with booby traps, dry sword swings, waterfall immersion and breathing techniques... A year later, Urokodaki informs Tanjiro that he has nothing more to teach him, and gives him one last hurdle to overcome in front of a giant boulder.

1-4.title: Final Selection
1-4.overview: To pass Final Selection, one must survive for seven days on Mt. Fujikasane where demons captured by the Demon Slayers have been imprisoned. So begins the battle for survival between the young swordsmen and the demons. Armed with the breathing techniques and stances he'd learned from Sakonji Urokodaki, Tanjiro slashes demon after demon. His two years of training have not gone to waste. But just then, a morphed demon appears out of nowhere.

1-5.title: My Own Steel
1-5.overview: When day breaks, there are only four swordsmen left standing after the seven-day battle. The guides who greet Tanjiro and the other survivors explain the Demon Slayer Corps system. All four are issued uniforms and Kasugai Crows as messengers, after which they must select the ore for their own Nichirin swords. After gazing hard at each lump of ore, and using his keen sense of smell, the one Tanjiro chooses is...

1-6.title: Swordsman Accompanying a Demon
1-6.overview: Tanjiro is now clad in the uniform of the Demon Slayer Corps. His Nichirin Sword on his hip, and Nezuko, now awake, in a special box made by Urokodaki on his back, he heads out for his first assignment. A town to the northwest where girls have been vanishing nightly. There, Tanjiro meets Kazumi, haggard with worry after his girlfriend's been abducted. Though he does catch the scent of a demon nearby, there's just no demon in sight. Tanjiro is sure that a demon is behind this sinister incident...

1-7.title: Muzan Kibutsuji
1-7.overview: Now split into three, the demons have driven Tanjiro into a corner. It is then that Nezuko attacks. Now that she’s become a demon herself, she’s no longer so weak that she needs protection. His mind made up, Tanjiro follows one of the demons into the swamp now spreading across the ground. Waiting for him there is...

1-8.title: The Smell of Enchanting Blood
1-8.overview: The next mission is in Asakusa, Tokyo. Tanjiro is taken aback by the opulent Taisho Era cityscape, but soon picks up the demon’s scent there. His pursuit of the scent leads him to Muzan Kibutsuji. Tanjiro attempts to strike him down. But Kibutsuji transforms a passerby into demon, triggering a commotion. As Tanjiro desperately tries to get things under control, someone appears before him...

1-9.title: Temari Demon and Arrow Demon
1-9.overview: It was two demons named Tamayo and Yushiro who came to Tanjiro’s rescue. Using the “Eyeblind” spell, Tamayo guides Tanjiro and Nezuko to her house. There, through his conversation with Tamayo, Tanjiro learns that there is a way to return demons to human form. Just then, two demons in pursuit of Tanjiro locate the house and unleash a furious assault...

1-10.title: Together Forever
1-10.overview: Tanjiro’s crisis continues. He uses multiple forms of the Water Breathing technique to hold out against Yahaba’s final Blood Demon Art, the "Kouketsu Arrow." Meanwhile, Nezuko and Susamaru are still battling it out. Worried about the outcome, Tamayo unleashes her own Blood Demon Art.

1-11.title: Tsuzumi Mansion
1-11.overview: Tanjiro's next destination, according to his Kasugai Crow, is to the south-southeast. On the way, Tanjiro runs into his fellow Final Selection survivor, the swordsman Zenitsu Agatsuma. Tanjiro has a hard time dealing with Zenitsu's passive attitude as they head deep into the mountains. They encounter two children whose older brother was taken away right in front of their house. There, Zenitsu hears the sound of a tsuzumi ringing out from somewhere.

1-12.title: The Boar Bares Its Fangs, Zenitsu Sleeps
1-12.overview: Inside the house, where the rooms spin each time the tsuzumi is played, Tanjiro gets separated from Zenitsu Agatsuma. Without Tanjiro by his side, Zenitsu is overcome by fear and despair as he takes Shoichi through the house. Meanwhile, Tanjiro meets the master of the house, the tsuzumi-playing demon, and an odd-looking man wearing a boar’s head mask.

1-13.title: Something More Important Than Life
1-13.overview: Every time Kyogai, the master of house, plays his tsuzumi, the room spins and Tanjiro struggles. Debilitated by the fractured bones he sustained in his previous battle, Tanjiro tries to fire himself up as he desperately fights on, but he is overwhelmed by Kyogai's Blood Demon Art. Will he find a way to slice off Kyogai's head?

1-14.title: The House With the Wisteria Family Crest
1-14.overview: After a desperate fight to the death, Tanjiro prevails over Kyogai. He exits the house to find Zenitsu who had escaped earlier. But it is then that he sees the strange circumstances before him... The battered Zenitsu holding the box containing Nezuko in his arms while the man in the boar's head mask stands in the way with two Nichirin Swords drawn.

1-15.title: Mount Natagumo
1-15.overview: Their next destination is to the north-northwest. Tanjiro and Nezuko head towards Mount Natagumo with Zenitsu and Inosuke. This mountain is covered with spider webs and is swarming with innumerable spiders. Leaving the cowering Zenitsu behind, Tanjiro and Inosuke head up the mountain where they run into fellow Demon Slayers entangled in spider webs.

1-16.title: Letting Someone Else Go First
1-16.overview: Tanjiro and Inosuke battle the Demon Slayers trapped by spider webs. After slashing the threads and destroying the webs, they head deeper into the mountain. The farther they advance through the forest, the thicker the threads become, and those under their control start moving in ways impossible for a human being. Stopping the Demon Slayers without hurting them isn't going to be easy, but then Tanjiro makes a certain move...

1-17.title: You Must Master a Single Thing
1-17.overview: One of the Twelve Kizuki, a direct subordinate of Muzan Kibutsuji, is here somewhere. When Tanjiro slays the Mother Spider Demon of Mt. Natagumo, he learns that a demon who might hold the key to turning Nezuko back into a human is somewhere in this very forest. With the battered Inosuke in tow, he heads deeper into the forest. Meanwhile, Zenitsu trudges forlornly through the woods only to encounter a spider with a human face.

1-18.title: A Forged Bond
1-18.overview: Tanjiro and Inosuke face off against the Father Spider Demon of Mt. Natagumo. Tanjiro unleashes an attack, only to get hurled away by the demon's overwhelming power. Landing near a river, he comes upon the young demon Rui torturing the Sister Spider Demon. When Rui calls their bond of terror and hatred "a family’s bond," Tanjiro is enraged. So begins the battle between Rui and Tanjiro.

1-19.title: Hinokami
1-19.overview: Swordsmen in the Demon Slayer Corps known as Hashiras have arrived on Mt. Natagumo. Giyu Tomioka, the Water Hashira, slays the Father Spider Demon with a single strike. Inosuke, thrilled to see such a display of swordsmanship by someone in a totally different league from himself, challenges Giyu to a duel. Meanwhile, Zenitsu lies near death as the poison circulates throughout his body. Just then, the Insect Hashira, Shinobu Kocho appears before him.

1-20.title: Pretend Family
1-20.overview: When Rui assaults him with his Blood Demon Art, Tanjiro braces himself for certain death. As his life flashes before his eyes, he suddenly remembers his father's dance, the kagura, and unleashes a new, non-Water Breathing attack. Hinokami Kagura Dance. Knowing that he’ll be receiving a simultaneous blow from the demon, he uses his new move to slice off Rui’s head. As Tanjiro crawls towards Nezuko, who lies on the ground, riddled with wounds, someone appears before him.

1-21.title: Against Corps Rules
1-21.overview: Seeing Tanjiro try to protect Nezuko even as he collapses triggers memories of Rui’s own past. Once a sickly boy, he became a demon after meeting Muzan Kibutsuji who gave him a share of his blood. But after he turns into a demon, his own parents try to kill him. Ever since then, he has been searching for a family. Seeking a bond that he can never hope to acquire...

1-22.title: Master of the Mansion
1-22.overview: After the battle is over, Tanjiro and Nezuko are taken to the Demon Slayer Corps headquarters. This is where the Hashira Meeting between the Corps leader, Ubuyashiki, and the Hashiras, the most powerful swordsmen in the Corps, is to be held. The Hashiras censure Tanjiro for violating the Demon Slayer Corps by protecting a demon. And then, the Wind Hashira, Sanemi Shinazugawa, raises his sword against Nezuko...

1-23.title: Hashira Meeting
1-23.overview: Ubuyashiki, the leader of the Demon Slayer Corps, finally appears before Tanjiro. He tells him that he will allow Tanjiro and Nezuko to join the Corps. But the Hashiras are unable to accept this decision right away. The Wind Hashira, Sanemi Shinazugawa, slashes his own arm and taunts Nezuko with his blood, trying to get her to show her true colors as a demon.

1-24.title: Rehabilitation Training
1-24.overview: The injured Tanjiro, Zenitsu and Inosuke are sent to the home of the Insect Hashira, Shinobu Kocho, for treatment. Two weeks later, Tanjiro and Inosuke start rehabilitation training. But the drills are brutal, and they find themselves broken in spirit. Unaware of the grueling regimen, Zenitsu joins them late and is visibly enthusiastic in front of girls, but...

1-25.title: Tsuguko, Kanao Tsuyuri
1-25.overview: Tanjiro, who's undergoing rehabilitation training at the Butterfly Mansion, works hard to keep up his Total Concentration Breathing techniques all day long. Though at first, he's helpless against Kanao, a swordswoman in his class who's training him, he slowly but surely begins to make some headway. Seeing Tanjiro devote himself to training every single day, Zenitsu and Inosuke resume training as well, but...

1-26.title: New Mission
1-26.overview: As Tanjiro and the others are devoted to their rehabilitation training, the absolute master of the demons, Muzan Kibutsuji, gathers the Lower Ranks of the Twelve Kizuki. The demons, too, are preparing to make their next move. As training draws to a close, Tanjiro has improved to the point where he can fight on equal terms with Kanao. Just then, he receives word of a new mission from his Kasugai Crow.

2-1.title: Flame Hashira: Kyojuro Rengoku
2-1.overview: Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku receives new orders: Travel to the Mugen Train, where over forty people have gone missing, and conduct an investigation. Leaving the Demon Slayer Corps Headquarters, he sets off on this new mission.

2-2.title: Deep Sleep
2-2.overview: Tanjiro's group, fresh from completing their training at the Butterfly Mansion, head to their next mission, the Mugen Train. There they rendezvous with Rengoku, who arrived ahead of them. Tanjiro is overwhelmed by the always-energetic Rengoku, Zenitsu is frightened by the prospect of facing demons as usual, and Inosuke is immensely excited by the sight of the huge machine. But on this train loaded with passengers, a new battle is about to begin.

2-3.title: Should Have Been
2-3.overview: Tanjiro, Nezuko, Zenitsu and Inosuke join Rengoku on the Mugen Train. Having heard that there may be demons on the train, they are on high alert, but they find themselves falling into a slumber. Within his dream, Tanjiro is reunited with his long lost family. However, it is soon revealed that this is a trap set by Enmu (Lower One).

2-4.title: Insult
2-4.overview: Tanjiro, Zenitsu, Inosuke and Rengoku have fallen into a deep sleep while under the control of Enmu's Blood Demon Art. As Enmu attempts to use his accomplices to destroy the spiritual cores of Tanjiro and his companions in order to defeat them, Tanjiro realizes that he is inside a dream and searches for a way to wake up. In order to awaken from the dream, Tanjiro makes a decision to use his sword to cut into his own neck.

2-5.title: Move Forward!
2-5.overview: After waking up from his dream by cutting his own neck, Tanjiro battles Enmu, who is the source of all the turmoil on the train. Enmu appears to be getting pleasure from inflicting pain on the passengers, which only infuriates Tanjiro even more. Tanjiro succeeds in severing Enmu's head, only to discover that Enmu's body is fused with the Mugen Train itself. Tanjiro is backed into a corner, but a freshly-awakened Inosuke comes to assist him and...

2-6.title: Akaza
2-6.overview: Nezuko, Zenitsu and Rengoku fight against Enmu to protect the passengers. Meanwhile, Tanjiro and Inosuke discover the location of Enmu's neck. They work in tandem to thwart Enmu's Blood Demon Art and sever Enmu's neck. The Mugen Train writhes in pain and derails. What will be the fate of the 200 or so passengers as well as Tanjiro and his friends?

2-7.title: Set Your Heart Ablaze
2-7.overview: The demon that appeared before Tanjiro and Rengoku after they defeated Enmu was the Upper Three, Akaza. While injured and on the ground, Tanjiro is almost attacked by Akaza and narrowly escapes death when Rengoku quickly strikes back. During the intense battle between Rengoku and Akaza, Akaza suggests to Rengoku that he should also become a demon. Rengoku vehemently refuses Akaza's offer, but his injured body is exhausted and being pushed past its physical limits...

3-1.title: Sound Hashira: Tengen Uzui
3-1.overview: After the Mugen Train incident, Akaza visits Muzan Kibutsuji. Guided by a crow, Tanjiro Kamado heads off to the Rengoku residence to convey Kyojuro Rengoku's last messages to his father and little brother. Tanjiro's group return to the Butterfly Mansion.

3-2.title: Infiltrating the Entertainment District
3-2.overview: After Tanjiro visits the Rengoku residence and meets Kyojuro's younger brother, Senjuro, to deliver Kyojuro's last message, Tanjiro spends his days training and completing missions. One day, he returns to the Butterfly Mansion to find Sound Hashira, Tengen Uzui, attempting to take Aoi and Naho away on a mission against their will. Tanjiro, Zenitsu and Inosuke offer to go on that mission instead, and they head to their next destination - the Entertainment District.

3-3.title: What Are You?
3-3.overview: After arriving at the Entertainment District, Tanjiro and his comrades infiltrate each House where Uzui's wives, Suma, Makio and Hinatsuru, work. While working as apprentices and searching for their whereabouts, Inosuke hears that Makio has been shutting herself away from everyone in her room.

3-4.title: Tonight
3-4.overview: As Tanjiro close in on the demon that has been preying upon the entertainment district. But even as he closes in, the others continue to follow their leads toward their query. Who will find the demon first? And will they be able to survive the confrontation when they do?

3-5.title: Things Are Gonna Get Real Flashy!!
3-5.overview: After being told of Zenitsu’s disappearance and to leave the Entertainment District by Uzui, Tanjiro and Inosuke decide that they will rescue Zenitsu. That evening, Tanjiro picks up a scent of a demon, which leads him to Koinatsu Oiran being swallowed by Daki’s belt. With Uzui nowhere in sight, Tanjiro must face the Upper Six demon alone.

3-6.title: Layered Memories
3-6.overview: During the fierce battle with Daki, Tanjiro continues to unleash the Hinokami Kagura, which causes a huge strain on his body. Meanwhile, Inosuke reaches the Belt Demon’s nest and saves people who have been captured. Makio, Suma, and Zenitsu, who have been freed from the belt, join in on the fight. As the ceiling of the nest is broken, Uzui appears wielding his swords.

3-7.title: Transformation
3-7.overview: Enraged by Daki's contempt for human life, Tanjiro attacks her with more intensity and gradually corners the demon. But he's already gone past his physical limit. As Tanjiro collapses and all seems lost again, Nezuko appears. A vicious battle ensues and Nezuko starts transforming into a more demon-like form...

3-8.title: Gathering
3-8.overview: After Nezuko attempts to attack innocent bystanders as her demon form advances, Tanjiro is finally able to make her fall asleep by singing a lullaby. Meanwhile, another demon emerges out of Daki's body after being beheaded by Uzui - Gyutaro, Daki's older brother and the other form of Upper Six. Uzui must now face both demons, Daki and Gyutaro.

3-9.title: Defeating an Upper Rank Demon
3-9.overview: Tanjiro, Zenitsu and Inosuke have joined Uzui in battle. While Zenitsu and Inosuke take on Daki, Tanjiro and Uzui deal with Gyutaro; however, they struggle as the demons have the upper hand with their coordinated attacks. But thanks to Hinatsuru's help and some teamwork from Uzui, Tanjiro's blade finds its way towards Gyutaro's neck...

3-10.title: Never Give Up
3-10.overview: Tanjiro and Uzui have been separated by Gyutaro’s Blood Demon Art. As Tanjiro joins the struggling Zenitsu and Inosuke, they manage to decapitate Daki at last thanks to their coordinated barrage of sword strikes. However, when Inosuke tries to run off with Daki’s head, he gets pierced by Gyutaro’s scythe. Uzui has also collapsed, leaving Tanjiro and the others with their backs to the wall.

3-11.title: No Matter How Many Lives
3-11.overview: Uzui deflects all of Gyutaro's Blood Demon Art attacks, and despite getting pierced in the jaw, Tanjiro is able to slice off Gyutaro's head. Though wounded from head to toe, Zenitsu and Inosuke also behead Daki, and they succeed in decapitating both demons at the same time. Just when it seems as though they've defeated the Upper Six demons after a fierce struggle, Gyutaro unleashes his Blood Demon Art...

4-1.title: Someone's Dream
4-1.overview: An Upper Rank Demon has been defeated for the first time in a hundred years by Uzui, Tanjiro, and his comrades' effort. This news causes a ripple effect not only among the members of the Demon Slayer Corps, but also the Upper Rank Demons, who have been summoned by Muzan Kibutsuji. Meanwhile, Tanjiro is recovering at the Butterfly Mansion when he discovers that he has upset his swordsmith Haganezuka after chipping his sword and decides to head to the village where the swordsmiths live to talk to him in person.

4-2.title: Yoriichi Type Zero
4-2.overview: Tanjiro intervenes during an argument between a pillar and an apprentice blacksmith and learns of the existence of an amazing training method.

4-3.title: A Sword From Over 300 Years Ago
4-3.overview: Tanjiro begins his training with Yoriichi Type Zero and is pushed to the limits by Kotetsu's relentless coaching and extreme training. Through this experience, Tanjiro masters a new skill of predicting where the opponent's next move will hit by using his sense of smell. During his training, Tanjiro lands a blow on Yoriichi Type Zero and ends up destroying it, but a sword from over 300 years ago appears from inside...

4-4.title: Thank You, Tokito
4-4.overview: Hantengu's head is slashed by Muichiro and he splits into two clones. Muichiro is blown away by Karaku. Tanjiro, Nezuko and Genya are stunned when the clones split into more clones. Muichiro rescues Kotetsu from a Goldfish Demon.

4-5.title: Bright Red Sword
4-5.overview: Tokito continues advancing through the forest and finds Mr. Kanamori. As soon as they arrive at the work hut in the middle of the forest, they are welcomed by Gyokko. Meanwhile, Tanjiro continues his fight against Hantengu.

4-6.title: Aren't You Going to Become a Hashira?
4-6.overview: Two simultaneous fights continue, Tanjiro, Nezuko and Genya against Hantengu and Tokito against Gyokko. Genya began to show a demonic form. Tanjiro asks him to look for Hantengu's real body, but memories of the past begin to plague Genya.

4-7.title: Awful Villain
4-7.overview: Genya aims for the neck of the fifth demon that split off from Hantengu, but the demon's neck is shockingly hard, and his sword snaps in half in his attempt to strike it. His gun is also ineffective and Genya is driven into a corner. Realizing that he is unable to sever the neck by himself, he entrusts defeating the fifth demon, which is believed to be the main body, to Tanjiro. Taking on Genya's will, Tanjiro wields his sword against the fleeing demon...

4-8.title: The Mu in Muichiro
4-8.overview: Muichiro, with the help of air blown by Kotetsu to him, escapes Gyokko's Water Prison Pot. Muichiro finally recalls his tragic past.

4-9.title: Mist Hashira: Muichiro Tokito
4-9.overview: Armed with his memories, Muichiro feels powerful and invincible, convinced that the demonic fifth moon has no chance against him.

4-10.title: Love Hashira: Mitsuri Kanroji
4-10.overview: Tanjiro, Nezuko, and Genya are struggling through an arduous battle against Zohakuten and his five tree dragons. They are forced to fight defensively against the tree dragons using the four emotion demon's powers, and Tanjiro is swallowed by one of them amidst the fight. Just as Tanjiro is close to meeting his demise, Mitsuri arrives in the nick of time and rescues him. And now, Mitsuri faces off against Zohakuten to rescue the captured Nezuko and Genya...!

4-11.title: A Connected Bond: Daybreak and First Light
4-11.overview: Tanjiro continues the fight against Hantengu. Amidst all his injuries and the Superior Four's skill, will he be able to defeat him? As the battle draws to a close, the Demon Slayer Squad must race against time to end the fight before dawn.

5-1.title: To Defeat Muzan Kibutsuji
5-1.overview: The Hashira, Sanemi and Iguro, along with their comrades head to an abandoned castle on top of a mountain for a mission, while Tanjiro is being treated at the Butterfly Mansion for the wounds he suffered at the Swordsmith Village. Later on, the Hashira gather at the Ubuyashiki Mansion to hold a Hashira meeting, where Muichiro reveals how the marks manifested. In an effort to strengthen the entire Demon Slayer Corps from the bottom up, the Hashira Training begins...

5-2.title: Water Hashira Giyu Tomioka's Pain
5-2.overview: Kagaya's Kasugai Crow suddenly appears in front of Tamayo and invites her to the Demon Slayer headquarters — even though she is a demon. Meanwhile, after receiving a letter from Kagaya at the Butterfly Mansion, Tanjiro pays a visit to Giyu, who is not participating in the Hashira Training. At first, Tanjiro is rejected by Giyu but patiently continues to try to talk to him. Giyu, who gives in to Tanjiro's persistence, begins to share the reason why he won't participate in the training.

5-3.title: Fully Recovered Tanjiro Joins the Hashira Training!!
5-3.overview: After talking with Tanjiro, Giyu is able to overcome his past self and decides to join the training. Meanwhile, Tanjiro's wounds have healed enough to join the training, and heads to his first training with the former Hashira, Uzui.

5-4.title: To Bring a Smile to One's Face
5-4.overview: After completing training with Uzui, Tanjiro visits the Tokito residence next. The Demon Slayer swordsmen who have already started the training are dispirited by Muichiro's intense training and harsh words. Tanjiro hears the swordsmen discussing if there's anything they can do about it...

5-5.title: I Even Ate Demons…
5-5.overview: After completing Mitsuri's training, Tanjiro heads to train with Iguro. When he arrives at the training site, Iguro is waiting for him, visibly angry. Will he be able to complete this horrifying training where he'll have to fix his sword skills?

5-6.title: The Strongest of the Demon Slayer Corps
5-6.overview: Tanjiro and Zenitsu head to Himejima's training site deep in the mountains and reunite with Inosuke and Murata. Tanjiro first starts the training by being hit by a waterfall but struggles with the coldness and weight of the water.

5-7.title: Stone Hashira: Gyōmei Himejima
