5-7.overview: Tanjiro was struggling with Himejima's tasks. Now he finally manages to move the boulder after receiving advice from Genya, whom he meets by chance. With this breakthrough, will Tanjiro be able to overcome Himejima's rigorous training?

5-8.title: The Hashira Unite
5-8.overview: During a silent night when the moon shines, Kagaya finally meets Muzan Kibutsuji, who appears at the Ubuyashiki Mansion.

353367.name: Wayne
353367.overview: In this gritty and sometimes bloody tale, sixteen year-old Wayne sets out on a dirt bike with his new crush Del to take back the 1978 Pontiac Trans Am that was stolen from his father before he died. It is Wayne and Del against the world.

similar.name: The Continental: From the World of John Wick

1-1.title: Chapter One: Get Some Then
1-1.overview: Wayne, a 16 year-old Dirty Harry with a heart of gold, sets out on his dirt-bike from Boston to Florida with his new crush Del, to get back a s*** hot '79 Trans Am that was stolen from his father before he died.

1-2.title: Chapter Two: No Priests
1-2.overview: When Wayne fails to do one simple task for Del, she questions her choice to leave Brockton. The consequences of this small failure have life-threatening results when Wayne crosses paths with a dangerous local.

1-3.title: Chapter Three: The Goddamned Beacon of Truth
1-3.overview: After Wayne and Del make an appearance on the local news, Del gives Wayne a lesson in lying in order to keep their new cool friends at bay. But it’s not long before their lies are discovered and their cover is blown.

1-4.title: Chapter Four: Find Something Black to Wear
1-4.overview: After being robbed, Wayne goes to work as a day laborer as Del becomes obsessed with a stranger’s death. Meanwhile, Carl and Teddy celebrate their birthday on the road and come to terms with who their father really is.

1-5.title: Chapter Five: Del
1-5.overview: A look back on a day long before Wayne met Del; a day that changed Del, Daddy, and the boys forever.

1-6.title: Chapter Six: Who Even Are We Now?
1-6.overview: When Del makes friends at a local Georgia high school, Wayne worries she might miss home. Or even worse--that she may want to stay and live the life she never had in Brockton. Meanwhile, Daddy and the boys are closing in fast, and Orlando helps Cole with a speech for the Principals Conference.

1-7.title: Chapter Seven: It'll Last Forever
1-7.overview: Wayne struggles with whether or not to tell Del that her dad is in the hospital, while Sergeant Geller lays a trap for Wayne and Del.

1-8.title: Chapter Eight: Musta Burned Like Hell
1-8.overview: After their first kiss, Wayne and Del arrive in Florida, where they have a chance encounter with the elusive Trans Am. But when Wayne reconnects with his mom Maureen, Del starts to realize Wayne’s real reason for coming to Florida might not be the car after all.

1-9.title: Chapter Nine: Thought We Was Friends
1-9.overview: When things with both Del and his mom go south, Wayne turns this attention back to his dad’s Trans Am. But he has to contend with Calvin and Reggie to get it. Meanwhile, Del learns a secret about Wayne that changes everything for her.

1-10.title: Chapter Ten: Buckle the F**k Up
1-10.overview: Wayne, now under arrest and on his own, must face off against Reggie in a brutal fight to settle their rivalry. Meanwhile, Del returns to Wayne’s mom’s house, determined to get her man back by any means necessary.

355774.name: Dr. STONE
355774.overview: One fateful day, all of humanity was petrified by a blinding flash of light. After several millennia, high schooler Taiju awakens and finds himself lost in a world of statues. However, he’s not alone! His science-loving friend Senku’s been up and running for a few months and he's got a grand plan in mind—to kickstart civilization with the power of science!

0-1.title: Behind the Scenes of Dr. STONE
0-1.overview: Crunchyroll takes you behind the scenes of this season’s biggest show, Dr. STONE. Meet the Producer, Shusuke Katagiri, and Director, Shinya Iino, as they take us through the process of creating a hit anime. From storyboards to screens, see the making of an episode of Dr. STONE.

0-2.title: Dr. STONE Special Feature
0-2.overview: A recap episode with additional scenes which was released on Jump's official YouTube channel for Jump Special Anime Festa 2020.

0-3.title: Ryusui
0-3.overview: Senku's team searches for oil, but their new captain, Ryusui, poses unexpected challenges.

1-1.title: Stone World
1-1.overview: Several thousand years after a mysterious phenomenon  turns all of humanity to stone, the extraordinarily intelligent, science-driven boy, Senku Ishigami, awakens from petrification. Facing a world of stone and the total collapse of civilization, Senku makes up his mind to use science to rebuild the world. Starting with his super strong childhood friend Taiju Oki, who awakened at the same time, they will begin to rebuild civilization from nothing. Depicting two million years of scientific history from the Stone Age to present day, the unprecedented crafting adventure story is about to begin.

1-2.title: King of the Stone World
1-2.overview: Facing immediate danger from wild animals Senku and Taiju are forced to revive Tsukasa Shishio "The Strongest High School Primate". Although Tsukasa has tremendous fighting ability and provides abundant food as their hunter, their new ally harbors an opposing view on restoring humanity.

1-3.title: Weapons of Science
1-3.overview: Senku does not trust the motivation of Shishio, so he will try to hide his plans from a new and unforeseen enemy for his plan to revive civilization.

1-4.title: Fire the Smoke Signal
1-4.overview: Senku has the idea of ​​creating gunpowder to have a way to balance the scale and have a chance to defeat Shishio. The production of gunpowder causes a fire. Shortly thereafter, Senku and the others discover smoke signals on the horizon. An accident? Hardly likely. Apparently there are other people in the stone world ...

1-5.title: Stone World The Beginning
1-5.overview: Shishio is determined to end Senku's life if he does not promise at that moment that he will abandon his idea of ​​recovering civilization as it was before the incident.

1-6.title: Two Nations of the Stone World
1-6.overview: Taiju and Yuzuriha figure out Senku's secret to reviving him. But now that he's back, they need to deal with Tsukasa.

1-7.title: Where Two Million Years Have Gone
1-7.overview: Kohaku shows Senku to her village, but it's going to take some convincing before they let him in. In the meantime, he makes friends with a like-minded, promising "sorcerer."

1-8.title: Stone Road
1-8.overview: Kohaku's sister, village priestess Ruri, is gravely ill. Senku, Chrome and Kohaku begin their quest to make antibiotics to save her life.

1-9.title: Let There Be the Light of Science
1-9.overview: Senku starts a ramen stand in hopes of winning over support for his kingdom of science, but some people are too principled to take such a bribe. Mentalist Asagiri Gen is not one of them.

1-10.title: A Flimsy Alliance
1-10.overview: Senku and his kingdom of science successfully test the first lightbulb since the collapse. Meanwhile, Asagiri Gen, a spy from Tsukasa's empire, is killed by an unknown attacker.

1-11.title: Clear World
1-11.overview: The development of glassworks, an important step for making sulfa drugs and for chemistry as a whole, turns out to have a surprising benefit for Suika.

1-12.title: Buddies Back to Back
1-12.overview: To make antibiotics, Senku and his kingdom need to obtain sulfuric acid from a fountain of the stuff. The team goes prepared, but there's no guarantee that they'll make it back alive.

1-13.title: Masked Warrior
1-13.overview: All that's needed to make antibiotics is alcohol. The best way to get some is to win the Grand Bout, which the Senku and his kingdom will also need to do in order to keep Magma away from Ruri and give her the drug.

1-14.title: Master of Flame
1-14.overview: After Magma's series of tricks to reach the final match, Chrome reveals a trick of his own! With a little extra help from Gen, Chrome just may be able to pull this one off!

1-15.title: The Culmination of Two Million Years
1-15.overview: After Senku's unlikely victory, quick marriage, and even hastier divorce, the kingdom of science is back to work to finally finish Ruri's medicine!

1-16.title: A Tale for the Ages
1-16.overview: Ruri reveals the origin of the village's name and Senku learns of his father's fate!

1-17.title: A Hundred Nights and a Thousand Skies
1-17.overview: Byakuya and the astronauts' story continues, and Senku's connection to Ishigami Village and the Hundred Tales is finally revealed.

1-18.title: Stone Wars
1-18.overview: Tsukasa's army is coming! Kinro struggles to hold the bridge against the deadly spearman Hyoga and his shock troops, but Senku and the villagers are ready with deadly new weapons of science!

1-19.title: To Modernity
1-19.overview: Hyoga is disarmed, but the kingdom of science is still in danger - Ishigami village is in flames! And Tsukasa will soon know that Senku is still alive... How will the villagers fight off the coming invasion?

1-20.title: The Age of Energy
1-20.overview: Work begins on creating the components for Senku's cell phone, but spinning gold wire is proving to be quite the task! Luckily, Chrome and Kaseki "invent" the water wheel and drastically improve the process!

1-21.title: Spartan Crafts Club
1-21.overview: With Chrome and Kaseki’s water wheel finished, Ishigami Village moves into the age of electricity! But with the primitive materials available to him, will Senku be able to create a filament that can withstand the intense heat of operating a vacuum tube?

1-22.title: The Treasure
1-22.overview: Senku, Chrome, and Magma venture into a cave in search of Tungsten, but there's a suspicious accident that leaves Senku and Chrome trapped at the bottom of a pit! What is Magma up to?!

1-23.title: Wave of Science
1-23.overview: Senku and the rest of the village get to work on making the components for the cell phone. It's hard work but everyone is pumped!

1-24.title: Voices Over Infinite Distance
1-24.overview: After a successful test of their new cell phone, Senku learns of a mysterious tale about a bee named Speaker who can play the voices of the dead.

2-1.title: Stone Wars Beginning
2-1.overview: Senku continues in trying to advance the Stone World, this time he makes "space food", it is in actuality cup noodles. After Senku finishes his project, Gen has an epiphany and devises a plan to take down Tsukasa's army without violence.

2-2.title: Hot Line
2-2.overview: While Senku's diversion buys Gen and others some time, soon Homura realizes something is not right.

2-3.title: Call from the Dead
2-3.overview: Taiju and Yuzuriha are on the verge of tears after they hear Senku's voice, and Senku informs them of his plan to win the war without any bloodshed.

2-4.title: Full Assault
2-4.overview: Chrome and Magma struggle with Ukyo, while Senku, gets his hands busy with building up an invention; a new hope.

2-5.title: Steam Gorilla
2-5.overview: The final touches to the automobile are made and it is used to transport the science supplies to a fortified cliffside that's close to the Tsukasa empire. From there the automobile is upgraded into a tank, but unbeknownst to the rescue group preparations by the empire have been made to counter any vehicular attack.

2-6.title: Prison Break
2-6.overview: Chrome must use all of his scientific knowledge to escape from his prison and save Senku and others.

2-7.title: Secret Mission
2-7.overview: Senku decides to use the Steam-Gorilla to capture The Miracle Cave. Using Lillian's recording, Senku gains the trust of more of Tsukasa's men. Ukyo reveals he saw Yuzuriha's secret mission to reassemble the fragments of statues Tsukasa destroyed.

2-8.title: Final Battle
2-8.overview: The Final Battle for the miracle cave starts as Senku and the Kingdom of Science conduct a frontal assault on the cave.

2-9.title: To Destroy and to Save
2-9.overview: Tsukasa and Hyoga are coming to capture the miracle cave. The Kingdom of Science must buy Senku and Chrome some time to turn the tide, or it is all over.

2-10.title: Humanity's Strongest Tag Team
2-10.overview: Senku demands a truce from Tsukasa in return for reviving his sister, Mirai, who Tsukasa comes to know is alive, but a new problem shows up when Hyoga shows his true self.

2-11.title: PROLOGUE OF Dr. STONE
2-11.overview: The Kingdom of Science is victorious, however it is not over for Senku. Senku must use all of his knowledge to cure Tsukasa who is severly injured.

3-1.title: NEW WORLD MAP
3-1.overview: While continuing to use the hot air balloon to search for the oil, it's decided that Ishigami Village needs to take up agriculture to prevent future food shortages, as well as to produce preserved food for their upcoming sea voyage.

3-2.title: Greed Equals Justice
3-2.overview: The Kingdom of Science will need rations to last them through their voyage to the other side of the world. But Senku, being no professional, burns all the bread he attempts to bake.

3-3.title: First Contact
3-3.overview: Senku, brings along a team to look for the Sagara Oil Fields. Meanwhile, Suika and Francois go truffle hunting.

3-4.title: Eyes of Science
3-4.overview: The morse code signal reading "WHY" saturates the airwaves too much for Ukyo to pinpoint a direction, so the Kingdom of Science works on a way to visualize the signal.

3-5.title: Science Vessel Perseus
3-5.overview: Kaseki's efforts to build the science vessel Perseus hit a roadblock when he realizes that it's impossible to get all the parts to fit in practice.

3-6.title: TREASURE BOX
3-6.overview: The Perseus crew are on their way to the treasure island, the birthplace of the Hundred Tales, where they hope to locate the treasure box left behind by the Soyuz crew.

3-7.title: Ray of Despair, Ray of Hope
3-7.overview: The Perseus arrives at the treasure island. A recon squad consisting of Senku, Soyuz, Kohaku, and Gen set off to locate the platinum and make contact with the islanders. Ukyo later discovers something on the seafloor and send Ginro to investigate.

3-8.title: The Trump Card Aboard the Science Vessel
3-8.overview: Amaryllis explains how she evaded petrification and how she came to her decision to sneak into the inner palace.

3-9.title: Beautiful Science
3-9.overview: Suika and Ginro work together to rescue the mobile lab from the Perseus. Reunited with Senku and the others, the group works on items to help Kohaku with the selection process.

3-10.title: SCIENCE WARS
3-10.overview: Amaryllis, Ginro and Kohaku are chosen to join the inner palace. The science team will need a way to communicate with them in secret, and, eventually, a way for them with the science team.

3-11.title: With This Fist, a Miracle
3-11.overview: Kohaku has located the treasure left behind by Byakuya and the others, but it's encased in concrete. Senku has to devise a plan to quietly get at the contents inside, so as to not alert the guards.

3-12.title: The Kingdom of Science's Counterattack
3-12.overview: Kohaku is forced to destroy Ryusui's statue to prove that she isn't a spy.

3-13.title: The Medusa's True Face
3-13.overview: The team revives Kaseki to work on the drone. Meanwhile, Ginro is called to see the Master.

3-14.title: Deal Game, Test of Wit
3-14.overview: More of the Kingdom of Science is brought back from petrification, but they are discovered in the cave by Moz.

3-15.title: Battle in Three Dimensions
3-15.overview: Moz and the Kingdom of Science form a tenuous, temporary alliance against Ibara. How long it will last is a question they can't afford to concern themselves with just yet.

3-16.title: Total War
3-16.overview: The Kingdom of Science attacks and tries to execute their plan to steal the petrification device. Moz convinces Kirisame to use the device, but Ryusui's instincts tell him something is off about the situation.

3-17.title: JOKER
3-17.overview: The Kingdom of Science members launch an attack on the islanders aboard the Perseus, but Moz isn't far behind and Senku and the others are forced to retreat inside the vessel. Ibara has them cornered, but Senku unleashes his Joker card.

3-18.title: Flicker of Doom
3-18.overview: Yo and the Kingdom of Science capture the petrification device, but Ibara isn't going down without a fight.

3-19.title: LAST MAN STANDING
3-19.overview: Much to Ibara's shock and dismay, Senku devised a plan and managed to escape petrification. Now the two enter into a head-to-head battle for control of the Medusa device.

3-20.title: FIRST DREAM
3-20.overview: Senku stands victorious. He then works on reviving the others and fixing their communications device, but while they are talking with Ruri they encounter a strong interference with the signal.

3-21.title: Treasure Island
3-21.overview: To the moon! That's the plan, at least. Senku and the Kingdom of Science need to devise a means with which to go to the moon and deal with Why-Man. The first step is allying with the people of Treasure Island and enlisting their help with some new crafts.

3-22.title: BEYOND THE NEW WORLD
3-22.overview: With the petrification device in the Kingdom's hands, it's time to revive Tsukasa. But there's just one problem: the device is out of batteries.

4-1.title: RYUSUI VS. SENKU
4-1.overview: Senku and his companions finally set off for America in search of corn. However, a dispute arises between Ryusui and Senku shortly after they depart.

4-2.title: SCIENCE JOURNEY
4-2.overview: Maintaining morale will be critical on the long journey to the Americas. Knowing where on the ocean you are is pretty important, too. The crew of the Perseus discuss.

4-3.title: Light Trap in the Darkness
4-3.overview: The Perseus lands in the Americas. They first head to Northern California in search of yellow dent corn, but discover a lot more than that.

4-4.title: Dr. X
4-4.overview: The search party narrowly escaped enemy machine gun fire. Unfortunately, the respite was short-lived.

4-5.title: DOCTOR VS. DOCTOR
4-5.overview: Tensions rise as Dr. Xeno makes his introductions to the Perseus.

4-6.title: SCIENCE IS ELEGANT
4-6.overview: Stanley orders Luna to infiltrate the Perseus and identify Doctor Taiju. Things go sideways when it turns out to be a little too easy.

4-7.title: The Two Scientists
4-7.overview: Senku had gotten his start in rocket building through an email exchange with Doctor Xeno. Their approaches to science soon diverged.

4-8.title: LOCK ON
4-8.overview: NASA scientist Dr. Xeno attempts to pick off the leader of the Kingdom of Science.

4-9.title: Light of Science
4-9.overview: With Senku having been shot, the Kingdom of Science plots its retaliation against Dr. Xeno.

4-10.title: Dirty Roads
4-10.overview: With Senku still confined to the bed, Chrome's team begins work on the tunnel to Xeno's base.

4-11.title: Those Who Know the Rules; Those Who Make Them
4-11.overview: Ryusui and Senku take to the skies in a science versus science dogfight while Xeno's forces mount a ground counterattack.

4-12.title: Reunion
4-12.overview: Xeno's army attacks and when all seems lost, Chrome and his friends finish the tunnel and capture Xeno.

4-13.title: Watching the Same Moon
4-13.overview: The team head to the source of the petrification beam in South America as they flee from Stanley's ship.

4-14.title: EARTH RACE
4-14.overview: Senku and company must flee from Stanley's ship, but they have to make stops to refuel.

4-15.title: The Escape
4-15.overview: With Stanley's ship hot on their tail, can science help Senku and company escape?

4-16.title: Medusa Mechanism
4-16.overview: The team is going to need a weapon for when Stanley inevitably catches up to them.

4-17.title: Sickening Yet Beautiful
4-17.overview: Senku and his team have lost Stanley for now, but they aren't out of — or rather, in — the woods just yet.

4-18.title: Diamond Heart
4-18.overview: The team discovers a giant pile of petrification devices. They take them apart to see what makes them tick.

4-19.title: Stone Sanctuary
4-19.overview: The team begins making, digging for, and polishing diamonds to replace the burnt-out ones inside the devices.

4-20.title: What I Once Sought to Destroy
4-20.overview: Suika is in charge of making sure Senku's plan works, but her kindness becomes an obstacle.

4-21.title: Our Dr. Stone
4-21.overview: With the revival team captured, it's up to Luna and Chelsea to revive everyone when the time comes.

4-22.title: Until We Meet Again
4-22.overview: With the petrification beam approaching, who will get their hands on the revival fluid?

4-23.title: Scientist, All Alone
4-23.overview: Suika gathers the team's statues, sets up camp and gets to work doing science.

4-24.title: Whole New World
4-24.overview: With Senku back, it's only a matter of time before the rest of the Kingdom of Science is revived.

4-25.title: Future Engine
4-25.overview: Senku and Dr. Xeno team up to gather the materials needed to make a rocket engine.

4-26.title: Fire
4-26.overview: The crew arrives in Spain, where they collect fluorite, olive oil and some treats.

4-27.title: The Universe Is Written in the Language of Mathematics
4-27.overview: The New Perseus sets out to India to recruit mathematicians for the space program.

4-28.title: Dawn of the Computer
4-28.overview: The computer that the team is building is a series of toroidal tubes. Senku explains.

4-29.title: The Truth About the Rocket
4-29.overview: The team gets to work wiring up several megabits' worth of memory donuts for their computer.

4-30.title: Stone to Space
4-30.overview: The team will need a stupidly insane amount of electricity to turn their bauxite into an aluminum rocket body.

4-31.title: Unknown Known
4-31.overview: With the computer completed, the team will need a user interface: a TV.

4-32.title: Challengers of Science
4-32.overview: The Kingdom of Science's rocket launches are mired by a string of rapid unscheduled disassemblies.

4-33.title: Wanting Everything
4-33.overview: The team is too small to build a round-trip rocket. They'll need to enlist help from around the world.

4-34.title: Countdown
4-34.overview: Ryusui may need to defer to a better pilot for the moon mission.

4-35.title: Giant Step
4-35.overview: The rocket needs to be assembled in space. Not an easy feat in the 21st century, let alone in the stone world.

4-36.title: Why-Man
4-36.overview: The team sets foot on the moon to confront Why-Man.

4-37.title: Ushers of an Exhilarating Future
4-37.overview: Senku offers Why-Man more exhilaration than they can handle.

357222.name: Modern Love
357222.overview: An unlikely friendship. A lost love resurfaced. A marriage at its turning point. A date that might not have been a date. An unconventional new family. These are unique stories about the joys and tribulations of love, each inspired by true events.

similar.name: Tyler Perry's For Better or Worse

1-1.title: When the Doorman Is Your Main Man
1-1.overview: “Ours was a common and unsung friendship, that between women living in New York, single and alone, and the doormen who take care of them, acting as gatekeepers, bodyguards, confidants and father figures.”

1-2.title: When Cupid Is a Prying Journalist
1-2.overview: “I tossed out one last question: ‘Have you ever been in love?’ No one, he said, had ever asked him that in an interview. ‘Yes,’ he finally answered. ‘But I didn’t realize it until it was too late.’ Then he asked me to turn off my recorder. I hit Stop."

1-3.title: Take Me as I Am, Whoever I Am
1-3.overview: “My personal life was another story. In love there’s no hiding: You have to let someone know who you are, but I didn’t have a clue who I was from one moment to the next.”

1-4.title: Rallying to Keep the Game Alive
1-4.overview: “We rallied, not with the adrenaline-pumping determination to win at all costs, but with the patience and control that came with not wanting it to be over: not the summer, not our son’s childhood, not this game, ever.”

1-5.title: At the Hospital, an Interlude of Clarity
1-5.overview: “There is never a good time to fall off your couch onto a martini glass and begin losing a dangerous amount of blood, but having this happen in the middle of a promising date is an especially bad time.”

1-6.title: So He Looked Like Dad. It Was Just Dinner, Right?
1-6.overview: “He was very handsome. He wore gray turtleneck sweaters and smelled like mint aftershave and old books. He was 55 and recently divorced for the second time. He was my father. He wasn't really my father.”

1-7.title: Hers Was a World of One
1-7.overview: “There was no guarantee that doing an open adoption would get us a baby any faster… in fact, our agency warned us that, as a gay male couple, we might be in for a long wait.”

1-8.title: The Race Grows Sweeter Near Its Final Lap
1-8.overview: “Old love is different. In our 70s and 80s, we had been through enough of life’s ups and downs to know who we were, and we had learned to compromise. The finish line was drawing closer.”

2-1.title: On a Serpentine Road, With the Top Down
2-1.overview: "Driving, with the top down, I’m reminded that I too can shift gears, face risk, handle inconvenience — and survive tragedy. My partner, eyes misting, says: 'You love that car. And your husband was an extraordinary man.'"

2-2.title: The Night Girl Finds a Day Boy
2-2.overview: "I'm a vampire, basically — going to bed around 8 or 9 a.m. and waking around 4 or 5 p.m. First dates usually go OK because they’re in the evening, but complications quickly arise."

2-3.title: Strangers on a (Dublin) Train
2-3.overview: "We met on a train. A perfect, flirtatious, six hours. The beginning of our love story? Trusting in the power of the universe, we hadn’t exchanged mobile numbers. Sometimes, a romantic plan isn’t enough."

2-4.title: A Life Plan for Two, Followed By One
2-4.overview: "He was everything a 10-year-old girl could ever hope for in a man. It was decided; I was in love. I started to wonder if the glow from my wedding dress would make him look washed-out. I began devising a plan in which he and I would end up '2gether 4ever,' as all my notebooks stated."

2-5.title: Am I ...? Maybe This Quiz Will Tell Me
2-5.overview: "In retrospect, maybe I should have known who I was the first time I went looking for a quiz called 'Am I gay?' But I didn’t."

2-6.title: In the Waiting Room of Estranged Spouses
2-6.overview: "A few months later, I was in the psychologist’s reception room, paying for my fourth really good cry, when a woman carrying a child walked in. I didn’t recognize her at first, and then I remembered her face. 'Are you the wife of the guy my wife is having an affair with?' I asked tactlessly. 'Yeah,' she said. 'But we’re not together anymore.'"

2-7.title: How Do You Remember Me?
2-7.overview: "I don’t remember his last name. He was handsome, with a nice smile and startlingly blue eyes. The sex was good, I think. We didn’t know each other well. We never would."

2-8.title: A Second Embrace, with Hearts and Eyes Open
2-8.overview: "On this night, long after we had thrown in the towel on us, here we were again, crawling back into the ring. This time, though, it would be different. We just never imagined how different it would become, or how quickly."

357888.name: Love, Death & Robots
357888.overview: Terrifying creatures, wicked surprises and dark comedy converge in this NSFW anthology of animated stories presented by Tim Miller and David Fincher.

similar.name: The Second Best Hospital in the Galaxy

1-1.title: SONNIE'S EDGE
1-1.overview: In the underground world of "beastie" fights, Sonnie is unbeatable -- as long as she keeps her edge.

1-2.title: THREE ROBOTS
1-2.overview: Long after the fall of humanity, three robots embark on a sightseeing tour of a post-apocalyptic city.

1-3.title: THE WITNESS
1-3.overview: After seeing a brutal murder, a woman flees from the killer through the streets of a surreal city.

1-4.title: SUITS
1-4.overview: A community of farmers use their homemade mechs to defend their families from an alien invasion.

1-5.title: SUCKER OF SOULS
1-5.overview: Unleashed by an archaeological dig, a bloodthirsty demon battles a team of mercenaries armed with... cats?

1-6.title: WHEN THE YOGURT TOOK OVER
1-6.overview: After scientists accidentally breed super-intelligent yogurt, it soon hungers for world domination.

1-7.title: BEYOND THE AQUILA RIFT
1-7.overview: Awakening after traveling light years off course, a ship's crew struggles to discover just how far they've come.

1-8.title: GOOD HUNTING
1-8.overview: The son of a spirit hunter forges a bond with a shape-shifting huli jing.

1-9.title: THE DUMP
1-9.overview: Ugly Dave calls the garbage dump home, and he's not about to let some city slicker take it away from him.

1-10.title: SHAPE-SHIFTERS
1-10.overview: Deep in Afghanistan, two Marines with supernatural powers face a threat from one of their own kind.

1-11.title: HELPING HAND
1-11.overview: Stranded in orbit, an astronaut must choose between life and limb before her oxygen runs out.

1-12.title: FISH NIGHT
1-12.overview: After their car breaks down in the desert, two salesmen take a dreamlike voyage to the dawn of time.

1-13.title: LUCKY 13
1-13.overview: After the drop-ship Lucky 13 lost two crews, no pilot would fly her... but rookies don't get a choice.

1-14.title: ZIMA BLUE
1-14.overview: The renowned artist Zima recounts his mysterious past and rise to fame before unveiling his final work.

1-15.title: BLINDSPOT
1-15.overview: A gang of cyborg thieves stage a high-speed heist of a heavily armored convoy.

1-16.title: ICE AGE
1-16.overview: A young couple moves into an apartment and finds a lost civilization inside their antique freezer.

1-17.title: ALTERNATE HISTORIES
1-17.overview: Want to see Hitler die in a variety of comically fantastic ways? Now you can. Welcome to Multiversity!

1-18.title: THE SECRET WAR
1-18.overview: Elite units of the Red Army fight an unholy evil deep in the ancient forests of Siberia.

2-1.title: Automated Customer Service
2-1.overview: If your home-cleaning unit is attempting to murder you, please press 3.

2-2.title: Ice
2-2.overview: Two brothers far from home join genetically "modded" locals in a deadly race.

2-3.title: Pop Squad
2-3.overview: A cop charged with fighting the scourge of overpopulation is haunted by the human toll of his work.

2-4.title: Snow in the Desert
2-4.overview: Every bounty hunter in the galaxy wants a piece of Snow.

2-5.title: The Tall Grass
2-5.overview: During a journey across the prairie, a man becomes transfixed by distant, ghostly lights.

2-6.title: All Through the House
2-6.overview: On Christmas Eve, two kids tiptoe downstairs to catch a glimpse of Santa. A twisted tale for adults only.

2-7.title: Life Hutch
2-7.overview: After crash-landing on a craggy planet, a pilot makes his way to shelter, only to face a threat within.

2-8.title: The Drowned Giant
2-8.overview: The body of a colossal young man washes ashore and becomes an object of fascination for the locals.

3-1.title: Three Robots: Exit Strategies
3-1.overview: Three robots walk into the post-apocalypse… and take a whirlwind tour of humankind's last attempts to save itself.

3-2.title: Bad Travelling
3-2.overview: Release the Thanapod! A ship’s crew member sailing an alien ocean strikes a deal with a ravenous monster of the deep.

3-3.title: The Very Pulse of the Machine
3-3.overview: When an exploratory mission to a Jovian moon ends in disaster, the lone survivor must begin a perilous but mind-expanding journey.

3-4.title: Night of the Mini Dead
3-4.overview: A bit of unholy cemetery sex ends badly, kicking off a worldwide zombie plague. It’s the cutest apocalypse you’ll ever see.

3-5.title: Kill Team Kill
3-5.overview: US Special Forces are trained to neutralize any threat — even a cybernetic killing machine created by the CIA. Their secret weapon? A sense of humor.

3-6.title: Swarm
3-6.overview: Two human scientists study the secrets of an ancient alien entity — but soon learn the horrible price of survival in a hostile universe.

3-7.title: Mason's Rats
3-7.overview: Welcome to the Ratpocalypse! Farmer Mason knows he has a real pest problem when they start shooting back. Bloody hell!

3-8.title: In Vaulted Halls Entombed
3-8.overview: Modern warfare meets elder gods. A special forces squad on a hostage rescue mission finds themselves trapped in a prison containing an age-old evil.

3-9.title: Jibaro
3-9.overview: A deaf knight and a siren of myth become entwined in a deadly dance. A fatal attraction infused with blood, death and treasure.

4-1.title: Can't Stop
4-1.overview: Turn up your stereo and tune into a Red Hot Chili Peppers concert that's unlike any other — with a few strings attached.

4-2.title: Close Encounters of the Mini Kind
4-2.overview: They came in peace. But when their first encounter with Earthlings goes awry, these extra-tiny extraterrestrials are ready for vengeance.

4-3.title: Spider Rose
4-3.overview: At the edge of the galaxy, a grieving woman dreams of revenge. Can an adorable newcomer help her destroy her enemies — without destroying her humanity?

4-4.title: 400 Boys
4-4.overview: Are they gods? Are they giants? All this band of survivors knows is that they're deadly — and they'll have to set aside their own turf war to stop them.

4-5.title: The Other Large Thing
4-5.overview: This furry revolutionary has plans for world domination. All he needs is a henchman with opposable thumbs.

4-6.title: Golgotha
4-6.overview: A mysterious race of aquatic aliens has arrived on Earth. They don't want to be taken to our leaders.

4-7.title: The Screaming of the Tyrannosaur
4-7.overview: In an orbital arena, gladiators and dinosaurs compete in a deadly race — and face a terrifying new opponent.

4-8.title: How Zeke Got Religion
4-8.overview: On a perilous mission into hostile territory, the crew of a World War II bomber encounters an unholy enemy.

4-9.title: Smart Appliances, Stupid Owners
4-9.overview: From thermostats to toothbrushes to toilets, these ultra-modern appliances have something to say about their hapless owners.

4-10.title: For He Can Creep
4-10.overview: London, 1757. Satan battles a cat for the soul of a poet whose verse could give him dominion over the earth.

358824.name: The Fiery Priest
358824.overview: People commit variety of ugly crimes these days. However, they forgive themselves by giving testimony every week. They believe that they can repent just by having faith. But the truth is that they have faith to repeat the sins again and again without remorse. These people atone for their evil deeds just to feel comfortable and carefree. It is not about the victims who are suffering because of them. They say every people are equal before the religions. But it is time to discriminate people who only uses them for their interest. Screening if they are really good people, punishing if they deserve to be punished, and defending justice is needed for modern day religion. A priest with this sense of justice teams up with a detective and a prosecutor. They try to solve the mysterious death of an elderly priest and serve justice.

1-1.title: Episode 1
1-1.overview: Hae Il is a priest in a small town. He takes care of problems in the neighbourhood, but things always get physical. He gets arrested while trying to stop a fraud. He has to leave the neighbourhood to avoid accusation. Meanwhile, Kyeong Seon who is a prosecutor, is trying her best to make connection with her seniors.

1-2.title: Episode 2
1-2.overview: Hae Il leaves Yeosu and head to Gudam. He stays at the Catholic church of Father Lee Young Jun who is like a real father to him. Dae Young is a detective at Gudam Police Station. He goes out to support a local event, and protestors appear at the scene. Meanwhile, Hae Il walks by the scene and witnesses protestors getting beaten up.

1-3.title: Episode 3
1-3.overview: Hae Il helps out the protestors at the ceremony and confronts Cheol Bum. Kyeong Seon gets a bribe from the accused of her case. New recruit Seung Ah joins Dae Young's team and becomes his partner. Meanwhile, Jang Ryong and his men make a scene at the church.

1-4.title: Episode 4
1-4.overview: Jan Ryong and his men are released without any penalty. Father Lee gets a call in the middle of the night. Next day, he is found dead at a mountain nearby. Hae Il requests an investigation, but the Gudam Police and the prosecutor refuse. Police announce that Father Lee was involved in various crimes, and Hae Il gets furious.

2-1.title: We're Back
2-1.overview: Father Michael Kim Haeil returns, ready to take down a notorious and powerful drug cartel in Busan.

2-2.title: When in Busan
2-2.overview: Haeil takes up teaching at a seminary in Busan, as drug lord Kim Hongsik arrives in the city.

2-3.title: Somewhere in Between Heaven and Hell
2-3.overview: Haeil digs into the cartel, while Hongsik begins building his empire in Busan.

2-4.title: Within the Devil's Circle
2-4.overview: Hae-il and Dae-young rescue Ja-young, while a suspect in interrogation suffers an accident amid the chaos, and the three decide to team up in their pursuit of the drug cartel; with his drug plant operational, Hong-sik begins expanding his reach.

2-5.title: Hard Measures for Insanity
2-5.overview: Haeil and Hongsik sense the tension as strong rivals, while Kyungsun gains Duhun's favor.

2-6.title: The Devil is Not as Black as He is Painted
2-6.overview: Haeil's pressure on Hongsik and the cartel grows, leading Hongsik to plot a fierce counterstrike.

2-7.title: A Priest's Duty Begins with Fury
2-7.overview: When the Virgin Mary statue is set ablaze, Haeil is certain it is the work of the drug cartel.

2-8.title: A Worm Gets Crushed When Stepped on
2-8.overview: Haeil discovers Hongsik's true identity, leading to an intense face-off between the two.

2-9.title: Stand Up Again
2-9.overview: Haeil's fall signals a new resolve. His team unites, prepared to crush the forces of darkness.

2-10.title: Blessings Start Rough
2-10.overview: Under flawless disguise, Haeil and Kyungsun infiltrate the ship, but Kyungsun faces danger.

2-11.title: Real Prayers are Made on the Move
2-11.overview: Haeil and Kyungsun narrowly escape danger, while Duhun and Hongsik each plot their own survival

360261.name: Euphoria
360261.overview: A group of high school students navigate love and friendships in a world of drugs, sex, trauma, and social media.

similar.name: My Life with the Walter Boys

0-1.title: Trouble Don't Last Always
0-1.overview: In the aftermath of being left by Jules at the train station and relapsing, Rue celebrates Christmas.

0-2.title: F**k Anyone Who's Not a Sea Blob
0-2.overview: Over the Christmas holiday, Jules reflects on the year.

1-1.title: Pilot
1-1.overview: Seventeen-year-old Rue returns home from rehab with no plans to stay clean.

1-2.title: Stuntin' Like My Daddy
1-2.overview: On the first day of school, Rue has a new friend, Jules, but struggles to put the past behind her.

1-3.title: Made You Look
1-3.overview: Kat starts camming. Jules falls for a boy online. Rue is confronted at NA, and Cassie visits McKay at college.

1-4.title: Shook Ones Pt. II
1-4.overview: Rue, trying to get clean for Jules, chaperones Gia at the carnival. Jules encounters Cal with his family.

1-5.title: '03 Bonnie and Clyde
1-5.overview: Maddy and Nate must deal with a police investigation. Rue and Jules each reflect on their relationship.

1-6.title: The Next Episode
1-6.overview: On Halloween, Rue worries about her reliance on Jules when she starts acting strange.

1-7.title: The Trials and Tribulations of Trying to Pee While Depressed
1-7.overview: Rue gets depressed and watches 22 straight episodes of a British reality show.​ Jules visits an old friend.

1-8.title: And Salt the Earth Behind You
1-8.overview: It's the winter formal at East Highland.

2-1.title: Trying to Get to Heaven Before They Close the Door
2-1.overview: Rue and Jules cross paths for the first time since Christmas as East Highland rings in the new year.

2-2.title: Out of Touch
2-2.overview: As the new semester kicks off, Jules questions Rue and Elliot’s new friendship, while Cal hunts for answers.

2-3.title: Ruminations: Big and Little Bullys
2-3.overview: Rue pursues a new business venture, Cassie settles into a routine, and Cal finds a target.

2-4.title: You Who Cannot See, Think of Those Who Can
2-4.overview: Jules and Elliot grow closer, Maddy celebrates her birthday and Cal takes a trip down memory lane.

2-5.title: Stand Still Like the Hummingbird
2-5.overview: Fate has a way of catching up with those who try to outrun it.

2-6.title: A Thousand Little Trees of Blood
2-6.overview: Rue tries to recover, Lexi questions putting on her play and Nate celebrates his newfound freedom.

2-7.title: The Theater and Its Double
2-7.overview: Art imitates life as the East Highland crew watches their complicated dynamics play out onstage.

2-8.title: All My Life, My Heart Has Yearned for a Thing I Cannot Name
2-8.overview: As the show goes on, fragments of memories collide with the present and future.

3-1.title: Andale
3-1.overview: A few years after high school, Rue's debts finally catch up with her. Hoping to finance her dream wedding, Cassie tries to become internet famous – to the disapproval of Nate, who's juggling the demands of running Cal's business.

3-2.title: America My Dream
3-2.overview: Maddy arrived in the city with no money, a suitcase full of clothes, and a plan.

3-3.title: The Ballad of Paladin
3-3.overview: While in art school, Jules learns she can fund her dreams by going on dates with rich men. Having worked her way up in Alamo's organization, Rue is sent on a special mission with Bishop. Meanwhile, Cassie's storybook wedding doesn't go as planned.

3-4.title: Kitty Likes to Dance
3-4.overview: Rue is offered a risky deal that draws her deeper into Alamo's world. While Nate battles the city council, Maddy gives Cassie a mission that could skyrocket her new career, and Lexi enlists Jules to create an original painting for LA Nights.

3-5.title: This Little Piggy
3-5.overview: She would never say it out loud, but Nate going broke finally granted Cassie permission to follow her dreams.

3-6.title: Stand Still and See
3-6.overview: Rue makes a deal with the devil in the form of a promise to Alamo...and gives a word of warning to Maddy. Later, Cassie gets her first real taste of stardom on the set of LA Nights, and Rue paints Jules a picture of her ideal future.

3-7.title: Rain or Shine
3-7.overview: Under intense financial pressure, Maddy schemes to get Cassie back in the spotlight. Meanwhile, Rue obsesses over the sign God gave her.

3-8.title: In God We Trust
3-8.overview: Danger closes in on all sides as Rue's double-dealing finally reaches its breaking point. While the medical van speeds towards the border, Maddy and Cassie must band together – and Alamo is struck by a life-changing epiphany.

382936.name: Maid
382936.overview: After fleeing an abusive relationship, a young mother finds a job cleaning houses as she fights to provide for her child and build them a better future.

similar.name: My Life with the Walter Boys

1-1.title: Dollar Store
1-1.overview: Fleeing in the night with Maddy, Alex seeks help from social services and lands a job with Value Maids, only to find her problems are just beginning.

1-2.title: Ponies
1-2.overview: After a long night on the floor of a ferry terminal with Maddy, Alex finds shelter, but custody issues and an unhappy client push her to the edge.

1-3.title: Sea Glass
1-3.overview: While navigating the complex government assistance system, Alex wrangles with Sean over Maddy's care and tackles a cleaning job that nearly breaks her.

1-4.title: Cashmere
1-4.overview: Cleaning Regina's gorgeous house on Thanksgiving, Alex imagines what it would be like to live in such luxury before taking the fantasy a step further.

1-5.title: Thief
1-5.overview: A job cleaning out the childhood home of a notorious local thief triggers memories for Alex, who also discovers what's causing Maddy's worrying cough.

1-6.title: M
1-6.overview: Determined to send Maddy to a better preschool, Alex desperately searches for a new place to live, a process complicated by her government benefits.

1-7.title: String Cheese
1-7.overview: Alex writes about her clients, including a couple living separate lives, as she juggles her tricky housing situation and Paula's fragile mental state.

1-8.title: Bear Hunt
1-8.overview: Amid a crushing series of setbacks, Alex explores the possibility of college while dealing with Paula's health crisis and offering Regina a helping hand.

1-9.title: Sky Blue
1-9.overview: Back at square one, Alex reaches out for a safe harbor and legal lifeline, realizing how much of herself she's lost along the way.

1-10.title: Snaps
1-10.overview: Gaining strength and support from a creative writing therapy group, Alex fights for her future by facing off with Sean over custody of Maddy.

384429.overview: When mysterious events change the course of an immigrant ship headed for New York in 1899, a mind-bending riddle unfolds for its bewildered passengers.

1-1.title: The Ship
1-1.overview: Maura helps a pregnant woman. The captain makes a brave decision after receiving a message from a lost ship — and discovers something mind-bending.

1-2.title: The Boy
1-2.overview: The captain experiences unexplainable flashbacks. A strange man follows Maura to her cabin where a boy is hiding. A bug leads to a tragedy on deck.

1-3.title: The Fog
1-3.overview: A girl and other passengers suffer a terrible fate. Olek frees Ling Yi from a box. The captain makes a discovery that challenges his trust in Maura.

1-4.title: The Fight
1-4.overview: Several crew members and passengers search the ship for the boy after locking up the captain, Olek, Jérôme and Ramiro. Krester's secret is revealed.

1-5.title: The Calling
1-5.overview: Maura has terrible flashbacks and makes a shocking move. A sound leads some passengers to jump overboard. Maura makes a discovery about her father.

1-6.title: The Pyramid
1-6.overview: Tove has scary flashbacks and wants to kill the boy. Daniel follows Maura and the captain into a strange place. Maura's father appears with a message.

1-7.title: The Storm
1-7.overview: Daniel asks Maura for something she doesn't understand. Olek and Ling Yi steer the ship before a tragedy occurs. Elliot's identity comes to light.

1-8.title: The Key
1-8.overview: Maura tells the passengers an unbelievable truth. Then, their memories shift and Daniel changes a code. Maura faces an unexpected reality.

384541.name: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
384541.overview: In a dystopia riddled with corruption and cybernetic implants, a talented but reckless street kid strives to become a mercenary outlaw — an edgerunner.

1-1.title: Let You Down
1-1.overview: After a night of streaming illegal braindance, David wakes up to reality: a rundown apartment with a broken washing machine and an overworked mother.

1-2.title: Like a Boy
1-2.overview: With his newly enhanced body, David heads to the Academy seeking revenge on his bully. Later, he meets a mysterious woman who wants to recruit him.

1-3.title: Smooth Criminal
1-3.overview: Surrounded by a group of rowdy edgerunners, David makes a plea to join their team. Meanwhile, sinister forces plot to lure him back to Arasaka Academy.

1-4.title: Lucky You
1-4.overview: Eager to learn the edgerunner ropes, David pesters Maine for another mission. Instead, Maine tasks Lucy with training him.

1-5.title: All Eyez on Me
1-5.overview: David makes a clever suggestion when the team strategizes for their next mission. However, he soon learns that their target can't be underestimated.

1-6.title: Girl on Fire
1-6.overview: Maine doesn't seem to be himself. But the team has bigger fish to fry: They must race against time to extract vital information from their prisoner.

1-7.title: Stronger
1-7.overview: Now an all-star edgerunner enhanced with more cybernetics, David leads his team into a new mission. An old contact reaches out to him for a big job.

1-8.title: Stay
1-8.overview: Faraday finds himself stuck between Arasaka and Militech. Lucy and Rebecca confront David about his change in behavior, but he refuses to listen.

1-9.title: Humanity
1-9.overview: Lucy's captors learn about her secret mission and dark past. David and his team head out to complete Faraday's job but realize that something is off.

1-10.title: My Moon My Man
1-10.overview: On the edge of cyberpsychosis but determined to save Lucy, David storms into Night City as Arasaka plots to deploy their ultimate lethal weapon.

385542.name: Moriarty the Patriot
385542.overview: In the late 19th century, the British Empire nobility reigns while its working class suffers at their hands. Sympathetic to their plight, William James Moriarty wants to topple it all. Frustrated by the systemic inequity, Moriarty strategizes to fix the entire nation. Not even consulting detective Sherlock Holmes can stand in his way. It’s time for crime to revolutionize the world!

0-1.title: Reminiscence of the Lily
0-1.overview: A newspaper article about a vandalized painting catches the eye of William James Moriarty. Recognizing the artist from his childhood days in the slums, he takes his brother Louis with him on a trip to the city of Bath to meet with the artist personally and identify the culprit. However, the person claiming to be the painter is not the man William remembers. Joined by Sherlock Holmes and John H. Watson, William looks for clues in order to find his old friend.

0-2.title: The Tea Party
0-2.overview: The Moriarty household faces its biggest crisis to date: hosting a tea party. Mysterious and closed off to the public, the Moriarty home hides an abundance of weapons, research, and other tools used in their underground activities. To keep their secret safe from overly curious—and completely smitten—aristocratic women, the entire team must maximize their skills and protect their base of operations at all costs.

1-1.title: The Earl’s Crime
1-1.overview: A rash of abductions of young boys that end up brutally murdered is plaguing London, and police are powerless to stop it. When William Moriarty discovers a clue linking all the victims, he and his brothers take an interest in the case.

1-2.title: The Scarlet Eyes, Act 1
1-2.overview: In 1866, a brilliant young orphan and his ailing younger brother are taken in by a charitable aid organization, where they catch the attention of the son of an earl, who is discontent with Britain’s class system.

1-3.title: The Scarlet Eyes, Act 2
1-3.overview: Albert invites the brothers to come live at the Moriarty’s estate, but the pair are not warmly welcomed by the other members of the household. Albert grows increasingly disturbed by his family’s intolerance, and resorts to drastic measures.

1-4.title: A Rare Breed
1-4.overview: William begins teaching at a university, and is invited to dinner at the home of the Viscount of Belfor. He and his brothers receive a tour of the viscount’s well-kept conservatory, but are taken aback by what they hear of the gardener and his wife.

1-5.title: The Dancers on the Bridge
1-5.overview: William learns that Lucian, one of his students at Durhnam University, hasn’t returned for three days. What’s more, the waitress Lucian had vowed to love throws herself from a bridge and dies. However, one of the university’s administrator assures William there’s nothing to worry about, but William disagrees and begins to investigate Lucian’s last movements.

1-6.title: The “Noahtic”, Act 1
1-6.overview: A commoner is chased down by a hunter and his dogs before being shot. The ocean liner Noahtic begins its maiden voyage and Count Blitz Enders, an openly arrogant noble, heavily criticizes that commoners are allowed aboard. Days previously, William shared his plan to slowly remake society by plunging London into an era of crime, all while committing murders designed to educate commoners in exactly how the nobility have been abusing them, starting with Blitz.

1-7.title: The “Noahtic”, Act 2
1-7.overview: Moriarty pretends to believe Blitz’s lie that he killed Thomas in self-defense and offers to cover up the crime.

1-8.title: A Study in “S”, Act 1
1-8.overview: Sherlock Holmes gets in trouble with his landlady Mrs. Hudson for not paying his rent. Holmes’ friend, Dr. Stamford, suggests Holmes get a flatmate and sends Dr. John Watson, whom Holmes deduces is a retired army doctor. Mrs. Hudson is impressed enough to allow Watson to become Holmes’ flatmate. Inspector Lestrade of Scotland Yard arrives and arrests Holmes for suspicion of murdering Count Drebber.

1-9.title: A Study in “S”, Act 2
1-9.overview: Sherlock and John, searching for the true criminal who killed Count Drebber, set a trap for the criminal using the wedding ring they found at the murder scene. Sherlock is able to deduce who the real killer is, who offers Sherlock a strange deal.

1-10.title: The Two Detectives, Act 1
1-10.overview: Sherlock is frustrated because he thinks there’s a mastermind behind the Noahtic and Drebber cases whose identity eludes him. Returning on a train after an unsatisfying investigation into another aristocrat’s death, he happens to meet William again.

1-11.title: The Two Detectives, Act 2
1-11.overview: With 48 minutes remaining before the train reaches the next station, Sherlock declares that William and he can find the murderer in time. Sherlock relies on the evidence at the scene, while William pursues a psychological profile of the killer.

1-12.title: A Scandal in the British Empire, Act 1
1-12.overview: Military Intelligence Service Director Mycroft orders Albert to recover classified papers that could rock the nation, and kill the woman who stole them. Sherlock is hired by the king of Bohemia to pursue Irene Adler, who threatens the king’s wedding plans.

1-13.title: A Scandal in the British Empire, Act 2
1-13.overview: Following William’s plan, Albert invites Irene to a masquerade, where a game with the famed “Lord of Crime” as its theme is being played. Dressed as a man, Irene uses the game to contact Albert, pleading for her safety in return for the stolen papers.

1-14.title: A Scandal in the British Empire, Act 3
1-14.overview: Despite Sherlock recognizing that Irene is dealing with the Lord of Crime, he sees her off. Irene negotiates with the Lord of Crime in an abandoned church, but before she can turn over the papers, Sherlock arrives, and makes a deal to keep Irene safe.

1-15.title: The Phantom of Whitechapel, Act 1
1-15.overview: Receiving a new name, Bonde joins the Moriarty ranks, and is sent to retrieve the contents of a safe deposit box with Moran, Louis, and Fred. But when an unexpected bank heist spurs the others into spontaneous action, Bonde is left wondering what to do.

1-16.title: The Phantom of Whitechapel, Act 2
1-16.overview: A series of murders is being carried out by someone claiming to be Jack the Ripper. In response, a vigilante group of the town's poor confronts Scotland Yard while William and the real Jack scramble to uncover the true culprit's aims and foil their plans.

1-17.title: The Riot in New Scotland Yard
1-17.overview: A culprit is arrested in the Jack the Ripper case which was solved by the Moriartys. Suspecting a frame-up by Arterton, Lestrade asks Sherlock for help in finding evidence that would prove it. Meanwhile, Paterson works to sneak Bonde inside the station.

1-18.title: The Merchant of London
1-18.overview: William outshined the adults in knowledge and nerve while saving the orphanage where he was staying. Judicial records state that William lent a nobleman £600 in the spirit of a certain play. But when the contract is broken, William takes drastic measures.

1-19.title: The White Knight of London, Act 1
1-19.overview: Adam Whiteley, a young MP in the House of Commons working toward an equitable society, garners public support as a "White Knight." Milverton is hired by those opposed to Whiteley to oust him. William takes interest in Whiteley, and decides to test him.

1-20.title: The White Knight of London, Act 2
1-20.overview: Whiteley goes alone to deal with the House of Lords with the irrefutable proof obtained from Albert in hand, but finds Milverton, the king of blackmailers. Even as Whiteley negotiates with him, Milverton's devilish clutches close in on his dear brother.

1-21.title: The Sign of Mary
1-21.overview: John introduces Sherlock to Mary, his fiancée. A stunned Sherlock realizes that Mary has another concern. She produces six pearls, detailing their connection to her missing father. She asks Sherlock to look into the matter, but is holding something back.

1-22.title: The Two Criminals
1-22.overview: Milverton blackmails Mary, exploiting her dalliance in antigovernment activities as a student. Sherlock decides to sneak into Milverton's estate to steal his evidence, but even that act was anticipated. Sherlock finds that he is not the only trespasser.

1-23.title: The Final Problem, Act 1
1-23.overview: When William James Moriarty claims responsibility for being the Lord of Crime in all the papers, aristocratic condemnation and public anger falls upon the Moriartys. The final problem of the Moriarty Plan that William has concocted at long last begins.

1-24.title: The Final Problem, Act 2
1-24.overview: William aims to complete his plan with his death, as Albert and the others each carry out their roles. Meanwhile, Sherlock deduces William's true reason for having him vanquish the Lord of Crime. Overlooking London, the pair face each other one last time.
